import SingularClosure.CriticalSmoothParseval
import SingularClosure.CriticalSerrinTime
import SingularClosure.SmoothDatumSobolev
import SingularClosure.PeriodicFourierInjective
import QuasiFeffermanB.PhysicalH1Admission
import Mathlib.Topology.Algebra.InfiniteSum.ENNReal

/-!
Physical Fourier normalization for Weak_Fourierman_B.

The real-valued infinite sum is used only with an explicit summability theorem.
The extended nonnegative sum retains infinity and is the budget-facing quantity.
Frequency zero is included with zero weight; all three vector components occur.
This file proves spatial identities. It asserts no endpoint continuation.
Prepared for the user's external pinned Lean 4.33.0 workflow; not locally run.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false
open Set Filter MeasureTheory
open scoped BigOperators ContDiff ENNReal Topology

namespace MethbokeAddon.WeakFouriermanB
open SingularClosure
noncomputable section

def FourierEnstrophyTerm (c : FourierCoeff) (ki : FourierIndex) : ℝ :=
  (galerkinFreqSq ki.1 : ℝ) * Complex.normSq (c ki.1 ki.2)

def FourierEnstrophy (c : FourierCoeff) : ℝ :=
  ∑' ki : FourierIndex, FourierEnstrophyTerm c ki

def ExtendedFourierEnstrophy (c : FourierCoeff) : ℝ≥0∞ :=
  ∑' ki : FourierIndex, ENNReal.ofReal (FourierEnstrophyTerm c ki)

theorem fourierEnstrophyTerm_nonneg (c : FourierCoeff) (ki : FourierIndex) :
    0 ≤ FourierEnstrophyTerm c ki := by
  have hk : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (galerkinFreqSq ki.1 : ℝ) := by
    exact_mod_cast galerkinFreqSq_nonneg ki.1
  exact mul_nonneg hk (Complex.normSq_nonneg _)

theorem fourierEnstrophyTerm_zero_frequency (c : FourierCoeff) (i : Fin 3) :
    FourierEnstrophyTerm c (0, i) = 0 := by
  simp [FourierEnstrophyTerm, galerkinFreqSq]

theorem fourierEnstrophy_nonneg (c : FourierCoeff) :
    0 ≤ FourierEnstrophy c :=
  tsum_nonneg (fourierEnstrophyTerm_nonneg c)

theorem fourierEnstrophy_summable
    (c : FourierCoeff) (hzero : SpectralMeanZero c)
    (w : CriticalSobolev 2) (hw : criticalCoeff 2 w = c) :
    Summable (FourierEnstrophyTerm c) := by
  have hs : Summable (fun ki : FourierIndex =>
      laplacianFrequency ki.1 * Complex.normSq (c ki.1 ki.2)) := by
    simpa only [hw] using
      critical_H1_laplacian_summable w (by simpa only [hw] using hzero)
  have hscale : (2 * Real.pi) ^ 2 ≠ 0 :=
    pow_ne_zero _ (mul_ne_zero (by norm_num) Real.pi_ne_zero)
  have hscaled := hs.mul_left (((2 * Real.pi) ^ 2)⁻¹)
  apply hscaled.congr
  intro ki
  simp only [FourierEnstrophyTerm, laplacianFrequency, ← mul_assoc,
    inv_mul_cancel₀ hscale, one_mul]

theorem ofReal_fourierEnstrophy_eq_extended
    (c : FourierCoeff) (hc : Summable (FourierEnstrophyTerm c)) :
    ENNReal.ofReal (FourierEnstrophy c) = ExtendedFourierEnstrophy c := by
  exact ENNReal.ofReal_tsum_of_nonneg (fourierEnstrophyTerm_nonneg c) hc

theorem extendedFourierEnstrophy_ne_top
    (c : FourierCoeff) (hc : Summable (FourierEnstrophyTerm c)) :
    ExtendedFourierEnstrophy c ≠ ⊤ := by
  rw [← ofReal_fourierEnstrophy_eq_extended c hc]
  exact ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top

theorem fourierEnstrophy_eq_modes_components
    (c : FourierCoeff) (hc : Summable (FourierEnstrophyTerm c)) :
    FourierEnstrophy c = ∑' k : Frequency,
      ∑ i : Fin 3, (galerkinFreqSq k : ℝ) * Complex.normSq (c k i) := by
  simpa only [FourierEnstrophy, FourierEnstrophyTerm, tsum_fintype] using hc.tsum_prod

theorem criticalH1_norm_sq_eq_fourierEnstrophy
    (c : FourierCoeff) (hzero : SpectralMeanZero c)
    (w : CriticalSobolev 2) (hw : criticalCoeff 2 w = c) :
    ‖w‖ ^ 2 = (4 * Real.pi ^ 2) * FourierEnstrophy c := by
  calc
    ‖w‖ ^ 2 = ∑' ki : FourierIndex,
        laplacianFrequency ki.1 * Complex.normSq (c ki.1 ki.2) := by
      rw [criticalSobolev_norm_sq, hw]
      exact tsum_congr (fun ki => critical_weight_two_laplacian c hzero ki.1 ki.2)
    _ = (2 * Real.pi) ^ 2 * FourierEnstrophy c := by
      simp only [laplacianFrequency, FourierEnstrophy, FourierEnstrophyTerm, mul_assoc]
      exact tsum_mul_left
    _ = (4 * Real.pi ^ 2) * FourierEnstrophy c := by ring

theorem smoothSynthesis_dissipation_eq_fourierEnstrophy
    (c : FourierCoeff)
    (hc : ∀ i : Fin 3, RapidScalarFourier (fun k => c k i))
    (hreal : SpectralReality c) (hzero : SpectralMeanZero c)
    (w : CriticalSobolev 2) (hw : criticalCoeff 2 w = c) :
    physicalDissipation (smoothFourierSynthesis c) =
      (4 * Real.pi ^ 2) * FourierEnstrophy c := by
  rw [critical_smoothFourierSynthesis_dissipation_eq_norm_sq c hc hreal hzero w hw]
  exact criticalH1_norm_sq_eq_fourierEnstrophy c hzero w hw

theorem physicalH1_of_smooth_periodic
    (v : Field) (hv : ContDiff ℝ ∞ v) (hp : SpatialPeriodic v) :
    CriticalPhysicalH1 v (fderiv ℝ v) :=
  critical_smooth_physicalH1 v hv hp

theorem smoothFourierSynthesis_datum_eq
    (v : Field) (hv : ContDiff ℝ ∞ v) (hp : SpatialPeriodic v) :
    smoothFourierSynthesis (datumFourierCoeff v) = v := by
  have hr := ALL_SOBOLEV_IMP_RAPID_SCALAR (datumFourierCoeff v)
    (fun s => SMOOTH_DATUM_MEM_TORUS_SOBOLEV s v hv hp)
  exact datumFourierCoeff_injective_continuous_periodic _ _
    (smoothFourierSynthesis_contDiff _ hr).continuous hv.continuous
    (smoothFourierSynthesis_periodic _) hp
    (datumFourierCoeff_smoothFourierSynthesis _ hr (datumFourierCoeff_reality v))

theorem smoothSigmaZero_fourierEnstrophy_summable
    (v : Field) (hv : SmoothSigmaZero v) :
    Summable (FourierEnstrophyTerm (datumFourierCoeff v)) := by
  have hH1 := physicalH1_of_smooth_periodic v hv.smooth hv.periodic
  have hz := smoothSigmaZero_fourier_meanZero hv
  exact fourierEnstrophy_summable (datumFourierCoeff v) hz
    (QuasiFeffermanB.physicalH1SobolevDatum hH1 hz)
    (QuasiFeffermanB.physicalH1SobolevDatum_coeff hH1 hz)

theorem smoothSigmaZero_dissipation_eq_fourierEnstrophy
    (v : Field) (hv : SmoothSigmaZero v) :
    physicalDissipation v =
      (4 * Real.pi ^ 2) * FourierEnstrophy (datumFourierCoeff v) := by
  have hH1 := physicalH1_of_smooth_periodic v hv.smooth hv.periodic
  have hz := smoothSigmaZero_fourier_meanZero hv
  have hr := ALL_SOBOLEV_IMP_RAPID_SCALAR (datumFourierCoeff v)
    (fun s => SMOOTH_DATUM_MEM_TORUS_SOBOLEV s v hv.smooth hv.periodic)
  have h := smoothSynthesis_dissipation_eq_fourierEnstrophy (datumFourierCoeff v)
    hr (datumFourierCoeff_reality v) hz
    (QuasiFeffermanB.physicalH1SobolevDatum hH1 hz)
    (QuasiFeffermanB.physicalH1SobolevDatum_coeff hH1 hz)
  simpa only [smoothFourierSynthesis_datum_eq v hv.smooth hv.periodic] using h

end
end MethbokeAddon.WeakFouriermanB

import MethbokeAddon.WeakFouriermanB.PhysicalFourier
import SingularClosure.CriticalSerrinTime
import Mathlib.MeasureTheory.Integral.Lebesgue.Add

/-!
The physical pre-continuation part of `Weak_Fourierman_B`.

The full Fourier sum is extended-nonnegative, so a divergent series cannot
silently acquire the default real `tsum` value zero. The time budget is a
`lintegral < infinity` assertion over the whole open front. No globally regular
solution wrapper, maximal-endpoint continuation theorem or gluing theorem is
assumed in the lemmas below. The result is the actual spatial L6 norm in time L4.

Prepared for external Lean 4.33.0 verification. No local compiler execution.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

open Set MeasureTheory Filter SingularClosure
open scoped BigOperators ENNReal ContDiff

namespace MethbokeAddon.WeakFouriermanB
noncomputable section

/-- Squared full-mode time budget through the entire open front. -/
def FourierBudgetFinite (c : ℝ → FourierCoeff) (T : ℝ) : Prop :=
  (∫⁻ t in Ioo (0 : ℝ) T, ExtendedFourierEnstrophy (c t) ^ 2) < (⊤ : ℝ≥0∞)

/-- The pointwise physical Parseval identity transfers an extended Fourier
budget to integrability of the square of actual physical dissipation. -/
theorem dissipation_square_integrable_of_fourier_budget
    (μ : Measure ℝ) (u : ℝ → Field) (c : ℝ → FourierCoeff)
    (hD : AEStronglyMeasurable (fun t => physicalDissipation (u t)) μ)
    (hParseval : ∀ᵐ t ∂μ,
      physicalDissipation (u t) = (4 * Real.pi ^ 2) * FourierEnstrophy (c t))
    (hExtended : ∀ᵐ t ∂μ,
      ENNReal.ofReal (FourierEnstrophy (c t)) = ExtendedFourierEnstrophy (c t))
    (hbudget : (∫⁻ t, ExtendedFourierEnstrophy (c t) ^ 2 ∂μ) < (⊤ : ℝ≥0∞)) :
    Integrable (fun t => physicalDissipation (u t) ^ 2) μ := by
  have heq :
      (∫⁻ t, ENNReal.ofReal (physicalDissipation (u t) ^ 2) ∂μ) =
        ENNReal.ofReal ((4 * Real.pi ^ 2) ^ 2) *
          (∫⁻ t, ExtendedFourierEnstrophy (c t) ^ 2 ∂μ) := by
    calc
      _ = ∫⁻ t, ENNReal.ofReal ((4 * Real.pi ^ 2) ^ 2) *
          ExtendedFourierEnstrophy (c t) ^ 2 ∂μ := by
        apply lintegral_congr_ae
        filter_upwards [hParseval, hExtended] with t hp he
        rw [hp, mul_pow, ENNReal.ofReal_mul (sq_nonneg _),
          ENNReal.ofReal_pow (fourierEnstrophy_nonneg (c t)) 2, he]
      _ = _ := lintegral_const_mul' _ _ ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top
  apply (lintegral_ofReal_ne_top_iff_integrable (hD.pow 2)
    (Eventually.of_forall fun t => sq_nonneg (physicalDissipation (u t)))).mp
  change (∫⁻ t, ENNReal.ofReal (physicalDissipation (u t) ^ 2) ∂μ) ≠
    (⊤ : ℝ≥0∞)
  rw [heq]
  exact (ENNReal.mul_lt_top ENNReal.ofReal_lt_top hbudget).ne

/-- Local physical Sobolev-to-Serrin integration for arbitrary time slices.
The proof uses the cached spatial theorem, with no global-flow hypothesis. -/
theorem local_serrin_of_energy_and_dissipation
    (μ : Measure ℝ) (u : ℝ → Field)
    (hregular : ∀ᵐ t ∂μ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (u t) ∧ SpatialPeriodic (u t))
    (hmeas : AEStronglyMeasurable (fun t => criticalSpatialNorm 6 (u t)) μ)
    (hD : Integrable (fun t => physicalDissipation (u t) ^ 2) μ)
    (hE : Integrable (fun t => physicalEnergy (u t) ^ 2) μ) :
    MemLp (fun t => criticalSpatialNorm 6 (u t)) 4 μ := by
  obtain ⟨K, hK, hbound⟩ := CRITICAL_SMOOTH_L6_FOURTH_BOUND
  have hdom : Integrable (fun t => K *
      (9 * physicalDissipation (u t) ^ 2 + physicalEnergy (u t) ^ 2)) μ :=
    ((hD.const_mul 9).add hE).const_mul K
  have hfour : Integrable (fun t => criticalSpatialNorm 6 (u t) ^ 4) μ := by
    apply hdom.mono' (hmeas.pow 4)
    filter_upwards [hregular] with t ht
    change ‖criticalSpatialNorm 6 (u t) ^ 4‖ ≤
      K * (9 * physicalDissipation (u t) ^ 2 + physicalEnergy (u t) ^ 2)
    rw [Real.norm_of_nonneg (pow_nonneg (criticalSpatialNorm_nonneg 6 _) 4)]
    exact hbound (u t) ht.1 ht.2
  apply (integrable_norm_rpow_iff hmeas
    (by norm_num : (4 : ℝ≥0∞) ≠ 0)
    (by norm_num : (4 : ℝ≥0∞) ≠ (⊤ : ℝ≥0∞))).mp
  have hnorm (t : ℝ) : ‖criticalSpatialNorm 6 (u t)‖ = criticalSpatialNorm 6 (u t) :=
    Real.norm_of_nonneg (criticalSpatialNorm_nonneg 6 _)
  have hpow (x : ℝ) : x ^ (4 : ℝ) = x ^ (4 : ℕ) := Real.rpow_ofNat x 4
  simpa only [ENNReal.toReal_ofNat, hnorm, hpow] using hfour

/-- A bounded actual kinetic energy has integrable square on a finite measure. -/
theorem physical_energy_square_integrable_of_bound
    (μ : Measure ℝ) [IsFiniteMeasure μ] (u : ℝ → Field) (E0 : ℝ)
    (hmeas : AEStronglyMeasurable (fun t => physicalEnergy (u t)) μ)
    (hbound : ∀ᵐ t ∂μ, physicalEnergy (u t) ≤ E0) :
    Integrable (fun t => physicalEnergy (u t) ^ 2) μ := by
  apply (integrable_const (E0 ^ 2) : Integrable (fun _ : ℝ => E0 ^ 2) μ).mono'
    (hmeas.pow 2)
  filter_upwards [hbound] with t ht
  change ‖physicalEnergy (u t) ^ 2‖ ≤ E0 ^ 2
  rw [Real.norm_of_nonneg (sq_nonneg _)]
  have hE0 : 0 ≤ physicalEnergy (u t) := by
    rw [physicalEnergy_eq_integral_norm_sq]
    exact integral_nonneg (fun x => sq_nonneg _)
  exact pow_le_pow_left₀ hE0 ht 2

/-- The complete local, pre-continuation implication: the full Fourier budget
gives the physical Serrin (4,6) norm on the SAME open front. The Parseval and
extended-sum hypotheses must describe the coefficients of these exact slices. -/
theorem local_serrin_of_fourier_budget
    (u : ℝ → Field) (c : ℝ → FourierCoeff) (T E0 : ℝ)
    (hregular : ∀ t ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) T, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (u t) ∧ SpatialPeriodic (u t))
    (hL6meas : AEStronglyMeasurable (fun t => criticalSpatialNorm 6 (u t))
      (volume.restrict (Ioo (0 : ℝ) T)))
    (hDmeas : AEStronglyMeasurable (fun t => physicalDissipation (u t))
      (volume.restrict (Ioo (0 : ℝ) T)))
    (hEmeas : AEStronglyMeasurable (fun t => physicalEnergy (u t))
      (volume.restrict (Ioo (0 : ℝ) T)))
    (hEnergy : ∀ t ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) T, physicalEnergy (u t) ≤ E0)
    (hParseval : ∀ t ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) T,
      physicalDissipation (u t) = (4 * Real.pi ^ 2) * FourierEnstrophy (c t))
    (hExtended : ∀ t ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) T,
      ENNReal.ofReal (FourierEnstrophy (c t)) = ExtendedFourierEnstrophy (c t))
    (hbudget : FourierBudgetFinite c T) :
    MemLp (fun t => criticalSpatialNorm 6 (u t)) 4
      (volume.restrict (Ioo (0 : ℝ) T)) := by
  have hmem : ∀ᵐ t ∂(volume.restrict (Ioo (0 : ℝ) T)), t ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) T :=
    ae_restrict_mem measurableSet_Ioo
  have hD := dissipation_square_integrable_of_fourier_budget
    (volume.restrict (Ioo (0 : ℝ) T)) u c hDmeas
    (hmem.mono fun t ht => hParseval t ht)
    (hmem.mono fun t ht => hExtended t ht) hbudget
  have hE := physical_energy_square_integrable_of_bound
    (volume.restrict (Ioo (0 : ℝ) T)) u E0 hEmeas
    (hmem.mono fun t ht => hEnergy t ht)
  exact local_serrin_of_energy_and_dissipation
    (volume.restrict (Ioo (0 : ℝ) T)) u
    (hmem.mono fun t ht => hregular t ht) hL6meas hD hE

/-- Actual physical coefficients of the same smooth slices supply both Parseval
and the full-series bridge. This is the physical Fourier-to-Serrin endpoint. -/
theorem physical_fourier_budget_to_serrin
    (u : ℝ → Field) (T E0 : ℝ)
    (hslices : ∀ t ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) T, SmoothSigmaZero (u t))
    (hL6meas : AEStronglyMeasurable (fun t => criticalSpatialNorm 6 (u t))
      (volume.restrict (Ioo (0 : ℝ) T)))
    (hDmeas : AEStronglyMeasurable (fun t => physicalDissipation (u t))
      (volume.restrict (Ioo (0 : ℝ) T)))
    (hEmeas : AEStronglyMeasurable (fun t => physicalEnergy (u t))
      (volume.restrict (Ioo (0 : ℝ) T)))
    (hEnergy : ∀ t ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) T, physicalEnergy (u t) ≤ E0)
    (hbudget : FourierBudgetFinite (fun t => datumFourierCoeff (u t)) T) :
    MemLp (fun t => criticalSpatialNorm 6 (u t)) 4
      (volume.restrict (Ioo (0 : ℝ) T)) := by
  apply local_serrin_of_fourier_budget u (fun t => datumFourierCoeff (u t)) T E0
    (fun t ht => ⟨(hslices t ht).smooth, (hslices t ht).periodic⟩)
    hL6meas hDmeas hEmeas hEnergy
  · intro t ht
    exact smoothSigmaZero_dissipation_eq_fourierEnstrophy (u t) (hslices t ht)
  · intro t ht
    exact ofReal_fourierEnstrophy_eq_extended (datumFourierCoeff (u t))
      (smoothSigmaZero_fourierEnstrophy_summable (u t) (hslices t ht))
  · exact hbudget

end
end MethbokeAddon.WeakFouriermanB

/-!
Local finite-front adapter for Weak_Fourierman_B.

Merged in dependency order from LocalMeasurability, LocalEnergy,
InitialEnergyTrace and LocalFrontAdapter. Proof bodies and local sections
are preserved. The completed regularity root still requires physical
endpoint continuation and same-trajectory gluing.
Prepared for external verification; no local Lean execution.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false


/-!
Local finite-front norm measurability for Weak_Fourierman_B.
All smoothness hypotheses concern only the open cylinder 0<t<T.
No positive-time-global flow wrapper or continuation hypothesis is used.
Prepared by static source inspection only; external Lean checking is pending.
-/


open Set Filter MeasureTheory
open scoped BigOperators ContDiff ENNReal Topology

namespace MethbokeAddon.WeakFouriermanB
open SingularClosure
noncomputable section

def localFrontSpacetime (T : ℝ) : Set (ℝ × Vec) :=
  {z | z.1 ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) T}

theorem localFrontSpacetime_isOpen (T : ℝ) : IsOpen (localFrontSpacetime T) :=
  isOpen_Ioo.preimage continuous_fst

/-- Joint smoothness on a finite open cylinder gives every spatial slice. -/
theorem local_spatial_slice_contDiff
    (u : Velocity) (T : ℝ)
    (hu : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ × Vec => u z.1 z.2) (localFrontSpacetime T))
    (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) T) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (u t) := by
  apply contDiff_iff_contDiffAt.mpr
  intro x
  have hj := hu.contDiffAt ((localFrontSpacetime_isOpen T).mem_nhds
    (show (t, x) ∈ localFrontSpacetime T from ht))
  simpa only [Function.comp_def] using
    hj.comp x (contDiff_prodMk_right t).contDiffAt

/-- The actual spatial coordinate derivative is a direction of the actual
joint Frechet derivative, at a point of the finite cylinder. -/
theorem local_coordinateDerivative_eq_joint
    (u : Velocity) (T : ℝ)
    (hu : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ × Vec => u z.1 z.2) (localFrontSpacetime T))
    (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) T) (x : Vec) (j : Fin 3) :
    coordinateDerivative (u t) j x =
      fderiv ℝ (fun z : ℝ × Vec => u z.1 z.2) (t, x) (0, unitVector j) := by
  have hj : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z : ℝ × Vec => u z.1 z.2) (t, x) :=
    (hu.contDiffAt ((localFrontSpacetime_isOpen T).mem_nhds
      (show (t, x) ∈ localFrontSpacetime T from ht))).differentiableAt (by simp)
  have hcomp : HasFDerivAt (u t)
      ((fderiv ℝ (fun z : ℝ × Vec => u z.1 z.2) (t, x)).comp
        (ContinuousLinearMap.inr ℝ ℝ Vec)) x := by
    simpa only [Function.comp_def] using
      hj.hasFDerivAt.comp x (hasFDerivAt_prodMk_right t x)
  rw [coordinateDerivative, hcomp.fderiv]
  rfl

theorem local_coordinateDerivative_continuousOn
    (u : Velocity) (T : ℝ)
    (hu : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ × Vec => u z.1 z.2) (localFrontSpacetime T))
    (j : Fin 3) :
    ContinuousOn (fun z : ℝ × Vec => coordinateDerivative (u z.1) j z.2)
      (localFrontSpacetime T) := by
  have hfd : ContinuousOn (fderiv ℝ (fun z : ℝ × Vec => u z.1 z.2))
      (localFrontSpacetime T) :=
    hu.continuousOn_fderiv_of_isOpen (localFrontSpacetime_isOpen T) (by simp)
  have happ : ContinuousOn
      (fun z : ℝ × Vec => fderiv ℝ (fun q : ℝ × Vec => u q.1 q.2) z (0, unitVector j))
      (localFrontSpacetime T) := hfd.clm_apply continuousOn_const
  apply happ.congr
  intro z hz
  exact local_coordinateDerivative_eq_joint u T hu z.1 hz z.2 j

/-- A zero extension is only a measurability device; no PDE extension is made. -/
theorem local_spatialNorm_aestronglyMeasurable
    (u : Velocity) (T : ℝ)
    (hu : ContinuousOn (fun z : ℝ × Vec => u z.1 z.2) (localFrontSpacetime T))
    (p : ℝ≥0∞) (hp0 : p ≠ 0) (hpTop : p ≠ (⊤ : ℝ≥0∞)) :
    AEStronglyMeasurable (fun t => criticalSpatialNorm p (u t))
      (volume.restrict (Ioo (0 : ℝ) T)) := by
  classical
  let F : ℝ × Vec → Vec :=
    (localFrontSpacetime T).piecewise (fun z => u z.1 z.2) (fun _ => 0)
  have hopen : MeasurableSet (localFrontSpacetime T) :=
    (localFrontSpacetime_isOpen T).measurableSet
  have hF : Measurable F :=
    hu.measurable_piecewise continuousOn_const hopen
  have hnorm : Measurable (fun t => criticalSpatialNorm p (fun x => F (t, x))) := by
    simp_rw [criticalSpatialNorm, eLpNorm_eq_lintegral_rpow_enorm_toReal hp0 hpTop]
    exact (((hF.enorm.pow_const p.toReal).lintegral_prod_right').pow_const
      (1 / p.toReal)).ennreal_toReal
  apply hnorm.aestronglyMeasurable.congr
  filter_upwards [ae_restrict_mem measurableSet_Ioo] with t ht
  apply congrArg (criticalSpatialNorm p)
  funext x
  change (localFrontSpacetime T).piecewise (fun z => u z.1 z.2)
    (fun _ => 0) (t, x) = u t x
  exact (localFrontSpacetime T).piecewise_eq_of_mem _ _
    (show (t, x) ∈ localFrontSpacetime T from ht)

theorem local_spatialNorm_six_aestronglyMeasurable
    (u : Velocity) (T : ℝ)
    (hu : ContinuousOn (fun z : ℝ × Vec => u z.1 z.2) (localFrontSpacetime T)) :
    AEStronglyMeasurable (fun t => criticalSpatialNorm 6 (u t))
      (volume.restrict (Ioo (0 : ℝ) T)) :=
  local_spatialNorm_aestronglyMeasurable u T hu 6 (by norm_num) (by norm_num)

/-- Actual kinetic energy is measurable from local joint continuity alone. -/
theorem local_physicalEnergy_aestronglyMeasurable
    (u : Velocity) (T : ℝ)
    (hu : ContinuousOn (fun z : ℝ × Vec => u z.1 z.2) (localFrontSpacetime T)) :
    AEStronglyMeasurable (fun t => physicalEnergy (u t))
      (volume.restrict (Ioo (0 : ℝ) T)) := by
  have hnorm := local_spatialNorm_aestronglyMeasurable u T hu 2
    (by norm_num) (by norm_num)
  apply (hnorm.pow 2).congr
  filter_upwards [ae_restrict_mem measurableSet_Ioo] with t ht
  change criticalSpatialNorm 2 (u t) ^ 2 = physicalEnergy (u t)
  have hc : Continuous (u t) :=
    hu.comp_continuous (continuous_const.prodMk continuous_id) (fun _ => ht)
  exact critical_velocity_L2_toReal_sq_eq_physicalEnergy (u t)
    (critical_continuous_memLp_cube (u t) hc 2)

/-- The actual dissipation is a finite sum of the energies of coordinate
derivatives. Continuity supplies all integrability needed to exchange the sum. -/
theorem physicalDissipation_eq_sum_coordinateEnergy
    (v : Field) (hv : ContDiff ℝ ∞ v) :
    physicalDissipation v = ∑ j : Fin 3, physicalEnergy (coordinateDerivative v j) := by
  have hc (j : Fin 3) : Continuous (coordinateDerivative v j) := by
    change Continuous (fun x => fderiv ℝ v x (unitVector j))
    exact (hv.continuous_fderiv (by simp)).clm_apply continuous_const
  have hI (j : Fin 3) : IntegrableOn
      (fun x => ‖coordinateDerivative v j x‖ ^ 2) unitCube volume :=
    ((hc j).norm.pow 2).continuousOn.integrableOn_compact isCompact_unitCube
  unfold physicalDissipation
  simp_rw [gradientSquareDensity_eq_sum_norm_sq]
  rw [integral_finsetSum Finset.univ (fun j _ => hI j)]
  simp only [physicalEnergy_eq_integral_norm_sq]

/-- Local joint smoothness makes the actual physical dissipation measurable. -/
theorem local_physicalDissipation_aestronglyMeasurable
    (u : Velocity) (T : ℝ)
    (hu : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ × Vec => u z.1 z.2) (localFrontSpacetime T)) :
    AEStronglyMeasurable (fun t => physicalDissipation (u t))
      (volume.restrict (Ioo (0 : ℝ) T)) := by
  have henergy (j : Fin 3) :
      AEStronglyMeasurable (fun t => physicalEnergy (coordinateDerivative (u t) j))
        (volume.restrict (Ioo (0 : ℝ) T)) :=
    local_physicalEnergy_aestronglyMeasurable
      (fun t => coordinateDerivative (u t) j) T
      (local_coordinateDerivative_continuousOn u T hu j)
  have hsum012 : AEStronglyMeasurable
      (fun t =>
        (physicalEnergy (coordinateDerivative (u t) 0) +
          physicalEnergy (coordinateDerivative (u t) 1)) +
          physicalEnergy (coordinateDerivative (u t) 2))
      (volume.restrict (Ioo (0 : ℝ) T)) :=
    ((henergy 0).add (henergy 1)).add (henergy 2)
  have hsum : AEStronglyMeasurable
      (fun t => ∑ j : Fin 3, physicalEnergy (coordinateDerivative (u t) j))
      (volume.restrict (Ioo (0 : ℝ) T)) := by
    simpa only [Fin.sum_univ_three] using hsum012
  apply hsum.congr
  filter_upwards [ae_restrict_mem measurableSet_Ioo] with t ht
  exact (physicalDissipation_eq_sum_coordinateEnergy (u t)
    (local_spatial_slice_contDiff u T hu t ht)).symm

end
end MethbokeAddon.WeakFouriermanB

/-!
Finite-front physical NSE energy, localized from the pinned smooth-energy
proof. No globally defined solution predicate or assumed energy inequality is
used. All PDE hypotheses are required only for 0<t<T. The initial energy is
supplied by an actual right-hand trace; the final upper bound is derived.

Prepared source only. No local Lean/Lake/kernel execution.
-/


open Set Filter MeasureTheory Metric SingularClosure
open scoped ContDiff Interval Topology

namespace MethbokeAddon.WeakFouriermanB
noncomputable section

private theorem local_energy_mem_of_half_ball {T t r : ℝ}
    (ht : t ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) T)
    (hr : r ∈ closedBall t (min t (T - t) / 2)) :
    r ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) T := by
  have hh : |r - t| ≤ min t (T - t) / 2 := by
    simpa only [Metric.mem_closedBall, Real.dist_eq] using hr
  have hleft := min_le_left t (T - t)
  have hright := min_le_right t (T - t)
  have hl := (abs_le.mp hh).1
  have hu := (abs_le.mp hh).2
  constructor <;> linarith [ht.1, ht.2]

/-- Dominated differentiation is confined to a compact neighborhood strictly
inside the finite front, rather than all positive times. -/
theorem local_hasDerivAt_real_cube_integral
    (T : ℝ) (F D : ℝ → Vec → ℝ)
    (hF : ContinuousOn (fun z : ℝ × Vec => F z.1 z.2) (localFrontSpacetime T))
    (hD : ContinuousOn (fun z : ℝ × Vec => D z.1 z.2) (localFrontSpacetime T))
    (hd : ∀ t ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) T, ∀ x : Vec,
      HasDerivAt (fun r => F r x) (D t x) t)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) T) :
    HasDerivAt (fun r => ∫ x in unitCube, F r x)
      (∫ x in unitCube, D t x) t := by
  let ρ : ℝ := min t (T - t) / 2
  have hρ : 0 < ρ := div_pos (lt_min ht.1 (sub_pos.mpr ht.2)) (by norm_num)
  have hFc (r : ℝ) (hr : r ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) T) : Continuous (F r) :=
    hF.comp_continuous (continuous_const.prodMk continuous_id) (fun _ => hr)
  have hDc (r : ℝ) (hr : r ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) T) : Continuous (D r) :=
    hD.comp_continuous (continuous_const.prodMk continuous_id) (fun _ => hr)
  have hsubset : closedBall t ρ ×ˢ unitCube ⊆ localFrontSpacetime T := by
    intro z hz
    exact local_energy_mem_of_half_ball ht hz.1
  obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ :=
    ((isCompact_closedBall t ρ).prod isCompact_unitCube).exists_bound_of_continuousOn
      (hD.mono hsubset)
  have hbound : ∀ᵐ x ∂volume.restrict unitCube,
      ∀ r ∈ closedBall t ρ, ‖D r x‖ ≤ C := by
    filter_upwards [ae_restrict_mem isCompact_unitCube.measurableSet] with x hx
    intro r hr
    exact hC (r, x) ⟨hr, hx⟩
  have hdiff : ∀ᵐ x ∂volume.restrict unitCube,
      ∀ r ∈ closedBall t ρ, HasDerivAt (fun q => F q x) (D r x) r :=
    Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun x r hr => hd r (local_energy_mem_of_half_ball ht hr) x
  have hmeas : ∀ᶠ r in 𝓝 t, AEStronglyMeasurable (F r) (volume.restrict unitCube) := by
    filter_upwards [Ioo_mem_nhds ht.1 ht.2] with r hr
    exact (hFc r hr).aestronglyMeasurable
  exact (hasDerivAt_integral_of_dominated_loc_of_deriv_le
    (μ := volume.restrict unitCube) (F := F) (F' := D)
    (bound := fun _ : Vec => C) (closedBall_mem_nhds t hρ) hmeas
    ((hFc t ht).continuousOn.integrableOn_compact isCompact_unitCube)
    (hDc t ht).aestronglyMeasurable hbound
    (continuous_const.continuousOn.integrableOn_compact isCompact_unitCube) hdiff).2

theorem local_real_cube_integral_continuousOn_Icc
    (T : ℝ) (F : ℝ → Vec → ℝ)
    (hF : ContinuousOn (fun z : ℝ × Vec => F z.1 z.2) (localFrontSpacetime T))
    (s t : ℝ) (hs : 0 < s) (ht : t < T) :
    ContinuousOn (fun r => ∫ x in unitCube, F r x) (Icc s t) := by
  have hsubset : Icc s t ×ˢ unitCube ⊆ localFrontSpacetime T := by
    intro z hz
    exact ⟨hs.trans_le hz.1.1, hz.1.2.trans_lt ht⟩
  obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ :=
    ((isCompact_Icc : IsCompact (Icc s t)).prod isCompact_unitCube).exists_bound_of_continuousOn
      (hF.mono hsubset)
  apply continuousOn_of_dominated (μ := volume.restrict unitCube) (bound := fun _ : Vec => C)
  · intro r hr
    have hc : Continuous (F r) :=
      hF.comp_continuous (continuous_const.prodMk continuous_id)
        (fun _ => ⟨hs.trans_le hr.1, hr.2.trans_lt ht⟩)
    exact hc.aestronglyMeasurable
  · intro r hr
    filter_upwards [ae_restrict_mem isCompact_unitCube.measurableSet] with x hx
    exact hC (r, x) ⟨hr, hx⟩
  · exact continuous_const.continuousOn.integrableOn_compact isCompact_unitCube
  · filter_upwards with x
    exact hF.comp (continuous_id.prodMk continuous_const).continuousOn
      (fun r hr => ⟨hs.trans_le hr.1, hr.2.trans_lt ht⟩)

theorem local_timeDerivative_eq_joint
    (u : Velocity) (T : ℝ)
    (hu : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ × Vec => u z.1 z.2) (localFrontSpacetime T))
    (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) T) (x : Vec) :
    timeDerivative u t x =
      fderiv ℝ (fun z : ℝ × Vec => u z.1 z.2) (t, x) (1, 0) := by
  have hj : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z : ℝ × Vec => u z.1 z.2) (t, x) :=
    (hu.contDiffAt ((localFrontSpacetime_isOpen T).mem_nhds
      (show (t, x) ∈ localFrontSpacetime T from ht))).differentiableAt (by simp)
  have hpath : HasDerivAt (fun r : ℝ => (r, x)) (1, 0) t :=
    (hasDerivAt_id t).prodMk (hasDerivAt_const t x)
  have h : HasDerivAt (fun r => u r x)
      (fderiv ℝ (fun z : ℝ × Vec => u z.1 z.2) (t, x) (1, 0)) t := by
    simpa only [Function.comp_def] using hj.hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt t hpath
  change derivWithin (fun r => u r x) (Ici (0 : ℝ)) t = _
  rw [derivWithin_of_mem_nhds (Ici_mem_nhds ht.1), h.deriv]

theorem local_time_hasDerivAt
    (u : Velocity) (T : ℝ)
    (hu : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ × Vec => u z.1 z.2) (localFrontSpacetime T))
    (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) T) (x : Vec) :
    HasDerivAt (fun r => u r x) (timeDerivative u t x) t := by
  have hj : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z : ℝ × Vec => u z.1 z.2) (t, x) :=
    (hu.contDiffAt ((localFrontSpacetime_isOpen T).mem_nhds
      (show (t, x) ∈ localFrontSpacetime T from ht))).differentiableAt (by simp)
  have hpath : HasDerivAt (fun r : ℝ => (r, x)) (1, 0) t :=
    (hasDerivAt_id t).prodMk (hasDerivAt_const t x)
  rw [local_timeDerivative_eq_joint u T hu t ht x]
  simpa only [Function.comp_def] using hj.hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt t hpath

theorem local_timeDerivative_continuousOn
    (u : Velocity) (T : ℝ)
    (hu : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ × Vec => u z.1 z.2) (localFrontSpacetime T)) :
    ContinuousOn (fun z : ℝ × Vec => timeDerivative u z.1 z.2) (localFrontSpacetime T) := by
  have hfd : ContinuousOn (fderiv ℝ (fun z : ℝ × Vec => u z.1 z.2)) (localFrontSpacetime T) :=
    hu.continuousOn_fderiv_of_isOpen (localFrontSpacetime_isOpen T) (by simp)
  have happ : ContinuousOn
      (fun z : ℝ × Vec => fderiv ℝ (fun q : ℝ × Vec => u q.1 q.2) z (1, 0))
      (localFrontSpacetime T) := hfd.clm_apply continuousOn_const
  apply happ.congr
  intro z hz
  exact local_timeDerivative_eq_joint u T hu z.1 hz z.2

theorem local_physicalEnergy_hasDerivAt
    (u : Velocity) (T : ℝ)
    (hu : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ × Vec => u z.1 z.2) (localFrontSpacetime T))
    (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) T) :
    HasDerivAt (fun r => physicalEnergy (u r))
      (2 * physicalFieldInner (u t) (timeDerivative u t)) t := by
  have hd := local_timeDerivative_continuousOn u T hu
  have h := local_hasDerivAt_real_cube_integral T
    (fun r x => ‖u r x‖ ^ 2) (fun r x => 2 * inner ℝ (u r x) (timeDerivative u r x))
    (hu.continuousOn.norm.pow 2) (continuousOn_const.mul (hu.continuousOn.inner hd))
    (fun r hr x => (local_time_hasDerivAt u T hu r hr x).norm_sq) t ht
  simpa only [physicalEnergy_eq_integral_norm_sq, physicalFieldInner, integral_const_mul] using h

section Classical

variable (ν T : ℝ) (u : Velocity) (p : Pressure)
variable (hu : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ × Vec => u z.1 z.2) (localFrontSpacetime T))
variable (hperiodic : ∀ r ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) T, SpatialPeriodic (u r))
variable (hsolenoidal : ∀ r ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) T, ∀ x : Vec, divergence (u r) x = 0)
variable (hp : ∀ r ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) T, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (p r))
variable (hpp : ∀ r ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) T, SpatialPeriodic (p r))
variable (hNSE : ∀ r ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) T, ∀ x : Vec,
  timeDerivative u r x + convection (u r) x + SingularClosure.gradient (p r) x =
    ν • laplacian (u r) x)

include hu hperiodic hsolenoidal hp hpp hNSE

/-- Actual physical NSE pairing at a finite-front time. -/
theorem local_smooth_energy_pairing (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) T) :
    physicalFieldInner (u t) (timeDerivative u t) = -ν * physicalDissipation (u t) := by
  have hus := local_spatial_slice_contDiff u T hu t ht
  have hud : Continuous (timeDerivative u t) :=
    (local_timeDerivative_continuousOn u T hu).comp_continuous
      (continuous_const.prodMk continuous_id) (fun _ => ht)
  have hconv : Continuous (convection (u t)) := convection_continuous hus
  have hgrad : Continuous (SingularClosure.gradient (p t)) := criticalWeak_gradient_continuous _ (hp t ht)
  have hI₁ := physicalFieldInner_integrable (u t) (timeDerivative u t) hus.continuous hud
  have hI₂ := physicalFieldInner_integrable (u t) (convection (u t)) hus.continuous hconv
  have hI₃ := physicalFieldInner_integrable (u t) (SingularClosure.gradient (p t)) hus.continuous hgrad
  have hI₁₂ : IntegrableOn (fun x =>
      inner ℝ (u t x) (timeDerivative u t x) + inner ℝ (u t x) (convection (u t) x))
      unitCube volume := hI₁.add hI₂
  have heq : timeDerivative u t + convection (u t) + SingularClosure.gradient (p t) = ν • laplacian (u t) :=
    funext (fun x => hNSE t ht x)
  have h := congrArg (physicalFieldInner (u t)) heq
  simp only [physicalFieldInner, Pi.add_apply, inner_add_right,
    Pi.smul_apply, inner_smul_right] at h
  rw [integral_add hI₁₂ hI₃, integral_add hI₁ hI₂, integral_const_mul] at h
  rw [critical_smooth_integral_inner_convection_eq_zero
      (u t) hus (hperiodic t ht) (hsolenoidal t ht),
    critical_smooth_integral_inner_gradient_eq_zero (u t) (p t) hus (hp t ht)
      (hperiodic t ht) (hpp t ht) (hsolenoidal t ht),
    critical_integral_inner_laplacian_self (u t) hus (hperiodic t ht)] at h
  change (∫ x in unitCube, inner ℝ (u t x) (timeDerivative u t x)) = _
  linarith

theorem local_nse_energy_hasDeriv (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) T) :
    HasDerivAt (fun r => physicalEnergy (u r))
      ((-2 * ν) * physicalDissipation (u t)) t := by
  have h := local_physicalEnergy_hasDerivAt u T hu t ht
  rw [local_smooth_energy_pairing ν T u p hu hperiodic hsolenoidal hp hpp hNSE t ht] at h
  convert h using 1 <;> ring

theorem local_nse_energy_identity (hν : 0 < ν)
    (s t : ℝ) (hs : 0 < s) (hst : s ≤ t) (ht : t < T) :
    IntervalIntegrable (fun r => physicalDissipation (u r)) volume s t ∧
      physicalEnergy (u t) + 2 * ν * (∫ r in s..t, physicalDissipation (u r)) =
        physicalEnergy (u s) := by
  have hP : ContinuousOn (fun r => physicalFieldInner (u r) (timeDerivative u r)) (Icc s t) :=
    local_real_cube_integral_continuousOn_Icc T
      (fun r x => inner ℝ (u r x) (timeDerivative u r x))
      (hu.continuousOn.inner (local_timeDerivative_continuousOn u T hu)) s t hs ht
  have hscaled : ContinuousOn
      (fun r => (-ν)⁻¹ * physicalFieldInner (u r) (timeDerivative u r)) (Icc s t) :=
    continuousOn_const.mul hP
  have hD : ContinuousOn (fun r => physicalDissipation (u r)) (Icc s t) := by
    apply hscaled.congr
    intro r hr
    change physicalDissipation (u r) =
      (-ν)⁻¹ * physicalFieldInner (u r) (timeDerivative u r)
    rw [local_smooth_energy_pairing ν T u p hu hperiodic hsolenoidal hp hpp hNSE r
      ⟨hs.trans_le hr.1, hr.2.trans_lt ht⟩]
    simp only [← mul_assoc, inv_mul_cancel₀ (neg_ne_zero.mpr hν.ne'), one_mul]
  have hE : ContinuousOn (fun r => physicalEnergy (u r)) (Icc s t) := by
    intro r hr
    exact (local_physicalEnergy_hasDerivAt u T hu r
      ⟨hs.trans_le hr.1, hr.2.trans_lt ht⟩).continuousAt.continuousWithinAt
  have hDI : IntervalIntegrable (fun r => physicalDissipation (u r)) volume s t :=
    hD.intervalIntegrable_of_Icc hst
  refine ⟨hDI, ?_⟩
  have hd : ∀ r ∈ Ioo s t, HasDerivAt (fun q => physicalEnergy (u q))
      ((-2 * ν) * physicalDissipation (u r)) r := by
    intro r hr
    exact local_nse_energy_hasDeriv ν T u p hu hperiodic hsolenoidal hp hpp hNSE r
      ⟨hs.trans hr.1, hr.2.trans ht⟩
  have hFTC := intervalIntegral.integral_eq_sub_of_hasDerivAt_of_le hst hE hd
    (hDI.const_mul (-2 * ν))
  rw [intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul] at hFTC
  linarith

theorem local_nse_energy_le_earlier (hν : 0 < ν)
    (s t : ℝ) (hs : 0 < s) (hst : s ≤ t) (ht : t < T) :
    physicalEnergy (u t) ≤ physicalEnergy (u s) := by
  obtain ⟨hDI, hidentity⟩ :=
    local_nse_energy_identity ν T u p hu hperiodic hsolenoidal hp hpp hNSE hν s t hs hst ht
  have hnonneg : 0 ≤ ∫ r in s..t, physicalDissipation (u r) := by
    apply intervalIntegral.integral_nonneg hst
    intro r hr
    exact integral_nonneg (gradientSquareDensity_nonneg (u r))
  have hterm : 0 ≤ 2 * ν * (∫ r in s..t, physicalDissipation (u r)) :=
    mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (by norm_num) hν.le) hnonneg
  linarith

/-- The energy upper bound is derived from local NSE and the right energy
trace. It is not stored as an assumed finite-front field. -/
theorem local_nse_energy_le_initial_trace (hν : 0 < ν) (E0 : ℝ)
    (htrace : Tendsto (fun r => physicalEnergy (u r)) (𝓝[>] (0 : ℝ)) (𝓝 E0))
    (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) T) :
    physicalEnergy (u t) ≤ E0 := by
  apply ge_of_tendsto htrace
  filter_upwards [Ioo_mem_nhdsGT ht.1] with s hs
  exact local_nse_energy_le_earlier ν T u p hu hperiodic hsolenoidal hp hpp hNSE
    hν s t hs.1 hs.2.le ht.2

end Classical
end
end MethbokeAddon.WeakFouriermanB

/-!
An actual strong physical L2 trace supplies the initial kinetic-energy trace.
The convergence is along an arbitrary filter; only eventual L2 membership is
needed. The final local theorem uses the same right-hand trace as the physical
Leray--Hopf interface, without assuming an energy bound or global solution.
Prepared for external verification only. No Lean execution was performed here.
-/


open Set Filter MeasureTheory SingularClosure
open scoped Topology ENNReal ContDiff

namespace MethbokeAddon.WeakFouriermanB
noncomputable section

/-- The literal physical kinetic energy is the squared norm of its L2 class. -/
theorem physicalEnergy_eq_L2Representative_norm_sq
    (v : Field) (hv : MemLp v 2 (volume.restrict unitCube)) :
    physicalEnergy v = ‖criticalL2Representative v‖ ^ 2 := by
  rw [criticalL2Representative_eq v hv, Lp.norm_toLp]
  exact (critical_velocity_L2_toReal_sq_eq_physicalEnergy v hv).symm

/-- Strong physical L2 convergence passes to actual equivalence classes.
Eventual membership avoids an artificial condition outside the local window. -/
theorem L2Representative_tendsto_of_strong_trace
    {ι : Type*} (l : Filter ι) (f : ι → Field) (a : Field)
    (hf : ∀ᶠ i in l, MemLp (f i) 2 (volume.restrict unitCube))
    (ha : MemLp a 2 (volume.restrict unitCube))
    (htrace : Tendsto
      (fun i => eLpNorm (f i - a) 2 (volume.restrict unitCube)) l (𝓝 0)) :
    Tendsto (fun i => criticalL2Representative (f i)) l
      (𝓝 (criticalL2Representative a)) := by
  apply tendsto_iff_dist_tendsto_zero.mpr
  have hr : Tendsto
      (fun i => (eLpNorm (f i - a) 2 (volume.restrict unitCube)).toReal)
      l (𝓝 (0 : ℝ)) := by
    simpa only [Function.comp_def, ENNReal.toReal_zero] using
      (ENNReal.tendsto_toReal
        (by simp : (0 : ℝ≥0∞) ≠ (⊤ : ℝ≥0∞))).comp htrace
  apply Filter.Tendsto.congr' _ hr
  filter_upwards [hf] with i hi
  rw [criticalL2Representative_eq (f i) hi, criticalL2Representative_eq a ha,
    dist_eq_norm, ← hi.toLp_sub ha, Lp.norm_toLp]

/-- The initial energy trace follows from genuine L2 convergence. -/
theorem physical_energy_tendsto_of_L2_trace
    {ι : Type*} (l : Filter ι) (f : ι → Field) (a : Field)
    (hf : ∀ᶠ i in l, MemLp (f i) 2 (volume.restrict unitCube))
    (ha : MemLp a 2 (volume.restrict unitCube))
    (htrace : Tendsto
      (fun i => eLpNorm (f i - a) 2 (volume.restrict unitCube)) l (𝓝 0)) :
    Tendsto (fun i => physicalEnergy (f i)) l (𝓝 (physicalEnergy a)) := by
  have hLp := L2Representative_tendsto_of_strong_trace l f a hf ha htrace
  have hsq : Tendsto (fun i => ‖criticalL2Representative (f i)‖ ^ 2) l
      (𝓝 (‖criticalL2Representative a‖ ^ 2)) := hLp.norm.pow 2
  rw [← physicalEnergy_eq_L2Representative_norm_sq a ha] at hsq
  apply Filter.Tendsto.congr' _ hsq
  filter_upwards [hf] with i hi
  exact (physicalEnergy_eq_L2Representative_norm_sq (f i) hi).symm

/-- Smooth slices on a finite open front plus the actual strong initial trace
give the energy trace needed by the localized NSE energy argument. -/
theorem local_physical_energy_trace_of_strong_L2_trace
    (u : Velocity) (a : Field) (T : ℝ) (hT : 0 < T)
    (ha : ContDiff ℝ ∞ a)
    (hu : ∀ t ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) T, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (u t))
    (htrace : Tendsto
      (fun t => eLpNorm (u t - a) 2 (volume.restrict unitCube))
      (𝓝[>] (0 : ℝ)) (𝓝 0)) :
    Tendsto (fun t => physicalEnergy (u t)) (𝓝[>] (0 : ℝ))
      (𝓝 (physicalEnergy a)) := by
  apply physical_energy_tendsto_of_L2_trace (𝓝[>] (0 : ℝ)) u a _
    (critical_continuous_memLp_cube a ha.continuous 2) htrace
  filter_upwards [Ioo_mem_nhdsGT hT] with t ht
  exact critical_continuous_memLp_cube (u t) (hu t ht).continuous 2

end
end MethbokeAddon.WeakFouriermanB

structure LocalPhysicalNSEFront (ν T : ℝ) (a : Field)
    (u : Velocity) (p : Pressure) : Prop where
  viscosity_pos : 0 < ν
  time_pos : 0 < T
  initial_smooth : SmoothSigmaZero a
  initial_value : u 0 = a
  velocity_smooth :
    ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ × Vec => u z.1 z.2) (localFrontSpacetime T)
  pressure_smooth :
    ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ × Vec => p z.1 z.2) (localFrontSpacetime T)
  velocity_periodic : ∀ t ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) T, SpatialPeriodic (u t)
  pressure_periodic : ∀ t ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) T, SpatialPeriodic (p t)
  divergence_free : ∀ t ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) T, ∀ x : Vec, divergence (u t) x = 0
  velocity_mean_zero : ∀ t ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) T, MeanZero (u t)
  pressure_mean_zero : ∀ t ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) T, PressureMeanZero (p t)
  equation : ∀ t ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) T, ∀ x : Vec,
    timeDerivative u t x + convection (u t) x + SingularClosure.gradient (p t) x =
      ν • laplacian (u t) x
  strong_initial_trace :
    Tendsto (fun t => eLpNorm (u t - a) 2 (volume.restrict unitCube))
      (𝓝[>] (0 : ℝ)) (𝓝 0)

theorem local_front_smooth_slices
    (ν T : ℝ) (a : Field) (u : Velocity) (p : Pressure)
    (H : LocalPhysicalNSEFront ν T a u p) (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) T) :
    SmoothSigmaZero (u t) := by
  exact ⟨local_spatial_slice_contDiff u T H.velocity_smooth t ht,
    H.velocity_periodic t ht, H.divergence_free t ht, H.velocity_mean_zero t ht⟩

theorem local_front_pressure_slice_smooth
    (ν T : ℝ) (a : Field) (u : Velocity) (p : Pressure)
    (H : LocalPhysicalNSEFront ν T a u p) (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) T) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (p t) := by
  apply contDiff_iff_contDiffAt.mpr
  intro x
  have hj := H.pressure_smooth.contDiffAt
    ((localFrontSpacetime_isOpen T).mem_nhds
      (show (t, x) ∈ localFrontSpacetime T from ht))
  simpa only [Function.comp_def] using
    hj.comp x (contDiff_prodMk_right t).contDiffAt

theorem local_front_initial_energy_trace
    (ν T : ℝ) (a : Field) (u : Velocity) (p : Pressure)
    (H : LocalPhysicalNSEFront ν T a u p) :
    Tendsto (fun t => physicalEnergy (u t)) (𝓝[>] (0 : ℝ))
      (𝓝 (physicalEnergy a)) := by
  exact local_physical_energy_trace_of_strong_L2_trace u a T H.time_pos
    H.initial_smooth.smooth
    (fun t ht => (local_front_smooth_slices ν T a u p H t ht).smooth)
    H.strong_initial_trace

theorem local_front_energy_bound
    (ν T : ℝ) (a : Field) (u : Velocity) (p : Pressure)
    (H : LocalPhysicalNSEFront ν T a u p) (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) T) :
    physicalEnergy (u t) ≤ physicalEnergy a := by
  exact local_nse_energy_le_initial_trace ν T u p H.velocity_smooth
    H.velocity_periodic H.divergence_free
    (fun r hr => local_front_pressure_slice_smooth ν T a u p H r hr)
    H.pressure_periodic H.equation H.viscosity_pos (physicalEnergy a)
    (local_front_initial_energy_trace ν T a u p H) t ht

/-- The current Fourier-to-Serrin bridge now consumes an actual local NSE
front and its initial L2 trace. Its auxiliary energy/measurability hypotheses
are derived here, not supplied as additional regularity assumptions. -/
theorem local_front_fourier_budget_to_serrin
    (ν T : ℝ) (a : Field) (u : Velocity) (p : Pressure)
    (H : LocalPhysicalNSEFront ν T a u p)
    (hbudget : FourierBudgetFinite (fun t => datumFourierCoeff (u t)) T) :
    MemLp (fun t => criticalSpatialNorm 6 (u t)) 4
      (volume.restrict (Ioo (0 : ℝ) T)) := by
  exact physical_fourier_budget_to_serrin u T (physicalEnergy a)
    (fun t ht => local_front_smooth_slices ν T a u p H t ht)
    (local_spatialNorm_six_aestronglyMeasurable u T H.velocity_smooth.continuousOn)
    (local_physicalDissipation_aestronglyMeasurable u T H.velocity_smooth)
    (local_physicalEnergy_aestronglyMeasurable u T H.velocity_smooth.continuousOn)
    (fun t ht => local_front_energy_bound ν T a u p H t ht) hbudget

end

/-!
Homogeneous physical Fourier-budget adapter for Weak_Fourierman_B.

The pinned homogeneous L6 proof is localized to arbitrary smooth, periodic,
mean-zero fields. The actual physical H1 Fourier datum supplies Parseval and
the order-lowering contraction supplies E <= D. No solution wrapper, PDE,
initial energy, energy trace, or assumed energy bound is used.

The final theorem gives the actual spatial L6 norm in time L4 on the SAME
open front. It does not establish continuation or global regularity.
The extended full-mode Fourier sum retains infinity. Prepared source only;
external verification is required, and no local Lean execution was performed.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

open Set MeasureTheory Filter SingularClosure
open scoped BigOperators ENNReal ContDiff Topology

namespace MethbokeAddon.WeakFouriermanB
noncomputable section

/-- Physical mean zero implies zero actual Fourier mode without a
divergence-free or solution hypothesis. -/
theorem meanZero_datumFourierCoeff_meanZero
    (v : Field) (hz : MeanZero v) :
    SpectralMeanZero (datumFourierCoeff v) := by
  intro i
  rw [datumFourierCoeff_zero hz.1, hz.2]
  simp

/-- Poincare in the coarse normalization needed below, for an actual field.
Both norms are identified with the same actual Fourier coefficients. -/
theorem smooth_periodic_meanZero_energy_le_dissipation
    (v : Field) (hv : ContDiff ℝ ∞ v) (hp : SpatialPeriodic v)
    (hz : MeanZero v) :
    physicalEnergy v ≤ physicalDissipation v := by
  have hH1 := physicalH1_of_smooth_periodic v hv hp
  have hzero := meanZero_datumFourierCoeff_meanZero v hz
  let w : CriticalSobolev 2 := QuasiFeffermanB.physicalH1SobolevDatum hH1 hzero
  have hw : criticalCoeff 2 w = datumFourierCoeff v :=
    QuasiFeffermanB.physicalH1SobolevDatum_coeff hH1 hzero
  let w0 : CriticalSobolev 0 := criticalSobolevLower 0 2 (by norm_num) w
  have hw0 : criticalCoeff 0 w0 = datumFourierCoeff v := by
    rw [criticalSobolevLower_coeff, hw]
  have hrapid := ALL_SOBOLEV_IMP_RAPID_SCALAR (datumFourierCoeff v)
    (fun s => SMOOTH_DATUM_MEM_TORUS_SOBOLEV s v hv hp)
  have hE := critical_smoothFourierSynthesis_energy_eq_norm_sq
    (datumFourierCoeff v) hrapid (datumFourierCoeff_reality v) w0 hw0
  have hD := critical_smoothFourierSynthesis_dissipation_eq_norm_sq
    (datumFourierCoeff v) hrapid (datumFourierCoeff_reality v) hzero w hw
  rw [smoothFourierSynthesis_datum_eq v hv hp] at hE hD
  rw [hE, hD]
  exact pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _)
    (criticalSobolevLower_norm_le 0 2 (by norm_num) w) 2

/-- The spatial L6 fourth power is controlled solely by squared dissipation.
The constant is independent of the field and of any time interval. -/
theorem SMOOTH_MEAN_ZERO_HOMOGENEOUS_L6_FOURTH :
    ∃ K : ℝ, 0 < K ∧ ∀ v : Field, ContDiff ℝ ∞ v → SpatialPeriodic v →
      MeanZero v → criticalSpatialNorm 6 v ^ 4 ≤ K * physicalDissipation v ^ 2 := by
  obtain ⟨K, hK, hb⟩ := CRITICAL_SMOOTH_L6_FOURTH_BOUND
  refine ⟨10 * K, by positivity, ?_⟩
  intro v hv hp hz
  have hE := smooth_periodic_meanZero_energy_le_dissipation v hv hp hz
  have hE0 : 0 ≤ physicalEnergy v := by
    rw [physicalEnergy_eq_integral_norm_sq]
    exact integral_nonneg (fun x => sq_nonneg _)
  have hE2 := pow_le_pow_left₀ hE0 hE 2
  calc
    _ ≤ K * (9 * physicalDissipation v ^ 2 + physicalEnergy v ^ 2) := hb v hv hp
    _ ≤ K * (9 * physicalDissipation v ^ 2 + physicalDissipation v ^ 2) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (add_le_add le_rfl hE2) hK.le
    _ = _ := by ring

def homogeneousL6FourthConstant : ℝ :=
  SMOOTH_MEAN_ZERO_HOMOGENEOUS_L6_FOURTH.choose

theorem homogeneousL6FourthConstant_pos : 0 < homogeneousL6FourthConstant :=
  SMOOTH_MEAN_ZERO_HOMOGENEOUS_L6_FOURTH.choose_spec.1

theorem homogeneousL6FourthConstant_bound
    (v : Field) (hv : ContDiff ℝ ∞ v) (hp : SpatialPeriodic v)
    (hz : MeanZero v) :
    criticalSpatialNorm 6 v ^ 4 ≤ homogeneousL6FourthConstant * physicalDissipation v ^ 2 :=
  SMOOTH_MEAN_ZERO_HOMOGENEOUS_L6_FOURTH.choose_spec.2 v hv hp hz

/-- Homogeneous domination works for an arbitrary time measure; no finite
time-measure or kinetic-energy integrability premise is necessary. -/
theorem homogeneous_l6_fourth_integrable_of_dissipation_square
    (μ : Measure ℝ) (u : ℝ → Field)
    (hregular : ∀ᵐ t ∂μ,
      ContDiff ℝ ∞ (u t) ∧ SpatialPeriodic (u t) ∧ MeanZero (u t))
    (hmeas : AEStronglyMeasurable (fun t => criticalSpatialNorm 6 (u t)) μ)
    (hD : Integrable (fun t => physicalDissipation (u t) ^ 2) μ) :
    Integrable (fun t => criticalSpatialNorm 6 (u t) ^ 4) μ := by
  apply (hD.const_mul homogeneousL6FourthConstant).mono' (hmeas.pow 4)
  filter_upwards [hregular] with t ht
  change ‖criticalSpatialNorm 6 (u t) ^ 4‖ ≤
    homogeneousL6FourthConstant * physicalDissipation (u t) ^ 2
  rw [Real.norm_of_nonneg (pow_nonneg (criticalSpatialNorm_nonneg 6 _) 4)]
  exact homogeneousL6FourthConstant_bound (u t) ht.1 ht.2.1 ht.2.2

theorem homogeneous_serrin_of_dissipation_square
    (μ : Measure ℝ) (u : ℝ → Field)
    (hregular : ∀ᵐ t ∂μ,
      ContDiff ℝ ∞ (u t) ∧ SpatialPeriodic (u t) ∧ MeanZero (u t))
    (hmeas : AEStronglyMeasurable (fun t => criticalSpatialNorm 6 (u t)) μ)
    (hD : Integrable (fun t => physicalDissipation (u t) ^ 2) μ) :
    MemLp (fun t => criticalSpatialNorm 6 (u t)) 4 μ := by
  have hfour := homogeneous_l6_fourth_integrable_of_dissipation_square
    μ u hregular hmeas hD
  apply (integrable_norm_rpow_iff hmeas
    (by norm_num : (4 : ℝ≥0∞) ≠ 0)
    (by norm_num : (4 : ℝ≥0∞) ≠ (⊤ : ℝ≥0∞))).mp
  have hnorm (t : ℝ) : ‖criticalSpatialNorm 6 (u t)‖ = criticalSpatialNorm 6 (u t) :=
    Real.norm_of_nonneg (criticalSpatialNorm_nonneg 6 _)
  have hpow (x : ℝ) : x ^ (4 : ℝ) = x ^ (4 : ℕ) := Real.rpow_ofNat x 4
  simpa only [ENNReal.toReal_ofNat, hnorm, hpow] using hfour

/-- The full Fourier budget gives squared physical dissipation integrability
for these exact slices. Summability and Parseval are proved from the physical
fields, rather than required as separate spectral assumptions. -/
theorem homogeneous_dissipation_square_integrable_of_fourier_budget
    (μ : Measure ℝ) (u : ℝ → Field)
    (hregular : ∀ᵐ t ∂μ,
      ContDiff ℝ ∞ (u t) ∧ SpatialPeriodic (u t) ∧ MeanZero (u t))
    (hDmeas : AEStronglyMeasurable (fun t => physicalDissipation (u t)) μ)
    (hbudget : (∫⁻ t, ExtendedFourierEnstrophy (datumFourierCoeff (u t)) ^ 2 ∂μ) <
      (⊤ : ℝ≥0∞)) :
    Integrable (fun t => physicalDissipation (u t) ^ 2) μ := by
  have hdata (t : ℝ)
      (ht : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (u t) ∧ SpatialPeriodic (u t) ∧ MeanZero (u t)) :
      physicalDissipation (u t) =
        (4 * Real.pi ^ 2) * FourierEnstrophy (datumFourierCoeff (u t)) ∧
      ENNReal.ofReal (FourierEnstrophy (datumFourierCoeff (u t))) =
        ExtendedFourierEnstrophy (datumFourierCoeff (u t)) := by
    have hH1 := physicalH1_of_smooth_periodic (u t) ht.1 ht.2.1
    have hzero := meanZero_datumFourierCoeff_meanZero (u t) ht.2.2
    let w : CriticalSobolev 2 := QuasiFeffermanB.physicalH1SobolevDatum hH1 hzero
    have hw : criticalCoeff 2 w = datumFourierCoeff (u t) :=
      QuasiFeffermanB.physicalH1SobolevDatum_coeff hH1 hzero
    constructor
    · have hrapid := ALL_SOBOLEV_IMP_RAPID_SCALAR (datumFourierCoeff (u t))
        (fun s => SMOOTH_DATUM_MEM_TORUS_SOBOLEV s (u t) ht.1 ht.2.1)
      have hD := smoothSynthesis_dissipation_eq_fourierEnstrophy
        (datumFourierCoeff (u t)) hrapid (datumFourierCoeff_reality (u t)) hzero w hw
      simpa only [smoothFourierSynthesis_datum_eq (u t) ht.1 ht.2.1] using hD
    · exact ofReal_fourierEnstrophy_eq_extended (datumFourierCoeff (u t))
        (fourierEnstrophy_summable (datumFourierCoeff (u t)) hzero w hw)
  exact dissipation_square_integrable_of_fourier_budget μ u
    (fun t => datumFourierCoeff (u t)) hDmeas
    (hregular.mono fun t ht => (hdata t ht).1)
    (hregular.mono fun t ht => (hdata t ht).2) hbudget

/-- Actual full Fourier budget to actual physical Serrin norm, without an
energy bound, an initial trace, or a global solution wrapper. -/
theorem homogeneous_physical_fourier_budget_to_serrin
    (μ : Measure ℝ) (u : ℝ → Field)
    (hregular : ∀ᵐ t ∂μ,
      ContDiff ℝ ∞ (u t) ∧ SpatialPeriodic (u t) ∧ MeanZero (u t))
    (hL6meas : AEStronglyMeasurable (fun t => criticalSpatialNorm 6 (u t)) μ)
    (hDmeas : AEStronglyMeasurable (fun t => physicalDissipation (u t)) μ)
    (hbudget : (∫⁻ t, ExtendedFourierEnstrophy (datumFourierCoeff (u t)) ^ 2 ∂μ) <
      (⊤ : ℝ≥0∞)) :
    MemLp (fun t => criticalSpatialNorm 6 (u t)) 4 μ :=
  homogeneous_serrin_of_dissipation_square μ u hregular hL6meas
    (homogeneous_dissipation_square_integrable_of_fourier_budget
      μ u hregular hDmeas hbudget)

/-- Local joint smoothness supplies all time measurability and slice
smoothness. Only periodicity, physical mean zero and the full Fourier budget
are additionally required on the same open front. -/
theorem local_homogeneous_fourier_budget_to_serrin
    (u : Velocity) (T : ℝ)
    (hu : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ × Vec => u z.1 z.2) (localFrontSpacetime T))
    (hp : ∀ t ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) T, SpatialPeriodic (u t))
    (hz : ∀ t ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) T, MeanZero (u t))
    (hbudget : FourierBudgetFinite (fun t => datumFourierCoeff (u t)) T) :
    MemLp (fun t => criticalSpatialNorm 6 (u t)) 4
      (volume.restrict (Ioo (0 : ℝ) T)) := by
  have hmem : ∀ᵐ t ∂(volume.restrict (Ioo (0 : ℝ) T)), t ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) T :=
    ae_restrict_mem measurableSet_Ioo
  exact homogeneous_physical_fourier_budget_to_serrin

/-!
An actual finite physical front supplies globally admissible smooth weak
momentum tests that agree with the front through any shorter positive time.

A smooth time map freezes late times inside the given front and preserves
all sufficiently early times. This extends the admissible test, not the NSE
solution. No extension/continuation field is assumed. In particular, the
same test preserves the strong initial trace of the original velocity.

Prepared source only; matching external cached verification is pending.

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option Elab.async true

open Set Filter MeasureTheory SingularClosure
open scoped ContDiff Topology

noncomputable section

/-- Equal to the identity near zero and equal to `c` outside the bump. -/
def finiteFrontTimeClamp (c : ℝ) (b : ContDiffBump (0 : ℝ)) (r : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  c + b r * (r - c)

theorem finiteFrontTimeClamp_contDiff (c : ℝ) (b : ContDiffBump (0 : ℝ)) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (finiteFrontTimeClamp c b) := by
  exact contDiff_const.add (b.contDiff.mul (contDiff_id.sub contDiff_const))

/-- Positive times remain strictly inside the front. No assertion about
negative-time smoothness of the original velocity is needed. -/
theorem finiteFrontTimeClamp_mem_Ioo {c T : ℝ} (b : ContDiffBump (0 : ℝ))
    (hc : c ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) T) (houter : b.rOut < T)
    (r : ℝ) (hr : 0 < r) :
    finiteFrontTimeClamp c b r ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) T := by
  by_cases hb : b r = 0
  · simpa only [finiteFrontTimeClamp, hb, zero_mul, add_zero] using hc
  · have hrball : r ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℝ) b.rOut := by
      rw [← b.support_eq]
      exact hb
    have habs : |r| < b.rOut := by
      simpa only [Metric.mem_ball, Real.dist_eq, sub_zero] using hrball
    have hrT : r < T := (le_abs_self r).trans_lt (habs.trans houter)
    have hb0 : 0 ≤ b r := b.nonneg
    have hb1 : b r ≤ 1 := b.le_one
    have hbpos : 0 < b r := lt_of_le_of_ne hb0 (Ne.symm hb)
    have hbrem : 0 ≤ 1 - b r := sub_nonneg.mpr hb1
    change 0 < c + b r * (r - c) ∧ c + b r * (r - c) < T
    constructor
    · nlinarith only [mul_pos hbpos hr, mul_nonneg hbrem hc.1.le]
    · nlinarith only [mul_pos hbpos (sub_pos.mpr hrT),
        mul_nonneg hbrem (sub_nonneg.mpr hc.2.le)]

/-- A finite physical front supplies one genuine global positive smooth
solenoidal test agreeing locally at every time up to the shorter horizon,
including near zero. The test is not asserted to solve NSE at later times. -/
theorem local_front_exists_global_test_through
    (ν T : ℝ) (a : Field) (u : Velocity) (p : Pressure)
    (H : LocalPhysicalNSEFront ν T a u p)
    (t : ℝ) (ht0 : 0 < t) (htT : t < T) :
    ∃ φ : Velocity, CriticalPositiveSolenoidalTest φ ∧
      (∀ r ∈ Ioc (0 : ℝ) t, φ =ᶠ[𝓝 r] u) ∧ φ =ᶠ[𝓝 (0 : ℝ)] u := by
  let c : ℝ := T / 2
  have hc : c ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) T := by
    dsimp [c]
    constructor <;> linarith
  let b : ContDiffBump (0 : ℝ) :=
    ⟨(t + T) / 2, (t + 3 * T) / 4, by linarith, by linarith⟩
  have houter : b.rOut < T := by
    dsimp [b]
    linarith
  have hinner : ∀ r ∈ Ioc (0 : ℝ) t, r ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℝ) b.rIn := by
    intro r hr
    apply Metric.mem_ball.mpr
    rw [Real.dist_eq, sub_zero, abs_of_pos hr.1]
    change r < (t + T) / 2
    linarith [hr.2]
  let ρ : ℝ → ℝ := finiteFrontTimeClamp c b
  have hρ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ ρ := finiteFrontTimeClamp_contDiff c b
  have hrange : ∀ r : ℝ, 0 < r → ρ r ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) T :=
    finiteFrontTimeClamp_mem_Ioo b hc houter
  let φ : Velocity := fun r x => u (ρ r) x
  have hmap : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ × Vec => (ρ z.1, z.2)) :=
    (hρ.comp contDiff_fst).prodMk contDiff_snd
  have hφ : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ × Vec => φ z.1 z.2) {z | 0 < z.1} := by
    intro z hz
    have hfront := H.velocity_smooth.contDiffAt
      ((localFrontSpacetime_isOpen T).mem_nhds
        (show (ρ z.1, z.2) ∈ localFrontSpacetime T from hrange z.1 hz))
    have hcomp : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun q : ℝ × Vec => φ q.1 q.2) z := by
      simpa only [φ, Function.comp_def] using hfront.comp z hmap.contDiffAt
    exact hcomp.contDiffWithinAt
  have hagree (r : ℝ) (hr : r ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℝ) b.rIn) :
      φ =ᶠ[𝓝 r] u := by
    have heq := b.eventuallyEq_one_of_mem_ball hr
    filter_upwards [heq] with q hq
    change b q = 1 at hq
    change u (ρ q) = u q
    have hρq : ρ q = q := by
      change c + b q * (q - c) = q
      rw [hq]
      ring
    rw [hρq]
  refine ⟨φ, ⟨hφ, ?_, ?_⟩, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro r hr
    exact H.velocity_periodic (ρ r) (hrange r hr)
  · intro r hr x
    exact H.divergence_free (ρ r) (hrange r hr) x
  · intro r hr
    exact hagree r (hinner r hr)
  · exact hagree 0 (Metric.mem_ball_self b.rIn_pos)

/-- In particular, every compact inner window admits an actual global
positive smooth solenoidal test agreeing in a time neighborhood of the window. -/
theorem local_front_exists_global_test_on_compact
    (ν T : ℝ) (a : Field) (u : Velocity) (p : Pressure)
    (H : LocalPhysicalNSEFront ν T a u p)
    (s t : ℝ) (hs : 0 < s) (hst : s ≤ t) (ht : t < T) :
    ∃ φ : Velocity, CriticalPositiveSolenoidalTest φ ∧
      ∀ r ∈ Icc s t, φ =ᶠ[𝓝 r] u := by
  obtain ⟨φ, hφ, hagree, _⟩ := local_front_exists_global_test_through
    ν T a u p H t (hs.trans_le hst) ht
  exact ⟨φ, hφ, fun r hr => hagree r ⟨hs.trans_le hr.1, hr.2⟩⟩

/-- Time-neighborhood equality of physical fields preserves the literal
within-nonnegative-time derivative used in the NSE equation. -/
theorem local_test_timeDerivative_eq_of_eventuallyEq
    {φ u : Velocity} {r : ℝ} (h : φ =ᶠ[𝓝 r] u) (x : Vec) :
    timeDerivative φ r x = timeDerivative u r x := by
  have hx : (fun q => φ q x) =ᶠ[𝓝 r] (fun q => u q x) := by
    filter_upwards [h] with q hq
    exact congrFun hq x
  exact hx.derivWithin_eq_of_nhds

end

Finite-window version of the actual physical weak/classical cross identity.

The velocity used for testing is globally a positive-time smooth solenoidal
test, as required by the existing weak momentum definition. It is required to
solve NSE only on the selected compact interval [s,t]. A smooth finite-front
time clamp can supply such a test without extending the NSE solution globally.

set_option autoImplicit false

noncomputable section

private theorem window_inner_sub_right (v f g : Field)
    (hv : MemLp v 2 (volume.restrict unitCube)) (hf : Continuous f)
    (hg : Continuous g) :
    physicalFieldInner v (f - g) = physicalFieldInner v f - physicalFieldInner v g := by
  unfold physicalFieldInner
  simp_rw [Pi.sub_apply, inner_sub_right]
  exact integral_sub (criticalWeakFieldInner_integrable v f hv hf)
    (criticalWeakFieldInner_integrable v g hv hg)

private theorem window_inner_smul_right (v f : Field) (c : ℝ) :
    physicalFieldInner v (c • f) = c * physicalFieldInner v f := by
  unfold physicalFieldInner
  simp only [Pi.smul_apply, inner_smul_right]
  exact integral_const_mul _ _

/-- The physical cross identity only needs the classical equation and pressure
regularity on the interval of integration. No global classical evolution, weak
gradient of v, relative-energy inequality, or comparison conclusion is assumed.
-/
theorem finite_window_weak_classical_cross_identity
    (ν : ℝ) (v φ : Velocity) (p : Pressure)
    (hv : CriticalIntegratedWeakMomentum ν v)
    (hφ : CriticalPositiveSolenoidalTest φ)
    (s t : ℝ) (hs : 0 < s) (hst : s ≤ t)
    (hp : ∀ r ∈ Icc s t, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (p r))
    (hpp : ∀ r ∈ Icc s t, SpatialPeriodic (p r))
    (hNSE : ∀ r ∈ Icc s t, ∀ x : Vec,
      timeDerivative φ r x + convection (φ r) x + SingularClosure.gradient (p r) x =
        ν • laplacian (φ r) x) :
    IntervalIntegrable (fun r =>
      2 * ν * physicalFieldInner (v r) (laplacian (φ r)) -
        physicalFieldInner (v r) (convection (φ r)) + criticalWeakTransport (v r) (φ r))
      volume s t ∧
    physicalFieldInner (v t) (φ t) - physicalFieldInner (v s) (φ s) =
      ∫ r in s..t,
        2 * ν * physicalFieldInner (v r) (laplacian (φ r)) -
          physicalFieldInner (v r) (convection (φ r)) + criticalWeakTransport (v r) (φ r) := by
  have hpoint (r : ℝ) (hr : r ∈ Icc s t) :
      criticalWeakMomentumIntegrand ν v φ r =
        2 * ν * physicalFieldInner (v r) (laplacian (φ r)) -
          physicalFieldInner (v r) (convection (φ r)) + criticalWeakTransport (v r) (φ r) := by
    have hrpos : 0 < r := hs.trans_le hr.1
    have hφs := hφ.spatial_smooth hrpos
    have hlap : Continuous (laplacian (φ r)) := (laplacian_contDiff (φ r) hφs).continuous
    have hconv : Continuous (convection (φ r)) := convection_continuous hφs
    have hgrad : Continuous (SingularClosure.gradient (p r)) := criticalWeak_gradient_continuous _ (hp r hr)
    have htime : timeDerivative φ r = ν • laplacian (φ r) - convection (φ r) - SingularClosure.gradient (p r) := by
      funext x
      change timeDerivative φ r x =
        ν • laplacian (φ r) x - convection (φ r) x - SingularClosure.gradient (p r) x
      calc
        _ = (timeDerivative φ r x + convection (φ r) x + SingularClosure.gradient (p r) x) -
            convection (φ r) x - SingularClosure.gradient (p r) x := by abel
        _ = _ := by rw [hNSE r hr x]
    have hνlap : Continuous (ν • laplacian (φ r)) := continuous_const.smul hlap
    have hpair : physicalFieldInner (v r) (timeDerivative φ r) =
        ν * physicalFieldInner (v r) (laplacian (φ r)) -
          physicalFieldInner (v r) (convection (φ r)) := by
      rw [htime,
        window_inner_sub_right _ _ _ (hv.spatial_L2 r hrpos) (hνlap.sub hconv) hgrad,
        window_inner_sub_right _ _ _ (hv.spatial_L2 r hrpos) hνlap hconv,
        window_inner_smul_right,
        hv.gradient_annihilation r hrpos (p r) (hp r hr) (hpp r hr), sub_zero]
    unfold criticalWeakMomentumIntegrand
    rw [hpair]
    ring
  obtain ⟨hI₁, hI₂, hI₃⟩ := hv.test_integrable φ hφ s t hs hst
  have hI : IntervalIntegrable (criticalWeakMomentumIntegrand ν v φ) volume s t :=
    (hI₁.add (hI₂.const_mul ν)).add hI₃
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · apply hI.congr
    intro r hr
    have hr' : r ∈ Ioc s t := by simpa only [uIoc_of_le hst] using hr
    exact hpoint r ⟨hr'.1.le, hr'.2⟩
  · apply (hv.momentum φ hφ s t hs hst).trans
    apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr
    intro r hr
    exact hpoint r (by simpa only [uIcc_of_le hst] using hr)

end

noncomputable section

private theorem finite_window_smooth_energy_pairing
    (ν : ℝ) (u : Velocity) (p : Pressure)
    (hu : CriticalPositiveSolenoidalTest u)
    (s b t : ℝ) (ht : 0 < t) (hmem : t ∈ Icc s b)
    (hp : ∀ r ∈ Icc s b, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (p r))
    (hpp : ∀ r ∈ Icc s b, SpatialPeriodic (p r))
    (hNSE : ∀ r ∈ Icc s b, ∀ x : Vec,
      timeDerivative u r x + convection (u r) x + SingularClosure.gradient (p r) x =
        ν • laplacian (u r) x) :
    physicalFieldInner (u t) (timeDerivative u t) = -ν * physicalDissipation (u t) := by
  have hus := hu.spatial_smooth ht
  have hud : Continuous (timeDerivative u t) :=
    hu.timeDerivative_continuousOn.comp_continuous
      (continuous_const.prodMk continuous_id) (fun _ => ht)
  have hconv : Continuous (convection (u t)) := convection_continuous hus
  have hgrad : Continuous (SingularClosure.gradient (p t)) := criticalWeak_gradient_continuous _ (hp t hmem)
  have hI₁ := physicalFieldInner_integrable (u t) (timeDerivative u t) hus.continuous hud
  have hI₂ := physicalFieldInner_integrable (u t) (convection (u t)) hus.continuous hconv
  have hI₃ := physicalFieldInner_integrable (u t) (SingularClosure.gradient (p t)) hus.continuous hgrad
  have hI₁₂ : IntegrableOn (fun x =>
      inner ℝ (u t x) (timeDerivative u t x) + inner ℝ (u t x) (convection (u t) x))
      unitCube volume := hI₁.add hI₂
  have heq : timeDerivative u t + convection (u t) + SingularClosure.gradient (p t) = ν • laplacian (u t) :=
    funext (fun x => hNSE t hmem x)
  have h := congrArg (physicalFieldInner (u t)) heq
  simp only [physicalFieldInner, Pi.add_apply, inner_add_right,
    Pi.smul_apply, inner_smul_right] at h
  rw [integral_add hI₁₂ hI₃, integral_add hI₁ hI₂, integral_const_mul] at h
  rw [critical_smooth_integral_inner_convection_eq_zero
      (u t) hus (hu.periodic t ht) (hu.solenoidal t ht),
    critical_smooth_integral_inner_gradient_eq_zero (u t) (p t) hus (hp t hmem)
      (hu.periodic t ht) (hpp t hmem) (hu.solenoidal t ht),
    critical_integral_inner_laplacian_self (u t) hus (hu.periodic t ht)] at h
  change (∫ x in unitCube, inner ℝ (u t x) (timeDerivative u t x)) = _
  linarith

/-- Classical energy equality uses the equation only on the selected window.
All integrability and derivative assertions are derived from the actual test.
-/
theorem finite_window_smooth_nse_energy_identity
    (ν : ℝ) (hν : 0 < ν) (u : Velocity) (p : Pressure)
    (hu : CriticalPositiveSolenoidalTest u)
    (s t : ℝ) (hs : 0 < s) (hst : s ≤ t)
    (hp : ∀ r ∈ Icc s t, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (p r))
    (hpp : ∀ r ∈ Icc s t, SpatialPeriodic (p r))
    (hNSE : ∀ r ∈ Icc s t, ∀ x : Vec,
      timeDerivative u r x + convection (u r) x + SingularClosure.gradient (p r) x =
        ν • laplacian (u r) x) :
    IntervalIntegrable (fun r => physicalDissipation (u r)) volume s t ∧
      physicalEnergy (u t) + 2 * ν * (∫ r in s..t, physicalDissipation (u r)) =
        physicalEnergy (u s) := by
  have hP : ContinuousOn (fun r => physicalFieldInner (u r) (timeDerivative u r)) (Icc s t) :=
    critical_real_cube_integral_continuousOn_Icc
      (fun r x => inner ℝ (u r x) (timeDerivative u r x))
      (hu.smooth.continuousOn.inner hu.timeDerivative_continuousOn) s t hs
  have hscaled : ContinuousOn
      (fun r => (-ν)⁻¹ * physicalFieldInner (u r) (timeDerivative u r)) (Icc s t) :=
    continuousOn_const.mul hP
  have hD : ContinuousOn (fun r => physicalDissipation (u r)) (Icc s t) := by
    apply hscaled.congr
    intro r hr
    change physicalDissipation (u r) =
      (-ν)⁻¹ * physicalFieldInner (u r) (timeDerivative u r)
    rw [finite_window_smooth_energy_pairing ν u p hu s t r (hs.trans_le hr.1) hr hp hpp hNSE]
    simp only [← mul_assoc, inv_mul_cancel₀ (neg_ne_zero.mpr hν.ne'), one_mul]
  have hE : ContinuousOn (fun r => physicalEnergy (u r)) (Icc s t) := by
    intro r hr
    exact (hu.physicalEnergy_hasDerivAt r (hs.trans_le hr.1)).continuousAt.continuousWithinAt
  have hDI : IntervalIntegrable (fun r => physicalDissipation (u r)) volume s t :=
    hD.intervalIntegrable_of_Icc hst
  refine ⟨hDI, ?_⟩
  have hd : ∀ r ∈ Ioo s t, HasDerivAt (fun q => physicalEnergy (u q))
      ((-2 * ν) * physicalDissipation (u r)) r := by
    intro r hr
    have h := hu.physicalEnergy_hasDerivAt r (hs.trans hr.1)
    rw [finite_window_smooth_energy_pairing ν u p hu s t r (hs.trans hr.1)
      ⟨hr.1.le, hr.2.le⟩ hp hpp hNSE] at h
    convert h using 1 <;> ring
  have hFTC := intervalIntegral.integral_eq_sub_of_hasDerivAt_of_le hst hE hd
    (hDI.const_mul (-2 * ν))
  rw [intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul] at hFTC
  linarith

/-- Derived physical relative energy, with the exact weak/classical cross term. -/
theorem finite_window_lh_smooth_relative_energy_raw
    (ν : ℝ) (hν : 0 < ν) (a₀ : CriticalPhysicalL2)
    (v u : Velocity) (G : ℝ → Vec → (Vec →L[ℝ] Vec)) (p : Pressure)
    (hv : CriticalLerayHopf ν a₀ v G)
    (hu : CriticalPositiveSolenoidalTest u)
    (s t : ℝ) (hs : 0 < s) (hst : s ≤ t)
    (hp : ∀ r ∈ Icc s t, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (p r))
    (hpp : ∀ r ∈ Icc s t, SpatialPeriodic (p r))
    (hNSE : ∀ r ∈ Icc s t, ∀ x : Vec,
      timeDerivative u r x + convection (u r) x + SingularClosure.gradient (p r) x =
        ν • laplacian (u r) x)
    (henergy : physicalEnergy (v t) +
      2 * ν * (∫ r in s..t, criticalGradientEnergy (G r)) ≤ physicalEnergy (v s)) :
    IntervalIntegrable (fun r => criticalGradientEnergy (G r - fderiv ℝ (u r))) volume s t ∧
    IntervalIntegrable (fun r => criticalWeakTransport (v r) (u r) -
      physicalFieldInner (v r) (convection (u r))) volume s t ∧
    physicalEnergy (v t - u t) +
      2 * ν * (∫ r in s..t, criticalGradientEnergy (G r - fderiv ℝ (u r))) ≤
      physicalEnergy (v s - u s) - 2 * (∫ r in s..t,
        criticalWeakTransport (v r) (u r) - physicalFieldInner (v r) (convection (u r))) := by
  have ht : 0 < t := hs.trans_le hst
  have hclassical := finite_window_smooth_nse_energy_identity ν hν u p hu s t hs hst hp hpp hNSE
  have hcross := finite_window_weak_classical_cross_identity ν v u p hv.momentum hu
    s t hs hst hp hpp hNSE
  obtain ⟨hTime, hLap, hTransport⟩ := hv.momentum.test_integrable u hu s t hs hst
  have hDv : IntervalIntegrable (fun r => criticalGradientEnergy (G r)) volume s t := by
    apply (hv.dissipation_integrable t ht).mono_set
    rw [uIcc_of_le hst, uIcc_of_le ht.le]
    exact Icc_subset_Icc hs.le le_rfl
  have hN : IntervalIntegrable (fun r => criticalWeakTransport (v r) (u r) -
      physicalFieldInner (v r) (convection (u r))) volume s t := by
    apply (hcross.1.sub (hLap.const_mul (2 * ν))).congr
    intro r _
    ring
  have hcross_eq : physicalFieldInner (v t) (u t) - physicalFieldInner (v s) (u s) =
      2 * ν * (∫ r in s..t, physicalFieldInner (v r) (laplacian (u r))) +
        (∫ r in s..t, criticalWeakTransport (v r) (u r) -
          physicalFieldInner (v r) (convection (u r))) := by
    rw [hcross.2]
    calc
      _ = ∫ r in s..t,
          (2 * ν) * physicalFieldInner (v r) (laplacian (u r)) +
            (criticalWeakTransport (v r) (u r) - physicalFieldInner (v r) (convection (u r))) := by
        apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr
        intro r _
        ring
      _ = _ := by
        rw [intervalIntegral.integral_add (hLap.const_mul (2 * ν)) hN,
          intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul]
  have hH1 : ∀ᵐ r ∂volume.restrict (Ioc s t), CriticalPhysicalH1 (v r) (G r) :=
    ae_restrict_of_ae_restrict_of_subset
      (Ioc_subset_Ioc hs.le le_rfl) (hv.spatial_H1 t ht)
  have hdiff : (fun r => criticalGradientEnergy (G r - fderiv ℝ (u r))) =ᵐ[
      volume.restrict (uIoc s t)]
      (fun r => criticalGradientEnergy (G r) + physicalDissipation (u r) +
        2 * physicalFieldInner (v r) (laplacian (u r))) := by
    rw [uIoc_of_le hst]
    filter_upwards [hH1, ae_restrict_mem measurableSet_Ioc] with r hHr hr
    have hrpos : 0 < r := hs.trans hr.1
    have hur := hu.spatial_smooth hrpos
    have hDu : MemLp (fderiv ℝ (u r)) 2 (volume.restrict unitCube) :=
      critical_continuous_memLp_cube _ (hur.continuous_fderiv (by simp)) 2
    rw [criticalGradientEnergy_sub _ _ hHr.derivative_L2 hDu,
      criticalGradientEnergy_fderiv (u r) hur]
    have hpairs := hHr.weakGradient.inner_laplacian (u r) hur (hu.periodic r hrpos)
    change physicalFieldInner (v r) (laplacian (u r)) =
      -criticalGradientPairing (G r) (fderiv ℝ (u r)) at hpairs
    linarith
  have hDvDu : IntervalIntegrable
      (fun r => criticalGradientEnergy (G r) + physicalDissipation (u r)) volume s t :=
    hDv.add hclassical.1
  have hDI : IntervalIntegrable
      (fun r => criticalGradientEnergy (G r - fderiv ℝ (u r))) volume s t :=
    (hDvDu.add (hLap.const_mul 2)).congr_ae hdiff.symm
  have hDint : (∫ r in s..t, criticalGradientEnergy (G r - fderiv ℝ (u r))) =
      (∫ r in s..t, criticalGradientEnergy (G r)) +
        (∫ r in s..t, physicalDissipation (u r)) +
          2 * (∫ r in s..t, physicalFieldInner (v r) (laplacian (u r))) := by
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_congr_ae_restrict hdiff]
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_add hDvDu (hLap.const_mul 2),
      intervalIntegral.integral_add hDv hclassical.1, intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul]
  refine ⟨hDI, hN, ?_⟩
  rw [critical_physicalEnergy_sub (v t) (u t) (hv.velocity_L2 t ht.le)
      (critical_continuous_memLp_cube _ (hu.spatial_smooth ht).continuous 2),
    critical_physicalEnergy_sub (v s) (u s) (hv.velocity_L2 s hs.le)
      (critical_continuous_memLp_cube _ (hu.spatial_smooth hs).continuous 2), hDint]
  nlinarith only [henergy, hclassical.2, hcross_eq]

/-- Derived physical relative energy after genuine rough transport polarization. -/
theorem finite_window_lh_smooth_relative_energy_transport
    (ν : ℝ) (hν : 0 < ν) (a₀ : CriticalPhysicalL2)
    (v u : Velocity) (G : ℝ → Vec → (Vec →L[ℝ] Vec)) (p : Pressure)
    (hv : CriticalLerayHopf ν a₀ v G)
    (hu : CriticalPositiveSolenoidalTest u)
    (s t : ℝ) (hs : 0 < s) (hst : s ≤ t)
    (hp : ∀ r ∈ Icc s t, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (p r))
    (hpp : ∀ r ∈ Icc s t, SpatialPeriodic (p r))
    (hNSE : ∀ r ∈ Icc s t, ∀ x : Vec,
      timeDerivative u r x + convection (u r) x + SingularClosure.gradient (p r) x =
        ν • laplacian (u r) x)
    (henergy : physicalEnergy (v t) +
      2 * ν * (∫ r in s..t, criticalGradientEnergy (G r)) ≤ physicalEnergy (v s)) :
    IntervalIntegrable (fun r => criticalGradientEnergy (G r - fderiv ℝ (u r))) volume s t ∧
    IntervalIntegrable (fun r => criticalRoughTransport (v r - u r)
      (G r - fderiv ℝ (u r)) (u r)) volume s t ∧
    physicalEnergy (v t - u t) +
      2 * ν * (∫ r in s..t, criticalGradientEnergy (G r - fderiv ℝ (u r))) ≤
      physicalEnergy (v s - u s) + 2 * (∫ r in s..t,
        criticalRoughTransport (v r - u r) (G r - fderiv ℝ (u r)) (u r)) := by
  have ht : 0 < t := hs.trans_le hst
  obtain ⟨hDI, hNI, hrelative⟩ := finite_window_lh_smooth_relative_energy_raw
    ν hν a₀ v u G p hv hu s t hs hst hp hpp hNSE henergy
  have hH1 : ∀ᵐ r ∂volume.restrict (Ioc s t), CriticalPhysicalH1 (v r) (G r) :=
    ae_restrict_of_ae_restrict_of_subset
      (Ioc_subset_Ioc hs.le le_rfl) (hv.spatial_H1 t ht)
  have hnonlinear :
      (fun r => criticalWeakTransport (v r) (u r) -
        physicalFieldInner (v r) (convection (u r))) =ᵐ[volume.restrict (uIoc s t)]
      (fun r => -criticalRoughTransport (v r - u r)
        (G r - fderiv ℝ (u r)) (u r)) := by
    rw [uIoc_of_le hst]
    filter_upwards [hH1, ae_restrict_mem measurableSet_Ioc] with r hHr hr
    have hrpos : 0 < r := hs.trans hr.1
    have hus := hu.spatial_smooth hrpos
    have hvL2 := hv.velocity_L2 r hrpos.le
    have hdiv := hv.momentum.gradient_annihilation r hrpos
    rw [CRITICAL_RELATIVE_NONLINEAR_IDENTITY (v r) (u r) hvL2 hdiv
      hus (hu.periodic r hrpos) (hu.solenoidal r hrpos)]
    exact CRITICAL_ROUGH_TRANSPORT_SKEW (v r - u r) (G r - fderiv ℝ (u r)) (u r)
      (hHr.sub_smooth (u r) hus (hu.periodic r hrpos))
      (critical_gradient_annihilation_sub_smooth (v r) (u r) hvL2 hdiv
        hus (hu.periodic r hrpos) (hu.solenoidal r hrpos))
      hus (hu.periodic r hrpos)
  have hRI : IntervalIntegrable (fun r => criticalRoughTransport (v r - u r)
      (G r - fderiv ℝ (u r)) (u r)) volume s t := by
    apply hNI.neg.congr_ae
    filter_upwards [hnonlinear] with r hr
    exact neg_eq_iff_eq_neg.mpr hr
  have hNint : (∫ r in s..t, criticalWeakTransport (v r) (u r) -
      physicalFieldInner (v r) (convection (u r))) =
      -(∫ r in s..t, criticalRoughTransport (v r - u r)
        (G r - fderiv ℝ (u r)) (u r)) := by
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_congr_ae_restrict hnonlinear, intervalIntegral.integral_neg]
  refine ⟨hDI, hRI, ?_⟩
  rw [hNint] at hrelative
  nlinarith only [hrelative]

end
