theorem finite_window_leray_hopf_serrin_comparison
    (ν : ℝ) (hν : 0 < ν) (a₀ : CriticalPhysicalL2)
    (v u : Velocity) (G : ℝ → Vec → (Vec →L[ℝ] Vec)) (p : Pressure)
    (hv : CriticalLerayHopf ν a₀ v G)
    (hu : CriticalPositiveSolenoidalTest u)
    (T : ℝ) (hT : 0 < T)
    (hp : ∀ r ∈ Ioc (0 : ℝ) T, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (p r))
    (hpp : ∀ r ∈ Ioc (0 : ℝ) T, SpatialPeriodic (p r))
    (hNSE : ∀ r ∈ Ioc (0 : ℝ) T, ∀ x : Vec,
      timeDerivative u r x + convection (u r) x + SingularClosure.gradient (p r) x =
        ν • laplacian (u r) x)
    (hu_trace : Tendsto
      (fun t => eLpNorm (u t - (a₀ : Vec → Vec)) 2 (volume.restrict unitCube))
      (𝓝[>] (0 : ℝ)) (𝓝 0))
    (hSerrin : MemLp (fun t => criticalSpatialNorm 6 (u t)) 4
      (volume.restrict (Ioc (0 : ℝ) T))) :
    ∀ t ∈ Ioc (0 : ℝ) T, v t =ᵐ[volume.restrict unitCube] u t := by
  obtain ⟨C, hC, htransport⟩ := CRITICAL_ROUGH_TRANSPORT_ENERGY_BOUND
  let U : ℝ → ℝ := fun r => criticalSpatialNorm 6 (u r)
  let B : ℝ → ℝ := fun r => 216 * C ^ 4 * (U r) ^ 4 / ν ^ 3 +
    3 * C ^ 2 * (U r) ^ 2 / ν
  let A : ℝ → ℝ := fun r => 2 * B r
  let E : ℝ → ℝ := fun r => physicalEnergy (v r - u r)
  have hUc : ContinuousOn U (Ioc (0 : ℝ) T) :=
    hu.eLpNorm_six_toReal_continuousOn T
  have hBc : ContinuousOn B (Ioc (0 : ℝ) T) :=
    ((continuousOn_const.mul (hUc.pow 4)).div_const (ν ^ 3)).add
      ((continuousOn_const.mul (hUc.pow 2)).div_const ν)
  have hAc : ContinuousOn A (Ioc (0 : ℝ) T) := continuousOn_const.mul hBc
  have hAnonneg : ∀ r ∈ Ioc (0 : ℝ) T, 0 ≤ A r := by
    intro r hr
    dsimp [A, B]
    positivity
  have hEnonneg : ∀ r ∈ Ioc (0 : ℝ) T, 0 ≤ E r := by
    intro r hr
    dsimp [E]
    rw [physicalEnergy_eq_integral_norm_sq]
    exact integral_nonneg (fun x => sq_nonneg _)
  haveI : IsFiniteMeasure (volume.restrict (Ioc (0 : ℝ) T)) :=
    ⟨by simp only [Measure.restrict_apply_univ, Real.volume_Ioc]; finiteness⟩
  have hBI : IntervalIntegrable B volume 0 T :=
    (intervalIntegrable_iff_integrableOn_Ioc_of_le hT.le).mpr
      (criticalSerrinEnergyCoefficient_integrable ν C U hSerrin)
  have hAI : IntervalIntegrable A volume 0 T := hBI.const_mul 2
  obtain ⟨ε, hε, hε_zero⟩ := CRITICAL_ADMISSIBLE_TIMES_TENDSTO_ZERO hT
    (fun s => ∀ t ∈ Icc s T, physicalEnergy (v t) +
      2 * ν * (∫ r in s..t, criticalGradientEnergy (G r)) ≤ physicalEnergy (v s))
    (hv.energy_intervals T hT)
  have hεWithin : Tendsto ε atTop (𝓝[>] (0 : ℝ)) :=
    tendsto_nhdsWithin_iff.mpr ⟨hε_zero, Eventually.of_forall (fun n => (hε n).1.1)⟩
  have hvε (n : ℕ) : MemLp (v (ε n)) 2 (volume.restrict unitCube) :=
    hv.velocity_L2 (ε n) (hε n).1.1.le
  have huε (n : ℕ) : MemLp (u (ε n)) 2 (volume.restrict unitCube) :=
    critical_continuous_memLp_cube _ (hu.spatial_smooth (hε n).1.1).continuous 2
  have ha₀ : MemLp (a₀ : Vec → Vec) 2 (volume.restrict unitCube) := Lp.memLp a₀
  have hv_trace_L2 := critical_toLp_tendsto_of_eLpNorm_sub
    (fun n => v (ε n)) (a₀ : Vec → Vec) hvε ha₀ (hv.strong_trace.comp hεWithin)
  have hu_trace_L2 := critical_toLp_tendsto_of_eLpNorm_sub
    (fun n => u (ε n)) (a₀ : Vec → Vec) huε ha₀ (hu_trace.comp hεWithin)
  have htrace : Tendsto (fun n => E (ε n)) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
    have heq (n : ℕ) : E (ε n) =
        ‖(hvε n).toLp (v (ε n)) - (huε n).toLp (u (ε n))‖ ^ 2 :=
      critical_physicalEnergy_sub_eq_norm_toLp_sub_sq _ _ (hvε n) (huε n)
    simpa only [heq, sub_self, norm_zero, zero_pow (by decide : (2 : ℕ) ≠ 0)] using
      (hv_trace_L2.sub hu_trace_L2).norm.pow 2
  have hprod (n : ℕ) : IntervalIntegrable (fun r => A r * E r) volume (ε n) T :=
    CRITICAL_RELATIVE_ENERGY_PRODUCT_INTERVAL_INTEGRABLE hv hu A (ε n) T
      (hε n).1.1 (hε n).1.2 (hAc.mono (fun r hr =>
        ⟨lt_of_lt_of_le (hε n).1.1 hr.1, hr.2⟩))
  have hrelative : ∀ n t, t ∈ Icc (ε n) T →
      E t ≤ E (ε n) + ∫ r in ε n..t, A r * E r := by
    intro n t ht
    have htpos : 0 < t := lt_of_lt_of_le (hε n).1.1 ht.1
    have hcoefB : ContinuousOn B (Icc (ε n) t) := hBc.mono (fun r hr =>
      ⟨lt_of_lt_of_le (hε n).1.1 hr.1, hr.2.trans ht.2⟩)
    have hBE : IntervalIntegrable (fun r => B r * E r) volume (ε n) t :=
      CRITICAL_RELATIVE_ENERGY_PRODUCT_INTERVAL_INTEGRABLE hv hu B (ε n) t
        (hε n).1.1 ht.1 hcoefB
    have hwindow : Icc (ε n) t ⊆ Ioc (0 : ℝ) T := by
      intro r hr
      exact ⟨(hε n).1.1.trans_le hr.1, hr.2.trans ht.2⟩
    obtain ⟨hD, hR, hrel⟩ := finite_window_lh_smooth_relative_energy_transport
      ν hν a₀ v u G p hv hu (ε n) t (hε n).1.1 ht.1
      (fun r hr => hp r (hwindow hr))
      (fun r hr => hpp r (hwindow hr))
      (fun r hr => hNSE r (hwindow hr)) ((hε n).2 t ht)
    have hupper : IntervalIntegrable (fun r =>
        (ν / 2) * criticalGradientEnergy (G r - fderiv ℝ (u r)) + B r * E r)
        volume (ε n) t := (hD.const_mul (ν / 2)).add hBE
    have hH1 : ∀ᵐ r ∂volume.restrict (Ioc (ε n) t), CriticalPhysicalH1 (v r) (G r) :=
      ae_restrict_of_ae_restrict_of_subset (Ioc_subset_Ioc (hε n).1.1.le le_rfl)
        (hv.spatial_H1 t htpos)
    have hpoint : (fun r => criticalRoughTransport (v r - u r)
        (G r - fderiv ℝ (u r)) (u r)) ≤ᵐ[volume.restrict (Ioc (ε n) t)]
        (fun r => (ν / 2) * criticalGradientEnergy (G r - fderiv ℝ (u r)) + B r * E r) := by
      filter_upwards [hH1, ae_restrict_mem measurableSet_Ioc] with r hHr hr
      have hrpos : 0 < r := (hε n).1.1.trans hr.1
      have hus := hu.spatial_smooth hrpos
      exact (le_abs_self _).trans (htransport ν hν (u r) (v r - u r)
        (G r - fderiv ℝ (u r)) (critical_continuous_memLp_cube _ hus.continuous 6)
        (hHr.sub_smooth (u r) hus (hu.periodic r hrpos)))
    have hbound : (∫ r in ε n..t, criticalRoughTransport (v r - u r)
        (G r - fderiv ℝ (u r)) (u r)) ≤
        (ν / 2) * (∫ r in ε n..t, criticalGradientEnergy (G r - fderiv ℝ (u r))) +
          (∫ r in ε n..t, B r * E r) := by
      calc
        _ ≤ ∫ r in ε n..t,
            (ν / 2) * criticalGradientEnergy (G r - fderiv ℝ (u r)) + B r * E r := by
          rw [intervalIntegral.integral_of_le ht.1, intervalIntegral.integral_of_le ht.1]
          exact setIntegral_mono_ae_restrict hR.1 hupper.1 hpoint
        _ = _ := by
          rw [intervalIntegral.integral_add (hD.const_mul (ν / 2)) hBE,
            intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul]
    have hDnonneg : 0 ≤ ∫ r in ε n..t,
        criticalGradientEnergy (G r - fderiv ℝ (u r)) :=
      intervalIntegral.integral_nonneg_of_forall ht.1
        (fun r => criticalGradientEnergy_nonneg _)
    have hAint : (∫ r in ε n..t, A r * E r) = 2 * (∫ r in ε n..t, B r * E r) := by
      simp only [A, mul_assoc, intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul]
    change E t + 2 * ν * (∫ r in ε n..t,
      criticalGradientEnergy (G r - fderiv ℝ (u r))) ≤
      E (ε n) + 2 * (∫ r in ε n..t,
        criticalRoughTransport (v r - u r) (G r - fderiv ℝ (u r)) (u r)) at hrel
    rw [hAint]
    nlinarith only [hrel, hbound, mul_nonneg hν.le hDnonneg]
  have hzero := CRITICAL_RELATIVE_ENERGY_ZERO_OF_LOCAL_ADMISSIBLE_TRACE hT
    hEnonneg hAc hAnonneg hAI hprod (le_refl (∫ r in (0 : ℝ)..T, A r))
    (fun n => (hε n).1) hε_zero htrace hrelative
  intro t ht
  have hvL2 := hv.velocity_L2 t ht.1.le
  have huL2 : MemLp (u t) 2 (volume.restrict unitCube) :=
    critical_continuous_memLp_cube _ (hu.spatial_smooth ht.1).continuous 2
  have hd := hvL2.sub huL2
  have hn : ‖hd.toLp (v t - u t)‖ = 0 := by
    have hsq : ‖hd.toLp (v t - u t)‖ ^ 2 = 0 := by
      rw [← critical_physicalEnergy_eq_norm_toLp_sq (v t - u t) hd]
      exact hzero t ht
    nlinarith only [hsq, norm_nonneg (hd.toLp (v t - u t))]
  have hz : hd.toLp (v t - u t) = 0 := norm_eq_zero.mp hn
  have hzae : (v t - u t) =ᵐ[volume.restrict unitCube] (0 : Field) :=
    hd.coeFn_toLp.symm.trans (Lp.eq_zero_iff_ae_eq_zero.mp hz)
  filter_upwards [hzae] with x hx
  exact sub_eq_zero.mp hx

end

theorem local_front_leray_hopf_identification_on
    (ν T : ℝ) (a : Field) (u : Velocity) (p : Pressure)
    (v : Velocity) (G : WeakGradientTrajectory)
    (H : LocalPhysicalNSEFront ν T a u p)
    (hv : CriticalLerayHopf ν (criticalL2Representative a) v G)
    (τ : ℝ) (hτ0 : 0 < τ) (hτT : τ < T)

      (volume.restrict (Ioc (0 : ℝ) τ))) :
    ∀ r ∈ Ioc (0 : ℝ) τ, v r =ᵐ[volume.restrict unitCube] u r := by
  obtain ⟨φ, hφ, hagree, hzero⟩ :=
    local_front_exists_global_test_through ν T a u p H τ hτ0 hτT

    fun r hr => ⟨hr.1, hr.2.trans_lt hτT⟩

    (hagree r hr).self_of_nhds

theorem compact_cylinder_velocity_bound (u : Velocity) (τ : ℝ)
    (hcont : ContinuousOn (fun z : ℝ × Vec => u z.1 z.2)
      (Icc (0 : ℝ) τ ×ˢ unitCube)) :
    ∃ M : ℝ, 0 ≤ M ∧
      ∀ r ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) τ, ∀ x ∈ unitCube, ‖u r x‖ ≤ M := by
  obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ :=
    ((isCompact_Icc : IsCompact (Icc (0 : ℝ) τ)).prod isCompact_unitCube).exists_bound_of_continuousOn
      hcont
  refine ⟨max M 0, le_max_right M 0, ?_⟩
  intro r hr x hx
  exact (hM (r, x) ⟨hr, hx⟩).trans (le_max_left M 0)

/-- The comparison constant is the literal spatial L6 norm of the constant
scalar function. Its finiteness is proved from the cube's finite measure. -/
theorem spatialNorm_six_le_constant_of_cube_bound (v : Field) (M : ℝ)
    (hbound : ∀ x ∈ unitCube, ‖v x‖ ≤ M) :
    criticalSpatialNorm 6 v ≤ criticalSpatialNorm 6 (fun _ : Vec => M) := by
  haveI : IsFiniteMeasure (volume.restrict unitCube) :=
    ⟨by simpa only [Measure.restrict_apply_univ] using
      isCompact_unitCube.measure_lt_top (μ := volume)⟩
  have hconst : MemLp (fun _ : Vec => M) 6 (volume.restrict unitCube) :=
    memLp_const M
  have hae : ∀ᵐ x ∂volume.restrict unitCube, ‖v x‖ ≤ M := by
    filter_upwards [ae_restrict_mem isCompact_unitCube.measurableSet] with x hx
    exact hbound x hx
  have hnorm : eLpNorm v 6 (volume.restrict unitCube) ≤
      eLpNorm (fun _ : Vec => M) 6 (volume.restrict unitCube) :=
    eLpNorm_mono_ae_real hae
  exact ENNReal.toReal_mono hconst.eLpNorm_lt_top.ne hnorm

theorem compact_cylinder_spatialNorm_six_bound (u : Velocity) (τ : ℝ)
    (hcont : ContinuousOn (fun z : ℝ × Vec => u z.1 z.2)
      (Icc (0 : ℝ) τ ×ˢ unitCube)) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧
      ∀ r ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) τ, criticalSpatialNorm 6 (u r) ≤ C := by
  obtain ⟨M, hM0, hM⟩ := compact_cylinder_velocity_bound u τ hcont
  refine ⟨criticalSpatialNorm 6 (fun _ : Vec => M),
    criticalSpatialNorm_nonneg 6 _, ?_⟩
  intro r hr
  exact spatialNorm_six_le_constant_of_cube_bound (u r) M (hM r hr)

/-- An actual finite physical NSE front, continuous on the closed shorter
cylinder including its initial trace, has the genuine L4-time/L6-space bound.
No squared Fourier budget or globally smooth trajectory is assumed. -/
theorem local_front_compact_cylinder_serrin
    (ν T : ℝ) (a : Field) (u : Velocity) (p : Pressure)
    (H : LocalPhysicalNSEFront ν T a u p)
    (τ : ℝ) (hτ : 0 < τ) (hτT : τ < T)
    (hcont : ContinuousOn (fun z : ℝ × Vec => u z.1 z.2)
      (Icc (0 : ℝ) τ ×ˢ unitCube)) :
    MemLp (fun r => criticalSpatialNorm 6 (u r)) 4
      (volume.restrict (Ioc (0 : ℝ) τ)) := by
  haveI : IsFiniteMeasure (volume.restrict (Ioc (0 : ℝ) τ)) :=
    ⟨by simp only [Measure.restrict_apply_univ, Real.volume_Ioc]; finiteness⟩
  have hsub : Ioc (0 : ℝ) τ ⊆ Ioo (0 : ℝ) T := by
    intro r hr
    exact ⟨hr.1, hr.2.trans_lt hτT⟩
  have hmeas : AEStronglyMeasurable (fun r => criticalSpatialNorm 6 (u r))
      (volume.restrict (Ioc (0 : ℝ) τ)) := by
    have hfull := local_spatialNorm_six_aestronglyMeasurable u T
      H.velocity_smooth.continuousOn
    exact hfull.mono_measure (Measure.restrict_mono_set volume hsub)
  obtain ⟨C, hC0, hC⟩ := compact_cylinder_spatialNorm_six_bound u τ hcont
  apply MemLp.of_bound hmeas C
  filter_upwards [ae_restrict_mem measurableSet_Ioc] with r hr
  rw [Real.norm_of_nonneg (criticalSpatialNorm_nonneg 6 (u r))]
  exact hC r ⟨hr.1.le, hr.2⟩

end

/-- Actual continuous periodic velocity fields agreeing almost everywhere on
the fundamental cube agree pointwise everywhere. This uses equality of their
literal Fourier integrals and the existing physical Fourier injectivity theorem.
-/
theorem continuous_periodic_field_eq_of_cube_ae
    {u v : Field} (hu : Continuous u) (hv : Continuous v)
    (huper : SpatialPeriodic u) (hvper : SpatialPeriodic v)
    (hae : u =ᵐ[volume.restrict unitCube] v) : u = v := by
  exact datumFourierCoeff_injective_continuous_periodic u v hu hv huper hvper
    (criticalCube_datumFourierCoeff_congr_ae hae)

/-- Integrating a scalar constant over the actual Euclidean fundamental cube
returns the constant, using the proved unit-volume product representation. -/
theorem pressure_integral_unitCube_const (c : ℝ) :
    (∫ _x : Vec in unitCube, c) = c := by
  rw [integral_unitCube_productMeasure]
  simp

/-- The actual scalar SingularClosure.gradient records every coordinate of the Fréchet
derivative. Equality of these gradients therefore determines the whole map. -/
theorem scalar_fderiv_eq_of_gradient_eq
    {p q : Vec → ℝ} {x : Vec} (hgrad : SingularClosure.gradient p x = SingularClosure.gradient q x) :
    fderiv ℝ p x = fderiv ℝ q x := by
  have hcoord (i : Fin 3) :
      fderiv ℝ p x (unitVector i) = fderiv ℝ q x (unitVector i) := by
    have h := congrArg (fun v : Vec => v i) hgrad
    change fderiv ℝ p x (unitVector i) = fderiv ℝ q x (unitVector i) at h
    exact h
  apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
  intro y
  have hrepr (L : Vec →L[ℝ] ℝ) :
      L y = ∑ i : Fin 3, y i • L (unitVector i) := by
    have h := congrArg L (sum_coordinate_unitVector y)
    simpa only [map_sum, map_smul] using h.symm
  rw [hrepr (fderiv ℝ p x), hrepr (fderiv ℝ q x)]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  rw [hcoord i]

/-- Smooth physical pressures with the same SingularClosure.gradient differ by a constant;
their actual zero spatial means force that constant to vanish. -/
theorem normalized_pressure_eq_of_gradient_eq
    {p q : Vec → ℝ}
    (hp : ContDiff ℝ ∞ p) (hq : ContDiff ℝ ∞ q)
    (hpmean : PressureMeanZero p) (hqmean : PressureMeanZero q)
    (hgrad : ∀ x : Vec, SingularClosure.gradient p x = SingularClosure.gradient q x) : p = q := by
  have hpD : Differentiable ℝ p := hp.differentiable (by simp)
  have hqD : Differentiable ℝ q := hq.differentiable (by simp)
  have hzero (x : Vec) : fderiv ℝ (fun y : Vec => p y - q y) x = 0 := by
    change fderiv ℝ (p - q) x = 0
    rw [fderiv_sub (hpD x) (hqD x),
      scalar_fderiv_eq_of_gradient_eq (hgrad x), sub_self]
  have hconstant : (fun x : Vec => p x - q x) =
      (fun _ : Vec => p 0 - q 0) := by
    funext x
    exact is_const_of_fderiv_eq_zero (hpD.sub hqD) hzero x 0
  have hc : p 0 - q 0 = 0 := by
    calc
      p 0 - q 0 = ∫ x in unitCube, p x - q x := by
        rw [hconstant, pressure_integral_unitCube_const]
      _ = 0 := by
        rw [integral_sub hpmean.1 hqmean.1, hpmean.2, hqmean.2, sub_self]
  funext x
  exact sub_eq_zero.mp ((congrFun hconstant x).trans hc)

/-- Pointwise velocity agreement on an open time neighborhood gives equality
of the literal right-half-line time derivatives, including the operator's
boundary convention. No replacement derivative is assumed. -/
theorem timeDerivative_eq_on_open_velocity_overlap
    {u v : Velocity} {I : Set ℝ} (hI : IsOpen I)
    (hvel : ∀ t ∈ I, u t = v t) {t : ℝ} (ht : t ∈ I) (x : Vec) :
    timeDerivative u t x = timeDerivative v t x := by
  have hevent : (fun s : ℝ => u s x) =ᶠ[𝓝 t] (fun s : ℝ => v s x) := by
    filter_upwards [hI.mem_nhds ht] with s hs
    exact congrFun (hvel s hs) x
  exact hevent.derivWithin_eq_of_nhds

/-- On an open velocity overlap, the two literal NSE equations have identical
time, convection and viscosity terms, hence identical pressure gradients. -/
theorem pressure_gradient_eq_on_open_velocity_overlap
    {ν : ℝ} {u v : Velocity} {p q : Pressure} {I : Set ℝ}
    (hI : IsOpen I) (hvel : ∀ t ∈ I, u t = v t)
    (hu : ∀ t ∈ I, ∀ x : Vec,
      timeDerivative u t x + convection (u t) x + SingularClosure.gradient (p t) x =
        ν • laplacian (u t) x)
    (hv : ∀ t ∈ I, ∀ x : Vec,
      timeDerivative v t x + convection (v t) x + SingularClosure.gradient (q t) x =
        ν • laplacian (v t) x) :
    ∀ t ∈ I, SingularClosure.gradient (p t) = SingularClosure.gradient (q t) := by
  intro t ht
  funext x
  have htime := timeDerivative_eq_on_open_velocity_overlap hI hvel ht x
  have hleft := hu t ht x
  rw [htime, hvel t ht] at hleft
  exact add_left_cancel (hleft.trans (hv t ht x).symm)

/-- The pressure part of same-path gluing is forced, once the actual velocity
overlap, equations, smooth pressure slices and zero means have been proved. -/
theorem normalized_pressure_eq_on_open_velocity_overlap
    {ν : ℝ} {u v : Velocity} {p q : Pressure} {I : Set ℝ}
    (hI : IsOpen I) (hvel : ∀ t ∈ I, u t = v t)
    (hu : ∀ t ∈ I, ∀ x : Vec,
      timeDerivative u t x + convection (u t) x + SingularClosure.gradient (p t) x =
        ν • laplacian (u t) x)
    (hv : ∀ t ∈ I, ∀ x : Vec,
      timeDerivative v t x + convection (v t) x + SingularClosure.gradient (q t) x =
        ν • laplacian (v t) x)
    (hp : ∀ t ∈ I, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (p t))
    (hq : ∀ t ∈ I, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (q t))
    (hpmean : ∀ t ∈ I, PressureMeanZero (p t))
    (hqmean : ∀ t ∈ I, PressureMeanZero (q t)) :
    ∀ t ∈ I, p t = q t := by
  intro t ht

    (hpmean t ht) (hqmean t ht)
    (fun x => congrFun
      (pressure_gradient_eq_on_open_velocity_overlap hI hvel hu hv t ht) x)

/-- Joint smoothness on an open time cylinder supplies each smooth pressure
slice by composition with the fixed-time inclusion. -/
theorem pressure_slice_contDiff_on_open_time_set
    {p : Pressure} {I : Set ℝ} (hI : IsOpen I)
    (hp : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ × Vec => p z.1 z.2)
      {z : ℝ × Vec | z.1 ∈ I}) {t : ℝ} (ht : t ∈ I) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (p t) := by
  apply contDiff_iff_contDiffAt.mpr
  intro x
  have hopen : IsOpen {z : ℝ × Vec | z.1 ∈ I} := hI.preimage continuous_fst
  have hj := hp.contDiffAt (hopen.mem_nhds
    (show (t, x) ∈ {z : ℝ × Vec | z.1 ∈ I} from ht))
  simpa only [Function.comp_def] using
    hj.comp x (contDiff_prodMk_right t).contDiffAt

/-- Jointly smooth normalized pressures agree pointwise throughout an open
time interval wherever their actual NSE velocities already agree there. -/
theorem normalized_pressure_eq_on_jointly_smooth_velocity_overlap
    {ν : ℝ} {u v : Velocity} {p q : Pressure} {I : Set ℝ}
    (hI : IsOpen I) (hvel : ∀ t ∈ I, u t = v t)
    (hu : ∀ t ∈ I, ∀ x : Vec,
      timeDerivative u t x + convection (u t) x + SingularClosure.gradient (p t) x =
        ν • laplacian (u t) x)
    (hv : ∀ t ∈ I, ∀ x : Vec,
      timeDerivative v t x + convection (v t) x + SingularClosure.gradient (q t) x =
        ν • laplacian (v t) x)
    (hp : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ × Vec => p z.1 z.2)
      {z : ℝ × Vec | z.1 ∈ I})
    (hq : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ × Vec => q z.1 z.2)
      {z : ℝ × Vec | z.1 ∈ I})
    (hpmean : ∀ t ∈ I, PressureMeanZero (p t))
    (hqmean : ∀ t ∈ I, PressureMeanZero (q t)) :
    ∀ t ∈ I, p t = q t := by
  exact normalized_pressure_eq_on_open_velocity_overlap hI hvel hu hv
    (fun _ ht => pressure_slice_contDiff_on_open_time_set hI hp ht)
    (fun _ ht => pressure_slice_contDiff_on_open_time_set hI hq ht)
    hpmean hqmean

def initialFrontSpacetime (T : ℝ) : Set (ℝ × Vec) :=
  {z | 0 ≤ z.1 ∧ z.1 < T}

/-- A literal finite initial classical pair, with smoothness up to time zero.
Existence of this pair is an explicit input, not inferred from smooth data.
-/
structure InitialClassicalFront (ν T : ℝ) (a : Field)
    (u : Velocity) (p : Pressure) : Prop where
  velocity_smooth :
    ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ × Vec => u z.1 z.2) (initialFrontSpacetime T)
  pressure_smooth :
    ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ × Vec => p z.1 z.2) (initialFrontSpacetime T)
  velocity_periodic : ∀ t ∈ Ico (0 : ℝ) T, SpatialPeriodic (u t)
  pressure_periodic : ∀ t ∈ Ico (0 : ℝ) T, SpatialPeriodic (p t)
  divergence_free : ∀ t ∈ Ico (0 : ℝ) T, ∀ x : Vec, divergence (u t) x = 0
  equation : ∀ t ∈ Ico (0 : ℝ) T, ∀ x : Vec,
    timeDerivative u t x + convection (u t) x + SingularClosure.gradient (p t) x =
      ν • laplacian (u t) x
  initial : u 0 = a
  velocity_mean_zero : ∀ t ∈ Ico (0 : ℝ) T, MeanZero (u t)
  pressure_mean_zero : ∀ t ∈ Ico (0 : ℝ) T, PressureMeanZero (p t)

def finiteCapSplice {E : Type*} (η : ℝ) (f g : ℝ → E) : ℝ → E :=
  fun t => if t < η then f t else g t

theorem finiteCapSplice_eventually_left {E : Type*}
    (η : ℝ) (f g : ℝ → E) {t : ℝ} (ht : t < η) :
    finiteCapSplice η f g =ᶠ[𝓝 t] f := by
  filter_upwards [Iio_mem_nhds ht] with r hr
  change r < η at hr
  change (if r < η then f r else g r) = f r
  exact if_pos hr

/-- On the overlap and to its right the splice is locally the tail, including
at the joining time. The conclusion is a neighborhood equality of functions.
-/
theorem finiteCapSplice_eventually_right {E : Type*}
    (δ T η : ℝ) (f g : ℝ → E) (hηT : η < T)
    (hagree : ∀ r ∈ Ioo δ T, f r = g r) {t : ℝ} (ht : δ < t) :
    finiteCapSplice η f g =ᶠ[𝓝 t] g := by
  filter_upwards [Ioi_mem_nhds ht] with r hr
  by_cases h : r < η
  · simpa only [finiteCapSplice, if_pos h] using hagree r ⟨hr, h.trans hηT⟩
  · simp only [finiteCapSplice, if_neg h]

private theorem finiteCapSplice_timeDerivative_congr
    {f g : Velocity} {t : ℝ} (h : f =ᶠ[𝓝 t] g) (x : Vec) :
    timeDerivative f t x = timeDerivative g t x := by
  have hx : (fun r => f r x) =ᶠ[𝓝 t] (fun r => g r x) := by
    filter_upwards [h] with r hr
    exact congrFun hr x
  exact hx.derivWithin_eq_of_nhds

/-- Smoothness of the actual splice on the closed nonnegative-time cylinder.
At zero the proof uses within-set smoothness from the finite initial front;
at the join it uses the open overlap and genuine tail smoothness.
-/
theorem finiteCapSplice_contDiffOn
    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    (δ T η : ℝ) (f g : ℝ → Vec → E) (hδη : δ < η) (hηT : η < T)
    (hf : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ × Vec => f z.1 z.2) (initialFrontSpacetime T))
    (hg : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ × Vec => g z.1 z.2) (tailSpacetime δ))
    (hagree : ∀ r ∈ Ioo δ T, f r = g r) :
    ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ × Vec => finiteCapSplice η f g z.1 z.2)
      forwardSpacetime := by
  intro z hz
  by_cases hleft : z.1 < η
  · have hzT : z.1 < T := hleft.trans hηT
    have htime : ∀ᶠ y : ℝ × Vec in 𝓝 z, y.1 < T :=
      (continuous_fst.tendsto z).eventually (Iio_mem_nhds hzT)
    have hlocal : initialFrontSpacetime T ∈ 𝓝[forwardSpacetime] z := by
      filter_upwards [self_mem_nhdsWithin, htime.filter_mono nhdsWithin_le_nhds]
        with y hy hyT
      exact ⟨hy, hyT⟩
    have hbase : ContDiffWithinAt ℝ ∞ (fun y : ℝ × Vec => f y.1 y.2)
        forwardSpacetime z :=
      (hf z ⟨hz, hzT⟩).mono_of_mem_nhdsWithin hlocal
    have heq : (fun y : ℝ × Vec => finiteCapSplice η f g y.1 y.2) =ᶠ[𝓝 z]
        (fun y : ℝ × Vec => f y.1 y.2) := by
      filter_upwards [(continuous_fst.tendsto z).eventually
        (finiteCapSplice_eventually_left η f g hleft)] with y hy
      exact congrFun hy y.2
    exact hbase.congr_of_eventuallyEq (heq.filter_mono nhdsWithin_le_nhds)
      heq.self_of_nhds
  · have hδz : δ < z.1 := hδη.trans_le (le_of_not_gt hleft)
    have htime : ∀ᶠ y : ℝ × Vec in 𝓝 z, δ < y.1 :=
      (continuous_fst.tendsto z).eventually (Ioi_mem_nhds hδz)
    have hlocal : tailSpacetime δ ∈ 𝓝[forwardSpacetime] z := by
      filter_upwards [htime.filter_mono nhdsWithin_le_nhds] with y hy
      exact hy.le
    have hbase : ContDiffWithinAt ℝ ∞ (fun y : ℝ × Vec => g y.1 y.2)
        forwardSpacetime z :=
      (hg z hδz.le).mono_of_mem_nhdsWithin hlocal
    have heq : (fun y : ℝ × Vec => finiteCapSplice η f g y.1 y.2) =ᶠ[𝓝 z]
        (fun y : ℝ × Vec => g y.1 y.2) := by
      filter_upwards [(continuous_fst.tendsto z).eventually
        (finiteCapSplice_eventually_right δ T η f g hηT hagree hδz)] with y hy
      exact congrFun hy y.2
    exact hbase.congr_of_eventuallyEq (heq.filter_mono nhdsWithin_le_nhds)
      heq.self_of_nhds

/-- Every field of GlobalSmoothNSE is proved for the constructed splice.
The overlap equalities concern the actual physical velocity and pressure.
-/
theorem finite_cap_splice_global_smooth
    (ν T δ η : ℝ) (a : Field) (u v : Velocity) (p q : Pressure)
    (H : InitialClassicalFront ν T a u p) (K : ClassicalTail ν δ v q)
    (hη0 : 0 < η) (hδη : δ < η) (hηT : η < T)
    (huv : ∀ r ∈ Ioo δ T, u r = v r)
    (hpq : ∀ r ∈ Ioo δ T, p r = q r) :
    GlobalSmoothNSE ν a (finiteCapSplice η u v) (finiteCapSplice η p q) := by
  have hleft (t : ℝ) (ht : t < η) : finiteCapSplice η u v t = u t :=
    (finiteCapSplice_eventually_left η u v ht).self_of_nhds
  have hleftp (t : ℝ) (ht : t < η) : finiteCapSplice η p q t = p t :=
    (finiteCapSplice_eventually_left η p q ht).self_of_nhds
  have hright (t : ℝ) (ht : δ < t) : finiteCapSplice η u v t = v t :=
    (finiteCapSplice_eventually_right δ T η u v hηT huv ht).self_of_nhds
  have hrightp (t : ℝ) (ht : δ < t) : finiteCapSplice η p q t = q t :=
    (finiteCapSplice_eventually_right δ T η p q hηT hpq ht).self_of_nhds
  refine {
    velocity_smooth := finiteCapSplice_contDiffOn δ T η u v hδη hηT
      H.velocity_smooth K.velocity_smooth huv
    pressure_smooth := finiteCapSplice_contDiffOn δ T η p q hδη hηT
      H.pressure_smooth K.pressure_smooth hpq
    velocity_periodic := ?_
    pressure_periodic := ?_
    divergence_free := ?_
    equation := ?_
    initial := ?_
    velocity_mean_zero := ?_
    pressure_mean_zero := ?_
  }
  · intro t ht
    by_cases h : t < η
    · rw [hleft t h]
      exact H.velocity_periodic t ⟨ht, h.trans hηT⟩
    · have hδt := hδη.trans_le (le_of_not_gt h)
      rw [hright t hδt]
      exact K.velocity_periodic t hδt.le
  · intro t ht
    by_cases h : t < η
    · rw [hleftp t h]
      exact H.pressure_periodic t ⟨ht, h.trans hηT⟩
    · have hδt := hδη.trans_le (le_of_not_gt h)
      rw [hrightp t hδt]
      exact K.pressure_periodic t hδt.le
  · intro t ht x
    by_cases h : t < η
    · rw [hleft t h]
      exact H.divergence_free t ⟨ht, h.trans hηT⟩ x
    · have hδt := hδη.trans_le (le_of_not_gt h)
      rw [hright t hδt]
      exact K.divergence_free t hδt.le x
  · intro t ht x
    by_cases h : t < η
    · rw [finiteCapSplice_timeDerivative_congr
        (finiteCapSplice_eventually_left η u v h) x, hleft t h, hleftp t h]
      exact H.equation t ⟨ht, h.trans hηT⟩ x
    · have hδt := hδη.trans_le (le_of_not_gt h)
      rw [finiteCapSplice_timeDerivative_congr
        (finiteCapSplice_eventually_right δ T η u v hηT huv hδt) x,
        hright t hδt, hrightp t hδt]
      exact K.equation t hδt.le x
  · rw [hleft 0 hη0]
    exact H.initial
  · intro t ht
    by_cases h : t < η
    · rw [hleft t h]
      exact H.velocity_mean_zero t ⟨ht, h.trans hηT⟩
    · have hδt := hδη.trans_le (le_of_not_gt h)
      rw [hright t hδt]
      exact K.velocity_mean_zero t hδt.le
  · intro t ht
    by_cases h : t < η
    · rw [hleftp t h]
      exact H.pressure_mean_zero t ⟨ht, h.trans hηT⟩
    · have hδt := hδη.trans_le (le_of_not_gt h)
      rw [hrightp t hδt]
      exact K.pressure_mean_zero t hδt.le

/-- Choose the joining time strictly inside the overlap. The resulting global
pair retains the whole original finite front and agrees with the supplied tail
from the joining time onward.
-/
theorem finite_cap_gluing
    (ν T δ : ℝ) (a : Field) (u v : Velocity) (p q : Pressure)
    (H : InitialClassicalFront ν T a u p) (K : ClassicalTail ν δ v q)
    (hδ0 : 0 ≤ δ) (hδT : δ < T)
    (huv : ∀ r ∈ Ioo δ T, u r = v r)
    (hpq : ∀ r ∈ Ioo δ T, p r = q r) :
    ∃ (U : Velocity) (P : Pressure), GlobalSmoothNSE ν a U P ∧
      (∀ r ∈ Ico (0 : ℝ) T, U r = u r ∧ P r = p r) ∧
      ∀ r : ℝ, (δ + T) / 2 ≤ r → U r = v r ∧ P r = q r := by
  let η : ℝ := (δ + T) / 2
  have hη0 : 0 < η := by dsimp [η]; linarith
  have hδη : δ < η := by dsimp [η]; linarith
  have hηT : η < T := by dsimp [η]; linarith
  refine ⟨finiteCapSplice η u v, finiteCapSplice η p q,
    finite_cap_splice_global_smooth ν T δ η a u v p q H K hη0 hδη hηT huv hpq, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro r hr
    by_cases h : r < η
    · constructor <;> simp only [finiteCapSplice, if_pos h]
    · have hδr : δ < r := hδη.trans_le (le_of_not_gt h)
      simpa only [finiteCapSplice, if_neg h] using
        And.intro (huv r ⟨hδr, hr.2⟩).symm (hpq r ⟨hδr, hr.2⟩).symm
  · intro r hr
    have h : ¬ r < η := not_lt_of_ge hr
    constructor <;> simp only [finiteCapSplice, if_neg h]

end

end MethbokeAddon.WeakFouriermanB

/-- Joint smoothness on an open time cylinder gives a genuinely smooth spatial
velocity slice. This is a restriction/composition fact, not an existence claim.
-/
theorem velocity_slice_contDiff_on_open_time_set
    {u : Velocity} {I : Set ℝ} (hI : IsOpen I)
    (hu : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ × Vec => u z.1 z.2)
      {z : ℝ × Vec | z.1 ∈ I}) {t : ℝ} (ht : t ∈ I) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (u t) := by
  apply contDiff_iff_contDiffAt.mpr
  intro x
  have hopen : IsOpen {z : ℝ × Vec | z.1 ∈ I} := hI.preimage continuous_fst
  have hj := hu.contDiffAt (hopen.mem_nhds
    (show (t, x) ∈ {z : ℝ × Vec | z.1 ∈ I} from ht))
  simpa only [Function.comp_def] using
    hj.comp x (contDiff_prodMk_right t).contDiffAt

/-- Same-path almost-everywhere agreement yields actual pointwise velocity
and normalized-pressure agreement throughout the open finite-cap/tail overlap.

The common-path premises use the same orientation as `HasSmoothTail`:
`w r =ᵐ classical_velocity r`. They are required at every overlap time, not
merely almost every time. No weak representative is differentiated here.
-/
theorem finite_cap_tail_overlap_of_same_path_ae
    (ν T δ : ℝ) (a : Field) (u v w : Velocity) (p q : Pressure)
    (H : InitialClassicalFront ν T a u p) (K : ClassicalTail ν δ v q)
    (hδ0 : 0 ≤ δ)
    (hfront_agrees : ∀ r ∈ Ioo δ T, w r =ᵐ[volume.restrict unitCube] u r)
    (htail_agrees : ∀ r ∈ Ioo δ T, w r =ᵐ[volume.restrict unitCube] v r) :
    (∀ r ∈ Ioo δ T, u r = v r) ∧ (∀ r ∈ Ioo δ T, p r = q r) := by
  have hfront_time (r : ℝ) (hr : r ∈ Ioo δ T) : r ∈ Ico (0 : ℝ) T :=
    ⟨hδ0.trans hr.1.le, hr.2⟩
  have hfront_subset : {z : ℝ × Vec | z.1 ∈ Ioo δ T} ⊆
      initialFrontSpacetime T := by
    intro z hz
    exact ⟨hδ0.trans hz.1.le, hz.2⟩
  have htail_subset : {z : ℝ × Vec | z.1 ∈ Ioo δ T} ⊆
      tailSpacetime δ := by
    intro z hz
    exact hz.1.le
  have hu_smooth : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ × Vec => u z.1 z.2)
      {z : ℝ × Vec | z.1 ∈ Ioo δ T} := H.velocity_smooth.mono hfront_subset
  have hv_smooth : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ × Vec => v z.1 z.2)
      {z : ℝ × Vec | z.1 ∈ Ioo δ T} := K.velocity_smooth.mono htail_subset
  have huv : ∀ r ∈ Ioo δ T, u r = v r := by
    intro r hr
    apply continuous_periodic_field_eq_of_cube_ae
      (velocity_slice_contDiff_on_open_time_set isOpen_Ioo hu_smooth hr).continuous
      (velocity_slice_contDiff_on_open_time_set isOpen_Ioo hv_smooth hr).continuous
      (H.velocity_periodic r (hfront_time r hr)) (K.velocity_periodic r hr.1.le)
    exact (hfront_agrees r hr).symm.trans (htail_agrees r hr)
  refine ⟨huv, ?_⟩
  apply normalized_pressure_eq_on_jointly_smooth_velocity_overlap isOpen_Ioo huv
  · intro r hr
    exact H.equation r (hfront_time r hr)
  · intro r hr
    exact K.equation r hr.1.le
  · exact H.pressure_smooth.mono hfront_subset
  · exact K.pressure_smooth.mono htail_subset
  · intro r hr
    exact H.pressure_mean_zero r (hfront_time r hr)
  · intro r hr
    exact K.pressure_mean_zero r hr.1.le

end

/-!
An admitted finite initial classical pair supplies its own physical trace,
local-front interface, compact Serrin bounds and same-Leray--Hopf-path
identification. Smooth data alone are not used to manufacture this pair.

The strong initial L2 trace is proved from actual joint continuity up to zero
and dominated integration on the compact cube. It is not an admission field.
No global continuation or universal finite-cap admission is concluded here.

Prepared source only; matching external cached verification is pending.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

open Set Filter MeasureTheory SingularClosure QuasiFeffermanB
open scoped ContDiff ENNReal Topology

namespace MethbokeAddon.WeakFouriermanB

noncomputable section

/-- Spatial restriction at the time boundary still gives an ordinary smooth
spatial field, since every spatial direction remains inside the cylinder. -/
theorem initial_front_smooth_slices
    (ν T : ℝ) (a : Field) (u : Velocity) (p : Pressure)
    (H : InitialClassicalFront ν T a u p)
    (r : ℝ) (hr : r ∈ Ico (0 : ℝ) T) : SmoothSigmaZero (u r) := by
  have hsmooth : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (u r) := by
    rw [← contDiffOn_univ]
    exact H.velocity_smooth.comp
      (contDiff_const.prodMk contDiff_id).contDiffOn (fun x _ => hr)
  exact ⟨hsmooth, H.velocity_periodic r hr,
    H.divergence_free r hr, H.velocity_mean_zero r hr⟩

theorem initial_front_initial_smooth
    (ν T : ℝ) (a : Field) (u : Velocity) (p : Pressure)
    (H : InitialClassicalFront ν T a u p) (hT : 0 < T) : SmoothSigmaZero a := by
  simpa only [H.initial] using
    initial_front_smooth_slices ν T a u p H 0 ⟨le_rfl, hT⟩

theorem initial_front_compact_cylinder_continuous
    (ν T : ℝ) (a : Field) (u : Velocity) (p : Pressure)
    (H : InitialClassicalFront ν T a u p)
    (τ : ℝ) (hτT : τ < T) :
    ContinuousOn (fun z : ℝ × Vec => u z.1 z.2)
      (Icc (0 : ℝ) τ ×ˢ unitCube) := by
  apply H.velocity_smooth.continuousOn.mono
  intro z hz
  exact ⟨hz.1.1, hz.1.2.trans_lt hτT⟩

/-- Dominated parameter integration works at the initial boundary as well.
The bound is extracted from the actual compact cylinder. -/
theorem initial_real_cube_integral_continuousOn_Icc
    (T : ℝ) (F : ℝ → Vec → ℝ)
    (hF : ContinuousOn (fun z : ℝ × Vec => F z.1 z.2) (initialFrontSpacetime T))
    (τ : ℝ) (hτT : τ < T) :
    ContinuousOn (fun r => ∫ x in unitCube, F r x) (Icc (0 : ℝ) τ) := by
  have hsubset : Icc (0 : ℝ) τ ×ˢ unitCube ⊆ initialFrontSpacetime T := by
    intro z hz
    exact ⟨hz.1.1, hz.1.2.trans_lt hτT⟩
  obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ :=
    ((isCompact_Icc : IsCompact (Icc (0 : ℝ) τ)).prod isCompact_unitCube).exists_bound_of_continuousOn
      (hF.mono hsubset)
  apply continuousOn_of_dominated (μ := volume.restrict unitCube)
    (bound := fun _ : Vec => C)
  · intro r hr
    have hc : Continuous (F r) :=
      hF.comp_continuous (continuous_const.prodMk continuous_id)
        (fun _ => ⟨hr.1, hr.2.trans_lt hτT⟩)
    exact hc.aestronglyMeasurable
  · intro r hr
    filter_upwards [ae_restrict_mem isCompact_unitCube.measurableSet] with x hx
    exact hC (r, x) ⟨hr, hx⟩
  · exact continuous_const.continuousOn.integrableOn_compact isCompact_unitCube
  · filter_upwards with x
    exact hF.comp (continuous_id.prodMk continuous_const).continuousOn
      (fun r hr => ⟨hr.1, hr.2.trans_lt hτT⟩)

/-- The literal strong physical L2 trace follows from initial-cylinder
smoothness and its actual initial value. It is not separately assumed. -/
theorem initial_front_strong_initial_trace
    (ν T : ℝ) (a : Field) (u : Velocity) (p : Pressure)
    (H : InitialClassicalFront ν T a u p) (hT : 0 < T) :
    Tendsto (fun r => eLpNorm (u r - a) 2 (volume.restrict unitCube))
      (𝓝[>] (0 : ℝ)) (𝓝 0) := by
  have ha : SmoothSigmaZero a := initial_front_initial_smooth ν T a u p H hT
  let τ : ℝ := T / 2
  have hτ : 0 < τ := by dsimp [τ]; linarith
  have hτT : τ < T := by dsimp [τ]; linarith
  have hF : ContinuousOn
      (fun z : ℝ × Vec => ‖u z.1 z.2 - a z.2‖ ^ 2) (initialFrontSpacetime T) :=
    (H.velocity_smooth.continuousOn.sub
      (ha.smooth.continuous.comp continuous_snd).continuousOn).norm.pow 2
  have hE : ContinuousOn (fun r => physicalEnergy (u r - a)) (Icc (0 : ℝ) τ) := by
    simpa only [physicalEnergy_eq_integral_norm_sq, Pi.sub_apply] using
      initial_real_cube_integral_continuousOn_Icc T
        (fun r x => ‖u r x - a x‖ ^ 2) hF τ hτT
  have hE0 : physicalEnergy (u 0 - a) = 0 := by
    simp [H.initial, physicalEnergy_eq_integral_norm_sq]
  have hτevent : ∀ᶠ r : ℝ in 𝓝[>] (0 : ℝ), r < τ :=
    nhdsWithin_le_nhds (Iio_mem_nhds hτ)
  have hwindow : Icc (0 : ℝ) τ ∈ 𝓝[>] (0 : ℝ) := by
    filter_upwards [self_mem_nhdsWithin, hτevent] with r hr hrτ
    exact ⟨hr.le, hrτ.le⟩
  have hfilter : 𝓝[>] (0 : ℝ) ≤ 𝓝[Icc (0 : ℝ) τ] (0 : ℝ) :=
    le_inf nhdsWithin_le_nhds (le_principal_iff.mpr hwindow)
  have hEtrace : Tendsto (fun r => physicalEnergy (u r - a))
      (𝓝[>] (0 : ℝ)) (𝓝 (0 : ℝ)) := by
    have h : Tendsto (fun r => physicalEnergy (u r - a))
        (𝓝[>] (0 : ℝ)) (𝓝 (physicalEnergy (u 0 - a))) :=
      (hE 0 ⟨le_rfl, hτ.le⟩).mono_left hfilter
    simpa only [hE0] using h
  have hlimit : Tendsto
      (fun r => ENNReal.ofReal (Real.sqrt (physicalEnergy (u r - a))))
      (𝓝[>] (0 : ℝ)) (𝓝 0) := by
    have hsqrt := (Real.continuous_sqrt.tendsto (0 : ℝ)).comp hEtrace
    simpa only [Function.comp_def, Real.sqrt_zero, ENNReal.ofReal_zero] using
      ENNReal.tendsto_ofReal hsqrt
  have hTevent : ∀ᶠ r : ℝ in 𝓝[>] (0 : ℝ), r < T :=
    nhdsWithin_le_nhds (Iio_mem_nhds hT)
  apply hlimit.congr'
  filter_upwards [self_mem_nhdsWithin, hTevent] with r hr hrT
  have hur := initial_front_smooth_slices ν T a u p H r ⟨hr.le, hrT⟩
  have hmem : MemLp (u r - a) 2 (volume.restrict unitCube) :=
    (smooth_datum_memLp hur).sub (smooth_datum_memLp ha)
  have hsq := critical_velocity_L2_toReal_sq_eq_physicalEnergy (u r - a) hmem
  have hroot : Real.sqrt (physicalEnergy (u r - a)) =
      (eLpNorm (u r - a) 2 (volume.restrict unitCube)).toReal := by
    rw [← hsq, Real.sqrt_sq ENNReal.toReal_nonneg]
  rw [hroot, ENNReal.ofReal_toReal hmem.eLpNorm_lt_top.ne]

/-- All LocalPhysicalNSEFront fields are derived from the initial classical
pair, including the previously independent strong initial trace field. -/
theorem initial_front_to_local_physical
    (ν T : ℝ) (a : Field) (u : Velocity) (p : Pressure)
    (H : InitialClassicalFront ν T a u p) (hν : 0 < ν) (hT : 0 < T) :
    LocalPhysicalNSEFront ν T a u p := by
  exact {
    viscosity_pos := hν
    time_pos := hT
    initial_smooth := initial_front_initial_smooth ν T a u p H hT
    initial_value := H.initial
    velocity_smooth := H.velocity_smooth.mono (fun z hz => ⟨hz.1.le, hz.2⟩)
    pressure_smooth := H.pressure_smooth.mono (fun z hz => ⟨hz.1.le, hz.2⟩)
    velocity_periodic := fun r hr => H.velocity_periodic r ⟨hr.1.le, hr.2⟩
    pressure_periodic := fun r hr => H.pressure_periodic r ⟨hr.1.le, hr.2⟩
    divergence_free := fun r hr => H.divergence_free r ⟨hr.1.le, hr.2⟩
    velocity_mean_zero := fun r hr => H.velocity_mean_zero r ⟨hr.1.le, hr.2⟩

/-!
Actual finite-cap classical admission through the original QFB cutoff.

The premise is an actual initial classical NSE pair on the half-open finite
cylinder, smooth up to time zero. Its horizon lies strictly beyond the literal
cutoff of the physical L2 representative of the same datum. The initial strong
trace and every shorter Serrin bound are derived from this pair. Q01 gives one
original weak path; finite-front comparison and Q09 identify both classical
pairs with that same path. Spatial continuity and normalized pressure then give
the actual overlap equalities used by the explicitly constructed smooth splice.

This is the conditional R0 admission step. It does not construct an initial
classical cap from arbitrary smooth data or extend an arbitrary analytic germ
to the cutoff. No global-solution or continuation field is an input premise.

Prepared source only; matching external cached compiler/type/axiom evidence is
pending. No local Lean execution. Staged outside active Material discovery.

open Set MeasureTheory SingularClosure QuasiFeffermanB
open scoped ContDiff Topology

namespace MethbokeAddon.WeakFouriermanB

noncomputable section

/-- An actual initial classical cap strictly beyond the QFB cutoff admits a
global smooth NSE pair preserving both its velocity and normalized pressure
throughout the original half-open cap. Existence of that finite cap is the
explicit admission premise; universal admission is not asserted.
-/
theorem finite_cap_classical_admission
    (ν T : ℝ) (a : Field) (u : Velocity) (p : Pressure)
    (hν : 0 < ν) (hcap : cutoff (criticalL2Representative a) ν < T)
    (H : InitialClassicalFront ν T a u p) :
    ∃ (U : Velocity) (P : Pressure), GlobalSmoothNSE ν a U P ∧
      ∀ r ∈ Ico (0 : ℝ) T, U r = u r ∧ P r = p r := by
  have hcutoff0 : 0 ≤ cutoff (criticalL2Representative a) ν :=
    CUTOFF_NONNEG (criticalL2Representative a) hν
  have hT : 0 < T := hcutoff0.trans_lt hcap
  have ha : SmoothSigmaZero a := initial_front_initial_smooth ν T a u p H hT
  obtain ⟨w, G, hw, hw0, hfront⟩ :=
    initial_front_original_leray_hopf ν T a u p H hν hT
  let δ : ℝ := (cutoff (criticalL2Representative a) ν + T) / 2
  have hcutoffδ : cutoff (criticalL2Representative a) ν < δ := by
    dsimp [δ]
    linarith
  have hδT : δ < T := by
    dsimp [δ]
    linarith
  have hδ0 : 0 < δ := hcutoff0.trans_lt hcutoffδ
  obtain ⟨v, q, K, htail⟩ :=
    Q09_POST_CUTOFF_SMOOTHNESS hν (smooth_datum_energySigmaZero ha) hw hcutoffδ
  have hoverlap := finite_cap_tail_overlap_of_same_path_ae ν T δ a u v w p q
    H K hδ0.le
    (fun r hr => hfront r ⟨hδ0.trans hr.1, hr.2⟩)
    (fun r hr => htail r hr.1.le)
  obtain ⟨U, P, hglobal, hpreserve, hlate⟩ :=
    finite_cap_gluing ν T δ a u v p q H K hδ0.le hδT hoverlap.1 hoverlap.2
  exact ⟨U, P, hglobal, hpreserve⟩

end

classical admission. The extension is an AnalyticOnNhd assertion for the actual
velocity and pressure on the open cylinder (-epsilon,T) x R^3; it is not a

The physical NSE equation in this interface is required only at nonnegative
times below T. The existing timeDerivative is a derivative within Ici 0, so it

def analyticCapSpacetime (ε T : ℝ) : Set (ℝ × Vec) :=
  {z | -ε < z.1 ∧ z.1 < T}

/-- Literal analytic velocity and pressure through t=0, with the actual
forward physical equation, initial value and periodic mean-zero semantics.
Positivity of epsilon and viscosity are explicit hypotheses of admission.
-/
structure AnalyticForwardNSECap (ν ε T : ℝ) (a : Field)
    (u : Velocity) (p : Pressure) : Prop where
  velocity_analytic :
    AnalyticOnNhd ℝ (fun z : ℝ × Vec => u z.1 z.2) (analyticCapSpacetime ε T)
  pressure_analytic :
    AnalyticOnNhd ℝ (fun z : ℝ × Vec => p z.1 z.2) (analyticCapSpacetime ε T)
  velocity_periodic : ∀ t ∈ Ico (0 : ℝ) T, SpatialPeriodic (u t)
  pressure_periodic : ∀ t ∈ Ico (0 : ℝ) T, SpatialPeriodic (p t)
  divergence_free : ∀ t ∈ Ico (0 : ℝ) T, ∀ x : Vec, divergence (u t) x = 0
  equation : ∀ t ∈ Ico (0 : ℝ) T, ∀ x : Vec,
    timeDerivative u t x + convection (u t) x + SingularClosure.gradient (p t) x =
      ν • laplacian (u t) x
  initial : u 0 = a
  velocity_mean_zero : ∀ t ∈ Ico (0 : ℝ) T, MeanZero (u t)
  pressure_mean_zero : ∀ t ∈ Ico (0 : ℝ) T, PressureMeanZero (p t)

theorem initial_front_subset_analytic_cap (ε T : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε) :
    initialFrontSpacetime T ⊆ analyticCapSpacetime ε T := by
  intro z hz
  have hneg : -ε < 0 := by linarith
  exact ⟨hneg.trans_le hz.1, hz.2⟩

/-- Analytic regularity is converted to smoothness on the same existing
domain, then restricted to the actual nonnegative finite cylinder.
-/
theorem analytic_forward_cap_to_initial_classical
    (ν ε T : ℝ) (a : Field) (u : Velocity) (p : Pressure)
    (hε : 0 < ε) (H : AnalyticForwardNSECap ν ε T a u p) :
    InitialClassicalFront ν T a u p := by
  have hsub := initial_front_subset_analytic_cap ε T hε
  have hu : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ × Vec => u z.1 z.2)
      (analyticCapSpacetime ε T) := H.velocity_analytic.contDiffOn_of_completeSpace
  have hp : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ × Vec => p z.1 z.2)
      (analyticCapSpacetime ε T) := H.pressure_analytic.contDiffOn_of_completeSpace
  exact {
    velocity_smooth := hu.mono hsub
    pressure_smooth := hp.mono hsub
    velocity_periodic := H.velocity_periodic
    pressure_periodic := H.pressure_periodic
    divergence_free := H.divergence_free
    equation := H.equation
    initial := H.initial
    velocity_mean_zero := H.velocity_mean_zero
    pressure_mean_zero := H.pressure_mean_zero
  }

/-- Conditional finite-cap analytic admission with the original literal QFB
cutoff. The resulting global pair retains the supplied velocity and pressure
at every nonnegative time strictly below the cap.
-/
theorem analytic_forward_cap_admission
    (ν ε T : ℝ) (a : Field) (u : Velocity) (p : Pressure)
    (hν : 0 < ν) (hε : 0 < ε)
    (hcap : cutoff (criticalL2Representative a) ν < T)
    (H : AnalyticForwardNSECap ν ε T a u p) :
    ∃ (U : Velocity) (P : Pressure), GlobalSmoothNSE ν a U P ∧
      ∀ r ∈ Ico (0 : ℝ) T, U r = u r ∧ P r = p r :=
  finite_cap_classical_admission ν T a u p hν hcap
    (analytic_forward_cap_to_initial_classical ν ε T a u p hε H)

/-- The same criterion written in the physical-energy normalization:
tau_Q = (physicalEnergy a)^2 / (8*pi^2*nu^5). The admitted analytic front
supplies smooth datum admission, so no equality with a representative norm
is assumed separately.
-/
theorem analytic_forward_cap_admission_physical_cutoff
    (ν ε T : ℝ) (a : Field) (u : Velocity) (p : Pressure)
    (hν : 0 < ν) (hε : 0 < ε)
    (hcap : (physicalEnergy a) ^ 2 / (8 * Real.pi ^ 2 * ν ^ 5) < T)
    (H : AnalyticForwardNSECap ν ε T a u p) :
    ∃ (U : Velocity) (P : Pressure), GlobalSmoothNSE ν a U P ∧
      ∀ r ∈ Ico (0 : ℝ) T, U r = u r ∧ P r = p r := by
  have Hfront := analytic_forward_cap_to_initial_classical ν ε T a u p hε H
  have hnonneg : 0 ≤ (physicalEnergy a) ^ 2 / (8 * Real.pi ^ 2 * ν ^ 5) := by
    positivity
  have hT : 0 < T := hnonneg.trans_lt hcap
  have ha : SmoothSigmaZero a := initial_front_initial_smooth ν T a u p Hfront hT
  have hcut : cutoff (criticalL2Representative a) ν < T := by
    rw [smooth_datum_cutoff ha ν]
    exact hcap
  exact finite_cap_classical_admission ν T a u p hν hcut Hfront

end

/-!
Literal two-sided analytic NSE cap and its forward physical adapter.

Unlike the earlier forward interface, the equation here holds throughout
(-epsilon,T), including negative times, and uses the ordinary derivative
deriv (fun r => u r x) t. Actual joint analyticity supplies ordinary temporal

unique differentiability of Ici 0 identifies the ordinary derivative with
SingularClosure.timeDerivative. Thus no negative-time meaning is assigned

The record is the literal physical analytic-cap witness in the frozen G_nu
scope, with epsilon>0 and T beyond the cutoff supplied explicitly by the
admission theorem. This file does not construct such a cap from a local germ,
and leaves the universal germ-to-cap assertion R1 unresolved.

noncomputable section

/-- Actual joint analyticity yields an ordinary temporal derivative at each
time strictly inside the analytic cylinder, including negative times.
-/
theorem analytic_cap_time_differentiableAt
    (ε T : ℝ) (u : Velocity)
    (hu : AnalyticOnNhd ℝ (fun z : ℝ × Vec => u z.1 z.2) (analyticCapSpacetime ε T))
    (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Ioo (-ε) T) (x : Vec) :
    DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun r : ℝ => u r x) t := by
  have hjoint : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ × Vec => u z.1 z.2)
      (analyticCapSpacetime ε T) := hu.contDiffOn_of_completeSpace
  have htime : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun r : ℝ => u r x) (Ioo (-ε) T) :=
    hjoint.comp (contDiff_id.prodMk contDiff_const).contDiffOn (fun r hr => hr)
  exact (htime.differentiableOn (by simp) t ht).differentiableAt
    (isOpen_Ioo.mem_nhds ht)

/-- Ordinary and physical forward derivatives coincide at t=0 as well as at
positive times. The nonnegative-time hypothesis is essential to this adapter.
-/
theorem analytic_cap_forward_timeDerivative_eq_deriv
    (ε T : ℝ) (u : Velocity)
    (hu : AnalyticOnNhd ℝ (fun z : ℝ × Vec => u z.1 z.2) (analyticCapSpacetime ε T))
    (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Ioo (-ε) T) (ht0 : 0 ≤ t) (x : Vec) :
    timeDerivative u t x = deriv (fun r : ℝ => u r x) t := by
  have hd := analytic_cap_time_differentiableAt ε T u hu t ht x
  exact hd.hasDerivAt.hasDerivWithinAt.derivWithin ((uniqueDiffOn_Ici 0) t ht0)

/-- Literal jointly analytic NSE evolution on the full open two-sided cap.
Every equation and spatial constraint applies on that same actual interval.
Initial value is an equality of the physical fields, not merely a jet.
-/
structure AnalyticTwoSidedNSECap (ν ε T : ℝ) (a : Field)
    (u : Velocity) (p : Pressure) : Prop where
  velocity_analytic :
    AnalyticOnNhd ℝ (fun z : ℝ × Vec => u z.1 z.2) (analyticCapSpacetime ε T)
  pressure_analytic :
    AnalyticOnNhd ℝ (fun z : ℝ × Vec => p z.1 z.2) (analyticCapSpacetime ε T)
  velocity_periodic : ∀ t ∈ Ioo (-ε) T, SpatialPeriodic (u t)
  pressure_periodic : ∀ t ∈ Ioo (-ε) T, SpatialPeriodic (p t)
  divergence_free : ∀ t ∈ Ioo (-ε) T, ∀ x : Vec, divergence (u t) x = 0
  equation : ∀ t ∈ Ioo (-ε) T, ∀ x : Vec,
    deriv (fun r : ℝ => u r x) t + convection (u t) x + SingularClosure.gradient (p t) x =
      ν • laplacian (u t) x
  initial : u 0 = a
  velocity_mean_zero : ∀ t ∈ Ioo (-ε) T, MeanZero (u t)
  pressure_mean_zero : ∀ t ∈ Ioo (-ε) T, PressureMeanZero (p t)

/-- Restrict the full analytic solution to the forward physical interface.
The derivative conversion is proved rather than assumed in a record field.
-/
theorem analytic_two_sided_cap_to_forward
    (ν ε T : ℝ) (a : Field) (u : Velocity) (p : Pressure)
    (hε : 0 < ε) (H : AnalyticTwoSidedNSECap ν ε T a u p) :
    AnalyticForwardNSECap ν ε T a u p := by
  have hsub : Ico (0 : ℝ) T ⊆ Ioo (-ε) T := by
    intro t ht
    have hneg : -ε < 0 := by linarith
    exact ⟨hneg.trans_le ht.1, ht.2⟩
  refine {
    velocity_analytic := H.velocity_analytic
    pressure_analytic := H.pressure_analytic
    velocity_periodic := fun t ht => H.velocity_periodic t (hsub ht)
    pressure_periodic := fun t ht => H.pressure_periodic t (hsub ht)
    divergence_free := fun t ht => H.divergence_free t (hsub ht)
    equation := ?_
    initial := H.initial
    velocity_mean_zero := fun t ht => H.velocity_mean_zero t (hsub ht)
    pressure_mean_zero := fun t ht => H.pressure_mean_zero t (hsub ht)
  }
  intro t ht x
  rw [analytic_cap_forward_timeDerivative_eq_deriv ε T u H.velocity_analytic
    t (hsub ht) ht.1 x]
  exact H.equation t (hsub ht) x

/-- The actual two-sided analytic cap, strictly beyond the original QFB
cutoff, yields a global smooth pair preserving the full forward cap.
-/
theorem analytic_two_sided_cap_admission
    (ν ε T : ℝ) (a : Field) (u : Velocity) (p : Pressure)
    (hν : 0 < ν) (hε : 0 < ε)
    (hcap : cutoff (criticalL2Representative a) ν < T)
    (H : AnalyticTwoSidedNSECap ν ε T a u p) :
    ∃ (U : Velocity) (P : Pressure), GlobalSmoothNSE ν a U P ∧
      ∀ r ∈ Ico (0 : ℝ) T, U r = u r ∧ P r = p r :=
  analytic_forward_cap_admission ν ε T a u p hν hε hcap
    (analytic_two_sided_cap_to_forward ν ε T a u p hε H)

/-- Literal physical-energy cutoff version of the two-sided cap theorem.
The full analytic witness remains an explicit premise; universal existence
or extension of such a witness is not asserted.
-/
theorem analytic_two_sided_cap_admission_physical_cutoff
    (ν ε T : ℝ) (a : Field) (u : Velocity) (p : Pressure)
    (hν : 0 < ν) (hε : 0 < ε)
    (hcap : (physicalEnergy a) ^ 2 / (8 * Real.pi ^ 2 * ν ^ 5) < T)
    (H : AnalyticTwoSidedNSECap ν ε T a u p) :
    ∃ (U : Velocity) (P : Pressure), GlobalSmoothNSE ν a U P ∧
      ∀ r ∈ Ico (0 : ℝ) T, U r = u r ∧ P r = p r :=
  analytic_forward_cap_admission_physical_cutoff ν ε T a u p hν hε hcap
    (analytic_two_sided_cap_to_forward ν ε T a u p hε H)

end

/-- The original target data class: smooth periodic solenoidal mean-zero

def R_nu (ν : ℝ) : Set Field :=

    ∃ (U : Velocity) (P : Pressure), GlobalSmoothNSE ν a U P}

/-- The frozen QFB admission class, including the explicit zero branch.
The nonzero branch uses a genuine two-sided analytic physical solution,
not a formal jet and not the weaker forward-only analytic predicate. -/
def D_Q (ν : ℝ) : Set Field :=
  {(0 : Field)} ∪ {a | SmoothSigmaZero a ∧ a ≠ 0 ∧
    ∃ (ε : ℝ) (u : Velocity) (p : Pressure), 0 < ε ∧
      AnalyticTwoSidedNSECap ν ε (2 * cutoff (criticalL2Representative a) ν) a u p}

/-- A continuous periodic nonzero datum cannot become the zero physical L2
class: almost-everywhere equality upgrades to pointwise equality through
the existing physical Fourier injectivity theorem. -/
theorem smooth_datum_representative_ne_zero
    {a : Field} (ha : SmoothSigmaZero a) (ha0 : a ≠ 0) :
    criticalL2Representative a ≠ 0 := by
  intro hzero
  have hrepzero : (criticalL2Representative a : Field)
      =ᵐ[volume.restrict unitCube] (0 : Field) := by
    rw [hzero]
    exact Lp.coeFn_zero Vec 2 (volume.restrict unitCube)
  apply ha0
  exact continuous_periodic_field_eq_of_cube_ae
    ha.smooth.continuous smoothSigmaZero_zero.smooth.continuous
    ha.periodic smoothSigmaZero_zero.periodic
    ((smooth_datum_representative_ae ha).symm.trans hrepzero)

every analytic germ belongs to D_Q, nor that every smooth datum is admitted.

  · obtain rfl := Set.mem_singleton_iff.mp hzero
    exact ⟨smoothSigmaZero_zero, 0, 0, globalSmoothNSE_zero ν⟩
  · have hcutoff : 0 < cutoff (criticalL2Representative a) ν :=
      CUTOFF_POS (criticalL2Representative a)
        (smooth_datum_representative_ne_zero hsmooth hne) hν
    obtain ⟨U, P, hglobal, hpreserve⟩ :=
      analytic_two_sided_cap_admission ν ε
        (2 * cutoff (criticalL2Representative a) ν) a u p hν hε
        (by linarith) H

/-!
A cubic differential inequality has a short-time bound determined only by
its cubic coefficient and its initial upper bound. The affine comparison
barrier produces the square budget used in the subsequent dissipation
estimate; no square-budget or continuation premise is assumed.

set_option autoImplicit false

open Set MeasureTheory
open scoped Interval

namespace MethbokeAddon.WeakFouriermanB

noncomputable section

def localCubicTime (κ R : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  1 / (16 * (κ + 1) * (R + 1) ^ 2)

theorem localCubicTime_pos {κ R : ℝ} (hκ : 0 ≤ κ) (hR : 0 ≤ R) :
    0 < localCubicTime κ R := by
  unfold localCubicTime
  positivity

/-- The right derivative at the initial time suffices for the affine fence.
The time and initial bounds contain no information about higher derivatives.
-/
theorem cubic_short_time_barrier
    {y d : ℝ → ℝ} {κ R T : ℝ}
    (hκ : 0 ≤ κ) (hR : 0 ≤ R) (hT : 0 ≤ T)
    (htime : T ≤ localCubicTime κ R)
    (hy : ContinuousOn y (Icc 0 T)) (hinit : y 0 ≤ R)
    (hderiv : ∀ t ∈ Ico 0 T, HasDerivWithinAt y (d t) (Ici 0) t)
    (hcubic : ∀ t ∈ Ico 0 T, d t ≤ κ * (y t) ^ 3) :
    ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T, y t ≤ 2 * (R + 1) := by
  let L : ℝ := 8 * (κ + 1) * (R + 1) ^ 3
  have hR1 : 0 < R + 1 := by linarith
  have hκ1 : 0 < κ + 1 := by linarith
  have hL : 0 < L := by dsimp [L]; positivity
  have hLtime : L * localCubicTime κ R = (R + 1) / 2 := by
    dsimp [L, localCubicTime]
    field_simp [ne_of_gt hκ1, ne_of_gt hR1]
    <;> ring
  have hfence_bound : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T,
      R + 1 + L * t ≤ 2 * (R + 1) := by
    intro t ht
    have hmul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (ht.2.trans htime) hL.le
    rw [hLtime] at hmul
    linarith
  have hfence : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T, y t ≤ R + 1 + L * t := by
    intro t ht
    refine image_le_of_deriv_right_lt_deriv_boundary
      (f' := d) (B := fun r => R + 1 + L * r) (B' := fun _ => L)
      hy ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ht
    · intro r hr
      exact (hderiv r hr).mono (fun s hs => hr.1.trans hs)
    · simpa only [mul_zero, add_zero] using hinit.trans (by linarith : R ≤ R + 1)
    · intro r
      simpa only [mul_one, id_eq] using!
        ((hasDerivAt_id r).const_mul L).const_add (R + 1)
    · intro r hr heq
      have hnonneg : 0 ≤ R + 1 + L * r :=
        add_nonneg hR1.le (mul_nonneg hL.le hr.1)
      have hcube := pow_le_pow_left₀ hnonneg (hfence_bound r ⟨hr.1, hr.2.le⟩) 3
      have hstrict : κ * (2 * (R + 1)) ^ 3 < L := by
        dsimp [L]
        nlinarith [pow_pos hR1 3]
      calc
        d r ≤ κ * (y r) ^ 3 := hcubic r hr
        _ = κ * (R + 1 + L * r) ^ 3 := by rw [heq]
        _ ≤ κ * (2 * (R + 1)) ^ 3 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hcube hκ
        _ < L := hstrict
  intro t ht
  exact (hfence t ht).trans (hfence_bound t ht)

/-- The short-time square budget is a conclusion of the differential
inequality and initial bound. -/
theorem cubic_short_time_square_budget
    {y d : ℝ → ℝ} {κ R T : ℝ}
    (hκ : 0 ≤ κ) (hR : 0 ≤ R) (hT : 0 ≤ T)
    (htime : T ≤ localCubicTime κ R)
    (hy : ContinuousOn y (Icc 0 T))
    (hnonneg : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T, 0 ≤ y t) (hinit : y 0 ≤ R)
    (hderiv : ∀ t ∈ Ico 0 T, HasDerivWithinAt y (d t) (Ici 0) t)
    (hcubic : ∀ t ∈ Ico 0 T, d t ≤ κ * (y t) ^ 3) :
    (∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..T, (y t) ^ 2) ≤ 4 * (R + 1) ^ 2 * T := by
  have hb := cubic_short_time_barrier hκ hR hT htime hy hinit hderiv hcubic
  have hpoint : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T, (y t) ^ 2 ≤ 4 * (R + 1) ^ 2 := by
    intro t ht
    have hsq := pow_le_pow_left₀ (hnonneg t ht) (hb t ht) 2
    nlinarith
  calc
    (∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..T, (y t) ^ 2) ≤
        ∫ _t in (0 : ℝ)..T, 4 * (R + 1) ^ 2 :=
      intervalIntegral.integral_mono_on hT
        ((hy.pow 2).intervalIntegrable_of_Icc hT) intervalIntegrable_const hpoint
    _ = 4 * (R + 1) ^ 2 * T := by
      rw [intervalIntegral.integral_const]
      simp only [sub_zero, smul_eq_mul]
      ring

/-- A short-time bound on the instantaneous energy plus accumulated
dissipation, with its square budget derived by the affine barrier. -/
theorem cubic_short_time_accumulation
    {y z d : ℝ → ℝ} {ν κ R T : ℝ}
    (hν : 0 < ν) (hκ : 0 ≤ κ) (hR : 0 ≤ R) (hT : 0 ≤ T)
    (htime : T ≤ localCubicTime κ R)
    (hy : ContinuousOn y (Icc 0 T)) (hz : ContinuousOn z (Icc 0 T))
    (hd : ContinuousOn d (Icc 0 T))
    (hnonneg : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T, 0 ≤ y t) (hinit : y 0 ≤ R)
    (hderiv : ∀ t ∈ Ico 0 T, HasDerivWithinAt y (d t) (Ici 0) t)
    (hcubic : ∀ t ∈ Ico 0 T, d t + ν * (z t) ^ 2 ≤ κ * (y t) ^ 3) :
    ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T,
      y t + ν * (∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..t, (z s) ^ 2) ≤
        (R + 1) * Real.exp (κ * (4 * (R + 1) ^ 2 * T)) := by
  have hupper : ∀ t ∈ Ico 0 T, d t ≤ κ * (y t) ^ 3 := by
    intro t ht
    have hzpos := mul_nonneg hν.le (sq_nonneg (z t))
    linarith [hcubic t ht]
  have hbudget := cubic_short_time_square_budget
    hκ hR hT htime hy hnonneg hinit hderiv hupper
  apply SingularClosure.CUBIC_ENERGY_OF_SQUARE_BUDGET
    hν hκ hT (by positivity) hy hz hd hnonneg
    (hinit.trans (by linarith : R ≤ R + 1)) ?_ ?_ hbudget
  · intro t ht
    exact (hderiv t ⟨ht.1.le, ht.2⟩).hasDerivAt (Ici_mem_nhds ht.1)
  · intro t ht
    exact hcubic t ⟨ht.1.le, ht.2⟩

end

end MethbokeAddon.WeakFouriermanB

import SingularClosure.SobolevTrajectoryCalculus

/-!
Cutoff-uniform short-time bounds for the actual Fourier--Galerkin solutions.
The time depends only on viscosity and an upper bound for the initial
physical H1 seminorm squared. The actual Galerkin equation and the proved
cutoff-independent nonlinear estimate supply the cubic inequality.

No AX6, square-budget, compactness, physical local-solution or continuation
premise is introduced. This is the finite-dimensional estimate needed before
the separate physical local-existence construction.

Prepared for cached external verification. No local Lean execution.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

open Set MeasureTheory SingularClosure
open scoped Interval

namespace MethbokeAddon.WeakFouriermanB

noncomputable section

def galerkinEnstrophyConstant : ℝ :=
  Classical.choose GALERKIN_COEFFICIENT_ENSTROPHY_INEQUALITY

theorem galerkinEnstrophyConstant_pos : 0 < galerkinEnstrophyConstant :=
  (Classical.choose_spec GALERKIN_COEFFICIENT_ENSTROPHY_INEQUALITY).1

theorem galerkinEnstrophyConstant_bound
    (ν : ℝ) (hν : 0 < ν) (a : Field) (N : ℕ)
    (g : GalerkinSolution ν a N) (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 ≤ t) :
    ∃ d : ℝ,
      HasDerivWithinAt (fun r => coefficientDissipation N (g.coeff r)) d (Ici 0) t ∧
        d + ν * coefficientLaplacianSquare N (g.coeff t) ≤
          galerkinEnstrophyConstant / ν ^ 3 * (coefficientDissipation N (g.coeff t)) ^ 3 :=
  (Classical.choose_spec GALERKIN_COEFFICIENT_ENSTROPHY_INEQUALITY).2 ν hν a N g t ht

def localGalerkinTime (ν R : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  localCubicTime (galerkinEnstrophyConstant / ν ^ 3) R

def localGalerkinAccumulationBound (ν R : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  (R + 1) * Real.exp
    ((galerkinEnstrophyConstant / ν ^ 3) * (4 * (R + 1) ^ 2 * localGalerkinTime ν R))

theorem localGalerkinTime_pos {ν R : ℝ} (hν : 0 < ν) (hR : 0 ≤ R) :
    0 < localGalerkinTime ν R := by
  apply localCubicTime_pos _ hR
  exact div_nonneg galerkinEnstrophyConstant_pos.le (pow_nonneg hν.le _)

theorem localGalerkinAccumulationBound_nonneg {ν R : ℝ} (hR : 0 ≤ R) :
    0 ≤ localGalerkinAccumulationBound ν R := by
  unfold localGalerkinAccumulationBound
  positivity

/-- The enstrophy-rate expression is the derivative at every nonnegative
time, including the right derivative at zero. -/
theorem galerkin_local_cubic_inequality
    (ν : ℝ) (hν : 0 < ν) (a : Field) (N : ℕ)
    (g : GalerkinSolution ν a N) (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 ≤ t) :
    coefficientEnstrophyRate ν N (g.coeff t) +
        ν * coefficientLaplacianSquare N (g.coeff t) ≤
      galerkinEnstrophyConstant / ν ^ 3 * (coefficientDissipation N (g.coeff t)) ^ 3 := by
  obtain ⟨d, hd, hb⟩ := galerkinEnstrophyConstant_bound ν hν a N g t ht
  have hrate : HasDerivWithinAt
      (fun r => coefficientDissipation N (g.coeff r))
      (coefficientEnstrophyRate ν N (g.coeff t)) (Ici 0) t :=
    g.coefficientDissipation_hasDerivWithinAt ht
  have heq : coefficientEnstrophyRate ν N (g.coeff t) = d :=
    (hrate.derivWithin ((uniqueDiffOn_Ici 0) t ht)).symm.trans
      (hd.derivWithin ((uniqueDiffOn_Ici 0) t ht))
  simpa only [heq] using hb

/-- Actual finite Galerkin H1/H2 estimates on one common interval. The
initial higher Sobolev norms and the cutoff do not occur in its length or
in its bound. The square budget is derived, rather than supplied.
-/
theorem galerkin_uniform_local_enstrophy_accumulation
    (ν R : ℝ) (hν : 0 < ν) (hR : 0 ≤ R)
    (a : Field) (ha : SmoothSigmaZero a) (hinit : physicalDissipation a ≤ R) :
    ∀ (N : ℕ) (g : GalerkinSolution ν a N),
      ∀ t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) (localGalerkinTime ν R),
        coefficientDissipation N (g.coeff t) ≤ 2 * (R + 1) ∧
        coefficientDissipation N (g.coeff t) +
            ν * (∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..t, coefficientLaplacianSquare N (g.coeff s)) ≤
          localGalerkinAccumulationBound ν R := by
  intro N g
  let T : ℝ := localGalerkinTime ν R
  let κ : ℝ := galerkinEnstrophyConstant / ν ^ 3
  let y : ℝ → ℝ := fun t => coefficientDissipation N (g.coeff t)
  let z : ℝ → ℝ := fun t => Real.sqrt (coefficientLaplacianSquare N (g.coeff t))
  let d : ℝ → ℝ := fun t => coefficientEnstrophyRate ν N (g.coeff t)
  have hT : 0 ≤ T := (localGalerkinTime_pos hν hR).le
  have hκ : 0 ≤ κ :=
    div_nonneg galerkinEnstrophyConstant_pos.le (pow_nonneg hν.le _)
  have hy : ContinuousOn y (Icc 0 T) :=
    g.coefficientDissipation_continuousOn.mono (fun t ht => ht.1)
  have hz : ContinuousOn z (Icc 0 T) :=
    (Real.continuous_sqrt.comp_continuousOn
      g.coefficientLaplacianSquare_continuousOn).mono (fun t ht => ht.1)
  have hd : ContinuousOn d (Icc 0 T) :=
    g.coefficientEnstrophyRate_continuousOn.mono (fun t ht => ht.1)
  have hy0 : y 0 ≤ R := (g.coefficientDissipation_initial_le ha).trans hinit
  have hnonneg : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T, 0 ≤ y t :=
    fun t _ => coefficientDissipation_nonneg N (g.coeff t)
  have hderiv : ∀ t ∈ Ico 0 T, HasDerivWithinAt y (d t) (Ici 0) t :=
    fun t ht => g.coefficientDissipation_hasDerivWithinAt ht.1
  have hcubic : ∀ t ∈ Ico 0 T, d t + ν * (z t) ^ 2 ≤ κ * (y t) ^ 3 := by
    intro t ht
    dsimp only [z]
    rw [Real.sq_sqrt (coefficientLaplacianSquare_nonneg N (g.coeff t))]
    exact galerkin_local_cubic_inequality ν hν a N g t ht.1
  have hupper : ∀ t ∈ Ico 0 T, d t ≤ κ * (y t) ^ 3 := by
    intro t ht
    have hzpos := mul_nonneg hν.le (sq_nonneg (z t))
    linarith [hcubic t ht]
  have hpoint := cubic_short_time_barrier hκ hR hT le_rfl hy hy0 hderiv hupper
  have hacc := cubic_short_time_accumulation
    hν hκ hR hT le_rfl hy hz hd hnonneg hy0 hderiv hcubic
  have hzsq (s : ℝ) : (z s) ^ 2 = coefficientLaplacianSquare N (g.coeff s) :=
    Real.sq_sqrt (coefficientLaplacianSquare_nonneg N (g.coeff s))
  intro t ht
  refine ⟨hpoint t ht, ?_⟩
  simpa only [y, κ, T, localGalerkinAccumulationBound, hzsq] using hacc t ht

/-- The same uniform estimate expressed entirely by the actual physical
gradient and Laplacian integrals of the Galerkin velocity.
-/
theorem galerkin_uniform_local_physical_accumulation
    (ν R : ℝ) (hν : 0 < ν) (hR : 0 ≤ R)
    (a : Field) (ha : SmoothSigmaZero a) (hinit : physicalDissipation a ≤ R) :
    ∀ (N : ℕ) (g : GalerkinSolution ν a N),
      ∀ t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) (localGalerkinTime ν R),
        physicalDissipation (g.velocity t) ≤ 2 * (R + 1) ∧
        physicalDissipation (g.velocity t) +
            ν * (∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..t,
              ∫ x in unitCube, ‖laplacian (g.velocity s) x‖ ^ 2) ≤
          localGalerkinAccumulationBound ν R := by
  intro N g t ht
  obtain ⟨hpoint, hacc⟩ :=
    galerkin_uniform_local_enstrophy_accumulation ν R hν hR a ha hinit N g t ht
  have he : physicalDissipation (g.velocity t) = coefficientDissipation N (g.coeff t) :=
    g.physicalDissipation_eq ht.1
  have hZ : (∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..t,
      ∫ x in unitCube, ‖laplacian (g.velocity s) x‖ ^ 2) =
        ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..t, coefficientLaplacianSquare N (g.coeff s) := by
    apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr
    intro s hs
    have hs' : s ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) t := by
      simpa only [uIcc_of_le ht.1] using hs
    exact finite_laplacian_integral_norm_sq N (g.coeff s) (g.real_symmetry s hs'.1)
  simpa only [he, hZ] using And.intro hpoint hacc

/-- The same interval supplies the literal H1 supremum and integrated H2
norm required by the high-order bootstrap, without a uniform AX6 premise.
-/
theorem galerkin_uniform_local_sobolev_bounds
    (ν R : ℝ) (hν : 0 < ν) (hR : 0 ≤ R)
    (a : Field) (ha : SmoothSigmaZero a) (hinit : physicalDissipation a ≤ R) :
    ∀ (N : ℕ) (g : GalerkinSolution ν a N),
      (∀ t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) (localGalerkinTime ν R),
        ‖g.sobolevState 1 t‖ ^ 2 ≤ 4 * (R + 1)) ∧
      IntervalIntegrable (fun t => ‖g.sobolevState 2 t‖ ^ 2)
        volume 0 (localGalerkinTime ν R) ∧
      (∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..(localGalerkinTime ν R), ‖g.sobolevState 2 t‖ ^ 2) ≤
        6 * (R + 1) * localGalerkinTime ν R + localGalerkinAccumulationBound ν R / ν := by
  intro N g
  let T : ℝ := localGalerkinTime ν R
  have hT : 0 ≤ T := (localGalerkinTime_pos hν hR).le
  have hb := galerkin_uniform_local_enstrophy_accumulation ν R hν hR a ha hinit N g
  have hiH2 : IntervalIntegrable (fun t => ‖g.sobolevState 2 t‖ ^ 2) volume 0 T :=
    (((g.sobolevState_continuousOn 2).mono (fun t ht => ht.1)).norm.pow 2).intervalIntegrable_of_Icc hT
  have hiZ : IntervalIntegrable
      (fun t => coefficientLaplacianSquare N (g.coeff t)) volume 0 T :=
    (g.coefficientLaplacianSquare_continuousOn.mono
      (fun t ht => ht.1)).intervalIntegrable_of_Icc hT
  have hZ : (∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..T, coefficientLaplacianSquare N (g.coeff t)) ≤
      localGalerkinAccumulationBound ν R / ν := by
    have hacc := (hb T ⟨hT, le_rfl⟩).2
    have hD := coefficientDissipation_nonneg N (g.coeff T)
    apply (le_div_iff₀ hν).2
    nlinarith
  refine ⟨?_, hiH2, ?_⟩
  · intro t ht
    change ‖finiteSobolev 1 N (g.coeff t)‖ ^ 2 ≤ _
    rw [finiteSobolev_H1_norm_sq]
    have hD := (hb t ht).1
    have hE := coefficientEnergy_le_dissipation N (g.coeff t)
    linarith
  · calc
      (∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..T, ‖g.sobolevState 2 t‖ ^ 2) ≤
          ∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..T, 6 * (R + 1) + coefficientLaplacianSquare N (g.coeff t) := by
        apply intervalIntegral.integral_mono_on hT hiH2 (intervalIntegrable_const.add hiZ)
        intro t ht
        change ‖finiteSobolev 2 N (g.coeff t)‖ ^ 2 ≤ _
        rw [finiteSobolev_H2_norm_sq]
        have hD := (hb t ht).1
        have hE := coefficientEnergy_le_dissipation N (g.coeff t)
        linarith
      _ = 6 * (R + 1) * T +
          ∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..T, coefficientLaplacianSquare N (g.coeff t) := by
        rw [intervalIntegral.integral_add intervalIntegrable_const hiZ,
          intervalIntegral.integral_const]
        simp only [sub_zero, smul_eq_mul]
        ring
      _ ≤ 6 * (R + 1) * T + localGalerkinAccumulationBound ν R / ν :=
        add_le_add le_rfl hZ

end

end MethbokeAddon.WeakFouriermanB

import SingularClosure.HighOrderAccumulation
import SingularClosure.HighOrderTimeModulus

/-!
Finite-window preservation of every Sobolev order for smooth initial data.

The only uniform analytic input is the actual integral of the finite Galerkin
H2 norm on one fixed interval. The high-order estimate and the smooth initial
Fourier bound give all higher orders on that same interval, including time zero.
The interval never shrinks with the requested regularity order. These are
source candidates requiring matching external compiler and axiom evidence.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

open Set MeasureTheory SingularClosure
open scoped Interval

namespace MethbokeAddon.WeakFouriermanB
noncomputable section

theorem local_galerkin_high_order_accumulation
    (ν : ℝ) (hν : 0 < ν) (a : Field) (ha : SmoothSigmaZero a)
    (T : ℝ) (hT : 0 < T)
    (S : ℝ) (hS : 0 ≤ S)
    (hH2 : ∀ N : ℕ, 1 ≤ N → ∀ g : GalerkinSolution ν a N,
      (∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..T, ‖g.sobolevState 2 t‖ ^ 2) ≤ S)
    (m : ℕ) :
    ∃ B : ℝ, 0 ≤ B ∧ ∀ N : ℕ, 1 ≤ N → ∀ g : GalerkinSolution ν a N,
      ∀ t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) T,
        ‖g.sobolevState m t‖ ^ 2 +
          ν * (∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..t, ‖g.sobolevState (m + 1) s‖ ^ 2) ≤ B := by
  obtain ⟨C, hC, hineq⟩ := GALERKIN_HIGH_ORDER_DIFFERENTIAL_INEQUALITY m
  let E₀ : ℝ := ‖smoothDatumSobolev m a ha.smooth ha.periodic‖ ^ 2
  let M : ℝ := 2 * ν * T + C / ν * S
  refine ⟨E₀ * Real.exp M, mul_nonneg (sq_nonneg _) (Real.exp_pos _).le, ?_⟩
  intro N hN g
  let y : ℝ → ℝ := fun t => highOrderEnergy m N (g.coeff t)
  let z : ℝ → ℝ := fun t => Real.sqrt (highOrderEnergy (m + 1) N (g.coeff t))
  let d : ℝ → ℝ := fun t => (-2 * ν) *
    (highOrderEnergy (m + 1) N (g.coeff t) - highOrderEnergy m N (g.coeff t)) -
      2 * highOrderNonlinearPower m N (g.coeff t)
  let A : ℝ → ℝ := fun t => 2 * ν + C / ν * highOrderEnergy 2 N (g.coeff t)
  have hy : ContinuousOn y (Icc 0 T) :=
    (g.highOrderEnergy_continuousOn m).mono (fun t ht => ht.1)
  have hz : ContinuousOn z (Icc 0 T) :=
    (Real.continuous_sqrt.comp_continuousOn
      (g.highOrderEnergy_continuousOn (m + 1))).mono (fun t ht => ht.1)
  have hE2 : ContinuousOn (fun t => highOrderEnergy 2 N (g.coeff t)) (Icc 0 T) :=
    (g.highOrderEnergy_continuousOn 2).mono (fun t ht => ht.1)
  have hA : ContinuousOn A (Icc 0 T) :=
    continuousOn_const.add (continuousOn_const.mul hE2)
  have hA_nonneg (t : ℝ) (_ht : t ∈ Icc 0 T) : 0 ≤ A t := by
    exact add_nonneg (mul_nonneg (by norm_num) hν.le)
      (mul_nonneg (div_nonneg hC.le hν.le) (highOrderEnergy_nonneg _ _ _))
  have hderiv (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Ioo 0 T) : HasDerivAt y (d t) t :=
    (g.highOrderEnergy_balance m ht.1.le).hasDerivAt (Ici_mem_nhds ht.1)
  have hlinear (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Ioo 0 T) :
      d t + ν * (z t) ^ 2 ≤ A t * y t := by
    obtain ⟨d', hd', hb⟩ := hineq ν hν a N g t ht.1.le
    have heq : d t = d' := (hderiv t ht).unique
      (hd'.hasDerivAt (Ici_mem_nhds ht.1))
    dsimp only [z]
    rw [Real.sq_sqrt (highOrderEnergy_nonneg _ _ _), heq]
    exact hb
  have hbudget : (∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..T, A s) ≤ M := by
    have h2 := hH2 N hN g
    have hiE2 : IntervalIntegrable (fun t => highOrderEnergy 2 N (g.coeff t)) volume 0 T :=
      hE2.intervalIntegrable_of_Icc hT.le
    have h2' : (∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..T, highOrderEnergy 2 N (g.coeff t)) ≤ S := by
      simpa only [highOrderEnergy_eq_sobolev_norm_sq, GalerkinSolution.sobolevState] using h2
    dsimp only [A, M]
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_add (intervalIntegrable_const)
      (hiE2.const_mul (C / ν)), intervalIntegral.integral_const,
      intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul]
    simp only [sub_zero, smul_eq_mul]
    nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h2' (div_nonneg hC.le hν.le)]
  have hb := LINEAR_ENERGY_OF_COEFFICIENT_BUDGET hν.le hT.le hy hz hA
    (fun t _ => highOrderEnergy_nonneg _ _ _) hA_nonneg
    (g.highOrderEnergy_initial_le ha m) hderiv hlinear hbudget
  intro t ht
  have hzsq (s : ℝ) : (z s) ^ 2 = highOrderEnergy (m + 1) N (g.coeff s) :=
    Real.sq_sqrt (highOrderEnergy_nonneg _ _ _)
  simpa only [y, E₀, hzsq, highOrderEnergy_eq_sobolev_norm_sq,
    GalerkinSolution.sobolevState] using hb t ht

theorem local_galerkin_high_order_pointwise
    (ν : ℝ) (hν : 0 < ν) (a : Field) (ha : SmoothSigmaZero a)
    (T : ℝ) (hT : 0 < T)
    (S : ℝ) (hS : 0 ≤ S)
    (hH2 : ∀ N : ℕ, 1 ≤ N → ∀ g : GalerkinSolution ν a N,
      (∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..T, ‖g.sobolevState 2 t‖ ^ 2) ≤ S)
    (m : ℕ) :
    ∃ B : ℝ, 0 ≤ B ∧ ∀ N : ℕ, 1 ≤ N → ∀ g : GalerkinSolution ν a N,
      ∀ t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) T, ‖g.sobolevState m t‖ ^ 2 ≤ B := by
  obtain ⟨B, hB, hb⟩ := local_galerkin_high_order_accumulation ν hν a ha T hT S hS hH2 m
  refine ⟨B, hB, ?_⟩
  intro N hN g t ht
  have hi : 0 ≤ ∫ r in (0 : ℝ)..t, ‖g.sobolevState (m + 1) r‖ ^ 2 :=
    intervalIntegral.integral_nonneg_of_forall ht.1 (fun r => sq_nonneg _)
  have h := hb N hN g t ht
  nlinarith [mul_nonneg hν.le hi]

/-- Uniform actual RHS norm in every integral Sobolev order. -/

theorem local_galerkin_high_order_rhs
    (ν : ℝ) (hν : 0 < ν) (a : Field) (ha : SmoothSigmaZero a)
    (T : ℝ) (hT : 0 < T)
    (S : ℝ) (hS : 0 ≤ S)
    (hH2 : ∀ N : ℕ, 1 ≤ N → ∀ g : GalerkinSolution ν a N,
      (∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..T, ‖g.sobolevState 2 t‖ ^ 2) ≤ S)
    (m : ℕ) :
    ∃ B : ℝ, 0 ≤ B ∧ ∀ N : ℕ, 1 ≤ N → ∀ g : GalerkinSolution ν a N,
      ∀ t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) T, ‖g.rhsSobolev m t‖ ^ 2 ≤ B := by
  obtain ⟨B2, hB2, hb2⟩ := local_galerkin_high_order_pointwise ν hν a ha T hT S hS hH2 2
  obtain ⟨B1, hB1, hb1⟩ := local_galerkin_high_order_pointwise ν hν a ha T hT S hS hH2 (m + 1)
  obtain ⟨B0, hB0, hb0⟩ := local_galerkin_high_order_pointwise ν hν a ha T hT S hS hH2 (m + 2)
  obtain ⟨C, hC, hrhs⟩ := GALERKIN_SOBOLEV_TIME_DERIVATIVE_BOUND m
  refine ⟨2 * ν ^ 2 * B0 + C * B2 * B1, by positivity, ?_⟩
  intro N hN g t ht
  have h := hrhs ν a N g t ht.1
  rw [g.sobolevState_derivWithin m t ht.1] at h
  have h' : ‖g.rhsSobolev m t‖ ^ 2 ≤
      2 * ν ^ 2 * ‖g.sobolevState (m + 2) t‖ ^ 2 +
        C * ‖g.sobolevState 2 t‖ ^ 2 * ‖g.sobolevState (m + 1) t‖ ^ 2 := by
    simpa only [highOrderEnergy_eq_sobolev_norm_sq, GalerkinSolution.sobolevState] using h
  have hv := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hb0 N hN g t ht)
    (mul_nonneg (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2) (sq_nonneg ν))
  have hp := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
    (mul_le_mul (hb2 N hN g t ht) (hb1 N hN g t ht) (sq_nonneg _) hB2) hC.le
  nlinarith

theorem local_galerkin_high_order_time_modulus
    (ν : ℝ) (hν : 0 < ν) (a : Field) (ha : SmoothSigmaZero a)
    (T : ℝ) (hT : 0 < T)
    (S : ℝ) (hS : 0 ≤ S)
    (hH2 : ∀ N : ℕ, 1 ≤ N → ∀ g : GalerkinSolution ν a N,
      (∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..T, ‖g.sobolevState 2 t‖ ^ 2) ≤ S)
    (m : ℕ) :
    ∃ B : ℝ, 0 ≤ B ∧ ∀ N : ℕ, 1 ≤ N → ∀ g : GalerkinSolution ν a N,
      ∀ s ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) T, ∀ t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) T,
        ‖g.sobolevState m t - g.sobolevState m s‖ ^ 2 ≤ B * |t - s| := by
  obtain ⟨B, hB, hb⟩ := local_galerkin_high_order_rhs ν hν a ha T hT S hS hH2 m
  refine ⟨T * B, mul_nonneg hT.le hB, ?_⟩
  intro N hN g s hs t ht
  have henergy : (∫ r in (0 : ℝ)..T, ‖g.rhsSobolev m r‖ ^ 2) ≤ T * B := by
    calc
      _ ≤ ∫ r in (0 : ℝ)..T, B := by
        apply intervalIntegral.integral_mono_on hT.le
          ((((g.rhsSobolev_continuousOn m).mono
            (fun r hr => hr.1)).norm.pow 2).intervalIntegrable_of_Icc hT.le)
          intervalIntegrable_const
        exact hb N hN g
      _ = _ := by simp
  have hordered {u v : ℝ} (hu : 0 ≤ u) (huv : u ≤ v) (hvT : v ≤ T) :
      ‖g.sobolevState m v - g.sobolevState m u‖ ^ 2 ≤ (v - u) * (T * B) :=
    (g.sobolevState_time_modulus m hu huv hvT).trans
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left henergy (sub_nonneg.mpr huv))
  rcases le_total s t with hst | hts
  · simpa only [abs_of_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hst), mul_comm] using
      hordered hs.1 hst ht.2
  · calc
      _ = ‖g.sobolevState m s - g.sobolevState m t‖ ^ 2 := by rw [norm_sub_rev]
      _ ≤ (s - t) * (T * B) := hordered ht.1 hts hs.2
      _ = (T * B) * |t - s| := by
        rw [abs_of_nonpos (sub_nonpos.mpr hts), neg_sub, mul_comm]

end
end MethbokeAddon.WeakFouriermanB

Actual finite-window compactness from a uniform local H2 time integral.
Smooth-data higher bounds and the genuine Galerkin time modulus feed the
proved compact Sobolev inclusion and Arzela--Ascoli. No limit, compactness
certificate, global budget, or physical solution is an input.

set_option autoImplicit false

open Set MeasureTheory Filter Metric SingularClosure
