local instance localCompactTimeInterval (T : ℝ) : CompactSpace (Icc (0 : ℝ) T) :=
  isCompact_iff_compactSpace.mp isCompact_Icc

theorem local_canonical_galerkin_H0_uniform_subsequence
    (ν : ℝ) (hν : 0 < ν) (a : Field) (ha : SmoothSigmaZero a)
    (T : ℝ) (hT : 0 < T)
    (S : ℝ) (hS : 0 ≤ S)
    (hH2 : ∀ N : ℕ, 1 ≤ N → ∀ g : GalerkinSolution ν a N,
      (∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..T, ‖g.sobolevState 2 t‖ ^ 2) ≤ S) :
    ∃ u : C(Icc (0 : ℝ) T, TorusSobolev 0), ∃ φ : ℕ → ℕ,
      StrictMono φ ∧ TendstoUniformly
        (fun n (t : Icc (0 : ℝ) T) =>
          (canonicalGalerkinSolution ν hν a ha (φ n + 1)).sobolevState 0 t.val)
        u atTop := by
  obtain ⟨B, hB, hbound⟩ := local_galerkin_high_order_pointwise ν hν a ha T hT S hS hH2 1
  obtain ⟨M, hM, hmod⟩ := local_galerkin_high_order_time_modulus ν hν a ha T hT S hS hH2 0
  let F : ℕ → (Icc (0 : ℝ) T) →ᵇ TorusSobolev 0 :=
    canonicalSobolevCurveBounded ν hν a ha T
  let K : Set (TorusSobolev 0) := closure ((torusSobolevInclusion 0) ''
    closedBall (0 : TorusSobolev 1) (B + 1))
  have hK : IsCompact K :=
    (torusSobolevInclusion_compact 0).isCompact_closure_image_closedBall (B + 1)
  have hrange (n : ℕ) (t : Icc (0 : ℝ) T) : F n t ∈ K := by
    apply subset_closure
    refine ⟨(canonicalGalerkinSolution ν hν a ha (n + 1)).sobolevState 1 t.val, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right]
      have hb := (hbound (n + 1) (by omega)
        (canonicalGalerkinSolution ν hν a ha (n + 1))) t.val t.property
      nlinarith [sq_nonneg
        (‖(canonicalGalerkinSolution ν hν a ha (n + 1)).sobolevState 1 t.val‖ - 1)]
    · exact (canonicalGalerkinSolution ν hν a ha (n + 1)).sobolevState_inclusion 0 t.val
  have huni : UniformEquicontinuous (fun n (t : Icc (0 : ℝ) T) => F n t) := by
    rw [Metric.uniformEquicontinuous_iff]
    intro ε hε
    refine ⟨ε ^ 2 / (M + 1), div_pos (sq_pos_of_pos hε) (by linarith), ?_⟩
    intro x y hxy n
    change dist (x.val : ℝ) y.val < ε ^ 2 / (M + 1) at hxy
    rw [Real.dist_eq] at hxy
    have hsmall : (M + 1) * |x.val - y.val| < ε ^ 2 := by
      have h := (lt_div_iff₀ (by linarith : 0 < M + 1)).mp hxy
      simpa only [mul_comm] using h
    have hb := hmod (n + 1) (by omega)
      (canonicalGalerkinSolution ν hν a ha (n + 1)) y.val y.property x.val x.property
    rw [dist_eq_norm]
    change ‖(canonicalGalerkinSolution ν hν a ha (n + 1)).sobolevState 0 x.val -
      (canonicalGalerkinSolution ν hν a ha (n + 1)).sobolevState 0 y.val‖ < ε
    nlinarith [abs_nonneg (x.val - y.val), norm_nonneg
      ((canonicalGalerkinSolution ν hν a ha (n + 1)).sobolevState 0 x.val -
        (canonicalGalerkinSolution ν hν a ha (n + 1)).sobolevState 0 y.val)]
  have hequi : Equicontinuous ((↑) : (Set.range F) → (Icc (0 : ℝ) T) → TorusSobolev 0) := by
    have he : ((↑) : (Set.range F) → (Icc (0 : ℝ) T) → TorusSobolev 0) =
        (fun f : Set.range F => fun t => F f.property.choose t) := by
      funext f t
      exact congrArg (fun q : (Icc (0 : ℝ) T) →ᵇ TorusSobolev 0 => q t)
        f.property.choose_spec.symm
    rw [he]
    exact huni.equicontinuous.comp (fun f : Set.range F => f.property.choose)
  have hcompact : IsCompact (closure (Set.range F)) :=
    BoundedContinuousFunction.arzela_ascoli K hK (Set.range F)
      (by intro f t hf; obtain ⟨n, rfl⟩ := hf; exact hrange n t) hequi
  obtain ⟨u, _, φ, hφ, hconv⟩ := hcompact.tendsto_subseq
    (fun n => subset_closure (Set.mem_range_self n))
  refine ⟨u.toContinuousMap, φ, hφ, ?_⟩
  change TendstoUniformly (fun n t => F (φ n) t) (fun t => u t) atTop
  simpa only [Function.comp_def] using
    (BoundedContinuousFunction.tendsto_iff_tendstoUniformly.mp hconv)


end
end MethbokeAddon.WeakFouriermanB

/-!
# Uniqueness of supplied physical initial classical fronts

Both classical pairs are compared to one original Leray--Hopf trajectory
constructed from their common datum. The accepted finite-front comparison
gives equality at every positive time almost everywhere on the physical cube;
continuity and periodicity give pointwise equality. The literal NSE equations
then determine normalized pressure on the positive overlap, and continuity
extends pressure equality to time zero.

No local-existence or continuation premise is introduced. The inputs are
actual InitialClassicalFront witnesses. Prepared source; matching external
cached compilation and fresh exact-type/axiom audits are required. No local
Lean, Lake or kernel execution was used.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

/-- Restrict an actual initial classical front to a shorter horizon. -/
theorem initial_front_restrict
    (ν T S : ℝ) (a : Field) (u : Velocity) (p : Pressure)
    (H : InitialClassicalFront ν T a u p) (hST : S ≤ T) :
    InitialClassicalFront ν S a u p := by
  have hsub : initialFrontSpacetime S ⊆ initialFrontSpacetime T :=
    fun _ hz => ⟨hz.1, hz.2.trans_le hST⟩
  exact {
    velocity_smooth := H.velocity_smooth.mono hsub
    pressure_smooth := H.pressure_smooth.mono hsub
    velocity_periodic := fun t ht => H.velocity_periodic t ⟨ht.1, ht.2.trans_le hST⟩
    pressure_periodic := fun t ht => H.pressure_periodic t ⟨ht.1, ht.2.trans_le hST⟩
    divergence_free := fun t ht => H.divergence_free t ⟨ht.1, ht.2.trans_le hST⟩
    equation := fun t ht => H.equation t ⟨ht.1, ht.2.trans_le hST⟩
    initial := H.initial
    velocity_mean_zero := fun t ht => H.velocity_mean_zero t ⟨ht.1, ht.2.trans_le hST⟩
    pressure_mean_zero := fun t ht => H.pressure_mean_zero t ⟨ht.1, ht.2.trans_le hST⟩
  }

/-- An actual global smooth solution restricts to every finite initial front. -/
theorem global_smooth_to_initial_front
    (ν T : ℝ) (a : Field) (u : Velocity) (p : Pressure)
    (H : GlobalSmoothNSE ν a u p) : InitialClassicalFront ν T a u p := by
  exact {
    velocity_smooth := H.velocity_smooth.mono (fun _ hz => hz.1)
    pressure_smooth := H.pressure_smooth.mono (fun _ hz => hz.1)
    velocity_periodic := fun t ht => H.velocity_periodic t ht.1
    pressure_periodic := fun t ht => H.pressure_periodic t ht.1
    divergence_free := fun t ht => H.divergence_free t ht.1
    equation := fun t ht => H.equation t ht.1
    initial := H.initial
    velocity_mean_zero := fun t ht => H.velocity_mean_zero t ht.1
    pressure_mean_zero := fun t ht => H.pressure_mean_zero t ht.1
  }

/-- Equality on the initial half-open cylinder transports the entire physical
front, including the derivative within the nonnegative half-line at zero. -/
theorem initial_front_congr
    (ν T : ℝ) (a : Field) (u v : Velocity) (p q : Pressure)
    (H : InitialClassicalFront ν T a u p) (hT : 0 < T)
    (huv : ∀ r ∈ Ico (0 : ℝ) T, v r = u r)
    (hpq : ∀ r ∈ Ico (0 : ℝ) T, q r = p r) :
    InitialClassicalFront ν T a v q := by
  have htime (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Ico (0 : ℝ) T) (x : Vec) :
      timeDerivative v t x = timeDerivative u t x := by
    have hTevent : ∀ᶠ r : ℝ in 𝓝[Ici (0 : ℝ)] t, r < T :=
      nhdsWithin_le_nhds (Iio_mem_nhds ht.2)
    have heq : (fun r => v r x) =ᶠ[𝓝[Ici (0 : ℝ)] t] (fun r => u r x) := by
      filter_upwards [self_mem_nhdsWithin, hTevent] with r hr hrT
      exact congrFun (huv r ⟨hr, hrT⟩) x
    exact heq.derivWithin_eq (congrFun (huv t ht) x)
  refine {
    velocity_smooth := H.velocity_smooth.congr (fun z hz => congrFun (huv z.1 hz) z.2)
    pressure_smooth := H.pressure_smooth.congr (fun z hz => congrFun (hpq z.1 hz) z.2)
    velocity_periodic := ?_
    pressure_periodic := ?_
    divergence_free := ?_
    equation := ?_
    initial := (huv 0 ⟨le_rfl, hT⟩).trans H.initial
    velocity_mean_zero := ?_
    pressure_mean_zero := ?_
  }
  · intro t ht
    rw [huv t ht]
    exact H.velocity_periodic t ht
  · intro t ht
    rw [hpq t ht]
    exact H.pressure_periodic t ht
  · intro t ht x
    rw [huv t ht]
    exact H.divergence_free t ht x
  · intro t ht x
    rw [htime t ht x, huv t ht, hpq t ht]
    exact H.equation t ht x
  · intro t ht
    rw [huv t ht]
    exact H.velocity_mean_zero t ht
  · intro t ht
    rw [hpq t ht]
    exact H.pressure_mean_zero t ht

private theorem continuousOn_Ico_eq_at_zero
    {E : Type*} [TopologicalSpace E] [T2Space E]
    {T : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) {f g : ℝ → E}
    (hf : ContinuousOn f (Ico (0 : ℝ) T))
    (hg : ContinuousOn g (Ico (0 : ℝ) T))
    (heq : ∀ t ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) T, f t = g t) : f 0 = g 0 := by
  have hTevent : ∀ᶠ t : ℝ in 𝓝[>] (0 : ℝ), t < T :=
    nhdsWithin_le_nhds (Iio_mem_nhds hT)
  have hwindow : Ico (0 : ℝ) T ∈ 𝓝[>] (0 : ℝ) := by
    filter_upwards [self_mem_nhdsWithin, hTevent] with t ht htT
    exact ⟨ht.le, htT⟩
  have hfilter : 𝓝[>] (0 : ℝ) ≤ 𝓝[Ico (0 : ℝ) T] (0 : ℝ) :=
    le_inf nhdsWithin_le_nhds (le_principal_iff.mpr hwindow)
  have hflim : Tendsto f (𝓝[>] (0 : ℝ)) (𝓝 (f 0)) :=
    (hf 0 ⟨le_rfl, hT⟩).mono_left hfilter
  have hglim : Tendsto g (𝓝[>] (0 : ℝ)) (𝓝 (g 0)) :=
    (hg 0 ⟨le_rfl, hT⟩).mono_left hfilter
  have hevent : f =ᶠ[𝓝[>] (0 : ℝ)] g := by
    filter_upwards [self_mem_nhdsWithin, hTevent] with t ht htT
    exact heq t ⟨ht, htT⟩
  exact tendsto_nhds_unique hflim (hglim.congr' hevent.symm)

/-- Complete local classical uniqueness: two actual solutions with the same
datum agree in both velocity and normalized pressure on their entire common
half-open initial interval, including time zero. One fixed original weak path
is used for both comparisons. No arbitrary-data existence claim is made. -/
theorem initial_classical_front_unique
    (ν T S : ℝ) (a : Field) (u v : Velocity) (p q : Pressure)
    (hν : 0 < ν) (hT : 0 < T) (hS : 0 < S)
    (H : InitialClassicalFront ν T a u p)
    (K : InitialClassicalFront ν S a v q) :
    ∀ r ∈ Ico (0 : ℝ) (min T S), u r = v r ∧ p r = q r := by
  have ha := initial_front_initial_smooth ν T a u p H hT
  obtain ⟨w, G, hw, _⟩ := smooth_datum_lerayHopf_exists ν hν a ha
  have hwu := initial_front_leray_hopf_identification ν T a u p w G H hν hT hw
  have hwv := initial_front_leray_hopf_identification ν S a v q w G K hν hS hw
  have htimeT (r : ℝ) (hr : r ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) (min T S)) :
      r ∈ Ico (0 : ℝ) T := ⟨hr.1.le, hr.2.trans_le (min_le_left T S)⟩
  have htimeS (r : ℝ) (hr : r ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) (min T S)) :
      r ∈ Ico (0 : ℝ) S := ⟨hr.1.le, hr.2.trans_le (min_le_right T S)⟩
  have huv : ∀ r ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) (min T S), u r = v r := by
    intro r hr
    exact continuous_periodic_field_eq_of_cube_ae
      (initial_front_smooth_slices ν T a u p H r (htimeT r hr)).smooth.continuous
      (initial_front_smooth_slices ν S a v q K r (htimeS r hr)).smooth.continuous
      (H.velocity_periodic r (htimeT r hr)) (K.velocity_periodic r (htimeS r hr))
      ((hwu r ⟨hr.1, (htimeT r hr).2⟩).symm.trans
        (hwv r ⟨hr.1, (htimeS r hr).2⟩))
  have hpq : ∀ r ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) (min T S), p r = q r := by
    apply normalized_pressure_eq_on_jointly_smooth_velocity_overlap isOpen_Ioo huv
    · intro r hr
      exact H.equation r (htimeT r hr)
    · intro r hr
      exact K.equation r (htimeS r hr)
    · exact H.pressure_smooth.mono (fun z hz => htimeT z.1 hz)
    · exact K.pressure_smooth.mono (fun z hz => htimeS z.1 hz)
    · intro r hr
      exact H.pressure_mean_zero r (htimeT r hr)
    · intro r hr
      exact K.pressure_mean_zero r (htimeS r hr)
  have hpq0 : p 0 = q 0 := by
    funext x
    apply continuousOn_Ico_eq_at_zero (lt_min hT hS)
      (f := fun r => p r x) (g := fun r => q r x)
    · exact H.pressure_smooth.continuousOn.comp
        (continuous_id.prodMk continuous_const).continuousOn
        (fun r hr => ⟨hr.1, hr.2.trans_le (min_le_left T S)⟩)
    · exact K.pressure_smooth.continuousOn.comp
        (continuous_id.prodMk continuous_const).continuousOn
        (fun r hr => ⟨hr.1, hr.2.trans_le (min_le_right T S)⟩)
    · intro r hr
      exact congrFun (hpq r hr) x
  intro r hr
  rcases eq_or_lt_of_le hr.1 with hzero | hpos
  · have hrzero : r = 0 := hzero.symm
    subst r
    exact ⟨H.initial.trans K.initial.symm, hpq0⟩
  · exact ⟨huv r ⟨hpos, hr.2⟩, hpq r ⟨hpos, hr.2⟩⟩

end
end MethbokeAddon.WeakFouriermanB

Actual time translation of an initial classical NSE front. The right
derivative at the new initial time is obtained from ordinary differentiability
at an interior old time. Translation by zero is treated separately.

These lemmas only translate supplied physical solutions; they do not assert
local existence or a lifespan. Matching external cached verification is required.

set_option autoImplicit false

theorem initial_front_time_hasDerivAt
    (ν T : ℝ) (a : Field) (u : Velocity) (p : Pressure)
    (H : InitialClassicalFront ν T a u p)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) T) (x : Vec) :
    HasDerivAt (fun r : ℝ => u r x) (timeDerivative u t x) t := by
  have hu : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ × Vec => u z.1 z.2)
      (localFrontSpacetime T) := H.velocity_smooth.mono (by
    intro z hz
    exact ⟨hz.1.le, hz.2⟩)
  exact local_time_hasDerivAt u T hu t ht x

theorem initial_front_timeDerivative_translate
    (ν T s : ℝ) (a : Field) (u : Velocity) (p : Pressure)
    (H : InitialClassicalFront ν T a u p) (hs : 0 ≤ s)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Ico (0 : ℝ) (T - s)) (x : Vec) :
    timeDerivative (fun r => u (s + r)) t x = timeDerivative u (s + t) x := by
  rcases eq_or_lt_of_le hs with hs0 | hspos
  · subst s
    simp only [zero_add]
  · have hst : s + t ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) T := by
      constructor <;> linarith [ht.1, ht.2]
    have hd := initial_front_time_hasDerivAt ν T a u p H (s + t) hst x
    have hc : HasDerivAt (fun r : ℝ => u (s + r) x)
        (timeDerivative u (s + t) x) t := by
      simpa only [Function.comp_def, id_eq, one_smul] using
        hd.scomp t ((hasDerivAt_id t).const_add s)
    exact hc.hasDerivWithinAt.derivWithin ((uniqueDiffOn_Ici 0) t ht.1)

theorem initial_front_time_translate
    (ν T s : ℝ) (a : Field) (u : Velocity) (p : Pressure)
    (H : InitialClassicalFront ν T a u p) (hs : 0 ≤ s) :
    InitialClassicalFront ν (T - s) (u s)
      (fun t => u (s + t)) (fun t => p (s + t)) := by
  have htime (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Ico (0 : ℝ) (T - s)) :
      s + t ∈ Ico (0 : ℝ) T := by
    constructor <;> linarith [ht.1, ht.2]
  have hmap : MapsTo (fun z : ℝ × Vec => (s + z.1, z.2))
      (initialFrontSpacetime (T - s)) (initialFrontSpacetime T) := by
    intro z hz
    exact htime z.1 hz
  have hc : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ × Vec => (s + z.1, z.2)) :=
    (contDiff_const.add contDiff_fst).prodMk contDiff_snd
  refine {
    velocity_smooth := H.velocity_smooth.comp hc.contDiffOn hmap
    pressure_smooth := H.pressure_smooth.comp hc.contDiffOn hmap
    velocity_periodic := fun t ht => H.velocity_periodic (s + t) (htime t ht)
    pressure_periodic := fun t ht => H.pressure_periodic (s + t) (htime t ht)
    divergence_free := fun t ht => H.divergence_free (s + t) (htime t ht)
    equation := ?_
    initial := by simp only [add_zero]
    velocity_mean_zero := fun t ht => H.velocity_mean_zero (s + t) (htime t ht)
    pressure_mean_zero := fun t ht => H.pressure_mean_zero (s + t) (htime t ht)
  }
  intro t ht x
  rw [initial_front_timeDerivative_translate ν T s a u p H hs t ht x]
  exact H.equation (s + t) (htime t ht) x

/-- The backwards shift is used only strictly after its new origin. This
keeps both the original and shifted derivatives at interior positive times.
-/
theorem initial_front_timeDerivative_shift_back
    (ν T s : ℝ) (a : Field) (u : Velocity) (p : Pressure)
    (H : InitialClassicalFront ν T a u p) (hs : 0 ≤ s)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Ioo s (s + T)) (x : Vec) :
    timeDerivative (fun r => u (r - s)) t x = timeDerivative u (t - s) x := by
  have hts : t - s ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) T := by
    constructor <;> linarith [ht.1, ht.2]
  have hd := initial_front_time_hasDerivAt ν T a u p H (t - s) hts x
  have hc : HasDerivAt (fun r : ℝ => u (r - s) x)
      (timeDerivative u (t - s) x) t := by
    simpa only [Function.comp_def, id_eq, one_smul] using
      hd.scomp t ((hasDerivAt_id t).sub_const s)
  exact hc.hasDerivWithinAt.derivWithin
    ((uniqueDiffOn_Ici 0) t (le_trans hs (le_of_lt ht.1)))

theorem initial_front_shift_back_equation
    (ν T s : ℝ) (a : Field) (u : Velocity) (p : Pressure)
    (H : InitialClassicalFront ν T a u p) (hs : 0 ≤ s)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Ioo s (s + T)) (x : Vec) :
    timeDerivative (fun r => u (r - s)) t x + convection (u (t - s)) x +
      SingularClosure.gradient (p (t - s)) x = ν • laplacian (u (t - s)) x := by
  rw [initial_front_timeDerivative_shift_back ν T s a u p H hs t ht x]
  apply H.equation
  constructor <;> linarith [ht.1, ht.2]

end

def physicalLaplacianSquare (v : Field) : ℝ :=
  ∫ x in unitCube, ‖laplacian v x‖ ^ 2

theorem physicalLaplacianSquare_nonneg (v : Field) :
    0 ≤ physicalLaplacianSquare v :=
  integral_nonneg (fun _ => sq_nonneg _)

theorem physical_dissipation_nonneg (v : Field) :
    0 ≤ physicalDissipation v := by
  unfold physicalDissipation
  apply integral_nonneg
  intro x
  rw [gradientSquareDensity_eq_sum_norm_sq]
  exact Finset.sum_nonneg (fun _ _ => sq_nonneg _)

/-- Commutation for literal operators on arbitrary smooth periodic fields. -/
theorem physical_laplacian_coordinateDerivative_commute
    (v : Field) (hv : ContDiff ℝ ∞ v) (hp : SpatialPeriodic v) (i : Fin 3) :
    laplacian (coordinateDerivative v i) = coordinateDerivative (laplacian v) i := by
  apply datumFourierCoeff_injective_continuous_periodic
  · exact (laplacian_contDiff _ (coordinateDerivative_smooth hv i)).continuous
  · exact (coordinateDerivative_smooth (laplacian_contDiff v hv) i).continuous
  · exact laplacian_spatialPeriodic _ (coordinateDerivative_spatialPeriodic i v hp)
  · exact coordinateDerivative_spatialPeriodic i _ (laplacian_spatialPeriodic v hp)
  · rw [datumFourierCoeff_laplacian _ (coordinateDerivative_smooth hv i)
        (coordinateDerivative_spatialPeriodic i v hp),
      datumFourierCoeff_coordinateDerivative i v hv hp,
      datumFourierCoeff_coordinateDerivative i _ (laplacian_contDiff v hv)
        (laplacian_spatialPeriodic v hp),
      datumFourierCoeff_laplacian v hv hp]
    funext k j
    simp only [laplacianCoefficient, spectralMultiplier]
    ring

/-- Every periodic spatial derivative has actual zero mean. -/
theorem physical_coordinateDerivative_meanZero
    (v : Field) (hv : ContDiff ℝ ∞ v) (hp : SpatialPeriodic v) (i : Fin 3) :
    MeanZero (coordinateDerivative v i) := by
  have hi : IntegrableOn (coordinateDerivative v i) unitCube volume :=
    (coordinateDerivative_continuous hv i).continuousOn.integrableOn_compact isCompact_unitCube
  refine ⟨hi, ?_⟩
  ext j
  change spatialMean (coordinateDerivative v i) j = 0
  have hz : datumFourierCoeff (coordinateDerivative v i) 0 j = 0 := by
    rw [datumFourierCoeff_coordinateDerivative i v hv hp]
    simp [spectralMultiplier, derivativeSymbol]
  rw [datumFourierCoeff_zero hi] at hz
  exact_mod_cast hz

/-- No finite-synthesis premise: the physical Hessian square equals the
physical Laplacian square for every smooth periodic vector field. -/
theorem physical_hessian_laplacian_eq
    (v : Field) (hv : ContDiff ℝ ∞ v) (hp : SpatialPeriodic v) :
    (∑ i : Fin 3, physicalDissipation (coordinateDerivative v i)) =
      physicalLaplacianSquare v := by
  have hterm (i : Fin 3) :
      physicalDissipation (coordinateDerivative v i) =
        ∫ x in unitCube,
          inner ℝ (coordinateDerivative (coordinateDerivative v i) i x) (laplacian v x) := by
    have h := critical_integral_inner_coordinateDerivative
      (coordinateDerivative v i) (laplacian v) (coordinateDerivative_smooth hv i)
      (laplacian_contDiff v hv) (coordinateDerivative_spatialPeriodic i v hp)
      (laplacian_spatialPeriodic v hp) i
    rw [← physical_laplacian_coordinateDerivative_commute v hv hp i,
      critical_integral_inner_laplacian_self _ (coordinateDerivative_smooth hv i)
        (coordinateDerivative_spatialPeriodic i v hp)] at h
    linarith
  simp_rw [hterm]
  rw [← integral_finsetSum Finset.univ (fun i _ =>
    ((coordinateDerivative_smooth (coordinateDerivative_smooth hv i) i).continuous.inner
      (laplacian_contDiff v hv).continuous).continuousOn.integrableOn_compact
        isCompact_unitCube)]
  apply integral_congr_ae
  filter_upwards [] with x
  rw [← sum_inner]
  change inner ℝ (laplacian v x) (laplacian v x) = ‖laplacian v x‖ ^ 2
  exact real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq _

theorem physical_coordinateDissipation_le_laplacianSquare
    (v : Field) (hv : ContDiff ℝ ∞ v) (hp : SpatialPeriodic v) (i : Fin 3) :
    physicalDissipation (coordinateDerivative v i) ≤ physicalLaplacianSquare v := by
  rw [← physical_hessian_laplacian_eq v hv hp]

/-- The constant is fixed before the arbitrary physical field. -/
theorem PHYSICAL_L6_FROM_DISSIPATION :
    ∃ C : ℝ≥0∞, C < ⊤ ∧ ∀ v : Field, ContDiff ℝ ∞ v → SpatialPeriodic v →
      MeanZero v → eLpNorm v 6 (volume.restrict unitCube) ≤
        C * (ENNReal.ofReal (physicalDissipation v)) ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) := by
  obtain ⟨K, hK0, hK⟩ := PERIODIC_SOBOLEV_H1_L6 (F := Vec)
  let C : ℝ≥0∞ :=
    (SNormLESNormFDerivOfEqConst Vec (volume : Measure Vec) 2 : ℝ≥0∞) *
      (343 : ℝ≥0∞) ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) *
        ((3 : ℝ≥0∞) ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) + ENNReal.ofReal K)
  refine ⟨C, by dsimp [C]; finiteness, ?_⟩
  intro v hv hp hz
  have hD := physical_fderiv_eLpNorm_two_le v hv
  have hV := physical_eLpNorm_two_le_dissipation v hv hp hz
  calc
    _ ≤ _ := hK v hv hp
    _ ≤ (SNormLESNormFDerivOfEqConst Vec (volume : Measure Vec) 2 : ℝ≥0∞) *
        (343 : ℝ≥0∞) ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) *
        ((3 : ℝ≥0∞) ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) *
          (ENNReal.ofReal (physicalDissipation v)) ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) +
          ENNReal.ofReal K * (ENNReal.ofReal (physicalDissipation v)) ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ)) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
        (add_le_add hD (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hV bot_le)) bot_le
    _ = _ := by dsimp [C]; ring

theorem PHYSICAL_DERIVATIVE_L6_FROM_LAPLACIAN :
    ∃ C : ℝ≥0∞, C < ⊤ ∧ ∀ v : Field, ContDiff ℝ ∞ v → SpatialPeriodic v →
      eLpNorm (fderiv ℝ v) 6 (volume.restrict unitCube) ≤
        C * (ENNReal.ofReal (physicalLaplacianSquare v)) ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) := by
  obtain ⟨C, hC, hSob⟩ := PHYSICAL_L6_FROM_DISSIPATION
  refine ⟨3 * C, by finiteness, ?_⟩
  intro v hv hp
  have hcoord (i : Fin 3) :
      eLpNorm (coordinateDerivative v i) 6 (volume.restrict unitCube) ≤
        C * (ENNReal.ofReal (physicalLaplacianSquare v)) ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) :=
    (hSob _ (coordinateDerivative_smooth hv i) (coordinateDerivative_spatialPeriodic i v hp)
      (physical_coordinateDerivative_meanZero v hv hp i)).trans
        (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (ENNReal.rpow_le_rpow
          (ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal (physical_coordinateDissipation_le_laplacianSquare v hv hp i))
          (by norm_num)) bot_le)
  have hmeas (i : Fin 3) : AEStronglyMeasurable
      (fun x => ‖coordinateDerivative v i x‖) (volume.restrict unitCube) :=
    (coordinateDerivative_continuous hv i).norm.aestronglyMeasurable
  calc
    _ ≤ eLpNorm (fun x => ∑ i : Fin 3, ‖coordinateDerivative v i x‖) 6
        (volume.restrict unitCube) :=
      eLpNorm_mono_real (fun x => opNorm_le_sum_coordinate_norm (fderiv ℝ v x))
    _ ≤ ∑ i : Fin 3, eLpNorm (fun x => ‖coordinateDerivative v i x‖) 6
        (volume.restrict unitCube) := by
      have hsum : (fun x => ∑ i : Fin 3, ‖coordinateDerivative v i x‖) =
          ∑ i : Fin 3, (fun x => ‖coordinateDerivative v i x‖) := by
        funext x
        simp only [Finset.sum_apply]
      rw [hsum]
      exact eLpNorm_sum_le (s := Finset.univ) (fun i _ => hmeas i)
        (by norm_num : (1 : ℝ≥0∞) ≤ 6)
    _ = ∑ i : Fin 3, eLpNorm (coordinateDerivative v i) 6
        (volume.restrict unitCube) := by simp only [eLpNorm_norm]
    _ ≤ ∑ _i : Fin 3, C * (ENNReal.ofReal (physicalLaplacianSquare v)) ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) :=

theorem PHYSICAL_NONLINEAR_THREE_QUARTER_BOUND :
    ∃ C : ℝ≥0∞, C < ⊤ ∧ ∀ v : Field, ContDiff ℝ ∞ v → SpatialPeriodic v →
      MeanZero v → ENNReal.ofReal (abs (∫ x in unitCube,

          C * (ENNReal.ofReal (physicalDissipation v)) ^ (3 / 4 : ℝ) *
            (ENNReal.ofReal (physicalLaplacianSquare v)) ^ (3 / 4 : ℝ) := by
  obtain ⟨A, hA, hSob⟩ := PHYSICAL_L6_FROM_DISSIPATION
  obtain ⟨B, hB, hDeriv⟩ := PHYSICAL_DERIVATIVE_L6_FROM_LAPLACIAN
  refine ⟨A * (3 : ℝ≥0∞) ^ (1 / 4 : ℝ) * B ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ), by finiteness, ?_⟩
  intro v hv hp hz
  have hd : Continuous (fderiv ℝ v) := (hv.fderiv_right (m := 0) (by norm_num)).continuous
  have hconv : Continuous (convection v) := hd.clm_apply hv.continuous
  have hlap := (laplacian_contDiff v hv).continuous
  have hD3 := cube_eLpNorm_three_le_interpolation (fderiv ℝ v) hd
  have hD2 := physical_fderiv_eLpNorm_two_le v hv
  have hD6 := hDeriv v hv hp
  have hV6 := hSob v hv hp hz
  calc
    _ ≤ eLpNorm (convection v) 2 (volume.restrict unitCube) *
        eLpNorm (laplacian v) 2 (volume.restrict unitCube) :=
      inner_integral_enorm_le_eLpNorm_two _ _ hconv hlap
    _ ≤ (eLpNorm v 6 (volume.restrict unitCube) *
        eLpNorm (fderiv ℝ v) 3 (volume.restrict unitCube)) *
        (ENNReal.ofReal (physicalLaplacianSquare v)) ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) := by
      rw [physical_laplacian_eLpNorm_two v hv]
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (convection_eLpNorm_two_le v hv) bot_le
    _ ≤ ((A * (ENNReal.ofReal (physicalDissipation v)) ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ)) *
        (((3 : ℝ≥0∞) ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) *
            (ENNReal.ofReal (physicalDissipation v)) ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ)) ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) *
          (B * (ENNReal.ofReal (physicalLaplacianSquare v)) ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ)) ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ))) *
        (ENNReal.ofReal (physicalLaplacianSquare v)) ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) := by
      apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right _ bot_le
      refine mul_le_mul hV6 ?_ bot_le bot_le
      exact hD3.trans (mul_le_mul
        (ENNReal.rpow_le_rpow hD2 (by norm_num))
        (ENNReal.rpow_le_rpow hD6 (by norm_num)) bot_le bot_le)
    _ = _ := ennreal_three_quarter_product _ _ _ _

theorem PHYSICAL_NONLINEAR_REAL_BOUND :
    ∃ K : ℝ, 0 ≤ K ∧ ∀ v : Field, ContDiff ℝ ∞ v → SpatialPeriodic v →
      MeanZero v → abs (∫ x in unitCube,
        inner ℝ (convection v x) (laplacian v x)) ≤
          K * (physicalDissipation v) ^ (3 / 4 : ℝ) *

  obtain ⟨C, hC, hbound⟩ := PHYSICAL_NONLINEAR_THREE_QUARTER_BOUND
  refine ⟨C.toReal, ENNReal.toReal_nonneg, ?_⟩
  intro v hv hp hz
  have h := ENNReal.toReal_mono (by finiteness) (hbound v hv hp hz)
  simpa only [ENNReal.toReal_mul, ← ENNReal.toReal_rpow,
    ENNReal.toReal_ofReal (abs_nonneg _),
    ENNReal.toReal_ofReal (physical_dissipation_nonneg v),
    ENNReal.toReal_ofReal (physicalLaplacianSquare_nonneg v)] using h

/-- The nonlinear absorption has a universal constant and no evolution premise. -/
theorem PHYSICAL_NONLINEAR_ABSORPTION :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ ν : ℝ, 0 < ν → ∀ v : Field,
      ContDiff ℝ ∞ v → SpatialPeriodic v → MeanZero v →
      2 * (∫ x in unitCube, inner ℝ (convection v x) (laplacian v x)) ≤
        ν * physicalLaplacianSquare v + C / ν ^ 3 * physicalDissipation v ^ 3 := by
  obtain ⟨K, hK, hb⟩ := PHYSICAL_NONLINEAR_REAL_BOUND
  refine ⟨(2 * K) ^ 4 + 1, by positivity, ?_⟩
  intro ν hν v hv hp hz
  have hD := physical_dissipation_nonneg v
  have hZ := physicalLaplacianSquare_nonneg v
  calc
    _ ≤ 2 * abs (∫ x in unitCube, inner ℝ (convection v x) (laplacian v x)) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (le_abs_self _) (by norm_num)
    _ ≤ 2 * (K * physicalDissipation v ^ (3 / 4 : ℝ) *
        physicalLaplacianSquare v ^ (3 / 4 : ℝ)) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hb v hv hp hz) (by norm_num)
    _ = 2 * K * physicalDissipation v ^ (3 / 4 : ℝ) *
        physicalLaplacianSquare v ^ (3 / 4 : ℝ) := by ring
    _ ≤ ν * physicalLaplacianSquare v +
        (2 * K) ^ 4 / ν ^ 3 * physicalDissipation v ^ 3 :=
      nonlinear_three_quarter_absorption hK hD hZ hν
    _ ≤ _ := by
      apply add_le_add le_rfl
      apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right _ (pow_nonneg hD _)
      exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (by linarith) (pow_nonneg hν.le _)

end

/-- Modal integral identities and a continuous Sobolev RHS give the actual
Hilbert-valued derivative throughout a closed finite interval, including zero.
-/
theorem local_sobolev_hasDerivWithinAt_of_coefficient_integral
    (s : ℕ) (T : ℝ) (hT : 0 ≤ T) (u r : ℝ → TorusSobolev s)
    (hr : ContinuousOn r (Icc (0 : ℝ) T))
    (hcoeff : ∀ t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) T, ∀ k : Frequency, ∀ i : Fin 3,
      (u t).val k i = (u 0).val k i + ∫ z in (0 : ℝ)..t, (r z).val k i)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) T) :
    HasDerivWithinAt u (r t) (Icc (0 : ℝ) T) t := by
  let r' : ℝ → TorusSobolev s := fun z => r (min (max z 0) T)
  have hr' : Continuous r' :=
    hr.comp_continuous ((continuous_id.max continuous_const).min continuous_const)
      (fun z => ⟨le_min (le_max_right z 0) hT, min_le_right _ _⟩)
  have hidentity (z : ℝ) (hz : z ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) T) :
      u z = u 0 + ∫ y in (0 : ℝ)..z, r' y := by
    have hri : IntervalIntegrable r volume 0 z :=
      (hr.mono (fun y hy => ⟨hy.1, hy.2.trans hz.2⟩)).intervalIntegrable_of_Icc hz.1
    rw [torusSobolev_integral_eq_of_coefficient_integral s u r z hri (hcoeff z hz)]
    congr 1
    apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr
    intro y hy
    have hm : y ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) z := by simpa only [uIcc_of_le hz.1] using hy
    simp only [r', max_eq_left hm.1, min_eq_left (hm.2.trans hz.2)]
  have hd : HasDerivWithinAt
      (fun z => u 0 + ∫ y in (0 : ℝ)..z, r' y) (r' t) (Icc (0 : ℝ) T) t :=
    ((hr'.integral_hasStrictDerivAt 0 t).hasDerivAt.const_add (u 0)).hasDerivWithinAt
  have hu := hd.congr_of_mem (fun z hz => hidentity z hz) ht
  simpa only [r', max_eq_left ht.1, min_eq_left ht.2] using hu

/-- Simultaneous time differentiation on a finite Sobolev scale. -/
theorem local_sobolevScale_contDiffOn_nat
    (T : ℝ) (hT : 0 < T)
    (U : ∀ m : ℕ, ℝ → TorusSobolev m)
    (F : ∀ m : ℕ, TorusSobolev (m + 2) → TorusSobolev m)
    (hU : ∀ m : ℕ, ContinuousOn (U m) (Icc (0 : ℝ) T))
    (hF : ∀ m : ℕ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (F m))
    (hderiv : ∀ (m : ℕ) (t : ℝ), t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) T →
      HasDerivWithinAt (U m) (F m (U (m + 2) t)) (Icc (0 : ℝ) T) t)
    (n m : ℕ) : ContDiffOn ℝ n (U m) (Icc (0 : ℝ) T) := by
  induction n generalizing m with
  | zero => exact contDiffOn_zero.mpr (hU m)
  | succ n ih =>
      change ContDiffOn ℝ ((n : ℕ∞ω) + 1) (U m) (Icc (0 : ℝ) T)
      apply (contDiffOn_succ_iff_derivWithin (uniqueDiffOn_Icc hT)).mpr
      refine ⟨fun t ht => (hderiv m t ht).differentiableWithinAt, by simp, ?_⟩
      have hcomp : ContDiffOn ℝ n (fun t => F m (U (m + 2) t)) (Icc (0 : ℝ) T) :=
        ((contDiff_infty.mp (hF m)) n).fun_comp_contDiffOn (ih (m + 2))
      apply hcomp.congr
      intro t ht
      exact (hderiv m t ht).derivWithin ((uniqueDiffOn_Icc hT) t ht)

theorem local_sobolev_scale_time_smooth
    (T : ℝ) (hT : 0 < T)
    (U : ∀ m : ℕ, ℝ → TorusSobolev m)
    (F : ∀ m : ℕ, TorusSobolev (m + 2) → TorusSobolev m)
    (hU : ∀ m : ℕ, ContinuousOn (U m) (Icc (0 : ℝ) T))
    (hF : ∀ m : ℕ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (F m))
    (hderiv : ∀ (m : ℕ) (t : ℝ), t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) T →
      HasDerivWithinAt (U m) (F m (U (m + 2) t)) (Icc (0 : ℝ) T) t) :
    ∀ m : ℕ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (U m) (Icc (0 : ℝ) T) := by
  intro m
  apply contDiffOn_infty.mpr
  intro n
  exact local_sobolevScale_contDiffOn_nat T hT U F hU hF hderiv n m

theorem local_sobolev_curves_joint_spacetime_smooth
    (T : ℝ) (U : ∀ s : ℕ, ℝ → TorusSobolev s)
    (hU : ∀ s : ℕ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (U s) (Icc (0 : ℝ) T))
    (hcoeff : ∀ (s : ℕ) (t : ℝ), t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) T →
      (U s t).val = (U 0 t).val) :
    ContDiffOn ℝ ∞
      (fun z : ℝ × Vec => smoothFourierSynthesis (U 0 z.1).val z.2)
      (initialFrontSpacetime T) := by
  apply contDiffOn_infty.mpr
  intro n
  have hE : ContDiffOn ℝ n (fun z : ℝ × Vec => sobolevPhysicalEvaluation n z.2)
      (initialFrontSpacetime T) :=
    ((sobolevPhysicalEvaluation_contDiff n).comp contDiff_snd).contDiffOn
  have htime : ContDiffOn ℝ n (fun z : ℝ × Vec => U (n + 4) z.1)
      (initialFrontSpacetime T) :=
    ((contDiffOn_infty.mp (hU (n + 4))) n).comp contDiff_fst.contDiffOn
      (fun z hz => ⟨hz.1, hz.2.le⟩)
  have h : ContDiffOn ℝ n
      (fun z : ℝ × Vec => smoothFourierSynthesis (U (n + 4) z.1).val z.2)
      (initialFrontSpacetime T) := by
    simpa only [sobolevPhysicalEvaluation_apply] using hE.clm_apply htime
  apply h.congr
  intro z hz
  exact congrArg (fun c : FourierCoeff => smoothFourierSynthesis c z.2)
    (hcoeff (n + 4) z.1 ⟨hz.1, hz.2.le⟩).symm

theorem local_sobolevTransportPressureCurve_contDiffOn
    (T : ℝ) (U : ∀ s : ℕ, ℝ → TorusSobolev s)
    (hU : ∀ s : ℕ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (U s) (Icc (0 : ℝ) T)) (s : ℕ) :
    ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (sobolevTransportPressureCurve U s) (Icc (0 : ℝ) T) := by
  have hprod : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞
      (fun t => sobolevDivergenceProduct s (U (s + 2) t) (U (s + 2) t))
      (Icc (0 : ℝ) T) :=
    (sobolevDivergenceProduct_diagonal_contDiff s).fun_comp_contDiffOn (hU (s + 2))
  exact ((torusSobolevPressure s).restrictScalars ℝ).contDiff.fun_comp_contDiffOn hprod

theorem local_sobolevTransportPressureCurve_coeff
    (T : ℝ) (U : ∀ s : ℕ, ℝ → TorusSobolev s)
    (hcoeff : ∀ (s : ℕ) (t : ℝ), t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) T →
      (U s t).val = (U 0 t).val)
    (s : ℕ) (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) T) :
    (sobolevTransportPressureCurve U s t).val =
      pressureVectorCoeff (fullTransportCoefficients (U 0 t)) := by
  have hlower : torusSobolevLower 0 (s + 2) (Nat.zero_le _) (U (s + 2) t) = U 0 t := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    simpa only [torusSobolevLower_coeff] using hcoeff (s + 2) t ht
  rw [sobolevTransportPressureCurve, torusSobolevPressure_coeff, sobolevDivergenceProduct_coeff]
  apply congrArg pressureVectorCoeff
  funext k i
  unfold sobolevDivergenceProductCoeff fullTransportCoefficients
  simp only [hlower]

theorem local_sobolev_pressure_joint_smooth
    (T : ℝ) (U : ∀ s : ℕ, ℝ → TorusSobolev s)
    (hU : ∀ s : ℕ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (U s) (Icc (0 : ℝ) T))
    (hcoeff : ∀ (s : ℕ) (t : ℝ), t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) T →
      (U s t).val = (U 0 t).val) :
    ContDiffOn ℝ ∞
      (fun z : ℝ × Vec => fullTransportPressure (U 0 z.1) z.2)
      (initialFrontSpacetime T) := by
  have hP : ∀ (s : ℕ) (t : ℝ), t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) T →
      (sobolevTransportPressureCurve U s t).val =
        (sobolevTransportPressureCurve U 0 t).val := by
    intro s t ht
    rw [local_sobolevTransportPressureCurve_coeff T U hcoeff s t ht,
      local_sobolevTransportPressureCurve_coeff T U hcoeff 0 t ht]
  have hjoint := local_sobolev_curves_joint_spacetime_smooth T
    (sobolevTransportPressureCurve U) (local_sobolevTransportPressureCurve_contDiffOn T U hU) hP
  have hscalar := (EuclideanSpace.proj (0 : Fin 3) : Vec →L[ℝ] ℝ).contDiff.fun_comp_contDiffOn hjoint
  apply hscalar.congr
  intro z hz
  change fullTransportPressure (U 0 z.1) z.2 =
    smoothFourierSynthesis (sobolevTransportPressureCurve U 0 z.1).val z.2 0
  rw [local_sobolevTransportPressureCurve_coeff T U hcoeff 0 z.1 ⟨hz.1, hz.2.le⟩,
    smoothFourierSynthesis_pressureVector_first]
  rfl

/-- Compatible actual Sobolev trajectories solving the untruncated Fourier NSE
on a fixed closed interval. No physical realization is assumed in this record.
-/
structure LocalSobolevFlow (ν T : ℝ) where
  state : ∀ r : ℕ, ℝ → TorusSobolev r
  continuous : ∀ r : ℕ, ContinuousOn (state r) (Icc (0 : ℝ) T)
  coeff : ∀ (r : ℕ) (t : ℝ), t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) T →
    (state r t).val = (state 0 t).val
  derivative : ∀ (r : ℕ) (t : ℝ), t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) T →
    HasDerivWithinAt (state r) (fourierSobolevRhs ν r (state (r + 2) t))
      (Icc (0 : ℝ) T) t
  reality : ∀ t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) T, SpectralReality (state 0 t).val
  solenoidal : ∀ t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) T, SpectralSolenoidal (state 0 t).val
  mean_zero : ∀ t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) T, SpectralMeanZero (state 0 t).val

def LocalSobolevFlow.velocity {ν T : ℝ} (L : LocalSobolevFlow ν T) : Velocity :=
  fun t => smoothFourierSynthesis (L.state 0 t).val

def LocalSobolevFlow.pressure {ν T : ℝ} (L : LocalSobolevFlow ν T) : Pressure :=
  fun t => fullTransportPressure (L.state 0 t)

theorem LocalSobolevFlow.state_all_mem
    {ν T : ℝ} (L : LocalSobolevFlow ν T) (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) T) (s : ℕ) :
    Memℓp (sobolevWeightedCoeff s (L.state 0 t).val) 2 := by
  rw [← L.coeff s t ht]
  exact (L.state s t).property

theorem LocalSobolevFlow.rhs_coeff
    {ν T : ℝ} (L : LocalSobolevFlow ν T) (r : ℕ) (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) T) :
    (fourierSobolevRhs ν r (L.state (r + 2) t)).val = fullFourierRhs ν (L.state 0 t) := by
  have hlower : torusSobolevLower 0 (r + 2) (Nat.zero_le _) (L.state (r + 2) t) =
      L.state 0 t := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    rw [torusSobolevLower_coeff]
    exact L.coeff (r + 2) t ht
  rw [fourierSobolevRhs_coefficient_eq_fullRhs, hlower]

theorem LocalSobolevFlow.time_smooth
    {ν T : ℝ} (L : LocalSobolevFlow ν T) (hT : 0 < T) :
    ∀ r : ℕ, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (L.state r) (Icc (0 : ℝ) T) :=
  local_sobolev_scale_time_smooth T hT L.state (fourierSobolevRhs ν)
    L.continuous (fourierSobolevRhs_contDiff ν) L.derivative

theorem LocalSobolevFlow.velocity_spacetime_smooth
    {ν T : ℝ} (L : LocalSobolevFlow ν T) (hT : 0 < T) :
    ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ × Vec => L.velocity z.1 z.2) (initialFrontSpacetime T) :=
  local_sobolev_curves_joint_spacetime_smooth T L.state (L.time_smooth hT) L.coeff

theorem LocalSobolevFlow.pressure_spacetime_smooth
    {ν T : ℝ} (L : LocalSobolevFlow ν T) (hT : 0 < T) :
    ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ × Vec => L.pressure z.1 z.2) (initialFrontSpacetime T) :=
  local_sobolev_pressure_joint_smooth T L.state (L.time_smooth hT) L.coeff

theorem LocalSobolevFlow.velocity_timeDerivative
    {ν T : ℝ} (L : LocalSobolevFlow ν T) (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Ico (0 : ℝ) T) :
    timeDerivative L.velocity t = smoothFourierSynthesis (fullFourierRhs ν (L.state 0 t)) := by
  funext x
  have ht' : t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) T := ⟨ht.1, ht.2.le⟩
  have hd := (sobolevPhysicalEvaluation4 x).hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivWithinAt t
    (L.derivative 4 t ht')
  have h4 : HasDerivWithinAt
      (fun z => smoothFourierSynthesis (L.state 4 z).val x)
      (smoothFourierSynthesis (fourierSobolevRhs ν 4 (L.state 6 t)).val x)
      (Icc (0 : ℝ) T) t := by
    simpa only [Function.comp_def, sobolevPhysicalEvaluation4,
      sobolevPhysicalEvaluation_apply] using! hd
  have h0 : HasDerivWithinAt (fun z => L.velocity z x)
      (smoothFourierSynthesis (fullFourierRhs ν (L.state 0 t)) x)
      (Icc (0 : ℝ) T) t := by
    rw [L.rhs_coeff 4 t ht'] at h4
    apply h4.congr_of_mem _ ht'
    intro z hz
    exact congrArg (fun c : FourierCoeff => smoothFourierSynthesis c x) (L.coeff 4 z hz).symm
  have hlocal : Icc (0 : ℝ) T ∈ 𝓝[Ici (0 : ℝ)] t := by
    have hupper : ∀ᶠ z : ℝ in 𝓝[Ici (0 : ℝ)] t, z < T :=
      nhdsWithin_le_nhds (Iio_mem_nhds ht.2)
    filter_upwards [self_mem_nhdsWithin, hupper] with z hz hzT
    exact ⟨hz, hzT.le⟩
  exact (h0.mono_of_mem_nhdsWithin hlocal).derivWithin ((uniqueDiffOn_Ici 0) t ht.1)

theorem LocalSobolevFlow.physical_equation
    {ν T : ℝ} (L : LocalSobolevFlow ν T) (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Ico (0 : ℝ) T) (x : Vec) :
    timeDerivative L.velocity t x + convection (L.velocity t) x +
      SingularClosure.gradient (L.pressure t) x = ν • laplacian (L.velocity t) x := by
  have ht' : t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) T := ⟨ht.1, ht.2.le⟩
  have hr (s : ℕ) : Memℓp (sobolevWeightedCoeff s (fullFourierRhs ν (L.state 0 t))) 2 := by
    rw [← L.rhs_coeff s t ht']
    exact (fourierSobolevRhs ν s (L.state (s + 2) t)).property
  rw [L.velocity_timeDerivative t ht]
  exact PHYSICAL_NSE_OF_FULL_FOURIER_RHS ν (L.state 0 t) (L.state_all_mem t ht')
    (L.reality t ht') (L.solenoidal t ht') hr x

theorem LocalSobolevFlow.velocity_smoothSigmaZero
    {ν T : ℝ} (L : LocalSobolevFlow ν T) (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) T) :
    SmoothSigmaZero (L.velocity t) :=
  smoothFourierSynthesis_smoothSigmaZero (L.state 0 t).val (L.state_all_mem t ht)
    (L.mean_zero t ht) (L.solenoidal t ht)

theorem LocalSobolevFlow.initial_eq
    {ν T : ℝ} (L : LocalSobolevFlow ν T) (hT : 0 ≤ T)
    (a : Field) (ha : SmoothSigmaZero a)
    (hinitial : (L.state 0 0).val = datumFourierCoeff a) : L.velocity 0 = a := by
  have h0 : (0 : ℝ) ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) T := ⟨le_rfl, hT⟩
  have hv := L.velocity_smoothSigmaZero 0 h0
  apply datumFourierCoeff_injective_continuous_periodic (L.velocity 0) a
    hv.smooth.continuous ha.smooth.continuous hv.periodic ha.periodic
  change datumFourierCoeff (smoothFourierSynthesis (L.state 0 0).val) = datumFourierCoeff a
  rw [datumFourierCoeff_smoothFourierSynthesis _
    (ALL_SOBOLEV_IMP_RAPID_SCALAR _ (L.state_all_mem 0 h0)) (L.reality 0 h0)]
  exact hinitial

/-- An actual local Sobolev flow with the literal initial coefficients gives
the finite classical front, including its normalized pressure and time zero.
-/
theorem LocalSobolevFlow.initialClassicalFront
    {ν T : ℝ} (L : LocalSobolevFlow ν T) (hT : 0 < T)
    (a : Field) (ha : SmoothSigmaZero a)
    (hinitial : (L.state 0 0).val = datumFourierCoeff a) :
    InitialClassicalFront ν T a L.velocity L.pressure := by
  refine {
    velocity_smooth := L.velocity_spacetime_smooth hT
    pressure_smooth := L.pressure_spacetime_smooth hT
    velocity_periodic := fun t ht => (L.velocity_smoothSigmaZero t ⟨ht.1, ht.2.le⟩).periodic
    pressure_periodic := fun t _ => fullTransportPressure_periodic (L.state 0 t)
    divergence_free := fun t ht => (L.velocity_smoothSigmaZero t ⟨ht.1, ht.2.le⟩).divergence_free
    equation := L.physical_equation
    initial := L.initial_eq hT.le a ha hinitial
    velocity_mean_zero := fun t ht => (L.velocity_smoothSigmaZero t ⟨ht.1, ht.2.le⟩).mean_zero
    pressure_mean_zero := ?_
  }
  intro t ht
  have ht' : t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) T := ⟨ht.1, ht.2.le⟩
  exact fullTransportPressure_meanZero (L.state 0 t) (L.state_all_mem t ht')
    (L.reality t ht') (L.solenoidal t ht')

end

/-!
Construction of an actual finite-window Sobolev NSE flow from the Galerkin
approximations. Higher membership and continuity follow from proved uniform
bounds, the untruncated modal equation follows from the actual H0 limit, and
its Sobolev derivative is proved by integration. The canonical construction
also identifies the literal initial Fourier coefficients of the smooth datum.
Prepared source only; matching external cached verification is required.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

open Set Filter MeasureTheory SingularClosure
open scoped Topology Interval

namespace MethbokeAddon.WeakFouriermanB
noncomputable section

/-- Finite-window construction from an actual Galerkin limit and explicit
all-order bounds. No physical solution or derivative equation is assumed. -/
theorem local_sobolev_flow_of_galerkin_limit
    (ν : ℝ) (a : Field) (φ : ℕ → ℕ) (hφ : StrictMono φ)
    (g : ∀ n : ℕ, GalerkinSolution ν a (φ n + 1))
    (T : ℝ) (hT : 0 < T)
    (u : ℝ → TorusSobolev 0) (hu : ContinuousOn u (Icc (0 : ℝ) T))
    (hconv : TendstoUniformlyOn (fun n t => (g n).sobolevState 0 t)
      u atTop (Icc (0 : ℝ) T))
    (hbound : ∀ s : ℕ, ∃ B : ℝ, 0 ≤ B ∧
      ∀ (n : ℕ) (t : ℝ), t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) T → ‖(g n).sobolevState s t‖ ≤ B) :
    ∃ L : LocalSobolevFlow ν T, ∀ t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) T, L.state 0 t = u t := by
  classical
  have hzero : (0 : ℝ) ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) T := ⟨le_rfl, hT.le⟩
  have hcoeff (s : ℕ) (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) T)
      (k : Frequency) (i : Fin 3) :
      Tendsto (fun n => ((g n).sobolevState s t).val k i) atTop (𝓝 ((u t).val k i)) := by
    have h := ((torusSobolevH0Coeff_continuous k i).tendsto (u t)).comp
      (hconv.tendsto_at ht)
    have heq : (fun n => ((g n).sobolevState s t).val k i) =
        (fun n => ((g n).sobolevState 0 t).val k i) := by
      funext n
      rw [(g n).sobolevState_coeff s ht.1, (g n).sobolevState_coeff 0 ht.1]
    rw [heq]
    exact h
  have hmem (s : ℕ) (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) T) :
      Memℓp (sobolevWeightedCoeff s (u t).val) 2 := by
    obtain ⟨B, _, hb⟩ := hbound s
    exact (torusSobolev_limit_mem_and_norm_le s
      (fun n => (g n).sobolevState s t) (u t).val B
      (fun n => hb n t ht) (hcoeff s t ht)).choose
  let U : ∀ s : ℕ, ℝ → TorusSobolev s := fun s t =>
    if ht : t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) T then ⟨(u t).val, hmem s t ht⟩ else 0
  have hUc (s : ℕ) (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) T) :
      (U s t).val = (u t).val := by
    have heq : U s t = (⟨(u t).val, hmem s t ht⟩ : TorusSobolev s) := dif_pos ht
    exact congrArg (fun z : TorusSobolev s => z.val) heq
  have hU0 (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) T) : U 0 t = u t :=
    Subtype.ext (hUc 0 t ht)
  have hUb (s : ℕ) : ∃ B : ℝ, 0 ≤ B ∧ ∀ t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) T, ‖U s t‖ ≤ B := by
    obtain ⟨B, hB, hb⟩ := hbound s
    refine ⟨B, hB, ?_⟩
    intro t ht
    obtain ⟨hc, hn⟩ := torusSobolev_limit_mem_and_norm_le s
      (fun n => (g n).sobolevState s t) (u t).val B
      (fun n => hb n t ht) (hcoeff s t ht)
    have heq : U s t = (⟨(u t).val, hc⟩ : TorusSobolev s) := Subtype.ext (hUc s t ht)
    rw [heq]
    exact hn
  have hinc (s : ℕ) (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) T) :
      torusSobolevInclusion s (U (s + 1) t) = U s t := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    rw [torusSobolevInclusion_coeff, hUc (s + 1) t ht, hUc s t ht]
  have hU (s : ℕ) : ContinuousOn (U s) (Icc (0 : ℝ) T) := by
    obtain ⟨B, _, hb⟩ := hUb (s + 1)
    have hc (k : Frequency) (i : Fin 3) :
        ContinuousOn (fun t => (U (s + 1) t).val k i) (Icc (0 : ℝ) T) := by
      apply ((torusSobolevH0Coeff_continuous k i).comp_continuousOn hu).congr
      intro t ht
      exact congrArg (fun c : FourierCoeff => c k i) (hUc (s + 1) t ht)
    apply (torusSobolevInclusion_continuousOn_of_coeff_continuousOn
      s (U (s + 1)) (Icc (0 : ℝ) T) B hb hc).congr
    intro t ht
    exact (hinc s t ht).symm
  have hR (s : ℕ) : ContinuousOn
      (fun t => fourierSobolevRhs ν s (U (s + 2) t)) (Icc (0 : ℝ) T) :=
    (fourierSobolevRhs_contDiff ν s).continuous.comp_continuousOn (hU (s + 2))
  have hRc (s : ℕ) (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) T) :
      (fourierSobolevRhs ν s (U (s + 2) t)).val = fullFourierRhs ν (u t) := by
    have hlower : torusSobolevLower 0 (s + 2) (Nat.zero_le _) (U (s + 2) t) = u t := by
      apply Subtype.ext
      rw [torusSobolevLower_coeff]
      exact hUc (s + 2) t ht
    rw [fourierSobolevRhs_coefficient_eq_fullRhs, hlower]
  have heq := galerkinLimit_coefficient_integral ν a φ hφ g T hT.le u hu hconv
  have hmodal (s : ℕ) (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) T)
      (k : Frequency) (i : Fin 3) :
      (U s t).val k i = (U s 0).val k i +
        ∫ z in (0 : ℝ)..t, (fourierSobolevRhs ν s (U (s + 2) z)).val k i := by
    rw [hUc s t ht, hUc s 0 hzero, heq t ht k i]
    congr 1
    apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr
    intro z hz
    have hz' : z ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) t := by simpa only [uIcc_of_le ht.1] using hz
    exact congrArg (fun c : FourierCoeff => c k i) (hRc s z ⟨hz'.1, hz'.2.trans ht.2⟩).symm
  have hd (s : ℕ) (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) T) :
      HasDerivWithinAt (U s) (fourierSobolevRhs ν s (U (s + 2) t)) (Icc (0 : ℝ) T) t :=
    local_sobolev_hasDerivWithinAt_of_coefficient_integral s T hT.le (U s)
      (fun z => fourierSobolevRhs ν s (U (s + 2) z)) (hR s) (hmodal s) t ht
  have hlim (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) T) :
      Tendsto (fun n => (g n).sobolevState 0 t) atTop (𝓝 (u t)) := hconv.tendsto_at ht
  have hreal (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) T) : SpectralReality (U 0 t).val := by
    rw [hUc 0 t ht]
    exact torusSobolevH0_reality_of_tendsto (hlim t ht)
      (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun n => (g n).sobolevState_reality 0 t ht.1))
  have hsol (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) T) : SpectralSolenoidal (U 0 t).val := by
    rw [hUc 0 t ht]
    exact torusSobolevH0_solenoidal_of_tendsto (hlim t ht)
      (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun n => (g n).sobolevState_solenoidal 0 t ht.1))
  have hzeroMode (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) T) : SpectralMeanZero (U 0 t).val := by
    rw [hUc 0 t ht]
    exact torusSobolevH0_zero_mode_of_tendsto (hlim t ht)
      (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun n => (g n).sobolevState_zero_mode 0 t ht.1))
  refine ⟨{
    state := U
    continuous := hU
    coeff := fun s t ht => (hUc s t ht).trans (hUc 0 t ht).symm
    derivative := hd
    reality := hreal
    solenoidal := hsol
    mean_zero := hzeroMode
  }, hU0⟩

/-- The local H2 bound constructs the actual finite-window Sobolev flow with
its original smooth datum. The higher norms do not reduce the interval. -/
theorem local_sobolev_flow_of_uniform_H2
    (ν : ℝ) (hν : 0 < ν) (a : Field) (ha : SmoothSigmaZero a)
    (T : ℝ) (hT : 0 < T) (S : ℝ) (hS : 0 ≤ S)
    (hH2 : ∀ N : ℕ, 1 ≤ N → ∀ g : GalerkinSolution ν a N,
      (∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..T, ‖g.sobolevState 2 t‖ ^ 2) ≤ S) :
    ∃ L : LocalSobolevFlow ν T, (L.state 0 0).val = datumFourierCoeff a := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨v, φ, hφ, hv⟩ :=
    local_canonical_galerkin_H0_uniform_subsequence ν hν a ha T hT S hS hH2
  let g := fun n => canonicalGalerkinSolution ν hν a ha (φ n + 1)
  let u : ℝ → TorusSobolev 0 := fun t =>
    if ht : t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) T then v ⟨t, ht⟩ else 0
  have hrestrict : (fun t : Icc (0 : ℝ) T => u t.val) = v := by
    funext t
    simp only [u, dif_pos t.property]
  have hconv : TendstoUniformlyOn (fun n t => (g n).sobolevState 0 t)
      u atTop (Icc (0 : ℝ) T) := by
    apply tendstoUniformlyOn_iff_tendstoUniformly_comp_coe.mpr
    change TendstoUniformly
      (fun n (t : Icc (0 : ℝ) T) => (g n).sobolevState 0 t.val)
      (fun t : Icc (0 : ℝ) T => u t.val) atTop
    rw [hrestrict]
    exact hv
  have hu : ContinuousOn u (Icc (0 : ℝ) T) :=
    hconv.continuousOn (Filter.Eventually.of_forall
      (fun n => ((g n).sobolevState_continuousOn 0).mono (fun t ht => ht.1))).frequently
  have hbound (s : ℕ) : ∃ B : ℝ, 0 ≤ B ∧
      ∀ (n : ℕ) (t : ℝ), t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) T → ‖(g n).sobolevState s t‖ ≤ B := by
    obtain ⟨B, hB, hb⟩ := local_galerkin_high_order_pointwise ν hν a ha T hT S hS hH2 s
    refine ⟨B + 1, by linarith, ?_⟩
    intro n t ht
    have hn := hb (φ n + 1) (by omega) (g n) t ht
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg (‖(g n).sobolevState s t‖ - 1)]
  obtain ⟨L, hL⟩ := local_sobolev_flow_of_galerkin_limit ν a φ hφ g T hT u hu hconv hbound
  refine ⟨L, ?_⟩
  have hzero : (0 : ℝ) ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) T := ⟨le_rfl, hT.le⟩
  rw [hL 0 hzero]
  change (u 0).val = datumFourierCoeff a
  have hu0 : u 0 = v ⟨0, hzero⟩ := dif_pos hzero
  rw [hu0]
  exact canonicalSobolevLimit_initial_coeff ν hν a ha T hT.le v φ hφ hv

end
end MethbokeAddon.WeakFouriermanB

/-- The explicit short-time bound constructs a smooth physical solution pair
for every smooth datum satisfying the stated enstrophy bound. -/
theorem local_initial_classical_front_exists
    (ν R : ℝ) (hν : 0 < ν) (hR : 0 ≤ R)
    (a : Field) (ha : SmoothSigmaZero a) (hinit : physicalDissipation a ≤ R) :
    ∃ u : Velocity, ∃ p : Pressure,
      InitialClassicalFront ν (localGalerkinTime ν R) a u p := by
  let T : ℝ := localGalerkinTime ν R
  let S : ℝ := 6 * (R + 1) * T + localGalerkinAccumulationBound ν R / ν
  have hT : 0 < T := localGalerkinTime_pos hν hR
  have hS : 0 ≤ S := by
    have hacc := localGalerkinAccumulationBound_nonneg (ν := ν) hR
    dsimp only [S]
    positivity
  have hH2 : ∀ N : ℕ, 1 ≤ N → ∀ g : GalerkinSolution ν a N,
      (∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..T, ‖g.sobolevState 2 t‖ ^ 2) ≤ S := by
    intro N _hN g
    exact (galerkin_uniform_local_sobolev_bounds ν R hν hR a ha hinit N g).2.2
  obtain ⟨L, hL⟩ := local_sobolev_flow_of_uniform_H2 ν hν a ha T hT S hS hH2
  exact ⟨L.velocity, L.pressure, L.initialClassicalFront hT a ha hL⟩

/-- A single positive lifespan works for every smooth initial datum in the
specified physical H1 ball. Higher smooth norms affect regularity bounds only.
-/
theorem uniform_H1_local_initial_classical_front_exists
    (ν R : ℝ) (hν : 0 < ν) (hR : 0 ≤ R) :
    ∃ T : ℝ, 0 < T ∧ ∀ a : Field, SmoothSigmaZero a → physicalH1Square a ≤ R →
      ∃ u : Velocity, ∃ p : Pressure, InitialClassicalFront ν T a u p := by
  refine ⟨localGalerkinTime ν R, localGalerkinTime_pos hν hR, ?_⟩
  intro a ha hH1
  have hE : 0 ≤ physicalEnergy a := by
    rw [physicalEnergy_eq_integral_norm_sq]
    exact integral_nonneg (fun x => sq_nonneg ‖a x‖)
  have hinit : physicalDissipation a ≤ R := by
    change physicalEnergy a + physicalDissipation a ≤ R at hH1
    linarith
  exact local_initial_classical_front_exists ν R hν hR a ha hinit

end

# One maximal physical classical trajectory from actual local existence

The lifetime is the extended nonnegative supremum of the durations of all
actual positive initial classical fronts. At each covered time one front is
chosen. Physical velocity and normalized-pressure uniqueness prove that these
choices agree with every supplied front; the resulting single pair therefore
has every shorter finite-front restriction.

The construction is conditional on an actual initial front, or on the explicit
local-existence premise in the final existence wrapper. It does not prove that
premise, an H1-controlled lifespan, or the full WFB conclusion. No existence,
uniqueness or continuation assertion is introduced as an axiom.

Prepared source only; external cached compilation and fresh exact-type/axiom
audits are required. No local Lean, Lake or kernel execution was used.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

open Set SingularClosure
open scoped ENNReal

noncomputable section

/-- A single physical pair on every positive finite interval below its
extended lifetime. Every other admitted initial front agrees with this pair,
and its duration is bounded by the lifetime. The last field excludes any
proper classical extension, including one given by a different representative.
-/
structure MaximalClassicalFront (ν : ℝ) (a : Field)
    (u : Velocity) (p : Pressure) (Tmax : ℝ≥0∞) : Prop where
  lifetime_pos : 0 < Tmax
  initial : u 0 = a
  finite_front : ∀ T : ℝ, 0 < T → ENNReal.ofReal T < Tmax →
    InitialClassicalFront ν T a u p
  agreement : ∀ (T : ℝ) (v : Velocity) (q : Pressure), 0 < T →
    InitialClassicalFront ν T a v q →
    ∀ r ∈ Ico (0 : ℝ) T, u r = v r ∧ p r = q r
  no_extension : ∀ (T : ℝ) (v : Velocity) (q : Pressure), 0 < T →
    InitialClassicalFront ν T a v q → ENNReal.ofReal T ≤ Tmax

private structure MaximalFrontWitness (ν : ℝ) (a : Field) where
  horizon : ℝ
  horizon_pos : 0 < horizon
  velocity : Velocity
  pressure : Pressure
  front : InitialClassicalFront ν horizon a velocity pressure

private def canonicalClassicalLifetime (ν : ℝ) (a : Field) : ℝ≥0∞ :=
  ⨆ F : MaximalFrontWitness ν a, ENNReal.ofReal F.horizon

private def canonicalClassicalVelocity (ν : ℝ) (a : Field) : Velocity := by
  classical
  exact fun t => if h : ∃ F : MaximalFrontWitness ν a, t < F.horizon then
    (Classical.choose h).velocity t else 0

private def canonicalClassicalPressure (ν : ℝ) (a : Field) : Pressure := by
  classical
  exact fun t => if h : ∃ F : MaximalFrontWitness ν a, t < F.horizon then
    (Classical.choose h).pressure t else 0

private theorem canonicalClassicalPair_agrees
    (ν : ℝ) (a : Field) (hν : 0 < ν) (F : MaximalFrontWitness ν a)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Ico (0 : ℝ) F.horizon) :
    canonicalClassicalVelocity ν a t = F.velocity t ∧
      canonicalClassicalPressure ν a t = F.pressure t := by
  classical
  have hex : ∃ G : MaximalFrontWitness ν a, t < G.horizon := ⟨F, ht.2⟩
  let G : MaximalFrontWitness ν a := Classical.choose hex
  have hGt : t < G.horizon := Classical.choose_spec hex
  have hagree := initial_classical_front_unique ν G.horizon F.horizon a
    G.velocity F.velocity G.pressure F.pressure hν G.horizon_pos F.horizon_pos
    G.front F.front t ⟨ht.1, lt_min hGt ht.2⟩
  simpa only [canonicalClassicalVelocity, canonicalClassicalPressure,
    dif_pos hex, G] using hagree

/-- Construct an actual maximal pair from one actual positive initial front.
There is no norm-controlled local-existence assertion in this theorem.
-/
theorem maximal_classical_front_exists_of_front
    (ν T : ℝ) (a : Field) (u : Velocity) (p : Pressure)
    (hν : 0 < ν) (hT : 0 < T) (H : InitialClassicalFront ν T a u p) :
    ∃ Tmax : ℝ≥0∞, ∃ (U : Velocity) (P : Pressure),
      MaximalClassicalFront ν a U P Tmax := by
  let F : MaximalFrontWitness ν a := ⟨T, hT, u, p, H⟩
  have hFle : ENNReal.ofReal F.horizon ≤ canonicalClassicalLifetime ν a :=
    le_iSup (fun G : MaximalFrontWitness ν a => ENNReal.ofReal G.horizon) F
  refine ⟨canonicalClassicalLifetime ν a, canonicalClassicalVelocity ν a,
    canonicalClassicalPressure ν a, ?_⟩
  refine {
    lifetime_pos := (ENNReal.ofReal_pos.mpr F.horizon_pos).trans_le hFle
    initial := (canonicalClassicalPair_agrees ν a hν F 0
      ⟨le_rfl, F.horizon_pos⟩).1.trans F.front.initial
    finite_front := ?_
    agreement := ?_
    no_extension := ?_
  }
  · intro S hS hSlife
    change ENNReal.ofReal S <
      ⨆ G : MaximalFrontWitness ν a, ENNReal.ofReal G.horizon at hSlife
    obtain ⟨G, hSG⟩ := lt_iSup_iff.mp hSlife
    have hSGreal : S < G.horizon :=
      (ENNReal.ofReal_lt_ofReal_iff_of_nonneg hS.le).mp hSG
    have HG := initial_front_restrict ν G.horizon S a G.velocity G.pressure
      G.front hSGreal.le
    apply initial_front_congr ν S a G.velocity (canonicalClassicalVelocity ν a)
      G.pressure (canonicalClassicalPressure ν a) HG hS
    · intro r hr
      exact (canonicalClassicalPair_agrees ν a hν G r
        ⟨hr.1, hr.2.trans hSGreal⟩).1
    · intro r hr
      exact (canonicalClassicalPair_agrees ν a hν G r
        ⟨hr.1, hr.2.trans hSGreal⟩).2
  · intro S v q hS K r hr
    exact canonicalClassicalPair_agrees ν a hν ⟨S, hS, v, q, K⟩ r hr
  · intro S v q hS K
    exact le_iSup (fun G : MaximalFrontWitness ν a => ENNReal.ofReal G.horizon)
      ⟨S, hS, v, q, K⟩

/-- Explicit local existence is the only construction premise beyond smooth
data and positive viscosity. It must be discharged by the physical local
theory before this theorem can close the maximal-trajectory WFB obligation.
-/
theorem maximal_classical_front_exists_of_local_existence
    (ν : ℝ) (hν : 0 < ν)
    (hLocal : ∀ b : Field, SmoothSigmaZero b →
      ∃ T : ℝ, 0 < T ∧ ∃ (v : Velocity) (q : Pressure),
        InitialClassicalFront ν T b v q)
    (a : Field) (ha : SmoothSigmaZero a) :
    ∃ Tmax : ℝ≥0∞, ∃ (U : Velocity) (P : Pressure),
      MaximalClassicalFront ν a U P Tmax := by
  obtain ⟨T, hT, u, p, H⟩ := hLocal a ha
  exact maximal_classical_front_exists_of_front ν T a u p hν hT H

/-- The no-extension and finite-restriction properties determine a unique
extended lifetime, including the infinite-lifetime case.
-/
theorem maximal_classical_front_lifetime_unique
    (ν : ℝ) (a : Field) (u v : Velocity) (p q : Pressure)
    (Tmax Smax : ℝ≥0∞)
    (H : MaximalClassicalFront ν a u p Tmax)
    (K : MaximalClassicalFront ν a v q Smax) : Tmax = Smax := by
  apply le_antisymm
  · by_contra h
    have hST : Smax < Tmax := lt_of_not_ge h
    obtain ⟨T, _, hSTreal, hTTmax⟩ := ENNReal.lt_iff_exists_real_btwn.mp hST
    have hT : 0 < T := ENNReal.ofReal_pos.mp (K.lifetime_pos.trans hSTreal)
    exact (not_le_of_gt hSTreal)
      (K.no_extension T u p hT (H.finite_front T hT hTTmax))
  · by_contra h
    have hTS : Tmax < Smax := lt_of_not_ge h
    obtain ⟨T, _, hTTreal, hTSmax⟩ := ENNReal.lt_iff_exists_real_btwn.mp hTS
    have hT : 0 < T := ENNReal.ofReal_pos.mp (H.lifetime_pos.trans hTTreal)
    exact (not_le_of_gt hTTreal)
      (H.no_extension T v q hT (K.finite_front T hT hTSmax))

/-- Both the lifetime and the actual velocity/normalized-pressure path are
unique on the physical interval. Values at or beyond a finite lifetime are
unconstrained and are not asserted equal.
-/
theorem maximal_classical_front_unique
    (ν : ℝ) (a : Field) (u v : Velocity) (p q : Pressure)
    (Tmax Smax : ℝ≥0∞)
    (H : MaximalClassicalFront ν a u p Tmax)
    (K : MaximalClassicalFront ν a v q Smax) :
    Tmax = Smax ∧ ∀ r : ℝ, 0 ≤ r → ENNReal.ofReal r < Tmax →
      u r = v r ∧ p r = q r := by
  have hmax := maximal_classical_front_lifetime_unique ν a u v p q Tmax Smax H K
  refine ⟨hmax, ?_⟩
  intro r hr0 hrmax
  obtain ⟨T, _, hrT, hTmax⟩ := ENNReal.lt_iff_exists_real_btwn.mp hrmax
  have hrTreal : r < T := (ENNReal.ofReal_lt_ofReal_iff_of_nonneg hr0).mp hrT
  have hT : 0 < T := hr0.trans_lt hrTreal
  have hTSmax : ENNReal.ofReal T < Smax := hTmax.trans_le hmax.le
  exact H.agreement T v q hT (K.finite_front T hT hTSmax) r ⟨hr0, hrTreal⟩

end

The terminal time is excluded from InitialClassicalFront. Every point of its

/-- A finite half-open restriction may reach the maximal lifetime itself,
because every time at which a physical field is required is strictly earlier.
-/
theorem maximal_classical_front_restrict_le
    (ν T : ℝ) (a : Field) (u : Velocity) (p : Pressure) (Tmax : ℝ≥0∞)
    (H : MaximalClassicalFront ν a u p Tmax) (hT : 0 < T)
    (hTmax : ENNReal.ofReal T ≤ Tmax) :
    InitialClassicalFront ν T a u p := by
  have hlocal (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Ico (0 : ℝ) T) :
      ∃ S : ℝ, t ∈ Ico (0 : ℝ) S ∧ InitialClassicalFront ν S a u p := by
    let S : ℝ := (t + T) / 2
    have hS : 0 < S := by dsimp only [S]; linarith [ht.1]
    have htS : t < S := by dsimp only [S]; linarith [ht.2]
    have hST : S < T := by dsimp only [S]; linarith [ht.2]
    have hSmax : ENNReal.ofReal S < Tmax :=
      ((ENNReal.ofReal_lt_ofReal_iff_of_nonneg hS.le).mpr hST).trans_le hTmax
    exact ⟨S, ⟨ht.1, htS⟩, H.finite_front S hS hSmax⟩
  have hwindow (z : ℝ × Vec) (S : ℝ) (hzS : z.1 < S) :
      initialFrontSpacetime S ∈ 𝓝[initialFrontSpacetime T] z := by
    have htime : ∀ᶠ y : ℝ × Vec in 𝓝 z, y.1 < S :=
      (continuous_fst.tendsto z).eventually (Iio_mem_nhds hzS)
    filter_upwards [self_mem_nhdsWithin, htime.filter_mono nhdsWithin_le_nhds]
      with y hy hyS
    exact ⟨hy.1, hyS⟩
  refine {
    velocity_smooth := ?_
    pressure_smooth := ?_
    velocity_periodic := ?_
    pressure_periodic := ?_
    divergence_free := ?_
    equation := ?_
    initial := H.initial
    velocity_mean_zero := ?_
    pressure_mean_zero := ?_
  }
  · intro z hz
    obtain ⟨S, hzS, HS⟩ := hlocal z.1 hz
    exact (HS.velocity_smooth z hzS).mono_of_mem_nhdsWithin (hwindow z S hzS.2)
  · intro z hz
    obtain ⟨S, hzS, HS⟩ := hlocal z.1 hz
    exact (HS.pressure_smooth z hzS).mono_of_mem_nhdsWithin (hwindow z S hzS.2)
  · intro t ht
    obtain ⟨S, htS, HS⟩ := hlocal t ht
    exact HS.velocity_periodic t htS
  · intro t ht
    obtain ⟨S, htS, HS⟩ := hlocal t ht
    exact HS.pressure_periodic t htS
  · intro t ht x
    obtain ⟨S, htS, HS⟩ := hlocal t ht
    exact HS.divergence_free t htS x
  · intro t ht x
    obtain ⟨S, htS, HS⟩ := hlocal t ht
    exact HS.equation t htS x
  · intro t ht
    obtain ⟨S, htS, HS⟩ := hlocal t ht
    exact HS.velocity_mean_zero t htS
  · intro t ht
    obtain ⟨S, htS, HS⟩ := hlocal t ht
    exact HS.pressure_mean_zero t htS

end

/-- Finite-to-finite smoothness of a splice. The later field is required only
on the open finite window `(δ,S)`, not on an infinite tail. -/
theorem finite_front_splice_contDiffOn
    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    (δ T S η : ℝ) (f g : ℝ → Vec → E) (hδη : δ < η) (hηT : η < T)
    (hf : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ × Vec => f z.1 z.2) (initialFrontSpacetime T))
    (hg : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ × Vec => g z.1 z.2)
      {z : ℝ × Vec | z.1 ∈ Ioo δ S})
    (hagree : ∀ r ∈ Ioo δ T, f r = g r) :
    ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ × Vec => finiteCapSplice η f g z.1 z.2)
      (initialFrontSpacetime S) := by
  intro z hz
  by_cases hleft : z.1 < η
  · have hzT : z.1 < T := hleft.trans hηT
    have htime : ∀ᶠ y : ℝ × Vec in 𝓝 z, y.1 < T :=
      (continuous_fst.tendsto z).eventually (Iio_mem_nhds hzT)
    have hlocal : initialFrontSpacetime T ∈ 𝓝[initialFrontSpacetime S] z := by
      filter_upwards [self_mem_nhdsWithin, htime.filter_mono nhdsWithin_le_nhds]
        with y hy hyT
      exact ⟨hy.1, hyT⟩
    have hbase : ContDiffWithinAt ℝ ∞ (fun y : ℝ × Vec => f y.1 y.2)
        (initialFrontSpacetime S) z :=
      (hf z ⟨hz.1, hzT⟩).mono_of_mem_nhdsWithin hlocal
    have heq : (fun y : ℝ × Vec => finiteCapSplice η f g y.1 y.2) =ᶠ[𝓝 z]
        (fun y : ℝ × Vec => f y.1 y.2) := by
      filter_upwards [(continuous_fst.tendsto z).eventually
        (finiteCapSplice_eventually_left η f g hleft)] with y hy
      exact congrFun hy y.2
    exact hbase.congr_of_eventuallyEq (heq.filter_mono nhdsWithin_le_nhds)
      heq.self_of_nhds
  · have hδz : δ < z.1 := hδη.trans_le (le_of_not_gt hleft)
    have htime : ∀ᶠ y : ℝ × Vec in 𝓝 z, δ < y.1 :=
      (continuous_fst.tendsto z).eventually (Ioi_mem_nhds hδz)
    have hlocal : {y : ℝ × Vec | y.1 ∈ Ioo δ S} ∈
        𝓝[initialFrontSpacetime S] z := by
      filter_upwards [self_mem_nhdsWithin, htime.filter_mono nhdsWithin_le_nhds]
        with y hy hyδ
      exact ⟨hyδ, hy.2⟩
    have hbase : ContDiffWithinAt ℝ ∞ (fun y : ℝ × Vec => g y.1 y.2)
        (initialFrontSpacetime S) z :=
      (hg z ⟨hδz, hz.2⟩).mono_of_mem_nhdsWithin hlocal
    have heq : (fun y : ℝ × Vec => finiteCapSplice η f g y.1 y.2) =ᶠ[𝓝 z]
        (fun y : ℝ × Vec => g y.1 y.2) := by
      filter_upwards [(continuous_fst.tendsto z).eventually
        (finiteCapSplice_eventually_right δ T η f g hηT hagree hδz)] with y hy
      exact congrFun hy y.2
    exact hbase.congr_of_eventuallyEq (heq.filter_mono nhdsWithin_le_nhds)
      heq.self_of_nhds

private theorem finiteFrontSplice_timeDerivative_congr
    {f g : Velocity} {t : ℝ} (h : f =ᶠ[𝓝 t] g) (x : Vec) :
    timeDerivative f t x = timeDerivative g t x := by
  have hx : (fun r => f r x) =ᶠ[𝓝 t] (fun r => g r x) := by
    filter_upwards [h] with r hr
    exact congrFun hr x
  exact hx.derivWithin_eq_of_nhds

/-- A supplied restart whose duration reaches beyond the old endpoint gives
an actual longer initial classical front. The constructed pair preserves the
entire old velocity and pressure, and agrees with the translated restart from
an interior joining time onward. No endpoint limit or global tail is assumed. -/
theorem initial_front_extend_from_restart
    (ν T s h : ℝ) (a : Field) (u v : Velocity) (p q : Pressure)
    (hν : 0 < ν) (H : InitialClassicalFront ν T a u p)
    (hs : s ∈ Ico (0 : ℝ) T) (hh : 0 < h)
    (K : InitialClassicalFront ν h (u s) v q) (hextend : T < s + h) :
    ∃ (U : Velocity) (P : Pressure), InitialClassicalFront ν (s + h) a U P ∧
      (∀ r ∈ Ico (0 : ℝ) T, U r = u r ∧ P r = p r) ∧
      ∀ r ∈ Ico ((s + T) / 2) (s + h),
        U r = v (r - s) ∧ P r = q (r - s) := by
  let V : Velocity := fun r => v (r - s)
  let Q : Pressure := fun r => q (r - s)
  let η : ℝ := (s + T) / 2
  have hη0 : 0 < η := by dsimp [η]; linarith [hs.1, hs.2]
  have hsη : s < η := by dsimp [η]; linarith [hs.2]
  have hηT : η < T := by dsimp [η]; linarith [hs.2]
  have hrestart := initial_classical_front_unique ν (T - s) h (u s)
    (fun r => u (s + r)) v (fun r => p (s + r)) q hν (sub_pos.mpr hs.2) hh
    (initial_front_time_translate ν T s a u p H hs.1) K
  have hagree : ∀ r ∈ Ioo s T, u r = V r ∧ p r = Q r := by
    intro r hr
    have htime : r - s ∈ Ico (0 : ℝ) (min (T - s) h) := by
      constructor
      · linarith [hr.1]
      · apply lt_min <;> linarith [hr.2]
    have hc : s + (r - s) = r := by ring
    simpa only [V, Q, hc] using hrestart (r - s) htime
  have huv : ∀ r ∈ Ioo s T, u r = V r := fun r hr => (hagree r hr).1
  have hpq : ∀ r ∈ Ioo s T, p r = Q r := fun r hr => (hagree r hr).2
  have htime (r : ℝ) (hr : r ∈ Ioo s (s + h)) :
      r - s ∈ Ico (0 : ℝ) h := by
    constructor <;> linarith [hr.1, hr.2]
  have hmap : MapsTo (fun z : ℝ × Vec => (z.1 - s, z.2))
      {z : ℝ × Vec | z.1 ∈ Ioo s (s + h)} (initialFrontSpacetime h) := by
    intro z hz
    exact htime z.1 hz
  have hc : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ × Vec => (z.1 - s, z.2)) :=
    (contDiff_fst.sub contDiff_const).prodMk contDiff_snd
  have hVsmooth : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ × Vec => V z.1 z.2)
      {z : ℝ × Vec | z.1 ∈ Ioo s (s + h)} :=
    K.velocity_smooth.comp hc.contDiffOn hmap
  have hQsmooth : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ × Vec => Q z.1 z.2)
      {z : ℝ × Vec | z.1 ∈ Ioo s (s + h)} :=
    K.pressure_smooth.comp hc.contDiffOn hmap
  have hleft (r : ℝ) (hr : r < η) : finiteCapSplice η u V r = u r :=
    (finiteCapSplice_eventually_left η u V hr).self_of_nhds
  have hleftp (r : ℝ) (hr : r < η) : finiteCapSplice η p Q r = p r :=
    (finiteCapSplice_eventually_left η p Q hr).self_of_nhds
  have hright (r : ℝ) (hr : s < r) : finiteCapSplice η u V r = V r :=
    (finiteCapSplice_eventually_right s T η u V hηT huv hr).self_of_nhds
  have hrightp (r : ℝ) (hr : s < r) : finiteCapSplice η p Q r = Q r :=
    (finiteCapSplice_eventually_right s T η p Q hηT hpq hr).self_of_nhds
  have hfront : InitialClassicalFront ν (s + h) a
      (finiteCapSplice η u V) (finiteCapSplice η p Q) := by
    refine {
      velocity_smooth := finite_front_splice_contDiffOn s T (s + h) η u V hsη hηT
        H.velocity_smooth hVsmooth huv
      pressure_smooth := finite_front_splice_contDiffOn s T (s + h) η p Q hsη hηT
        H.pressure_smooth hQsmooth hpq
      velocity_periodic := ?_
      pressure_periodic := ?_
      divergence_free := ?_
      equation := ?_
      initial := ?_
      velocity_mean_zero := ?_
      pressure_mean_zero := ?_
    }
    · intro r hr
      by_cases hleft' : r < η
      · rw [hleft r hleft']
        exact H.velocity_periodic r ⟨hr.1, hleft'.trans hηT⟩
      · have hsr := hsη.trans_le (le_of_not_gt hleft')
        rw [hright r hsr]
        exact K.velocity_periodic (r - s) (htime r ⟨hsr, hr.2⟩)
    · intro r hr
      by_cases hleft' : r < η
      · rw [hleftp r hleft']
        exact H.pressure_periodic r ⟨hr.1, hleft'.trans hηT⟩
      · have hsr := hsη.trans_le (le_of_not_gt hleft')
        rw [hrightp r hsr]
        exact K.pressure_periodic (r - s) (htime r ⟨hsr, hr.2⟩)
    · intro r hr x
      by_cases hleft' : r < η
      · rw [hleft r hleft']
        exact H.divergence_free r ⟨hr.1, hleft'.trans hηT⟩ x
      · have hsr := hsη.trans_le (le_of_not_gt hleft')
        rw [hright r hsr]
        exact K.divergence_free (r - s) (htime r ⟨hsr, hr.2⟩) x
    · intro r hr x
      by_cases hleft' : r < η
      · rw [finiteFrontSplice_timeDerivative_congr
          (finiteCapSplice_eventually_left η u V hleft') x,
          hleft r hleft', hleftp r hleft']
        exact H.equation r ⟨hr.1, hleft'.trans hηT⟩ x
      · have hsr := hsη.trans_le (le_of_not_gt hleft')
        rw [finiteFrontSplice_timeDerivative_congr
          (finiteCapSplice_eventually_right s T η u V hηT huv hsr) x,
          hright r hsr, hrightp r hsr]
        exact initial_front_shift_back_equation ν h s (u s) v q K hs.1 r ⟨hsr, hr.2⟩ x
    · rw [hleft 0 hη0]
      exact H.initial
    · intro r hr
      by_cases hleft' : r < η
      · rw [hleft r hleft']
        exact H.velocity_mean_zero r ⟨hr.1, hleft'.trans hηT⟩
      · have hsr := hsη.trans_le (le_of_not_gt hleft')
        rw [hright r hsr]
        exact K.velocity_mean_zero (r - s) (htime r ⟨hsr, hr.2⟩)
    · intro r hr
      by_cases hleft' : r < η
      · rw [hleftp r hleft']
        exact H.pressure_mean_zero r ⟨hr.1, hleft'.trans hηT⟩
      · have hsr := hsη.trans_le (le_of_not_gt hleft')
        rw [hrightp r hsr]
        exact K.pressure_mean_zero (r - s) (htime r ⟨hsr, hr.2⟩)
  refine ⟨finiteCapSplice η u V, finiteCapSplice η p Q, hfront, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro r hr
    by_cases hleft' : r < η
    · exact ⟨hleft r hleft', hleftp r hleft'⟩
    · have hsr := hsη.trans_le (le_of_not_gt hleft')
      exact ⟨(hright r hsr).trans (huv r ⟨hsr, hr.2⟩).symm,
        (hrightp r hsr).trans (hpq r ⟨hsr, hr.2⟩).symm⟩
  · intro r hr
    have hsr : s < r := hsη.trans_le hr.1
    exact ⟨hright r hsr, hrightp r hsr⟩

end

/-!
Physical enstrophy evolution on finite classical fronts. The derivative is
derived from the actual spatial-gradient integral and the literal NSE; it is
not an input inequality. Prepared source, requiring external verification.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

open Set Filter MeasureTheory SingularClosure
