theorem initialFrontSpacetime_uniqueDiffOn (T : ℝ) :
    UniqueDiffOn ℝ (initialFrontSpacetime T) := by
  have heq : initialFrontSpacetime T = Ico (0 : ℝ) T ×ˢ (univ : Set Vec) := by
    ext z
    simp [initialFrontSpacetime]
  rw [heq]
  exact (uniqueDiffOn_Ico 0 T).prod uniqueDiffOn_univ

/-- The within-cylinder derivative gives the ordinary spatial derivative
even at time zero: every spatial slice stays in the cylinder. -/
theorem initial_coordinateDerivative_eq_jointWithin
    (u : Velocity) (T : ℝ)
    (hu : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ × Vec => u z.1 z.2) (initialFrontSpacetime T))
    (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Ico (0 : ℝ) T) (x : Vec) (j : Fin 3) :
    coordinateDerivative (u t) j x =
      fderivWithin ℝ (fun z : ℝ × Vec => u z.1 z.2)
        (initialFrontSpacetime T) (t, x) (0, unitVector j) := by
  have hd : DifferentiableWithinAt ℝ (fun z : ℝ × Vec => u z.1 z.2)
      (initialFrontSpacetime T) (t, x) :=
    (hu (t, x) ht).differentiableWithinAt (by simp)
  have hc : HasFDerivAt (u t)
      ((fderivWithin ℝ (fun z : ℝ × Vec => u z.1 z.2)
        (initialFrontSpacetime T) (t, x)).comp (ContinuousLinearMap.inr ℝ ℝ Vec)) x := by
    simpa only [Function.comp_def] using
      hd.hasFDerivWithinAt.comp_hasFDerivAt x (hasFDerivAt_prodMk_right t x)
        (Eventually.of_forall (fun _ => ht))
  rw [coordinateDerivative, hc.fderiv]
  rfl

theorem initial_coordinateDerivative_contDiffOn
    (u : Velocity) (T : ℝ)
    (hu : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ × Vec => u z.1 z.2) (initialFrontSpacetime T))
    (j : Fin 3) :
    ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ × Vec => coordinateDerivative (u z.1) j z.2)
      (initialFrontSpacetime T) := by
  have hD := hu.fderivWithin (initialFrontSpacetime_uniqueDiffOn T) (m := ∞) (by simp)
  have hA : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞
      (fun z : ℝ × Vec => fderivWithin ℝ (fun q : ℝ × Vec => u q.1 q.2)
        (initialFrontSpacetime T) z (0, unitVector j)) (initialFrontSpacetime T) :=
    hD.clm_apply contDiffOn_const
  apply hA.congr
  intro z hz
  exact initial_coordinateDerivative_eq_jointWithin u T hu z.1 hz z.2 j

theorem initial_laplacian_contDiffOn
    (u : Velocity) (T : ℝ)
    (hu : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ × Vec => u z.1 z.2) (initialFrontSpacetime T)) :
    ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ × Vec => laplacian (u z.1) z.2)
      (initialFrontSpacetime T) := by
  change ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ × Vec =>
    ∑ j : Fin 3, coordinateDerivative (coordinateDerivative (u z.1) j) j z.2)
      (initialFrontSpacetime T)
  exact ContDiffOn.sum (fun j _ => initial_coordinateDerivative_contDiffOn
    (fun t => coordinateDerivative (u t) j) T (initial_coordinateDerivative_contDiffOn u T hu j) j)

theorem initial_convection_continuousOn
    (u : Velocity) (T : ℝ)
    (hu : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ × Vec => u z.1 z.2) (initialFrontSpacetime T)) :
    ContinuousOn (fun z : ℝ × Vec => convection (u z.1) z.2) (initialFrontSpacetime T) := by
  have hs : ContinuousOn (fun z : ℝ × Vec =>
      ∑ j : Fin 3, u z.1 z.2 j • coordinateDerivative (u z.1) j z.2)
      (initialFrontSpacetime T) := by
    apply continuousOn_finset_sum
    intro j _
    exact ((EuclideanSpace.proj j : Vec →L[ℝ] ℝ).continuous.comp_continuousOn
      hu.continuousOn).smul (initial_coordinateDerivative_contDiffOn u T hu j).continuousOn
  apply hs.congr
  intro z _
  exact critical_matrix_apply_eq_sum _ _

theorem initial_physicalDissipation_continuousOn_Icc
    (u : Velocity) (T : ℝ)
    (hu : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ × Vec => u z.1 z.2) (initialFrontSpacetime T))
    (τ : ℝ) (hτT : τ < T) :
    ContinuousOn (fun t => physicalDissipation (u t)) (Icc (0 : ℝ) τ) := by
  apply initial_real_cube_integral_continuousOn_Icc T
    (fun t x => gradientSquareDensity (u t) x) _ τ hτT
  simp_rw [gradientSquareDensity_eq_sum_norm_sq]
  apply continuousOn_finset_sum
  intro j _
  exact (initial_coordinateDerivative_contDiffOn u T hu j).continuousOn.norm.pow 2

theorem initial_physicalLaplacianSquare_continuousOn_Icc
    (u : Velocity) (T : ℝ)
    (hu : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ × Vec => u z.1 z.2) (initialFrontSpacetime T))
    (τ : ℝ) (hτT : τ < T) :
    ContinuousOn (fun t => physicalLaplacianSquare (u t)) (Icc (0 : ℝ) τ) :=
  initial_real_cube_integral_continuousOn_Icc T
    (fun t x => ‖laplacian (u t) x‖ ^ 2)
    ((initial_laplacian_contDiffOn u T hu).continuousOn.norm.pow 2) τ hτT

theorem local_coordinateDerivative_contDiffOn
    (u : Velocity) (T : ℝ)
    (hu : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ × Vec => u z.1 z.2) (localFrontSpacetime T))
    (j : Fin 3) :
    ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ × Vec => coordinateDerivative (u z.1) j z.2)
      (localFrontSpacetime T) := by
  have hD := hu.fderiv_of_isOpen (localFrontSpacetime_isOpen T) (m := ∞) (by simp)
  have hA : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞
      (fun z : ℝ × Vec => fderiv ℝ (fun q : ℝ × Vec => u q.1 q.2) z (0, unitVector j))
      (localFrontSpacetime T) := hD.clm_apply contDiffOn_const
  apply hA.congr
  intro z hz
  exact local_coordinateDerivative_eq_joint u T hu z.1 hz z.2 j

theorem local_timeDerivative_contDiffOn
    (u : Velocity) (T : ℝ)
    (hu : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ × Vec => u z.1 z.2) (localFrontSpacetime T)) :
    ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ × Vec => timeDerivative u z.1 z.2)
      (localFrontSpacetime T) := by
  have hD := hu.fderiv_of_isOpen (localFrontSpacetime_isOpen T) (m := ∞) (by simp)
  have hA : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞
      (fun z : ℝ × Vec => fderiv ℝ (fun q : ℝ × Vec => u q.1 q.2) z (1, 0))
      (localFrontSpacetime T) := hD.clm_apply contDiffOn_const
  apply hA.congr
  intro z hz
  exact local_timeDerivative_eq_joint u T hu z.1 hz z.2

/-- Schwarz symmetry on the open physical cylinder, applied to the actual
time and coordinate derivative operators. -/
theorem local_time_coordinateDerivative_commute
    (u : Velocity) (T : ℝ)
    (hu : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ × Vec => u z.1 z.2) (localFrontSpacetime T))
    (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) T) (j : Fin 3) (x : Vec) :
    timeDerivative (fun r => coordinateDerivative (u r) j) t x =
      coordinateDerivative (timeDerivative u t) j x := by
  let F : ℝ × Vec → Vec := fun z => u z.1 z.2
  have hz : (t, x) ∈ localFrontSpacetime T := ht
  have hF : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ F (t, x) :=
    hu.contDiffAt ((localFrontSpacetime_isOpen T).mem_nhds hz)
  have hd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fderiv ℝ F) (t, x) :=
    ((hu.fderiv_of_isOpen (localFrontSpacetime_isOpen T) (m := ∞) (by simp)).contDiffAt
      ((localFrontSpacetime_isOpen T).mem_nhds hz)).differentiableAt (by simp)
  have hs : HasFDerivAt
      (fun z : ℝ × Vec => coordinateDerivative (u z.1) j z.2)
      ((ContinuousLinearMap.apply ℝ Vec (0, unitVector j)).comp
        (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ F) (t, x))) (t, x) := by
    apply ((ContinuousLinearMap.apply ℝ Vec (0, unitVector j)).hasFDerivAt.comp
      (t, x) hd.hasFDerivAt).congr_of_eventuallyEq
    filter_upwards [(localFrontSpacetime_isOpen T).mem_nhds hz] with z hz'
    exact local_coordinateDerivative_eq_joint u T hu z.1 hz' z.2 j
  have ht' : HasFDerivAt (fun z : ℝ × Vec => timeDerivative u z.1 z.2)
      ((ContinuousLinearMap.apply ℝ Vec (1, 0)).comp
        (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ F) (t, x))) (t, x) := by
    apply ((ContinuousLinearMap.apply ℝ Vec (1, 0)).hasFDerivAt.comp
      (t, x) hd.hasFDerivAt).congr_of_eventuallyEq
    filter_upwards [(localFrontSpacetime_isOpen T).mem_nhds hz] with z hz'
    exact local_timeDerivative_eq_joint u T hu z.1 hz' z.2
  rw [local_timeDerivative_eq_joint _ T (local_coordinateDerivative_contDiffOn u T hu j) t ht x,
    local_coordinateDerivative_eq_joint _ T (local_timeDerivative_contDiffOn u T hu) t ht x j,
    hs.fderiv, ht'.fderiv]
  exact hF.isSymmSndFDerivAt (by
    simp only [minSmoothness_of_isRCLikeNormedField]
    exact WithTop.coe_le_coe.mpr (show (2 : ℕ∞) ≤ ⊤ from le_top))
      (1, 0) (0, unitVector j)

theorem local_timeDerivative_spatialPeriodic
    (u : Velocity) (T : ℝ)
    (hp : ∀ r ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) T, SpatialPeriodic (u r))
    (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) T) : SpatialPeriodic (timeDerivative u t) := by
  intro x j
  have heq : (fun r => u r (x + unitVector j)) =ᶠ[𝓝 t] (fun r => u r x) := by
    filter_upwards [isOpen_Ioo.mem_nhds ht] with r hr
    exact hp r hr x j
  exact heq.derivWithin_eq_of_nhds

/-- Differentiating physical enstrophy and integrating by parts transfers
the spatial derivative to the Laplacian of the actual velocity. -/
theorem local_physicalDissipation_hasDerivAt
    (u : Velocity) (T : ℝ)
    (hu : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ × Vec => u z.1 z.2) (localFrontSpacetime T))
    (hp : ∀ r ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) T, SpatialPeriodic (u r))
    (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) T) :
    HasDerivAt (fun r => physicalDissipation (u r))
      (-2 * physicalFieldInner (timeDerivative u t) (laplacian (u t))) t := by
  have hj (j : Fin 3) := local_physicalEnergy_hasDerivAt
    (fun r => coordinateDerivative (u r) j) T (local_coordinateDerivative_contDiffOn u T hu j) t ht
  have hsum : HasDerivAt (fun r => ∑ j : Fin 3, physicalEnergy (coordinateDerivative (u r) j))
      (∑ j : Fin 3, 2 * physicalFieldInner (coordinateDerivative (u t) j)
        (timeDerivative (fun r => coordinateDerivative (u r) j) t)) t := by
    simpa only [Fin.sum_univ_three, Pi.add_apply] using! ((hj 0).add (hj 1)).add (hj 2)
  have hD : HasDerivAt (fun r => physicalDissipation (u r))
      (∑ j : Fin 3, 2 * physicalFieldInner (coordinateDerivative (u t) j)
        (timeDerivative (fun r => coordinateDerivative (u r) j) t)) t := by
    apply hsum.congr_of_eventuallyEq
    filter_upwards [isOpen_Ioo.mem_nhds ht] with r hr
    exact physicalDissipation_eq_sum_coordinateEnergy (u r) (local_spatial_slice_contDiff u T hu r hr)
  have hfield (j : Fin 3) : timeDerivative (fun r => coordinateDerivative (u r) j) t =
      coordinateDerivative (timeDerivative u t) j :=
    funext (local_time_coordinateDerivative_commute u T hu t ht j)
  simp_rw [hfield] at hD
  have hpair := critical_integral_inner_laplacian (timeDerivative u t) (u t)
    (local_spatial_slice_contDiff _ T (local_timeDerivative_contDiffOn u T hu) t ht)
    (local_spatial_slice_contDiff u T hu t ht)
    (local_timeDerivative_spatialPeriodic u T hp t ht) (hp t ht)
  have hswap : (∑ j : Fin 3, physicalFieldInner (coordinateDerivative (u t) j)
      (coordinateDerivative (timeDerivative u t) j)) =
      -(physicalFieldInner (timeDerivative u t) (laplacian (u t))) := by
    have hc (j : Fin 3) : physicalFieldInner (coordinateDerivative (u t) j)
        (coordinateDerivative (timeDerivative u t) j) =
        physicalFieldInner (coordinateDerivative (timeDerivative u t) j)
          (coordinateDerivative (u t) j) := critical_physicalFieldInner_comm _ _
    simp_rw [hc]
    exact (neg_eq_iff_eq_neg.mp hpair.symm)
  rw [← Finset.mul_sum, hswap] at hD
  convert hD using 1 <;> ring

theorem physical_laplacian_divergence_free
    (v : Field) (hv : SmoothSigmaZero v) (x : Vec) :
    divergence (laplacian v) x = 0 := by
  have hs := laplacian_contDiff v hv.smooth
  have hp := laplacian_spatialPeriodic v hv.periodic
  have hr := ALL_SOBOLEV_IMP_RAPID_SCALAR (datumFourierCoeff (laplacian v))
    (fun s => SMOOTH_DATUM_MEM_TORUS_SOBOLEV s (laplacian v) hs hp)
  have hsol : SpectralSolenoidal (datumFourierCoeff (laplacian v)) := by
    rw [datumFourierCoeff_laplacian v hv.smooth hv.periodic]
    intro k
    have hc := smoothSigmaZero_fourier_solenoidal hv k
    calc
      (∑ j : Fin 3, (k j : ℂ) * laplacianCoefficient (datumFourierCoeff v) k j) =
          -(laplacianFrequency k : ℂ) * (∑ j : Fin 3, (k j : ℂ) * datumFourierCoeff v k j) := by
        rw [Finset.mul_sum]
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro j _
        simp only [laplacianCoefficient]
        ring
      _ = 0 := by rw [hc]; ring
  have h := smoothFourierSynthesis_divergence_free (datumFourierCoeff (laplacian v)) hr hsol x
  rwa [smoothFourierSynthesis_datum_eq (laplacian v) hs hp] at h

def physicalEnstrophyRate (ν : ℝ) (v : Field) : ℝ :=
  (-2 * ν) * physicalLaplacianSquare v +
    2 * physicalFieldInner (convection v) (laplacian v)

theorem initial_physicalEnstrophyRate_continuousOn_Icc
    (ν : ℝ) (u : Velocity) (T : ℝ)
    (hu : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ × Vec => u z.1 z.2) (initialFrontSpacetime T))
    (τ : ℝ) (hτT : τ < T) :
    ContinuousOn (fun t => physicalEnstrophyRate ν (u t)) (Icc (0 : ℝ) τ) := by
  have hZ := initial_physicalLaplacianSquare_continuousOn_Icc u T hu τ hτT
  have hN : ContinuousOn
      (fun t => physicalFieldInner (convection (u t)) (laplacian (u t)))
      (Icc (0 : ℝ) τ) :=
    initial_real_cube_integral_continuousOn_Icc T
      (fun t x => inner ℝ (convection (u t) x) (laplacian (u t) x))
      ((initial_convection_continuousOn u T hu).inner
        (initial_laplacian_contDiffOn u T hu).continuousOn) τ hτT
  exact (continuousOn_const.mul hZ).add (continuousOn_const.mul hN)

theorem initial_front_enstrophy_pairing
    (ν T : ℝ) (a : Field) (u : Velocity) (p : Pressure)
    (H : InitialClassicalFront ν T a u p)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) T) :
    -2 * physicalFieldInner (timeDerivative u t) (laplacian (u t)) =
      physicalEnstrophyRate ν (u t) := by
  have hus := initial_front_smooth_slices ν T a u p H t ⟨ht.1.le, ht.2⟩
  have hu : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ × Vec => u z.1 z.2) (localFrontSpacetime T) :=
    H.velocity_smooth.mono (fun z hz => ⟨hz.1.le, hz.2⟩)
  have hps : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (p t) := by
    rw [← contDiffOn_univ]
    exact H.pressure_smooth.comp (contDiff_const.prodMk contDiff_id).contDiffOn
      (fun _ _ => ⟨ht.1.le, ht.2⟩)
  have hlap := (laplacian_contDiff (u t) hus.smooth).continuous
  have hud : Continuous (timeDerivative u t) :=
    (local_spatial_slice_contDiff _ T (local_timeDerivative_contDiffOn u T hu) t ht).continuous
  have hconv := convection_continuous hus.smooth
  have hgrad := criticalWeak_gradient_continuous (p t) hps
  have hI₁ := physicalFieldInner_integrable (laplacian (u t)) (timeDerivative u t) hlap hud
  have hI₂ := physicalFieldInner_integrable (laplacian (u t)) (convection (u t)) hlap hconv
  have hI₃ := physicalFieldInner_integrable (laplacian (u t)) (SingularClosure.gradient (p t)) hlap hgrad
  have hI₁₂ : IntegrableOn (fun x =>
      inner ℝ (laplacian (u t) x) (timeDerivative u t x) +
        inner ℝ (laplacian (u t) x) (convection (u t) x)) unitCube volume :=
    hI₁.add hI₂
  have heq : timeDerivative u t + convection (u t) + SingularClosure.gradient (p t) =
      ν • laplacian (u t) := funext (H.equation t ⟨ht.1.le, ht.2⟩)
  have h := congrArg (physicalFieldInner (laplacian (u t))) heq
  simp only [physicalFieldInner, Pi.add_apply, inner_add_right,
    Pi.smul_apply, inner_smul_right] at h
  rw [integral_add hI₁₂ hI₃, integral_add hI₁ hI₂, integral_const_mul,
    critical_smooth_integral_inner_gradient_eq_zero _ (p t)
      (laplacian_contDiff (u t) hus.smooth) hps
      (laplacian_spatialPeriodic (u t) hus.periodic) (H.pressure_periodic t ⟨ht.1.le, ht.2⟩)
      (physical_laplacian_divergence_free (u t) hus)] at h
  simp_rw [real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq] at h
  change physicalFieldInner (laplacian (u t)) (timeDerivative u t) +
    physicalFieldInner (laplacian (u t)) (convection (u t)) + 0 =
      ν * physicalLaplacianSquare (u t) at h
  rw [critical_physicalFieldInner_comm (laplacian (u t)) (timeDerivative u t),
    critical_physicalFieldInner_comm (laplacian (u t)) (convection (u t))] at h
  unfold physicalEnstrophyRate
  linarith

theorem initial_front_physicalEnstrophy_hasDerivAt
    (ν T : ℝ) (a : Field) (u : Velocity) (p : Pressure)
    (H : InitialClassicalFront ν T a u p)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) T) :
    HasDerivAt (fun r => physicalDissipation (u r)) (physicalEnstrophyRate ν (u t)) t := by
  have hu : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ × Vec => u z.1 z.2) (localFrontSpacetime T) :=
    H.velocity_smooth.mono (fun z hz => ⟨hz.1.le, hz.2⟩)
  have h := local_physicalDissipation_hasDerivAt u T hu
    (fun r hr => H.velocity_periodic r ⟨hr.1.le, hr.2⟩) t ht
  rwa [initial_front_enstrophy_pairing ν T a u p H t ht] at h

theorem INITIAL_FRONT_PHYSICAL_ENSTROPHY_CUBIC :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ ν T : ℝ, 0 < ν → ∀ a : Field,
      ∀ u : Velocity, ∀ p : Pressure, InitialClassicalFront ν T a u p →
      ∀ t ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) T,
        HasDerivAt (fun r => physicalDissipation (u r)) (physicalEnstrophyRate ν (u t)) t ∧
        physicalEnstrophyRate ν (u t) + ν * physicalLaplacianSquare (u t) ≤
          C / ν ^ 3 * physicalDissipation (u t) ^ 3 := by
  obtain ⟨C, hC, hb⟩ := PHYSICAL_NONLINEAR_ABSORPTION
  refine ⟨C, hC, ?_⟩
  intro ν T hν a u p H t ht
  refine ⟨initial_front_physicalEnstrophy_hasDerivAt ν T a u p H t ht, ?_⟩
  have hs := initial_front_smooth_slices ν T a u p H t ⟨ht.1.le, ht.2⟩
  have h := hb ν hν (u t) hs.smooth hs.periodic hs.mean_zero
  change 2 * physicalFieldInner (convection (u t)) (laplacian (u t)) ≤ _ at h
  unfold physicalEnstrophyRate
  linarith

/-- All continuity premises needed by the scalar budget estimate are derived
from the actual initial front, including the time-zero boundary. -/
theorem initial_front_enstrophy_scalar_continuity
    (ν T : ℝ) (a : Field) (u : Velocity) (p : Pressure)
    (H : InitialClassicalFront ν T a u p) (τ : ℝ) (hτT : τ < T) :
    ContinuousOn (fun t => physicalDissipation (u t)) (Icc (0 : ℝ) τ) ∧
    ContinuousOn (fun t => Real.sqrt (physicalLaplacianSquare (u t))) (Icc (0 : ℝ) τ) ∧
    ContinuousOn (fun t => physicalEnstrophyRate ν (u t)) (Icc (0 : ℝ) τ) := by
  exact ⟨initial_physicalDissipation_continuousOn_Icc u T H.velocity_smooth τ hτT,
    Real.continuous_sqrt.comp_continuousOn
      (initial_physicalLaplacianSquare_continuousOn_Icc u T H.velocity_smooth τ hτT),
    initial_physicalEnstrophyRate_continuousOn_Icc ν u T H.velocity_smooth τ hτT⟩

end

/-!
# Physical continuation from a uniform H1 bound

A single H1 bound below the maximal lifetime supplies a common positive
restart duration through the constructed physical local-existence theorem.
If the lifetime were finite, restarting strictly before it and gluing on an
interior overlap would give an admitted front with a strictly larger duration.
This contradicts the actual maximal front's no-extension property.

No field value, trace or regularity at a finite maximal endpoint is used.
Smoothness of the restart datum is derived from a shorter actual front.
No local-existence, restart or continuation assertion is assumed as an axiom.
Prepared source only; the entire dependency chain requires matching external
cached compilation and fresh exact-type/axiom audits. No local Lean ran.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

open Set MeasureTheory SingularClosure
open scoped ENNReal

noncomputable section

private theorem strongContinuation_physicalH1Square_nonneg (v : Field) :
    0 ≤ physicalH1Square v := by
  have hE : 0 ≤ physicalEnergy v := by
    rw [physicalEnergy_eq_integral_norm_sq]
    exact integral_nonneg (fun x => sq_nonneg ‖v x‖)
  have hD : 0 ≤ physicalDissipation v :=
    integral_nonneg (gradientSquareDensity_nonneg v)
  exact add_nonneg hE hD

/-- Uniform boundedness of the actual physical H1 square on the whole
pre-endpoint path excludes a finite maximal lifetime. The bound includes time
zero; its nonnegativity is derived rather than separately assumed.
-/
theorem maximal_classical_lifetime_eq_top_of_uniform_H1
    (ν R : ℝ) (a : Field) (u : Velocity) (p : Pressure) (Tmax : ℝ≥0∞)
    (hν : 0 < ν) (H : MaximalClassicalFront ν a u p Tmax)
    (hbound : ∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ t → ENNReal.ofReal t < Tmax →
      physicalH1Square (u t) ≤ R) : Tmax = ⊤ := by
  have hR : 0 ≤ R :=
    (strongContinuation_physicalH1Square_nonneg (u 0)).trans
      (hbound 0 le_rfl (by simpa only [ENNReal.ofReal_zero] using H.lifetime_pos))
  obtain ⟨h, hh, hlocal⟩ := uniform_H1_local_initial_classical_front_exists ν R hν hR
  by_contra hfinite
  let τ : ℝ := Tmax.toReal
  have hτ : 0 < τ := ENNReal.toReal_pos H.lifetime_pos.ne' hfinite
  let s : ℝ := max (τ / 2) (τ - h / 2)
  have hs0 : 0 ≤ s := by
    exact (by linarith : 0 ≤ τ / 2).trans (le_max_left (τ / 2) (τ - h / 2))
  have hsτ : s < τ := by
    exact max_lt (by linarith) (by linarith)
  have hreach : τ < s + h := by
    have hnear : τ - h / 2 ≤ s := le_max_right (τ / 2) (τ - h / 2)
    linarith
  let T : ℝ := (s + τ) / 2
  have hsT : s < T := by dsimp only [T]; linarith
  have hTτ : T < τ := by dsimp only [T]; linarith
  have hT : 0 < T := hs0.trans_lt hsT
  have hTmax : ENNReal.ofReal T < Tmax :=
    (ENNReal.ofReal_lt_iff_lt_toReal hT.le hfinite).mpr hTτ
  have hsmax : ENNReal.ofReal s < Tmax :=
    (ENNReal.ofReal_lt_iff_lt_toReal hs0 hfinite).mpr hsτ
  have HF : InitialClassicalFront ν T a u p := H.finite_front T hT hTmax
  have hdata : SmoothSigmaZero (u s) :=
    initial_front_smooth_slices ν T a u p HF s ⟨hs0, hsT⟩
  obtain ⟨v, q, K⟩ := hlocal (u s) hdata (hbound s hs0 hsmax)
  obtain ⟨U, P, Hlong, _⟩ := initial_front_extend_from_restart ν T s h a u v p q
    hν HF ⟨hs0, hsT⟩ hh K (hTτ.trans hreach)
  have hlong : ENNReal.ofReal (s + h) ≤ Tmax :=
    H.no_extension (s + h) U P (hτ.trans hreach) Hlong
  have hstrict : Tmax < ENNReal.ofReal (s + h) := by
    calc
      Tmax = ENNReal.ofReal τ := (ENNReal.ofReal_toReal hfinite).symm
      _ < ENNReal.ofReal (s + h) :=
        (ENNReal.ofReal_lt_ofReal_iff_of_nonneg hτ.le).mpr hreach
  exact (not_le_of_gt hstrict) hlong

end
end MethbokeAddon.WeakFouriermanB

/-- Full open-front budget of this exact maximal velocity, stopped at the
smaller of its extended lifetime and the finite physical cutoff. The minimum
is finite, so its real value is the actual endpoint of this open interval.
-/
def MaximalFourierBudgetFinite (u : Velocity) (Tmax : ℝ≥0∞) (cutoff : ℝ) : Prop :=
  FourierBudgetFinite (fun t => datumFourierCoeff (u t))
    (min Tmax (ENNReal.ofReal cutoff)).toReal

/-- Actual joint smoothness supplies measurability; actual physical slices
supply the full-series Parseval identity. No spectral equality is assumed.
-/
theorem initial_front_dissipation_square_integrable_of_fourier_budget
    (ν T : ℝ) (a : Field) (u : Velocity) (p : Pressure)
    (H : InitialClassicalFront ν T a u p)
    (hbudget : FourierBudgetFinite (fun t => datumFourierCoeff (u t)) T) :
    Integrable (fun t => physicalDissipation (u t) ^ 2)
      (volume.restrict (Ioo (0 : ℝ) T)) := by
  have hu : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ × Vec => u z.1 z.2)
      (localFrontSpacetime T) :=
    H.velocity_smooth.mono (fun z hz => ⟨hz.1.le, hz.2⟩)
  apply homogeneous_dissipation_square_integrable_of_fourier_budget
    (volume.restrict (Ioo (0 : ℝ) T)) u ?_
    (local_physicalDissipation_aestronglyMeasurable u T hu) hbudget
  filter_upwards [ae_restrict_mem measurableSet_Ioo] with t ht
  have hs := initial_front_smooth_slices ν T a u p H t ⟨ht.1.le, ht.2⟩
  exact ⟨hs.smooth, hs.periodic, hs.mean_zero⟩

/-- The actual physical enstrophy-square integral over the whole open front
controls enstrophy and accumulated Laplacian square at every earlier time.
The constant is shared by all closed subintervals approaching the endpoint.
-/
theorem initial_front_enstrophy_accumulation_of_dissipation_square
    (ν T : ℝ) (a : Field) (u : Velocity) (p : Pressure)
    (hν : 0 < ν) (hT : 0 < T) (H : InitialClassicalFront ν T a u p)
    (hD : Integrable (fun t => physicalDissipation (u t) ^ 2)
      (volume.restrict (Ioo (0 : ℝ) T))) :
    ∃ B : ℝ, 0 ≤ B ∧ ∀ t ∈ Ico (0 : ℝ) T,
      physicalDissipation (u t) +
        ν * (∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..t, physicalLaplacianSquare (u s)) ≤ B := by
  obtain ⟨C, hC, hcubic⟩ := INITIAL_FRONT_PHYSICAL_ENSTROPHY_CUBIC
  let M : ℝ := ∫ s in Ioo (0 : ℝ) T, physicalDissipation (u s) ^ 2
  have hM : 0 ≤ M := integral_nonneg (fun _ => sq_nonneg _)
  let B : ℝ := physicalDissipation (u 0) * Real.exp (C / ν ^ 3 * M)
  refine ⟨B, mul_nonneg (physical_dissipation_nonneg _) (Real.exp_pos _).le, ?_⟩
  intro t ht
  let b : ℝ := (t + T) / 2
  have hb : 0 ≤ b := by dsimp only [b]; linarith [ht.1]
  have htb : t ≤ b := by dsimp only [b]; linarith [ht.2]
  have hbT : b < T := by dsimp only [b]; linarith [ht.2]
  have hcont := initial_front_enstrophy_scalar_continuity ν T a u p H b hbT
  have hsub : Ioc (0 : ℝ) b ⊆ Ioo (0 : ℝ) T := by
    intro s hs
    exact ⟨hs.1, hs.2.trans_lt hbT⟩
  have hclosed : (∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..b, physicalDissipation (u s) ^ 2) ≤ M := by
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_of_le hb]
    exact integral_mono_measure (Measure.restrict_mono_set volume hsub)
      (Eventually.of_forall (fun s => sq_nonneg (physicalDissipation (u s)))) hD
  have hscalar := CUBIC_ENERGY_OF_SQUARE_BUDGET_EXACT_INITIAL
    (y := fun s => physicalDissipation (u s))
    (z := fun s => Real.sqrt (physicalLaplacianSquare (u s)))
    (d := fun s => physicalEnstrophyRate ν (u s))
    (ν := ν) (κ := C / ν ^ 3) (T := b) (M := M)
    hν (div_nonneg hC.le (pow_nonneg hν.le _)) hb hM
    hcont.1 hcont.2.1 hcont.2.2
    (fun s _ => physical_dissipation_nonneg (u s))
    (fun s hs => (hcubic ν T hν a u p H s ⟨hs.1, hs.2.trans hbT⟩).1)
    (by
      intro s hs
      rw [Real.sq_sqrt (physicalLaplacianSquare_nonneg (u s))]
      exact (hcubic ν T hν a u p H s ⟨hs.1, hs.2.trans hbT⟩).2)
    hclosed
  have hzsq (s : ℝ) : Real.sqrt (physicalLaplacianSquare (u s)) ^ 2 =
      physicalLaplacianSquare (u s) :=
    Real.sq_sqrt (physicalLaplacianSquare_nonneg (u s))
  simpa only [B, hzsq] using hscalar t ⟨ht.1, htb⟩

/-- The full Fourier premise supplies the actual physical square budget
used by the accumulation theorem, with no separate enstrophy assumption.
-/
theorem initial_front_enstrophy_accumulation_of_fourier_budget
    (ν T : ℝ) (a : Field) (u : Velocity) (p : Pressure)
    (hν : 0 < ν) (hT : 0 < T) (H : InitialClassicalFront ν T a u p)
    (hbudget : FourierBudgetFinite (fun t => datumFourierCoeff (u t)) T) :
    ∃ B : ℝ, 0 ≤ B ∧ ∀ t ∈ Ico (0 : ℝ) T,
      physicalDissipation (u t) +
        ν * (∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..t, physicalLaplacianSquare (u s)) ≤ B :=
  initial_front_enstrophy_accumulation_of_dissipation_square ν T a u p hν hT H
    (initial_front_dissipation_square_integrable_of_fourier_budget ν T a u p H hbudget)

/-- Poincare converts the derived enstrophy bound into a uniform bound for
the actual inhomogeneous physical H1 square, including the initial time.
-/
theorem initial_front_uniform_H1_of_dissipation_square
    (ν T : ℝ) (a : Field) (u : Velocity) (p : Pressure)
    (hν : 0 < ν) (hT : 0 < T) (H : InitialClassicalFront ν T a u p)
    (hD : Integrable (fun t => physicalDissipation (u t) ^ 2)
      (volume.restrict (Ioo (0 : ℝ) T))) :
    ∃ R : ℝ, 0 ≤ R ∧ ∀ t ∈ Ico (0 : ℝ) T, physicalH1Square (u t) ≤ R := by
  obtain ⟨B, hB, hb⟩ := initial_front_enstrophy_accumulation_of_dissipation_square
    ν T a u p hν hT H hD
  refine ⟨2 * B, by positivity, ?_⟩
  intro t ht
  have hZ : 0 ≤ ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..t, physicalLaplacianSquare (u s) :=
    intervalIntegral.integral_nonneg_of_forall ht.1
      (fun s => physicalLaplacianSquare_nonneg (u s))
  have hD : physicalDissipation (u t) ≤ B := by
    have hνZ := mul_nonneg hν.le hZ
    linarith [hb t ht]
  have hs := initial_front_smooth_slices ν T a u p H t ht
  have hE := smooth_periodic_meanZero_energy_le_dissipation
    (u t) hs.smooth hs.periodic hs.mean_zero
  unfold physicalH1Square
  linarith

/-- The actual full Fourier budget yields the physical H1 bound through
the physical dissipation-square core, with no extra bound premise.
-/
theorem initial_front_uniform_H1_of_fourier_budget
    (ν T : ℝ) (a : Field) (u : Velocity) (p : Pressure)
    (hν : 0 < ν) (hT : 0 < T) (H : InitialClassicalFront ν T a u p)
    (hbudget : FourierBudgetFinite (fun t => datumFourierCoeff (u t)) T) :
    ∃ R : ℝ, 0 ≤ R ∧ ∀ t ∈ Ico (0 : ℝ) T, physicalH1Square (u t) ≤ R :=
  initial_front_uniform_H1_of_dissipation_square ν T a u p hν hT H
    (initial_front_dissipation_square_integrable_of_fourier_budget ν T a u p H hbudget)

/-- The full budget through min(lifetime,cutoff) bounds the same actual
maximal trajectory on that entire half-open cap. In particular the constant
does not depend on how closely a closed subinterval approaches the cap.
-/
theorem maximal_front_uniform_H1_before_budget_cap
    (ν cutoff : ℝ) (a : Field) (u : Velocity) (p : Pressure) (Tmax : ℝ≥0∞)
    (hν : 0 < ν) (H : MaximalClassicalFront ν a u p Tmax)
    (hbudget : MaximalFourierBudgetFinite u Tmax cutoff) :
    ∃ R : ℝ, 0 ≤ R ∧ ∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ t →
      ENNReal.ofReal t < min Tmax (ENNReal.ofReal cutoff) →
      physicalH1Square (u t) ≤ R := by
  let cap : ℝ≥0∞ := min Tmax (ENNReal.ofReal cutoff)
  have hfinite : cap ≠ ⊤ :=
    ne_top_of_le_ne_top ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top (min_le_right _ _)
  by_cases hcap : 0 < cap
  · let T : ℝ := cap.toReal
    have hT : 0 < T := ENNReal.toReal_pos hcap.ne' hfinite
    have hTmax : ENNReal.ofReal T ≤ Tmax := by
      rw [ENNReal.ofReal_toReal hfinite]
      exact min_le_left _ _
    have HF := maximal_classical_front_restrict_le ν T a u p Tmax H hT hTmax
    obtain ⟨R, hR, hb⟩ := initial_front_uniform_H1_of_fourier_budget
      ν T a u p hν hT HF hbudget
    refine ⟨R, hR, ?_⟩
    intro t ht htc
    exact hb t ⟨ht, (ENNReal.ofReal_lt_iff_lt_toReal ht hfinite).mp htc⟩
  · refine ⟨0, le_rfl, ?_⟩
    intro t ht htc
    have hc : cap ≤ 0 := le_of_not_gt hcap
    exact False.elim ((not_lt_of_ge (bot_le : (0 : ℝ≥0∞) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal t))
      (htc.trans_le hc))

end

The actual physical enstrophy-square budget extends a finite classical front
beyond its endpoint, preserving its velocity and normalized pressure. The
derived uniform physical H1 bound supplies a common positive restart time;
restarting before the old endpoint and gluing yields a longer actual front.
No endpoint value, trace or regularity is used. Consequently a finite maximal
endpoint cannot have this budget on its whole open pre-endpoint interval.

This theorem concerns arbitrary actual classical trajectories and has no
Fourier or Galerkin hypothesis. Prepared source only; matching external

/-- Finite actual physical enstrophy-square integral yields a genuine longer
classical front preserving the entire old velocity and normalized pressure.
All restart information is derived from the actual front and the budget.
-/
theorem initial_front_extends_of_dissipation_square
    (ν T : ℝ) (a : Field) (u : Velocity) (p : Pressure)
    (hν : 0 < ν) (hT : 0 < T) (H : InitialClassicalFront ν T a u p)
    (hD : Integrable (fun t => physicalDissipation (u t) ^ 2)
      (volume.restrict (Ioo (0 : ℝ) T))) :
    ∃ S : ℝ, T < S ∧ ∃ (U : Velocity) (P : Pressure),
      InitialClassicalFront ν S a U P ∧
        ∀ t ∈ Ico (0 : ℝ) T, U t = u t ∧ P t = p t := by
  obtain ⟨R, hR, hbound⟩ := initial_front_uniform_H1_of_dissipation_square
    ν T a u p hν hT H hD
  obtain ⟨h, hh, hlocal⟩ := uniform_H1_local_initial_classical_front_exists ν R hν hR
  let s : ℝ := max (T / 2) (T - h / 2)
  have hs0 : 0 ≤ s :=
    (by linarith : 0 ≤ T / 2).trans (le_max_left (T / 2) (T - h / 2))
  have hsT : s < T := max_lt (by linarith) (by linarith)
  have hreach : T < s + h := by
    have hnear : T - h / 2 ≤ s := le_max_right (T / 2) (T - h / 2)
    linarith
  have hdata : SmoothSigmaZero (u s) :=
    initial_front_smooth_slices ν T a u p H s ⟨hs0, hsT⟩
  obtain ⟨v, q, K⟩ := hlocal (u s) hdata (hbound s ⟨hs0, hsT⟩)
  obtain ⟨U, P, Hlong, hagree, _⟩ := initial_front_extend_from_restart
    ν T s h a u v p q hν H ⟨hs0, hsT⟩ hh K hreach
  exact ⟨s + h, hreach, U, P, Hlong, hagree⟩

/-- A finite maximal classical lifetime cannot have finite actual physical
enstrophy-square integral over its entire open pre-endpoint interval.
-/
theorem maximal_classical_front_no_finite_dissipation_square
    (ν : ℝ) (a : Field) (u : Velocity) (p : Pressure) (Tmax : ℝ≥0∞)

    (hfinite : Tmax ≠ ⊤)
    (hD : Integrable (fun t => physicalDissipation (u t) ^ 2)
      (volume.restrict (Ioo (0 : ℝ) Tmax.toReal))) : False := by
  have hT : 0 < Tmax.toReal := ENNReal.toReal_pos H.lifetime_pos.ne' hfinite

  obtain ⟨R, _, hR⟩ := initial_front_uniform_H1_of_dissipation_square
    ν Tmax.toReal a u p hν hT HF hD
  have htop : Tmax = ⊤ := maximal_classical_lifetime_eq_top_of_uniform_H1
    ν R a u p Tmax hν H (by
      intro t ht htmax
      exact hR t ⟨ht, (ENNReal.ofReal_lt_iff_lt_toReal ht hfinite).mp htmax⟩)
  exact hfinite htop

end

/-!
The maximal lifetime extends strictly beyond the prescribed finite cutoff.
If the maximal lifetime were at or before that cutoff, the derived H1 bound
would cover its whole pre-endpoint trajectory. Actual H1-controlled restart
and maximality would then force an infinite lifetime, contradicting the
finite cutoff. This includes equality without evaluating the trajectory at
its maximal endpoint.

The full open Fourier-budget hypothesis is retained. Prepared source only;
matching external cached compilation and fresh audits remain required.

/-- A finite full Fourier budget excludes both an earlier maximal endpoint
and an endpoint exactly equal to the prescribed cutoff.
-/
theorem maximal_classical_lifetime_strictly_exceeds_cutoff
    (ν cutoff : ℝ) (a : Field) (u : Velocity) (p : Pressure) (Tmax : ℝ≥0∞)
    (hν : 0 < ν) (H : MaximalClassicalFront ν a u p Tmax)
    (hbudget : MaximalFourierBudgetFinite u Tmax cutoff) :
    ENNReal.ofReal cutoff < Tmax := by
  by_contra hnot
  have hle : Tmax ≤ ENNReal.ofReal cutoff := le_of_not_gt hnot
  obtain ⟨R, _, hR⟩ := maximal_front_uniform_H1_before_budget_cap
    ν cutoff a u p Tmax hν H hbudget
  have htop : Tmax = ⊤ := maximal_classical_lifetime_eq_top_of_uniform_H1
    ν R a u p Tmax hν H (by
      intro t ht htmax
      exact hR t ht (by simpa only [min_eq_left hle] using htmax))
  exact (ne_top_of_le_ne_top ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top hle) htop

/-- Strict cutoff overlap gives a genuine positive classical front with
duration beyond that cutoff, suitable for the finite-cap admission theorem.
-/
theorem maximal_front_exists_strictly_after_cutoff
    (ν cutoff : ℝ) (a : Field) (u : Velocity) (p : Pressure) (Tmax : ℝ≥0∞)
    (hν : 0 < ν) (hcutoff : 0 ≤ cutoff)
    (H : MaximalClassicalFront ν a u p Tmax)
    (hbudget : MaximalFourierBudgetFinite u Tmax cutoff) :
    ∃ T : ℝ, 0 < T ∧ cutoff < T ∧ ENNReal.ofReal T < Tmax ∧
      InitialClassicalFront ν T a u p := by
  have hstrict := maximal_classical_lifetime_strictly_exceeds_cutoff
    ν cutoff a u p Tmax hν H hbudget
  obtain ⟨T, hT0, hcutT, hTmax⟩ := ENNReal.lt_iff_exists_real_btwn.mp hstrict
  have hcut : cutoff < T :=
    (ENNReal.ofReal_lt_ofReal_iff_of_nonneg hcutoff).mp hcutT
  have hT : 0 < T := hcutoff.trans_lt hcut
  exact ⟨T, hT, hcut, hTmax, H.finite_front T hT hTmax⟩

end

/-!
# The strict-cutoff composition step for the WFB route

An actual maximal classical trajectory whose lifetime lies strictly beyond
the original physical QFB cutoff supplies a finite initial cap. The accepted
classical R0 admission theorem is applied once to that cap. Its one global
velocity/pressure pair agrees with every shorter part of the original path by
the proved maximal-front agreement property. The no-extension property then
forces the lifetime to be infinite.

Strict cutoff overlap remains an explicit premise. This module does not infer
it from a Fourier budget, construct a local lifespan, or prove the full WFB
criterion. Prepared source; matching external cached compiler/type/axiom
verification is required. No local Lean, Lake or kernel execution was used.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

open Set SingularClosure QuasiFeffermanB
open scoped ENNReal

namespace MethbokeAddon.WeakFouriermanB
noncomputable section

/-- Strict overlap with the literal QFB cutoff gives one global physical pair
preserving the whole original maximal velocity and normalized pressure, and
forces the maximal lifetime to be infinite. The strict-cutoff premise is not
derived here from the WFB Fourier-budget hypothesis. -/
theorem maximal_classical_front_global_of_strict_cutoff
    (ν : ℝ) (a : Field) (u : Velocity) (p : Pressure) (Tmax : ℝ≥0∞)
    (hν : 0 < ν) (H : MaximalClassicalFront ν a u p Tmax)
    (hcut : ENNReal.ofReal (cutoff (criticalL2Representative a) ν) < Tmax) :
    Tmax = ⊤ ∧ ∃ (U : Velocity) (P : Pressure), GlobalSmoothNSE ν a U P ∧
      ∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ t → ENNReal.ofReal t < Tmax → U t = u t ∧ P t = p t := by
  have hcut0 : 0 ≤ cutoff (criticalL2Representative a) ν :=
    CUTOFF_NONNEG (criticalL2Representative a) hν
  obtain ⟨T, _, hcutT, hTmax⟩ := ENNReal.lt_iff_exists_real_btwn.mp hcut
  have hcutTreal : cutoff (criticalL2Representative a) ν < T :=
    (ENNReal.ofReal_lt_ofReal_iff_of_nonneg hcut0).mp hcutT
  have hT : 0 < T := hcut0.trans_lt hcutTreal
  obtain ⟨U, P, hglobal, _⟩ := finite_cap_classical_admission ν T a u p
    hν hcutTreal (H.finite_front T hT hTmax)
  have htop : Tmax = ⊤ := by
    by_contra hfinite
    have hlarge : 0 < Tmax.toReal + 1 := by positivity
    have hbound : ENNReal.ofReal (Tmax.toReal + 1) ≤ Tmax :=
      H.no_extension (Tmax.toReal + 1) U P hlarge
        (global_smooth_to_initial_front ν (Tmax.toReal + 1) a U P hglobal)
    have hstrict : Tmax < ENNReal.ofReal (Tmax.toReal + 1) := by
      calc
        Tmax = ENNReal.ofReal Tmax.toReal := (ENNReal.ofReal_toReal hfinite).symm
        _ < ENNReal.ofReal (Tmax.toReal + 1) :=
          (ENNReal.ofReal_lt_ofReal_iff_of_nonneg ENNReal.toReal_nonneg).mpr
            (by linarith)
    exact (not_lt_of_ge hbound) hstrict
  refine ⟨htop, U, P, hglobal, ?_⟩
  intro t ht _
  have hwindow : 0 < t + 1 := by linarith
  have hagree := H.agreement (t + 1) U P hwindow
    (global_smooth_to_initial_front ν (t + 1) a U P hglobal)
    t ⟨ht, by linarith⟩
  exact ⟨hagree.1.symm, hagree.2.symm⟩

end
end MethbokeAddon.WeakFouriermanB

/-- Every smooth datum has an actual maximal classical trajectory. The
norm-controlled physical local theorem discharges the existence premise of

theorem smooth_datum_maximal_classical_front_exists
    (ν : ℝ) (hν : 0 < ν) (a : Field) (ha : SmoothSigmaZero a) :
    ∃ Tmax : ℝ≥0∞, ∃ (u : Velocity) (p : Pressure),
      MaximalClassicalFront ν a u p Tmax := by
  have hR : 0 ≤ physicalDissipation a :=

theorem Weak_Fourierman_B
    (ν : ℝ) (hν : 0 < ν) (a : Field) (_ha : SmoothSigmaZero a)
    (u : Velocity) (p : Pressure) (Tmax : ℝ≥0∞)

  have hstrict := maximal_classical_lifetime_strictly_exceeds_cutoff
    ν (cutoff (criticalL2Representative a) ν) a u p Tmax hν H hbudget

The comparison is made at every pre-endpoint time by restricting the actual
maximal trajectory to a strictly longer finite front. The original weak pair
is fixed before choosing that front. Its initial representative is the actual

all later comparisons. No global smooth reference or new weak-path existence
premise is assumed. Prepared source; matching external cached compilation and

/-- Every original weak trajectory from the same datum agrees with the actual
maximal classical velocity at every pre-endpoint time, including zero. -/
theorem maximal_front_leray_hopf_identification
    (ν : ℝ) (a : Field) (u v : Velocity) (p : Pressure)
    (G : QuasiFeffermanB.WeakGradientTrajectory) (Tmax : ℝ≥0∞)
    (hν : 0 < ν) (ha : SmoothSigmaZero a)
    (H : MaximalClassicalFront ν a u p Tmax)
    (hv : CriticalLerayHopf ν (criticalL2Representative a) v G) :
    ∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ t → ENNReal.ofReal t < Tmax →
      v t =ᵐ[volume.restrict unitCube] u t := by
  intro t ht0 htmax
  rcases eq_or_lt_of_le ht0 with hzero | hpos
  · subst t
    have hinit : v 0 =ᵐ[volume.restrict unitCube] a :=
      hv.initial.trans (smooth_datum_representative_ae ha)
    simpa only [H.initial] using hinit
  · obtain ⟨T, _, htT, hTmax⟩ := ENNReal.lt_iff_exists_real_btwn.mp htmax
    have htTreal : t < T :=
      (ENNReal.ofReal_lt_ofReal_iff_of_nonneg hpos.le).mp htT
    have hT : 0 < T := hpos.trans htTreal
    exact initial_front_leray_hopf_identification ν T a u p v G
      (H.finite_front T hT hTmax) hν hT hv t ⟨hpos, htTreal⟩

/-- Construct one original Q01 weak trajectory and identify that same witness
on the entire maximal classical front. Compact horizons are used only inside
the comparison proof, never to choose replacement weak trajectories. -/
theorem maximal_front_original_leray_hopf
    (ν : ℝ) (a : Field) (u : Velocity) (p : Pressure) (Tmax : ℝ≥0∞)
    (hν : 0 < ν) (ha : SmoothSigmaZero a)
    (H : MaximalClassicalFront ν a u p Tmax) :
    ∃ (v : Velocity) (G : QuasiFeffermanB.WeakGradientTrajectory),
      CriticalLerayHopf ν (criticalL2Representative a) v G ∧
      (v 0 =ᵐ[volume.restrict unitCube] a) ∧
      ∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ t → ENNReal.ofReal t < Tmax →
        v t =ᵐ[volume.restrict unitCube] u t := by
  obtain ⟨v, G, hv, hv0⟩ := smooth_datum_lerayHopf_exists ν hν a ha
  exact ⟨v, G, hv, hv0,
    maximal_front_leray_hopf_identification ν a u v p G Tmax hν ha H hv⟩

end

The original Leray--Hopf pair is supplied explicitly and retained throughout.
Its identification with every compact maximal-front restriction and its Q09
tail are combined using the same weak representative. Spatial almost-everywhere
agreement becomes pointwise velocity agreement, and the physical equations and

The strict cutoff overlap remains explicit. No replacement weak witness is
chosen by R0, and no tail or global-existence conclusion is assumed in a new

/-- A normalized tail of the same original weak trajectory agrees pointwise
with the maximal classical velocity and pressure on their whole open overlap.
The weak representative is fixed for every compact comparison horizon. -/
theorem maximal_front_tail_overlap_of_same_leray_hopf
    (ν δ : ℝ) (a : Field) (u v w : Velocity) (p q : Pressure)
    (G : WeakGradientTrajectory) (Tmax : ℝ≥0∞)
    (hν : 0 < ν) (ha : SmoothSigmaZero a)
    (H : MaximalClassicalFront ν a u p Tmax)
    (hv : CriticalLerayHopf ν (criticalL2Representative a) v G)
    (K : ClassicalTail ν δ w q) (hδ0 : 0 ≤ δ)
    (htail : ∀ t : ℝ, δ ≤ t → v t =ᵐ[volume.restrict unitCube] w t) :
    ∀ t : ℝ, δ < t → ENNReal.ofReal t < Tmax → u t = w t ∧ p t = q t := by
  have hidentify := maximal_front_leray_hopf_identification ν a u v p G Tmax
    hν ha H hv
  intro t hδt htmax
  have ht0 : 0 < t := hδ0.trans_lt hδt
  obtain ⟨T, _, htT, hTmax⟩ := ENNReal.lt_iff_exists_real_btwn.mp htmax
  have htTreal : t < T :=
    (ENNReal.ofReal_lt_ofReal_iff_of_nonneg ht0.le).mp htT
  have hT : 0 < T := ht0.trans htTreal
  have hoverlap := finite_cap_tail_overlap_of_same_path_ae ν T δ a u w v p q
    (H.finite_front T hT hTmax) K hδ0
    (by
      intro r hr
      have hr0 : 0 ≤ r := hδ0.trans hr.1.le
      have hrmax : ENNReal.ofReal r < Tmax :=
        ((ENNReal.ofReal_lt_ofReal_iff_of_nonneg hr0).mpr hr.2).trans hTmax
      exact hidentify r hr0 hrmax)
    (fun r hr => htail r hr.1.le)
  exact ⟨hoverlap.1 t ⟨hδt, htTreal⟩, hoverlap.2 t ⟨hδt, htTreal⟩⟩

/-- Apply Q09 to the supplied original weak witness, derive the actual
velocity/normalized-pressure overlap, and glue one global pair. The returned
tail remains attached to that witness at every tail time; the global pair
preserves the entire maximal front and equals that same tail after the seam.
-/
theorem maximal_front_tail_gluing_of_leray_hopf
    (ν : ℝ) (a : Field) (u v : Velocity) (p : Pressure)
    (G : WeakGradientTrajectory) (Tmax : ℝ≥0∞)
    (hν : 0 < ν) (ha : SmoothSigmaZero a)
    (H : MaximalClassicalFront ν a u p Tmax)
    (hv : CriticalLerayHopf ν (criticalL2Representative a) v G)
    (hcut : ENNReal.ofReal (cutoff (criticalL2Representative a) ν) < Tmax) :
    ∃ (δ η : ℝ) (w : Velocity) (q : Pressure) (U : Velocity) (P : Pressure),
      cutoff (criticalL2Representative a) ν < δ ∧ δ < η ∧
      ENNReal.ofReal η < Tmax ∧ ClassicalTail ν δ w q ∧
      (∀ t : ℝ, δ ≤ t → v t =ᵐ[volume.restrict unitCube] w t) ∧
      (∀ t : ℝ, δ < t → ENNReal.ofReal t < Tmax → u t = w t ∧ p t = q t) ∧
      GlobalSmoothNSE ν a U P ∧
      (∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ t → ENNReal.ofReal t < Tmax → U t = u t ∧ P t = p t) ∧
      ∀ t : ℝ, η ≤ t → U t = w t ∧ P t = q t := by
  have hcut0 : 0 ≤ cutoff (criticalL2Representative a) ν :=
    CUTOFF_NONNEG (criticalL2Representative a) hν
  obtain ⟨T, _, hcutT, hTmax⟩ := ENNReal.lt_iff_exists_real_btwn.mp hcut
  have hcutTreal : cutoff (criticalL2Representative a) ν < T :=
    (ENNReal.ofReal_lt_ofReal_iff_of_nonneg hcut0).mp hcutT
  have hT : 0 < T := hcut0.trans_lt hcutTreal
  let δ : ℝ := (cutoff (criticalL2Representative a) ν + T) / 2
  let η : ℝ := (δ + T) / 2
  have hcutδ : cutoff (criticalL2Representative a) ν < δ := by
    dsimp [δ]
    linarith
  have hδT : δ < T := by dsimp [δ]; linarith
  have hδ0 : 0 < δ := hcut0.trans_lt hcutδ
  have hδη : δ < η := by dsimp [η]; linarith
  have hηT : η < T := by dsimp [η]; linarith
  have hη0 : 0 ≤ η := hδ0.le.trans hδη.le
  have hηmax : ENNReal.ofReal η < Tmax :=
    ((ENNReal.ofReal_lt_ofReal_iff_of_nonneg hη0).mpr hηT).trans hTmax
  obtain ⟨w, q, K, htail⟩ :=
    Q09_POST_CUTOFF_SMOOTHNESS hν (smooth_datum_energySigmaZero ha) hv hcutδ
  have hoverlap := maximal_front_tail_overlap_of_same_leray_hopf
    ν δ a u v w p q G Tmax hν ha H hv K hδ0.le htail
  have hrmax (r : ℝ) (hr : r ∈ Ioo δ T) : ENNReal.ofReal r < Tmax :=
    ((ENNReal.ofReal_lt_ofReal_iff_of_nonneg
      (hδ0.le.trans hr.1.le)).mpr hr.2).trans hTmax
  obtain ⟨U, P, hglobal, _, hlate⟩ := finite_cap_gluing ν T δ a u w p q
    (H.finite_front T hT hTmax) K hδ0.le hδT
    (fun r hr => (hoverlap r hr.1 (hrmax r hr)).1)
    (fun r hr => (hoverlap r hr.1 (hrmax r hr)).2)
  refine ⟨δ, η, w, q, U, P, hcutδ, hδη, hηmax, K, htail, hoverlap,
    hglobal, ?_, hlate⟩
  intro t ht _
  have hwindow : 0 < t + 1 := by linarith
  have hagree := H.agreement (t + 1) U P hwindow
    (global_smooth_to_initial_front ν (t + 1) a U P hglobal)
    t ⟨ht, by linarith⟩
  exact ⟨hagree.1.symm, hagree.2.symm⟩

end

/-!
# Scalar descent on a closed time slab

The comparison uses the explicit derivative rate and differentiability only
in the interior. No stopping condition or Navier--Stokes hypothesis occurs
in this scalar module.

namespace MethbokeAddon.EhrenfestObstruction

open Set

/-- An upper bound on the explicit interior derivative gives terminal descent. -/
theorem terminal_le_of_rate_le
    (v rate : ℝ → ℝ) (T gamma : ℝ)
    (hT : 0 < T)
    (hcont : ContinuousOn v (Icc 0 T))
    (hderiv : ∀ t ∈ Ioo 0 T, HasDerivAt v (rate t) t)
    (hrate : ∀ t ∈ Ioo 0 T, rate t ≤ -gamma) :
    v T ≤ v 0 - gamma * T := by
  obtain ⟨s, hs, hslope⟩ :=
    exists_hasDerivAt_eq_slope v rate hT hcont hderiv
  have hrate_s := hrate s hs
  rw [hslope] at hrate_s
  have hslope_le : (v T - v 0) / T ≤ -gamma := by
    simpa only [sub_zero] using hrate_s
  have hdiff : v T - v 0 ≤ -gamma * T :=
    (div_le_iff₀ hT).mp hslope_le
  linarith

/-- Terminal positivity is incompatible with descent consuming the initial budget. -/
theorem positive_terminal_contradiction
    (v rate : ℝ → ℝ) (T gamma : ℝ)
    (hT : 0 < T)
    (hcont : ContinuousOn v (Icc 0 T))
    (hderiv : ∀ t ∈ Ioo 0 T, HasDerivAt v (rate t) t)
    (hrate : ∀ t ∈ Ioo 0 T, rate t ≤ -gamma)
    (hbudget : v 0 ≤ gamma * T)
    (hpositive : 0 < v T) : False := by
  have hterminal :=
    terminal_le_of_rate_le v rate T gamma hT hcont hderiv hrate
  linarith

end MethbokeAddon.EhrenfestObstruction

/-!
# A scalar lower-level hit under a pre-hit derivative bound

The rate hypothesis is imposed only while the whole preceding history stays
strictly above the target level, and only before the horizon 1 / gamma.
The proof constructs a hit; it assumes no first-hit time.
-/

namespace MethbokeAddon.EhrenfestObstruction

open Set

/-- A guarded negative derivative forces the scalar function below the target
level by the explicit deadline. -/
theorem stopped_scalar_le_by_deadline
    (v rate : ℝ → ℝ) (gamma r : ℝ)
    (hgamma : 0 < gamma) (hr : 0 < r)
    (hr0 : r < v 0) (hv0 : v 0 ≤ 1)
    (hcont : ContinuousOn v (Icc 0 (1 / gamma)))
    (hderiv : ∀ t, 0 ≤ t → t < 1 / gamma →
      (∀ s, 0 ≤ s → s ≤ t → r < v s) →
      HasDerivWithinAt v (rate t) (Ici 0) t ∧ rate t ≤ -gamma) :
    ∃ t ∈ Icc 0 ((v 0 - r) / gamma), v t ≤ r := by
  classical
  let d : ℝ := (v 0 - r) / gamma
  have hdpos : 0 < d := div_pos (sub_pos.mpr hr0) hgamma
  have hdT : d < 1 / gamma := by
    exact div_lt_div_of_pos_right (by linarith : v 0 - r < 1) hgamma
  have hcontd : ContinuousOn v (Icc 0 d) :=
    hcont.mono (fun x hx => ⟨hx.1, hx.2.trans hdT.le⟩)
  change ∃ t ∈ Icc 0 d, v t ≤ r
  by_contra hno
  have hlower : ∀ s ∈ Icc 0 d, r < v s := by
    intro s hs
    by_contra hnot
    exact hno ⟨s, hs, le_of_not_gt hnot⟩
  have hint : ∀ t ∈ Ioo 0 d,
      HasDerivAt v (rate t) t ∧ rate t ≤ -gamma := by
    intro t ht
    have hhistory : ∀ s, 0 ≤ s → s ≤ t → r < v s := by
      intro s hs0 hst
      exact hlower s ⟨hs0, hst.trans ht.2.le⟩

    terminal_le_of_rate_le v rate d gamma hdpos hcontd
      (fun t ht => (hint t ht).1) (fun t ht => (hint t ht).2)

    dsimp [d]
    rw [mul_comm]
    exact div_mul_cancel₀ _ hgamma.ne'

the explicit deadline. Continuity turns the lower-level witness into equality. -/
theorem stopped_scalar_hitting
    (v rate : ℝ → ℝ) (gamma r : ℝ)
    (hgamma : 0 < gamma) (hr : 0 < r)
    (hr0 : r < v 0) (hv0 : v 0 ≤ 1)
    (hcont : ContinuousOn v (Icc 0 (1 / gamma)))
    (hderiv : ∀ t, 0 ≤ t → t < 1 / gamma →

      HasDerivWithinAt v (rate t) (Ici 0) t ∧ rate t ≤ -gamma) :

  obtain ⟨s, hs, hsr⟩ :=
    stopped_scalar_le_by_deadline v rate gamma r hgamma hr hr0 hv0 hcont hderiv
  have hdeadline : (v 0 - r) / gamma < 1 / gamma :=
    div_lt_div_of_pos_right (by linarith : v 0 - r < 1) hgamma
  have hsT : s ≤ 1 / gamma := hs.2.trans hdeadline.le
  have hconts : ContinuousOn v (Icc 0 s) :=
    hcont.mono (fun x hx => ⟨hx.1, hx.2.trans hsT⟩)
  obtain ⟨t, ht, htr⟩ :=
    intermediate_value_Icc' hs.1 hconts
      (show r ∈ Icc (v s) (v 0) from ⟨hsr, hr0.le⟩)
  exact ⟨t, ⟨ht.1, ht.2.trans hs.2⟩, htr⟩

# Literal data and stopped drift for EHRENFEST-OBSTRUCTION

The family is the actual canonical Fourier--Galerkin family for one smooth
datum and one positive viscosity. The logical index `n` always represents
the physical cutoff `n + 1`. The stopped predicate contains only the explicit
coefficient drift, constants and the no-hit guard; it contains no regularity

/-- Actual smooth periodic, solenoidal, mean-zero initial data. -/
abbrev SmoothDatum := {a : Field // SmoothSigmaZero a}

/-- The exact canonical Galerkin family, with strictly positive cutoff. -/
def canonicalFamily (ν : ℝ) (hν : 0 < ν) (a : SmoothDatum) (n : ℕ) :
    GalerkinSolution ν a.val (n + 1) :=
  canonicalGalerkinSolution ν hν a.val a.property (n + 1)

/-- Half the physical gradient-square sum. -/
def halfEnstrophy (N : ℕ) (c : FourierCoeff) : ℝ :=
  coefficientDissipation N c / 2

/-- The bounded reciprocal observable when `eStar > 0`. -/
def reciprocalValue (eStar : ℝ) (N : ℕ) (c : FourierCoeff) : ℝ :=
  (1 + halfEnstrophy N c / eStar)⁻¹

/-- Literal reciprocal drift. The nonlinear-power sign is the native one:
`D' = -2 * ν * Z - 2 * P`, so the reciprocal rate has numerator `ν * Z + P`. -/
def reciprocalDrift (ν eStar : ℝ) (N : ℕ) (c : FourierCoeff) : ℝ :=
  (ν * coefficientLaplacianSquare N c +
      coefficientEnstrophyNonlinearPower N c) /
    (eStar * (1 + halfEnstrophy N c / eStar) ^ 2)

def canonicalEnstrophy (ν : ℝ) (hν : 0 < ν) (a : SmoothDatum)
    (n : ℕ) (t : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  halfEnstrophy (n + 1) ((canonicalFamily ν hν a n).coeff t)

def canonicalReciprocal (ν : ℝ) (hν : 0 < ν) (a : SmoothDatum)
    (eStar : ℝ) (n : ℕ) (t : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  reciprocalValue eStar (n + 1) ((canonicalFamily ν hν a n).coeff t)

def canonicalDrift (ν : ℝ) (hν : 0 < ν) (a : SmoothDatum)
    (eStar : ℝ) (n : ℕ) (t : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  reciprocalDrift ν eStar (n + 1) ((canonicalFamily ν hν a n).coeff t)

/-- Strictly before the horizon, with every earlier point below threshold.
No first-hit time or existence of a hit is built into this definition. -/
def PreHit (e : ℝ → ℝ) (R T t : ℝ) : Prop :=
  0 ≤ t ∧ t < T ∧ ∀ s : ℝ, 0 ≤ s → s ≤ t → e s < R

/-- The one explicit stopped-drift premise for a fixed actual datum. -/
def StoppedForDatum (ν : ℝ) (hν : 0 < ν) (a : SmoothDatum)
    (eStar gamma : ℝ) (R : ℕ → ℝ) : Prop :=
  0 < eStar ∧ 0 < gamma ∧ (∀ n : ℕ, 0 < R n) ∧
    Tendsto R atTop atTop ∧
      ∃ n₀ : ℕ, ∀ n : ℕ, n₀ ≤ n → ∀ t : ℝ,
        PreHit (canonicalEnstrophy ν hν a n) (R n) (1 / gamma) t →
          canonicalDrift ν hν a eStar n t ≤ -gamma

/-- Existential dynamical assumption, not a global custom axiom. -/
def StoppedCommutatorBound (ν : ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∃ hν : 0 < ν, ∃ a : SmoothDatum, ∃ eStar gamma : ℝ, ∃ R : ℕ → ℝ,
    StoppedForDatum ν hν a eStar gamma R

/-- The actual universal smooth periodic NSE statement at viscosity `ν`. -/
def NSE_B (ν : ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ a : Field, SmoothSigmaZero a →
    ∃ (U : Velocity) (P : Pressure), GlobalSmoothNSE ν a U P

end

theorem halfEnstrophy_nonneg (N : ℕ) (c : FourierCoeff) :

theorem reciprocal_denominator_pos (eStar : ℝ) (heStar : 0 < eStar)
    (N : ℕ) (c : FourierCoeff) :
    0 < 1 + halfEnstrophy N c / eStar := by
  have hq : 0 ≤ halfEnstrophy N c / eStar :=
    div_nonneg (halfEnstrophy_nonneg N c) heStar.le
  linarith

theorem reciprocalValue_bounds (eStar : ℝ) (heStar : 0 < eStar)
    (N : ℕ) (c : FourierCoeff) :
    0 < reciprocalValue eStar N c ∧ reciprocalValue eStar N c ≤ 1 := by
  have hden := reciprocal_denominator_pos eStar heStar N c
  have hq : 0 ≤ halfEnstrophy N c / eStar :=
    div_nonneg (halfEnstrophy_nonneg N c) heStar.le
  constructor
  · exact inv_pos.mpr hden
  · have hdiv : (1 : ℝ) / (1 + halfEnstrophy N c / eStar) ≤ 1 := by
      apply (div_le_iff₀ hden).2
      nlinarith
    simpa only [reciprocalValue, one_div] using hdiv

/-- The reciprocal identity for any actual finite Galerkin solution. -/
theorem galerkin_reciprocal_hasDerivWithinAt
    (ν : ℝ) (a : Field) (N : ℕ) (g : GalerkinSolution ν a N)
    (eStar : ℝ) (heStar : 0 < eStar) (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 ≤ t) :
    HasDerivWithinAt
      (fun r => reciprocalValue eStar N (g.coeff r))
      (reciprocalDrift ν eStar N (g.coeff t)) (Ici 0) t := by
  have hden : 1 + (coefficientDissipation N (g.coeff t) / 2) / eStar ≠ 0 := by
    exact ne_of_gt (reciprocal_denominator_pos eStar heStar N (g.coeff t))
  have hInner : HasDerivWithinAt
      (fun r : ℝ => 1 + (coefficientDissipation N (g.coeff r) / 2) / eStar)
      (((-2 * ν) * coefficientLaplacianSquare N (g.coeff t) -
        2 * coefficientEnstrophyNonlinearPower N (g.coeff t)) / 2 / eStar)
      (Ici 0) t :=
    (((g.coefficientEnstrophy_identity ht).div_const 2).div_const eStar).const_add 1
  have hOuter : HasDerivAt (fun x : ℝ => x⁻¹)
      (-((1 + (coefficientDissipation N (g.coeff t) / 2) / eStar) ^ 2)⁻¹)
      (1 + (coefficientDissipation N (g.coeff t) / 2) / eStar) :=
    hasDerivAt_inv hden
  -- Scalar composition can select the real inner-product module instance.
  -- The final convert! normalizes that instance diamond at default transparency.
  have hInv := hOuter.scomp_hasDerivWithinAt t hInner
  have hrate :
      (((-2 * ν) * coefficientLaplacianSquare N (g.coeff t) -
          2 * coefficientEnstrophyNonlinearPower N (g.coeff t)) / 2 / eStar) •
          (-((1 + (coefficientDissipation N (g.coeff t) / 2) / eStar) ^ 2)⁻¹) =
        reciprocalDrift ν eStar N (g.coeff t) := by
    simp only [smul_eq_mul, reciprocalDrift, halfEnstrophy, div_eq_mul_inv, mul_inv_rev]
    ring
  rw [hrate] at hInv
  convert! hInv using 1 <;>
    simp only [Function.comp_apply, reciprocalValue, halfEnstrophy]

theorem canonical_enstrophy_nonneg
    (ν : ℝ) (hν : 0 < ν) (a : SmoothDatum) (n : ℕ) (t : ℝ) :
    0 ≤ canonicalEnstrophy ν hν a n t := by
  exact halfEnstrophy_nonneg (n + 1) ((canonicalFamily ν hν a n).coeff t)

theorem canonical_reciprocal_bounds
    (ν : ℝ) (hν : 0 < ν) (a : SmoothDatum)
    (eStar : ℝ) (heStar : 0 < eStar) (n : ℕ) (t : ℝ) (_ht : 0 ≤ t) :

      canonicalReciprocal ν hν a eStar n t ≤ 1 := by

theorem canonical_reciprocal_hasDerivWithinAt
    (ν : ℝ) (hν : 0 < ν) (a : SmoothDatum)
    (eStar : ℝ) (heStar : 0 < eStar) (n : ℕ) (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 ≤ t) :
    HasDerivWithinAt (canonicalReciprocal ν hν a eStar n)

theorem canonical_reciprocal_hasDerivAt

    (eStar : ℝ) (heStar : 0 < eStar) (n : ℕ) (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 < t) :

theorem canonical_reciprocal_continuousOn_Ici

    (eStar : ℝ) (heStar : 0 < eStar) (n : ℕ) :
    ContinuousOn (canonicalReciprocal ν hν a eStar n) (Ici 0) := by
  intro t ht

theorem canonical_reciprocal_continuousOn_Icc

    (eStar : ℝ) (heStar : 0 < eStar) (n : ℕ) (T : ℝ) :

/-- Twice the real Fourier pairing with the positive Laplacian weight. -/
def dissipationRatePairing (N : ℕ) (c d : FourierCoeff) : ℝ :=
  ∑ k ∈ cutoffModes N, ∑ i : Fin 3,
    ((2 * Real.pi) ^ 2 * (galerkinFreqSq k : ℝ)) *
      (2 * (star (c k i) * d k i).re)

/-- The H1 square derivative needs only the actual coordinate derivatives. -/
theorem coefficient_dissipation_hasDerivWithinAt
    (N : ℕ) (c : ℝ → FourierCoeff) (d : FourierCoeff)
    {s : Set ℝ} {t : ℝ}
    (hc : ∀ k ∈ cutoffModes N, ∀ i : Fin 3,
      HasDerivWithinAt (fun r => c r k i) (d k i) s t) :
    HasDerivWithinAt (fun r => coefficientDissipation N (c r))
      (dissipationRatePairing N (c t) d) s t := by
  unfold coefficientDissipation dissipationRatePairing
  apply HasDerivWithinAt.fun_sum
  intro k hk
  apply HasDerivWithinAt.fun_sum
  intro i hi
  exact (hasDerivWithinAt_complex_normSq (hc k hk i)).const_mul _

/-- Subtraction preserves the exact finite-coefficient derivative formula. -/
theorem coefficient_error_dissipation_hasDerivWithinAt
    (N : ℕ) (c v : ℝ → FourierCoeff) (dc dv : FourierCoeff)
    {s : Set ℝ} {t : ℝ}
    (hc : ∀ k ∈ cutoffModes N, ∀ i : Fin 3,
      HasDerivWithinAt (fun r => c r k i) (dc k i) s t)
    (hv : ∀ k ∈ cutoffModes N, ∀ i : Fin 3,
      HasDerivWithinAt (fun r => v r k i) (dv k i) s t) :
    HasDerivWithinAt
      (fun r => coefficientDissipation N (c r - v r))
      (dissipationRatePairing N (c t - v t) (dc - dv)) s t := by
  apply coefficient_dissipation_hasDerivWithinAt
  intro k hk i
  exact (hc k hk i).sub (hv k hk i)

theorem dissipationRatePairing_add_right
    (N : ℕ) (c d f : FourierCoeff) :
    dissipationRatePairing N c (d + f) =
      dissipationRatePairing N c d + dissipationRatePairing N c f := by
  simp only [dissipationRatePairing, Pi.add_apply, mul_add,
    Complex.add_re, Finset.sum_add_distrib]

theorem dissipationRatePairing_sub_right
    (N : ℕ) (c d f : FourierCoeff) :
    dissipationRatePairing N c (d - f) =
      dissipationRatePairing N c d - dissipationRatePairing N c f := by
  simp only [dissipationRatePairing, Pi.sub_apply, mul_sub,
    Complex.sub_re, Finset.sum_sub_distrib]

    (ν : ℝ) (N : ℕ) (c : FourierCoeff) :

theorem forced_coefficient_dissipation_identity
    (ν : ℝ) (N : ℕ) (c : ℝ → FourierCoeff) (f : FourierCoeff)
    {s : Set ℝ} {t : ℝ}
    (heq : ∀ k ∈ cutoffModes N, ∀ i : Fin 3,
      HasDerivWithinAt (fun r => c r k i)
        (galerkinRhs ν N (c t) k i + f k i) s t) :

      ((-2 * ν) * coefficientLaplacianSquare N (c t) -
        2 * coefficientEnstrophyNonlinearPower N (c t) +

  have hd := coefficient_dissipation_hasDerivWithinAt N c
    (galerkinRhs ν N (c t) + f) heq
  rw [dissipationRatePairing_add_right,
    dissipationRatePairing_galerkinRhs] at hd

absorption as Galerkin solutions. No evolution equation is used here. -/
theorem FINITE_ERROR_NONLINEAR_ABSORPTION :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ ν : ℝ, 0 < ν → ∀ N : ℕ,

theorem FORCED_COEFFICIENT_ENSTROPHY_INEQUALITY :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ ν : ℝ, 0 < ν → ∀ N : ℕ,

/-!
# Finite Fourier component bounds from the actual H2 norm

These are source-prepared candidates for the Ehrenfest smooth-reference layer.
They use the actual weighted coefficient space and actual finite synthesis.
No solution, convergence, residual-bound or regularity port is assumed.
Matching external cached compilation and fresh type/axiom audits are required.
No local Lean execution was used.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

open SingularClosure
open scoped BigOperators

namespace MethbokeAddon.EhrenfestObstruction
noncomputable section

/-- A single component's finite H2 sum is bounded by the full H2 norm. -/
theorem finite_component_H2_sum_le (s : Finset Frequency)
    (c : TorusSobolev 2) (i : Fin 3) :
    (∑ k ∈ s, (torusSobolevWeight k ^ 2 * ‖c.val k i‖) ^ 2) ≤ ‖c‖ ^ 2 := by
  have h := torusSobolev_finite_weighted_sum_le 2 c
    (s.product ({i} : Finset (Fin 3)))
  have hproduct :
      (∑ ki ∈ s.product ({i} : Finset (Fin 3)),
        ‖sobolevWeightedCoeff 2 c.val ki‖ ^ 2) =
      ∑ k ∈ s, ∑ j ∈ ({i} : Finset (Fin 3)),
        ‖sobolevWeightedCoeff 2 c.val (k, j)‖ ^ 2 :=
    Finset.sum_product s ({i} : Finset (Fin 3))
      (fun ki : FourierIndex => ‖sobolevWeightedCoeff 2 c.val ki‖ ^ 2)
  rw [hproduct] at h
  simpa only [Finset.sum_singleton, torusSobolev_weightedCoeff_norm] using h

/-- The finite coefficient l1 square has a support-independent H2 bound. -/
theorem finite_component_l1_sq_le_H2_norm_sq (s : Finset Frequency)
    (c : TorusSobolev 2) (i : Fin 3) :
    (∑ k ∈ s, ‖c.val k i‖) ^ 2 ≤ latticeSobolevConstant * ‖c‖ ^ 2 := by
  exact (finite_l1_sq_le_H2_sq s (fun k => c.val k i)).trans
    (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (finite_component_H2_sum_le s c i)
      latticeSobolevConstant_pos.le)

/-- A support-independent scalar Fourier l1 bound with an explicit constant. -/
theorem finite_component_l1_le_H2_norm (s : Finset Frequency)
    (c : TorusSobolev 2) (i : Fin 3) :
    (∑ k ∈ s, ‖c.val k i‖) ≤ Real.sqrt latticeSobolevConstant * ‖c‖ := by
  have hsq := finite_component_l1_sq_le_H2_norm_sq s c i
  have hsum : 0 ≤ ∑ k ∈ s, ‖c.val k i‖ :=
    Finset.sum_nonneg (fun k _ => norm_nonneg _)
  have hright : 0 ≤ Real.sqrt latticeSobolevConstant * ‖c‖ :=
    mul_nonneg (Real.sqrt_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg _)
  have hright_sq : (Real.sqrt latticeSobolevConstant * ‖c‖) ^ 2 =
      latticeSobolevConstant * ‖c‖ ^ 2 := by
    rw [mul_pow, Real.sq_sqrt latticeSobolevConstant_pos.le]
  exact (sq_le_sq₀ hsum hright).mp (hsq.trans_eq hright_sq.symm)

/-- The actual unit-period Fourier characters have unit complex norm. -/
theorem ehrenfest_fourierCharacter_norm (k : Frequency) (x : Vec) :
    ‖fourierCharacter k x‖ = 1 := by
  simp [fourierCharacter, Complex.norm_exp, Complex.mul_re]

/-- Every finite-synthesis component is bounded by its coefficient l1 sum. -/
theorem finiteSynthesis_component_abs_le_l1
    (N : ℕ) (c : FourierCoeff) (x : Vec) (i : Fin 3) :
    |finiteSynthesis N c x i| ≤ ∑ k ∈ cutoffModes N, ‖c k i‖ := by
  change |(∑ k ∈ cutoffModes N, fourierCharacter k x * c k i).re| ≤ _
  calc
    _ ≤ ‖∑ k ∈ cutoffModes N, fourierCharacter k x * c k i‖ :=
      Complex.abs_re_le_norm _
    _ ≤ ∑ k ∈ cutoffModes N, ‖fourierCharacter k x * c k i‖ :=
      norm_sum_le _ _
    _ = ∑ k ∈ cutoffModes N, ‖c k i‖ := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro k hk
      rw [norm_mul, ehrenfest_fourierCharacter_norm, one_mul]

/-- Uniform pointwise component control of the actual finite real synthesis. -/
theorem finiteSynthesis_component_abs_le_H2_norm
    (N : ℕ) (c : TorusSobolev 2) (x : Vec) (i : Fin 3) :
    |finiteSynthesis N c.val x i| ≤ Real.sqrt latticeSobolevConstant * ‖c‖ :=
  (finiteSynthesis_component_abs_le_l1 N c.val x i).trans
    (finite_component_l1_le_H2_norm (cutoffModes N) c i)

end
end MethbokeAddon.EhrenfestObstruction

/-!
# Explicit smooth-datum Sobolev norm bounds

Source-prepared candidates: no local Lean execution or acceptance claim.
The estimate is extracted from the actual Fourier-decay membership proof.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

open SingularClosure
open scoped BigOperators ContDiff ENNReal

namespace MethbokeAddon.EhrenfestObstruction
noncomputable section

/-- Uniform finite weighted-square bound for actual smooth-datum coefficients. -/
theorem smooth_datum_finite_weighted_sum_le (s : ℕ) (a : Field)
    (ha : ContDiff ℝ ∞ a) (hp : SpatialPeriodic a) (t : Finset FourierIndex) :
    (∑ ki ∈ t, ‖sobolevWeightedCoeff s (datumFourierCoeff a) ki‖ ^ 2) ≤
      3 * smoothDatumDecayConstant s a ^ 2 * latticeSobolevConstant := by
  classical
  have hsub : t ⊆ (t.image Prod.fst).product (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin 3)) := by
    intro ki hki
    exact Finset.mem_product.mpr
      ⟨Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨ki, hki, rfl⟩, Finset.mem_univ _⟩
  have hsum :
      (∑ k ∈ t.image Prod.fst, (torusSobolevWeight k)⁻¹ ^ 4) ≤
        latticeSobolevConstant := by
    have h := Summable.sum_le_tsum (t.image Prod.fst) (fun k _ => by positivity)
      summable_torusSobolevWeight_inv_four
    unfold latticeSobolevConstant
    linarith
  calc
    _ ≤ ∑ ki ∈ t, smoothDatumDecayConstant s a ^ 2 *
        (torusSobolevWeight ki.1)⁻¹ ^ 4 :=
      Finset.sum_le_sum (fun ki _ => smooth_datum_weightedCoeff_sq_le s a ha hp ki)
    _ ≤ ∑ ki ∈ (t.image Prod.fst).product (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin 3)),
        smoothDatumDecayConstant s a ^ 2 * (torusSobolevWeight ki.1)⁻¹ ^ 4 :=
      Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg hsub (fun ki _ _ => by positivity)
    _ = 3 * smoothDatumDecayConstant s a ^ 2 *
        ∑ k ∈ t.image Prod.fst, (torusSobolevWeight k)⁻¹ ^ 4 := by
      simp [Finset.sum_product, Finset.mul_sum, mul_assoc]
    _ ≤ _ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hsum (by positivity)

/-- The actual smooth-datum Hilbert norm is controlled by its explicit decay constant. -/
theorem smoothDatumSobolev_norm_le (s : ℕ) (a : Field)
    (ha : ContDiff ℝ ∞ a) (hp : SpatialPeriodic a) :
    ‖smoothDatumSobolev s a ha hp‖ ≤
      Real.sqrt (3 * latticeSobolevConstant) * smoothDatumDecayConstant s a := by
  have hC : 0 ≤ smoothDatumDecayConstant s a := smoothDatumDecayConstant_nonneg s a
  have hL : 0 ≤ 3 * latticeSobolevConstant :=
    mul_nonneg (by norm_num) latticeSobolevConstant_pos.le
  have hsq :
      (Real.sqrt (3 * latticeSobolevConstant) * smoothDatumDecayConstant s a) ^ 2 =
        3 * smoothDatumDecayConstant s a ^ 2 * latticeSobolevConstant := by
    rw [mul_pow, Real.sq_sqrt hL]
    ring
  change ‖torusSobolevRepr s (smoothDatumSobolev s a ha hp)‖ ≤ _
  apply lp.norm_le_of_forall_sum_le (p := (2 : ℝ≥0∞)) (by norm_num)
    (mul_nonneg (Real.sqrt_nonneg _) hC)
  intro t
  simp only [ENNReal.toReal_ofNat, Real.rpow_two, hsq]
  simpa only [torusSobolevRepr_apply, smoothDatumSobolev_coeff, sobolevWeightedCoeff]
    using smooth_datum_finite_weighted_sum_le s a ha hp t

/-- Squared-norm form of the extracted smooth-datum estimate. -/
theorem smoothDatumSobolev_norm_sq_le (s : ℕ) (a : Field)
    (ha : ContDiff ℝ ∞ a) (hp : SpatialPeriodic a) :
    ‖smoothDatumSobolev s a ha hp‖ ^ 2 ≤
      3 * smoothDatumDecayConstant s a ^ 2 * latticeSobolevConstant := by
  have hL : 0 ≤ 3 * latticeSobolevConstant :=
    mul_nonneg (by norm_num) latticeSobolevConstant_pos.le
  calc
    _ ≤ (Real.sqrt (3 * latticeSobolevConstant) * smoothDatumDecayConstant s a) ^ 2 :=
      pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) (smoothDatumSobolev_norm_le s a ha hp) 2
    _ = _ := by
      rw [mul_pow, Real.sq_sqrt hL]
      ring

end
end MethbokeAddon.EhrenfestObstruction

/-!
# Support-independent component C1 bounds for finite Fourier synthesis

Source-prepared candidates; matching external cached compilation remains required.
The derivative operator is the actual Fourier multiplier, and the derivative
identity below is the existing physical Frechet derivative identity.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

open SingularClosure
open scoped BigOperators

namespace MethbokeAddon.EhrenfestObstruction
noncomputable section

/-- One coordinate derivative consumes one actual Fourier Sobolev order. -/
theorem ehrenfest_coordinateDerivative_multiplier_bound
    (s : ℕ) (j : Fin 3) (k : Frequency) :
    torusSobolevWeight k ^ s * ‖derivativeSymbol j k‖ ≤
      1 * torusSobolevWeight k ^ (s + 1) := by
  rw [one_mul, pow_succ]
  exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (derivativeSymbol_norm_le_weight k j)
    (pow_nonneg (torusSobolevWeight_pos k).le s)

/-- The actual derivative multiplier as a continuous linear map. -/
def ehrenfestTorusSobolevCoordinateDerivative (s : ℕ) (j : Fin 3) :
    TorusSobolev (s + 1) →L[ℂ] TorusSobolev s :=
  torusSobolevMultiplier s (s + 1) (derivativeSymbol j) 1 zero_le_one
    (ehrenfest_coordinateDerivative_multiplier_bound s j)

@[simp]
theorem ehrenfestTorusSobolevCoordinateDerivative_coeff
    (s : ℕ) (j : Fin 3) (c : TorusSobolev (s + 1)) :
    (ehrenfestTorusSobolevCoordinateDerivative s j c).val =
      spectralMultiplier (derivativeSymbol j) c.val :=
  torusSobolevMultiplier_coeff s (s + 1) (derivativeSymbol j) 1 zero_le_one
    (ehrenfest_coordinateDerivative_multiplier_bound s j) c

theorem ehrenfestTorusSobolevCoordinateDerivative_norm_le
    (s : ℕ) (j : Fin 3) (c : TorusSobolev (s + 1)) :
    ‖ehrenfestTorusSobolevCoordinateDerivative s j c‖ ≤ ‖c‖ := by
  have heq : ehrenfestTorusSobolevCoordinateDerivative s j c =
      torusSobolevMultiplierLinear s (s + 1) (derivativeSymbol j) 1 zero_le_one
        (ehrenfest_coordinateDerivative_multiplier_bound s j) c :=
    (torusSobolevMultiplierLinear s (s + 1) (derivativeSymbol j) 1 zero_le_one
      (ehrenfest_coordinateDerivative_multiplier_bound s j)).mkContinuous_apply 1
      (torusSobolevMultiplierLinear_norm_le s (s + 1) (derivativeSymbol j) 1 zero_le_one
        (ehrenfest_coordinateDerivative_multiplier_bound s j)) c
  rw [heq]
  simpa only [one_mul] using
    torusSobolevMultiplierLinear_norm_le s (s + 1) (derivativeSymbol j) 1 zero_le_one
      (ehrenfest_coordinateDerivative_multiplier_bound s j) c

/-- Every projected velocity component is bounded uniformly in the cutoff. -/
theorem finiteSynthesis_component_abs_le_H3_norm
    (N : ℕ) (c : TorusSobolev 3) (x : Vec) (i : Fin 3) :
    |finiteSynthesis N c.val x i| ≤ Real.sqrt latticeSobolevConstant * ‖c‖ := by
  have h := finiteSynthesis_component_abs_le_H2_norm N
    (torusSobolevInclusionLinear 2 c) x i
  have hnorm := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (torusSobolevInclusion_norm_le 2 c)
    (Real.sqrt_nonneg latticeSobolevConstant)
  simpa only [torusSobolevInclusionLinear_coeff] using h.trans hnorm

/-- Every projected coordinate-derivative component has the same uniform H3 bound. -/
theorem finiteSynthesis_coordinateDerivative_component_abs_le_H3_norm
    (N : ℕ) (c : TorusSobolev 3) (x : Vec) (j i : Fin 3) :
    |coordinateDerivative (finiteSynthesis N c.val) j x i| ≤
      Real.sqrt latticeSobolevConstant * ‖c‖ := by
  rw [finiteSynthesis_coordinateDerivative,
    ← ehrenfestTorusSobolevCoordinateDerivative_coeff 2 j c]
  exact (finiteSynthesis_component_abs_le_H2_norm N
    (ehrenfestTorusSobolevCoordinateDerivative 2 j c) x i).trans
    (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
      (ehrenfestTorusSobolevCoordinateDerivative_norm_le 2 j c)
      (Real.sqrt_nonneg latticeSobolevConstant))

/-- Componentwise C1 control for the actual finite physical Fourier field. -/
theorem finiteSynthesis_C1_components_le_H3_norm
    (N : ℕ) (c : TorusSobolev 3) (x : Vec) :
    (∀ i : Fin 3, |finiteSynthesis N c.val x i| ≤
      Real.sqrt latticeSobolevConstant * ‖c‖) ∧
    (∀ j i : Fin 3, |coordinateDerivative (finiteSynthesis N c.val) j x i| ≤
      Real.sqrt latticeSobolevConstant * ‖c‖) :=
  ⟨fun i => finiteSynthesis_component_abs_le_H3_norm N c x i,
    fun j i => finiteSynthesis_coordinateDerivative_component_abs_le_H3_norm N c x j i⟩

end
end MethbokeAddon.EhrenfestObstruction

/-!
Actual smooth-reference estimates on each closed interval strictly inside an
initial classical front. The Fourier-decay constants are the existing physical
integrals of spatial derivatives, and their bounds are obtained by compactness.
Prepared source only: matching external cached compilation and audits remain.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

open Set MeasureTheory SingularClosure
open MethbokeAddon.WeakFouriermanB
open scoped BigOperators ContDiff

namespace MethbokeAddon.EhrenfestObstruction
noncomputable section

/-- Repeated ordinary spatial differentiation preserves joint smoothness,
including at the initial time boundary. -/
theorem initial_iteratedCoordinateDerivative_contDiffOn
    (u : Velocity) (S : ℝ)
    (hu : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ × Vec => u z.1 z.2)
      (initialFrontSpacetime S))
    (j : Fin 3) (m : ℕ) :
    ContDiffOn ℝ ∞
      (fun z : ℝ × Vec => iteratedCoordinateDerivative j m (u z.1) z.2)
      (initialFrontSpacetime S) := by
  induction m with
  | zero => exact hu
  | succ m ih =>
      exact initial_coordinateDerivative_contDiffOn
        (fun t => iteratedCoordinateDerivative j m (u t)) S ih j

/-- The physical component L1 norm is continuous on every shorter closed slab. -/
theorem initial_componentL1_continuousOn_Icc
    (u : Velocity) (S : ℝ)
    (hu : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ × Vec => u z.1 z.2)
      (initialFrontSpacetime S))
    (i : Fin 3) (T : ℝ) (hTS : T < S) :
    ContinuousOn (fun t => ∫ x in unitCube, ‖u t x i‖) (Icc (0 : ℝ) T) := by
  exact initial_real_cube_integral_continuousOn_Icc S
    (fun t x => ‖u t x i‖)
    (((EuclideanSpace.proj i : Vec →L[ℝ] ℝ).continuous.comp_continuousOn
      hu.continuousOn).norm) T hTS

/-- Every actual coordinate-derivative L1 norm is continuous on a shorter slab. -/
theorem initial_coordinateDerivativeL1_continuousOn_Icc
    (u : Velocity) (S : ℝ)
    (hu : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ × Vec => u z.1 z.2)
      (initialFrontSpacetime S))
    (j : Fin 3) (m : ℕ) (i : Fin 3) (T : ℝ) (hTS : T < S) :
    ContinuousOn (fun t => coordinateDerivativeL1 j m (u t) i)
      (Icc (0 : ℝ) T) := by
  exact initial_componentL1_continuousOn_Icc
    (fun t => iteratedCoordinateDerivative j m (u t)) S
    (initial_iteratedCoordinateDerivative_contDiffOn u S hu j m) i T hTS

/-- The repository's literal Fourier-decay constant varies continuously in time. -/
theorem initial_fourierDecayConstant_continuousOn_Icc
    (u : Velocity) (S : ℝ)
    (hu : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ × Vec => u z.1 z.2)
      (initialFrontSpacetime S))
    (m : ℕ) (T : ℝ) (hTS : T < S) :
    ContinuousOn (fun t => fourierDecayConstant m (u t)) (Icc (0 : ℝ) T) := by
  unfold fourierDecayConstant
  apply continuousOn_finset_sum
  intro i _
  apply (initial_componentL1_continuousOn_Icc u S hu i T hTS).add
  apply continuousOn_finset_sum
  intro j _
  exact initial_coordinateDerivativeL1_continuousOn_Icc u S hu j m i T hTS

/-- The actual weighted Fourier-decay constant is continuous on every shorter slab. -/
theorem initial_smoothDatumDecayConstant_continuousOn_Icc
    (u : Velocity) (S : ℝ)
    (hu : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ × Vec => u z.1 z.2)
      (initialFrontSpacetime S))
    (s : ℕ) (T : ℝ) (hTS : T < S) :
    ContinuousOn (fun t => smoothDatumDecayConstant s (u t)) (Icc (0 : ℝ) T) := by
  unfold smoothDatumDecayConstant
  exact continuousOn_const.mul
    (initial_fourierDecayConstant_continuousOn_Icc u S hu (2 * (s + 2)) T hTS)

/-- Compactness supplies a uniform Fourier-decay bound from the actual front;
the bound is a conclusion and is not an independent certificate field. -/
theorem initial_front_uniform_decay_constant
    (ν S : ℝ) (a : Field) (u : Velocity) (p : Pressure)
    (H : InitialClassicalFront ν S a u p)
    (s : ℕ) (T : ℝ) (hTS : T < S) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 1 ≤ C ∧ ∀ t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) T,
      smoothDatumDecayConstant s (u t) ≤ C := by
  obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ :=
    (isCompact_Icc : IsCompact (Icc (0 : ℝ) T)).exists_bound_of_continuousOn
      (initial_smoothDatumDecayConstant_continuousOn_Icc u S H.velocity_smooth s T hTS)
  refine ⟨max 1 C, le_max_left _ _, ?_⟩
  intro t ht
  have hCt : |smoothDatumDecayConstant s (u t)| ≤ C := by
    simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs] using hC t ht
  exact (le_abs_self _).trans (hCt.trans (le_max_right _ _))

/-- The actual Fourier Sobolev state of the reference field at an admitted time. -/
def initialFrontSobolev (s : ℕ)
    (ν S : ℝ) (a : Field) (u : Velocity) (p : Pressure)
    (H : InitialClassicalFront ν S a u p)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Ico (0 : ℝ) S) : TorusSobolev s :=
  smoothDatumSobolev s (u t)
    (initial_front_smooth_slices ν S a u p H t ht).smooth
    (initial_front_smooth_slices ν S a u p H t ht).periodic

@[simp]
theorem initialFrontSobolev_coeff (s : ℕ)
    (ν S : ℝ) (a : Field) (u : Velocity) (p : Pressure)
    (H : InitialClassicalFront ν S a u p)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Ico (0 : ℝ) S) :
    (initialFrontSobolev s ν S a u p H t ht).val = datumFourierCoeff (u t) := rfl

/-- Actual physical mean zero supplies the zero mode needed by Galerkin cutoffs. -/
theorem initialFrontSobolev_meanZero (s : ℕ)
    (ν S : ℝ) (a : Field) (u : Velocity) (p : Pressure)
    (H : InitialClassicalFront ν S a u p)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Ico (0 : ℝ) S) :
    SpectralMeanZero (initialFrontSobolev s ν S a u p H t ht).val :=
  smoothSigmaZero_fourier_meanZero (initial_front_smooth_slices ν S a u p H t ht)

/-- Every actual smooth reference front has a uniform H^s bound on each
strictly shorter closed interval. No Fourier-norm continuity is postulated. -/
theorem initial_front_uniform_sobolev_norm
    (ν S : ℝ) (a : Field) (u : Velocity) (p : Pressure)
    (H : InitialClassicalFront ν S a u p)
    (s : ℕ) (T : ℝ) (hTS : T < S) :
    ∃ K : ℝ, 1 ≤ K ∧ ∀ t (ht : t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) T),
      ‖initialFrontSobolev s ν S a u p H t ⟨ht.1, ht.2.trans_lt hTS⟩‖ ≤ K := by
  obtain ⟨C, hC, hbound⟩ := initial_front_uniform_decay_constant ν S a u p H s T hTS
  refine ⟨max 1 (Real.sqrt (3 * latticeSobolevConstant) * C), le_max_left _ _, ?_⟩
  intro t ht
  have hsmooth := initial_front_smooth_slices ν S a u p H t
    ⟨ht.1, ht.2.trans_lt hTS⟩
  change ‖smoothDatumSobolev s (u t) hsmooth.smooth hsmooth.periodic‖ ≤ _
  exact (smoothDatumSobolev_norm_le s (u t) hsmooth.smooth hsmooth.periodic).trans
    ((mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hbound t ht) (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)).trans
      (le_max_right _ _))

/-- The actual projected reference enstrophy is bounded independently of cutoff
by physical Bessel and compactness of the smooth front's physical dissipation. -/
theorem initial_front_uniform_projected_dissipation
    (ν S : ℝ) (a : Field) (u : Velocity) (p : Pressure)
    (H : InitialClassicalFront ν S a u p)
    (T : ℝ) (hTS : T < S) :
    ∃ K : ℝ, 1 ≤ K ∧ ∀ N t (ht : t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) T),
      coefficientDissipation N (datumFourierCoeff (u t)) ≤ K := by
  obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ :=
    (isCompact_Icc : IsCompact (Icc (0 : ℝ) T)).exists_bound_of_continuousOn
      (initial_physicalDissipation_continuousOn_Icc u S H.velocity_smooth T hTS)
  refine ⟨max 1 C, le_max_left _ _, ?_⟩
  intro N t ht
  have hsmooth := initial_front_smooth_slices ν S a u p H t
    ⟨ht.1, ht.2.trans_lt hTS⟩
  have hb : coefficientDissipation N (datumFourierCoeff (u t)) ≤
      physicalDissipation (u t) :=
    coefficientDissipation_initial_cutoff_le N (u t) hsmooth.smooth hsmooth.periodic
  have hCt : |physicalDissipation (u t)| ≤ C := by
    simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs] using hC t ht
  exact hb.trans ((le_abs_self _).trans (hCt.trans (le_max_right _ _)))

/-- The actual projected reference velocity and every coordinate derivative
are bounded uniformly in time, space and cutoff on each shorter closed slab. -/
theorem initial_front_uniform_projected_C1_components
    (ν S : ℝ) (a : Field) (u : Velocity) (p : Pressure)
    (H : InitialClassicalFront ν S a u p)
    (T : ℝ) (hTS : T < S) :
    ∃ B : ℝ, 1 ≤ B ∧ ∀ N t (ht : t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) T) (x : Vec),
      (∀ i : Fin 3, |finiteSynthesis N (datumFourierCoeff (u t)) x i| ≤ B) ∧
      (∀ j i : Fin 3,
        |coordinateDerivative (finiteSynthesis N (datumFourierCoeff (u t))) j x i| ≤ B) := by
  obtain ⟨K, hK, hbound⟩ := initial_front_uniform_sobolev_norm ν S a u p H 3 T hTS
  refine ⟨max 1 (Real.sqrt latticeSobolevConstant * K), le_max_left _ _, ?_⟩
  intro N t ht x
  have h := finiteSynthesis_C1_components_le_H3_norm N
    (initialFrontSobolev 3 ν S a u p H t ⟨ht.1, ht.2.trans_lt hTS⟩) x
  have hb : Real.sqrt latticeSobolevConstant *
      ‖initialFrontSobolev 3 ν S a u p H t ⟨ht.1, ht.2.trans_lt hTS⟩‖ ≤
      max 1 (Real.sqrt latticeSobolevConstant * K) :=
    (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hbound t ht) (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)).trans
      (le_max_right _ _)
  exact ⟨fun i => (h.1 i).trans hb, fun j i => (h.2 j i).trans hb⟩

end
end MethbokeAddon.EhrenfestObstruction
