/-!
The actual H2-to-H1 reference tail, with the canonical positive cutoff N=n+1.
The quantitative tail estimate is reused from SingularClosure.TorusSobolev.
Prepared source only; external cached compilation and audits remain pending.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

open Set SingularClosure
open MethbokeAddon.WeakFouriermanB

namespace MethbokeAddon.EhrenfestObstruction
noncomputable section

/-- The actual high-frequency reference remainder, as an H1 coefficient state. -/
def referenceH1Tail (n : ℕ) (c : TorusSobolev 2) : TorusSobolev 1 :=
  torusSobolevInclusion 1 c -
    torusSobolevCutoff 1 (n + 1) (torusSobolevInclusion 1 c)

/-- One extra Sobolev derivative gives the exact positive-cutoff tail rate. -/
theorem referenceH1Tail_norm_le (n : ℕ) (c : TorusSobolev 2) :
    ‖referenceH1Tail n c‖ ≤ ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)⁻¹ * ‖c‖ :=
  torusSobolevInclusion_tail 1 (n + 1) (Nat.succ_pos n) c

/-- Mean-zero states identify the Sobolev cutoff with the literal Galerkin cutoff. -/
theorem referenceH1Tail_coeff (n : ℕ) (c : TorusSobolev 2)
    (hc : ∀ i : Fin 3, c.val 0 i = 0) :
    (referenceH1Tail n c).val = c.val - cutoffCoeff (n + 1) c.val := by
  have hzero : ∀ i : Fin 3, (torusSobolevInclusion 1 c).val 0 i = 0 := by
    simpa only [torusSobolevInclusion_coeff] using hc
  change (torusSobolevInclusion 1 c).val -
    (torusSobolevCutoff 1 (n + 1) (torusSobolevInclusion 1 c)).val = _
  rw [torusSobolevCutoff_eq_galerkinCutoff 1 (n + 1)
    (torusSobolevInclusion 1 c) hzero, torusSobolevInclusion_coeff]

/-- A uniform H2 bound gives a uniform n-indexed H1 tail bound. -/
theorem referenceH1Tail_norm_le_of_norm_le
    (n : ℕ) (c : TorusSobolev 2) (K : ℝ) (hK : ‖c‖ ≤ K) :
    ‖referenceH1Tail n c‖ ≤ ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)⁻¹ * K := by
  exact (referenceH1Tail_norm_le n c).trans
    (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hK (inv_nonneg.mpr (Nat.cast_nonneg _)))

/-- The reference tail is the literal unprojected-minus-Galerkin coefficient array. -/
theorem initial_front_H1_tail_coeff
    (ν S : ℝ) (a : Field) (u : Velocity) (p : Pressure)
    (H : InitialClassicalFront ν S a u p)
    (n : ℕ) (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Ico (0 : ℝ) S) :
    (referenceH1Tail n (initialFrontSobolev 2 ν S a u p H t ht)).val =
      datumFourierCoeff (u t) - cutoffCoeff (n + 1) (datumFourierCoeff (u t)) := by
  exact referenceH1Tail_coeff n _
    (initialFrontSobolev_meanZero 2 ν S a u p H t ht)

/-- Uniform reference tails are derived from the actual initial classical front. -/
theorem initial_front_uniform_H1_tail
    (ν S : ℝ) (a : Field) (u : Velocity) (p : Pressure)
    (H : InitialClassicalFront ν S a u p)
    (T : ℝ) (hTS : T < S) :
    ∃ K : ℝ, 1 ≤ K ∧ ∀ n t (ht : t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) T),
      ‖referenceH1Tail n
        (initialFrontSobolev 2 ν S a u p H t ⟨ht.1, ht.2.trans_lt hTS⟩)‖ ≤
        ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)⁻¹ * K := by
  obtain ⟨K, hK, hbound⟩ := initial_front_uniform_sobolev_norm ν S a u p H 2 T hTS
  refine ⟨K, hK, ?_⟩
  intro n t ht
  exact referenceH1Tail_norm_le_of_norm_le n _ K (hbound t ht)

end
end MethbokeAddon.EhrenfestObstruction

/-!
# Order equivalences for reciprocal thresholds

All statements are scalar algebra on nonnegative enstrophy values. No time
evolution or PDE premise occurs here.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

namespace MethbokeAddon.EhrenfestObstruction

theorem scalar_reciprocal_denominator_pos
    (eStar e : ℝ) (heStar : 0 < eStar) (he : 0 ≤ e) :
    0 < 1 + e / eStar := by
  have hdiv : 0 ≤ e / eStar := div_nonneg he heStar.le
  linarith

theorem reciprocal_threshold_pos
    (eStar R : ℝ) (heStar : 0 < eStar) (hR : 0 ≤ R) :
    0 < (1 + R / eStar)⁻¹ :=
  inv_pos.mpr (scalar_reciprocal_denominator_pos eStar R heStar hR)

/-- Being below an enstrophy threshold is equivalent to being strictly above
the corresponding reciprocal threshold. -/
theorem reciprocal_threshold_strict_iff
    (eStar e R : ℝ) (heStar : 0 < eStar) (he : 0 ≤ e) (hR : 0 ≤ R) :
    (1 + R / eStar)⁻¹ < (1 + e / eStar)⁻¹ ↔ e < R := by
  rw [inv_lt_inv₀
    (scalar_reciprocal_denominator_pos eStar R heStar hR)
    (scalar_reciprocal_denominator_pos eStar e heStar he)]
  constructor
  · intro h
    have hdiv : e / eStar < R / eStar := by linarith
    exact (div_lt_div_iff_of_pos_right heStar).mp hdiv
  · intro h
    have hdiv := div_lt_div_of_pos_right h heStar
    linarith

/-- A reciprocal value below the reciprocal threshold means the enstrophy
has reached or exceeded the original threshold. -/
theorem reciprocal_threshold_weak_iff
    (eStar e R : ℝ) (heStar : 0 < eStar) (he : 0 ≤ e) (hR : 0 ≤ R) :
    (1 + e / eStar)⁻¹ ≤ (1 + R / eStar)⁻¹ ↔ R ≤ e := by
  rw [inv_le_inv₀
    (scalar_reciprocal_denominator_pos eStar e heStar he)
    (scalar_reciprocal_denominator_pos eStar R heStar hR)]
  constructor
  · intro h
    have hdiv : R / eStar ≤ e / eStar := by linarith
    exact (div_le_div_iff_of_pos_right heStar).mp hdiv
  · intro h
    have hdiv := (div_le_div_iff_of_pos_right heStar).mpr h
    linarith

theorem reciprocal_threshold_eq_iff
    (eStar e R : ℝ) (heStar : 0 < eStar) (he : 0 ≤ e) (hR : 0 ≤ R) :
    (1 + e / eStar)⁻¹ = (1 + R / eStar)⁻¹ ↔ e = R := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    apply le_antisymm
    · exact (reciprocal_threshold_weak_iff eStar R e heStar hR he).mp h.ge
    · exact (reciprocal_threshold_weak_iff eStar e R heStar he hR).mp h.le
  · intro h
    rw [h]

end MethbokeAddon.EhrenfestObstruction

import MethbokeAddon.EhrenfestObstruction.ReciprocalDrift
import MethbokeAddon.EhrenfestObstruction.ReciprocalThreshold

/-!
# Canonical threshold crossing under the literal stopped bound

For a cutoff already above its threshold, time zero is a crossing witness.
Otherwise the scalar hitting theorem supplies an exact hit before 1/gamma.
No uniform initial-enstrophy estimate is needed for this dichotomy.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

open Set

namespace MethbokeAddon.EhrenfestObstruction

theorem canonical_reciprocal_threshold_strict_iff
    (ν : ℝ) (hν : 0 < ν) (a : SmoothDatum)
    (eStar : ℝ) (heStar : 0 < eStar) (n : ℕ) (t R : ℝ) (hR : 0 ≤ R) :
    (1 + R / eStar)⁻¹ < canonicalReciprocal ν hν a eStar n t ↔
      canonicalEnstrophy ν hν a n t < R := by
  change (1 + R / eStar)⁻¹ <
      (1 + canonicalEnstrophy ν hν a n t / eStar)⁻¹ ↔
    canonicalEnstrophy ν hν a n t < R
  exact reciprocal_threshold_strict_iff eStar
    (canonicalEnstrophy ν hν a n t) R heStar
    (canonical_enstrophy_nonneg ν hν a n t) hR

theorem canonical_reciprocal_threshold_weak_iff
    (ν : ℝ) (hν : 0 < ν) (a : SmoothDatum)
    (eStar : ℝ) (heStar : 0 < eStar) (n : ℕ) (t R : ℝ) (hR : 0 ≤ R) :
    canonicalReciprocal ν hν a eStar n t ≤ (1 + R / eStar)⁻¹ ↔
      R ≤ canonicalEnstrophy ν hν a n t := by
  change (1 + canonicalEnstrophy ν hν a n t / eStar)⁻¹ ≤
      (1 + R / eStar)⁻¹ ↔ R ≤ canonicalEnstrophy ν hν a n t
  exact reciprocal_threshold_weak_iff eStar
    (canonicalEnstrophy ν hν a n t) R heStar
    (canonical_enstrophy_nonneg ν hν a n t) hR

theorem canonical_reciprocal_threshold_eq_iff
    (ν : ℝ) (hν : 0 < ν) (a : SmoothDatum)
    (eStar : ℝ) (heStar : 0 < eStar) (n : ℕ) (t R : ℝ) (hR : 0 ≤ R) :
    canonicalReciprocal ν hν a eStar n t = (1 + R / eStar)⁻¹ ↔
      canonicalEnstrophy ν hν a n t = R := by
  change (1 + canonicalEnstrophy ν hν a n t / eStar)⁻¹ =
      (1 + R / eStar)⁻¹ ↔ canonicalEnstrophy ν hν a n t = R
  exact reciprocal_threshold_eq_iff eStar
    (canonicalEnstrophy ν hν a n t) R heStar
    (canonical_enstrophy_nonneg ν hν a n t) hR

/-- If the initial enstrophy is strictly below the positive threshold, the
literal stopped bound produces an exact hit strictly before the horizon. -/
theorem canonical_stopped_exact_threshold_hitting
    (ν : ℝ) (hν : 0 < ν) (a : SmoothDatum)
    (eStar gamma R : ℝ) (n : ℕ)
    (heStar : 0 < eStar) (hgamma : 0 < gamma) (hR : 0 < R)
    (hbelow : canonicalEnstrophy ν hν a n 0 < R)
    (hStopped : ∀ t : ℝ,
      PreHit (canonicalEnstrophy ν hν a n) R (1 / gamma) t →
        canonicalDrift ν hν a eStar n t ≤ -gamma) :
    ∃ t ∈ Ico 0 (1 / gamma), canonicalEnstrophy ν hν a n t = R := by
  let v : ℝ → ℝ := canonicalReciprocal ν hν a eStar n
  let rate : ℝ → ℝ := canonicalDrift ν hν a eStar n
  let r : ℝ := (1 + R / eStar)⁻¹
  have hr : 0 < r := reciprocal_threshold_pos eStar R heStar hR.le
  have hr0 : r < v 0 :=
    (canonical_reciprocal_threshold_strict_iff ν hν a eStar heStar n 0 R hR.le).mpr
      hbelow
  have hv0 : v 0 ≤ 1 :=
    (canonical_reciprocal_bounds ν hν a eStar heStar n 0 le_rfl).2
  have hcont : ContinuousOn v (Icc 0 (1 / gamma)) :=
    canonical_reciprocal_continuousOn_Icc ν hν a eStar heStar n (1 / gamma)
  have hderiv : ∀ t, 0 ≤ t → t < 1 / gamma →
      (∀ s, 0 ≤ s → s ≤ t → r < v s) →
      HasDerivWithinAt v (rate t) (Ici 0) t ∧ rate t ≤ -gamma := by
    intro t ht0 htT hhistory
    have hpre : PreHit (canonicalEnstrophy ν hν a n) R (1 / gamma) t := by
      refine ⟨ht0, htT, ?_⟩
      intro s hs0 hst
      exact (canonical_reciprocal_threshold_strict_iff
        ν hν a eStar heStar n s R hR.le).mp (hhistory s hs0 hst)
    exact ⟨canonical_reciprocal_hasDerivWithinAt
      ν hν a eStar heStar n t ht0, hStopped t hpre⟩
  obtain ⟨t, ht, hvt⟩ :=
    stopped_scalar_hitting v rate gamma r hgamma hr hr0 hv0 hcont hderiv
  have hdeadline : (v 0 - r) / gamma < 1 / gamma :=
    div_lt_div_of_pos_right (by linarith : v 0 - r < 1) hgamma
  refine ⟨t, ⟨ht.1, ht.2.trans_lt hdeadline⟩, ?_⟩
  exact (canonical_reciprocal_threshold_eq_iff
    ν hν a eStar heStar n t R hR.le).mp hvt

/-- Each positive threshold is crossed before the horizon: time zero handles
the case where the initial value is already at or above the threshold. -/
theorem canonical_stopped_threshold_crossing
    (ν : ℝ) (hν : 0 < ν) (a : SmoothDatum)
    (eStar gamma R : ℝ) (n : ℕ)
    (heStar : 0 < eStar) (hgamma : 0 < gamma) (hR : 0 < R)
    (hStopped : ∀ t : ℝ,
      PreHit (canonicalEnstrophy ν hν a n) R (1 / gamma) t →
        canonicalDrift ν hν a eStar n t ≤ -gamma) :
    ∃ t ∈ Ico 0 (1 / gamma), R ≤ canonicalEnstrophy ν hν a n t := by
  by_cases hInitial : R ≤ canonicalEnstrophy ν hν a n 0
  · exact ⟨0, ⟨le_rfl, div_pos zero_lt_one hgamma⟩, hInitial⟩
  · obtain ⟨t, ht, hhit⟩ :=
      canonical_stopped_exact_threshold_hitting ν hν a eStar gamma R n
        heStar hgamma hR (lt_of_not_ge hInitial) hStopped
    exact ⟨t, ht, hhit.ge⟩

/-- The original stopped premise gives threshold-crossing witnesses for every
eventually qualifying cutoff. No initial-enstrophy uniformity premise is added. -/
theorem stopped_threshold_escape
    (ν : ℝ) (hν : 0 < ν) (a : SmoothDatum)
    (eStar gamma : ℝ) (R : ℕ → ℝ)
    (hStopped : StoppedForDatum ν hν a eStar gamma R) :
    ∃ n₀ : ℕ, ∀ n : ℕ, n₀ ≤ n →
      ∃ t ∈ Ico 0 (1 / gamma), R n ≤ canonicalEnstrophy ν hν a n t := by
  rcases hStopped with ⟨heStar, hgamma, hR, _hRtop, n₀, hstop⟩
  refine ⟨n₀, ?_⟩
  intro n hn
  exact canonical_stopped_threshold_crossing ν hν a eStar gamma (R n) n
    heStar hgamma (hR n) (hstop n hn)

end MethbokeAddon.EhrenfestObstruction

import MethbokeAddon.EhrenfestObstruction.StoppedFamily

import Mathlib.Order.Filter.AtTopBot.Basic

/-!
# Finite canonical slab suprema and divergence under stopped drift

Every fixed Galerkin trajectory has continuous enstrophy on a closed
nonnegative time slab. Its real supremum is therefore finite and attained.
The original stopped premise forces these actual suprema to tend to infinity
as the cutoff index tends to infinity.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

open Set Filter SingularClosure

namespace MethbokeAddon.EhrenfestObstruction

theorem canonical_enstrophy_continuousOn_Ici
    (ν : ℝ) (hν : 0 < ν) (a : SmoothDatum) (n : ℕ) :
    ContinuousOn (canonicalEnstrophy ν hν a n) (Ici 0) := by
  intro t ht
  change ContinuousWithinAt
    (fun s : ℝ => coefficientDissipation (n + 1)
      ((canonicalFamily ν hν a n).coeff s) / 2) (Ici 0) t
  exact (((canonicalFamily ν hν a n).coefficientEnstrophy_identity ht).div_const 2).continuousWithinAt

theorem canonical_enstrophy_continuousOn_Icc
    (ν : ℝ) (hν : 0 < ν) (a : SmoothDatum) (n : ℕ) (T : ℝ) :
    ContinuousOn (canonicalEnstrophy ν hν a n) (Icc 0 T) :=
  (canonical_enstrophy_continuousOn_Ici ν hν a n).mono (fun _ ht => ht.1)

/-- The actual closed-slab supremum, not an assumed uniform bound. -/
noncomputable def canonicalSlabEnstrophySup
    (ν : ℝ) (hν : 0 < ν) (a : SmoothDatum) (T : ℝ) (n : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  sSup (canonicalEnstrophy ν hν a n '' Icc 0 T)

/-- Each finite-cutoff enstrophy image is bounded above by compactness. -/
theorem canonical_enstrophy_bddAbove_Icc
    (ν : ℝ) (hν : 0 < ν) (a : SmoothDatum) (n : ℕ) (T : ℝ) :
    BddAbove (canonicalEnstrophy ν hν a n '' Icc 0 T) :=
  isCompact_Icc.bddAbove_image (canonical_enstrophy_continuousOn_Icc ν hν a n T)

/-- On a nonempty slab the real supremum is a value of the actual trajectory. -/
theorem canonical_slab_enstrophy_sup_attained
    (ν : ℝ) (hν : 0 < ν) (a : SmoothDatum) (T : ℝ) (n : ℕ)
    (hT : 0 ≤ T) :
    ∃ t ∈ Icc 0 T,
      canonicalSlabEnstrophySup ν hν a T n = canonicalEnstrophy ν hν a n t := by
  have hnonempty : (Icc (0 : ℝ) T).Nonempty := ⟨0, ⟨le_rfl, hT⟩⟩
  exact isCompact_Icc.exists_sSup_image_eq hnonempty
    (canonical_enstrophy_continuousOn_Icc ν hν a n T)

/-- Every actual slab value is bounded by its genuine conditional supremum. -/
theorem canonical_enstrophy_le_slab_sup
    (ν : ℝ) (hν : 0 < ν) (a : SmoothDatum) (T : ℝ) (n : ℕ)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Icc 0 T) :
    canonicalEnstrophy ν hν a n t ≤ canonicalSlabEnstrophySup ν hν a T n := by
  exact le_csSup (canonical_enstrophy_bddAbove_Icc ν hν a n T)
    (mem_image_of_mem (canonicalEnstrophy ν hν a n) ht)

theorem stopped_threshold_le_slab_sup
    (ν : ℝ) (hν : 0 < ν) (a : SmoothDatum)
    (eStar gamma : ℝ) (R : ℕ → ℝ)
    (hStopped : StoppedForDatum ν hν a eStar gamma R) :
    ∃ n₀ : ℕ, ∀ n : ℕ, n₀ ≤ n →
      R n ≤ canonicalSlabEnstrophySup ν hν a (1 / gamma) n := by
  obtain ⟨n₀, hcross⟩ :=
    stopped_threshold_escape ν hν a eStar gamma R hStopped
  refine ⟨n₀, ?_⟩
  intro n hn
  obtain ⟨t, ht, hRt⟩ := hcross n hn
  exact hRt.trans (canonical_enstrophy_le_slab_sup
    ν hν a (1 / gamma) n t ⟨ht.1, ht.2.le⟩)

/-- The actual finite closed-slab suprema diverge along the canonical cutoffs. -/
theorem stopped_slab_sup_tendsto_atTop
    (ν : ℝ) (hν : 0 < ν) (a : SmoothDatum)
    (eStar gamma : ℝ) (R : ℕ → ℝ)
    (hStopped : StoppedForDatum ν hν a eStar gamma R) :
    Tendsto (fun n => canonicalSlabEnstrophySup ν hν a (1 / gamma) n)
      atTop atTop := by
  obtain ⟨n₀, hsup⟩ :=
    stopped_threshold_le_slab_sup ν hν a eStar gamma R hStopped
  have hRtop : Tendsto R atTop atTop := hStopped.2.2.2.1
  refine tendsto_atTop_atTop.mpr ?_
  intro B
  obtain ⟨nB, hB⟩ := tendsto_atTop_atTop.mp hRtop B
  refine ⟨max n₀ nB, ?_⟩
  intro n hn
  exact (hB n ((le_max_right n₀ nB).trans hn)).trans
    (hsup n ((le_max_left n₀ nB).trans hn))

/-- An explicit pointwise form of divergence, with a witness for every
sufficiently large cutoff and every requested finite level. -/
theorem stopped_eventually_large_enstrophy
    (ν : ℝ) (hν : 0 < ν) (a : SmoothDatum)
    (eStar gamma : ℝ) (R : ℕ → ℝ)
    (hStopped : StoppedForDatum ν hν a eStar gamma R) :
    ∀ B : ℝ, ∃ n₀ : ℕ, ∀ n : ℕ, n₀ ≤ n →
      ∃ t ∈ Icc 0 (1 / gamma), B ≤ canonicalEnstrophy ν hν a n t := by
  intro B
  obtain ⟨n₀, hlarge⟩ := tendsto_atTop_atTop.mp
    (stopped_slab_sup_tendsto_atTop ν hν a eStar gamma R hStopped) B
  refine ⟨n₀, ?_⟩
  intro n hn
  have hgamma : 0 < gamma := hStopped.2.1
  obtain ⟨t, ht, hatt⟩ := canonical_slab_enstrophy_sup_attained
    ν hν a (1 / gamma) n (div_pos zero_lt_one hgamma).le
  refine ⟨t, ht, ?_⟩
  rw [← hatt]
  exact hlarge n hn

end MethbokeAddon.EhrenfestObstruction

import Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.FDeriv.Mul
import Mathlib.Analysis.Complex.Basic
import Mathlib.Tactic.Ring
import Mathlib.Tactic.NormNum

/-!
Pointwise transport--multiplication commutator on actual differentiable
functions. The zero-order coefficient cancels identically. This is the
algebraic core of the operator translation, not an L2 domain, self-adjointness
or unitary-group theorem. Prepared for external verification only.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

namespace MethbokeAddon.EhrenfestObstruction
noncomputable section

variable {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]

/-- Transport plus a zero-order multiplication coefficient. -/
def transportExpression (b : E → E) (z : E → ℂ) (f : E → ℂ) (x : E) : ℂ :=
  fderiv ℝ f x (b x) + z x * f x

/-- The formal Hamiltonian expression with the fixed negative-i convention. -/
def hamiltonianExpression (hbar : ℝ) (b : E → E) (z : E → ℂ)
    (f : E → ℂ) (x : E) : ℂ :=
  -Complex.I * (hbar : ℂ) * transportExpression b z f x

/-- The zeroth-order coefficient cancels from the transport commutator. -/
theorem transport_multiplication_commutator
    (b : E → E) (z g ψ : E → ℂ) (x : E)
    (hg : DifferentiableAt ℝ g x) (hψ : DifferentiableAt ℝ ψ x) :
    transportExpression b z (fun y => g y * ψ y) x -
        g x * transportExpression b z ψ x =
      fderiv ℝ g x (b x) * ψ x := by
  unfold transportExpression
  rw [fderiv_fun_mul hg hψ]
  simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply,
    smul_eq_mul]
  ring

/-- Unnormalized exact commutator of the formal Hamiltonian expression. -/
theorem hamiltonian_multiplication_commutator
    (hbar : ℝ) (b : E → E) (z g ψ : E → ℂ) (x : E)
    (hg : DifferentiableAt ℝ g x) (hψ : DifferentiableAt ℝ ψ x) :
    hamiltonianExpression hbar b z (fun y => g y * ψ y) x -
        g x * hamiltonianExpression hbar b z ψ x =
      -Complex.I * (hbar : ℂ) * (fderiv ℝ g x (b x) * ψ x) := by
  unfold hamiltonianExpression
  calc
    _ = -Complex.I * (hbar : ℂ) *
        (transportExpression b z (fun y => g y * ψ y) x -
          g x * transportExpression b z ψ x) := by ring
    _ = _ := by rw [transport_multiplication_commutator b z g ψ x hg hψ]

/-- Exact pointwise Heisenberg normalization; hbar cancels from the rate. -/
theorem normalized_hamiltonian_commutator
    (hbar : ℝ) (hbar_pos : 0 < hbar)
    (b : E → E) (z g ψ : E → ℂ) (x : E)
    (hg : DifferentiableAt ℝ g x) (hψ : DifferentiableAt ℝ ψ x) :
    (Complex.I / (hbar : ℂ)) *
        (hamiltonianExpression hbar b z (fun y => g y * ψ y) x -
          g x * hamiltonianExpression hbar b z ψ x) =
      fderiv ℝ g x (b x) * ψ x := by
  rw [hamiltonian_multiplication_commutator hbar b z g ψ x hg hψ]
  have hne : (hbar : ℂ) ≠ 0 := Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr (ne_of_gt hbar_pos)
  have hfactor : (Complex.I / (hbar : ℂ)) * (-Complex.I * (hbar : ℂ)) = 1 := by
    simp only [div_eq_mul_inv]
    calc
      _ = -(Complex.I * Complex.I) * ((hbar : ℂ) * (hbar : ℂ)⁻¹) := by ring
      _ = 1 := by rw [Complex.I_mul_I, mul_inv_cancel₀ hne]; norm_num
  rw [← mul_assoc, hfactor, one_mul]

end
end MethbokeAddon.EhrenfestObstruction

-/

set_option autoImplicit false

/-- Real finite synthesis uses only nonzero modes and has actual zero mean. -/
theorem finiteSynthesis_meanZero_of_reality
    (N : ℕ) (c : FourierCoeff) (hreal : SpectralReality c) :
    MeanZero (finiteSynthesis N c) := by
  have hi : IntegrableOn (finiteSynthesis N c) unitCube volume :=
    (finiteSynthesis_contDiff N c).continuous.continuousOn.integrableOn_compact
      isCompact_unitCube
  refine ⟨hi, ?_⟩
  ext j
  change spatialMean (finiteSynthesis N c) j = 0
  have hz : datumFourierCoeff (finiteSynthesis N c) 0 j = 0 := by
    rw [criticalGalerkin_datumFourierCoeff_finiteSynthesis N c hreal]
    simp [cutoffCoeff, cutoffModes_zero_not_mem]
  rw [datumFourierCoeff_zero hi] at hz
  exact_mod_cast hz

/-- Direct finite-field specialization of the arbitrary physical nonlinear
absorption theorem, with both quadratic integrals converted by Parseval. -/
theorem FINITE_ERROR_ABSORPTION_FROM_PHYSICAL :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ ν : ℝ, 0 < ν → ∀ N : ℕ,
      ∀ c : FourierCoeff,
      (∀ k : Frequency, k ∉ cutoffModes N → ∀ i : Fin 3, c k i = 0) →
      SpectralReality c → SpectralSolenoidal c →
      -2 * coefficientEnstrophyNonlinearPower N c ≤
        ν * coefficientLaplacianSquare N c +
          C / ν ^ 3 * (coefficientDissipation N c) ^ 3 := by
  obtain ⟨C, hC, hbound⟩ := WeakFouriermanB.PHYSICAL_NONLINEAR_ABSORPTION
  refine ⟨C, hC, ?_⟩
  intro ν hν N c hsupp hreal hsol
  have h := hbound ν hν (finiteSynthesis N c)
    (finiteSynthesis_contDiff N c) (finiteSynthesis_periodic N c)
    (finiteSynthesis_meanZero_of_reality N c hreal)
  rw [WeakFouriermanB.physicalLaplacianSquare,
    finite_laplacian_integral_norm_sq N c hreal,
    physicalDissipation, FINITE_PHYSICAL_REAL_ENSTROPHY_PARSEVAL N c hreal] at h
  rw [coefficientEnstrophyNonlinearPower_eq_physical N c hsupp hreal hsol]
  linarith

theorem dissipationRatePairing_cutoff_right
    (N : ℕ) (c f : FourierCoeff) :
    dissipationRatePairing N c (cutoffCoeff N f) =
      dissipationRatePairing N c f := by
  unfold dissipationRatePairing
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro k hk
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i hi
  rw [cutoffCoeff_apply_of_mem f hk i]

/-- A solenoidal test coefficient removes the actual modewise Leray map. -/
theorem dissipationRatePairing_leray_right
    (N : ℕ) (c f : FourierCoeff) (hsol : SpectralSolenoidal c) :
    dissipationRatePairing N c (fun k => coefficientLeray k (f k)) =
      dissipationRatePairing N c f := by
  unfold dissipationRatePairing
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro k hk
  simp_rw [← mul_assoc]
  rw [← Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.mul_sum,
    ← physical_complex_re_sum, ← physical_complex_re_sum,
    coefficientLeray_pairing k (c k) (f k) (hsol k)]

/-- The exact physical power of a forcing field, with the Laplacian sign. -/
theorem dissipationRatePairing_fourier_eq_physical
    (N : ℕ) (c : FourierCoeff) (F : Field) (hF : Continuous F) :
    dissipationRatePairing N c (datumFourierCoeff F) =
      -2 * (∫ x in unitCube,
        inner ℝ (laplacian (finiteSynthesis N c) x) (F x)) := by
  rw [finiteSynthesis_laplacian,
    integral_finiteSynthesis_pairing N (laplacianCoefficient c) F hF]
  unfold dissipationRatePairing
  simp only [Finset.mul_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro k hk
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i hi
  have hscalar (r : ℝ) (z w : ℂ) :
      r * (2 * (star z * w).re) = -2 * (star (-(r : ℂ) * z) * w).re := by
    simp [Complex.star_def, Complex.mul_re, Complex.mul_im] <;> ring
  exact hscalar (laplacianFrequency k) (c k i) (datumFourierCoeff F k i)

/-- Pointwise Young inequality with its exact coefficient; no square roots. -/
theorem physical_inner_young (δ : ℝ) (hδ : 0 < δ) (a b : Vec) :
    -2 * inner ℝ a b ≤ δ * ‖a‖ ^ 2 + ‖b‖ ^ 2 / δ := by
  have hsq : 0 ≤ inner ℝ (δ • a + b) (δ • a + b) :=
    real_inner_self_nonneg
  rw [real_inner_add_add_self] at hsq
  simp only [real_inner_smul_left, real_inner_smul_right] at hsq
  simp only [real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq] at hsq
  have hdiv : (‖b‖ ^ 2 / δ) * δ = ‖b‖ ^ 2 :=
    div_mul_cancel₀ _ hδ.ne'
  apply (mul_le_mul_iff_right₀ hδ).mp
  nlinarith

/-- Integrating Young gives literal L2 forcing control on the physical cube. -/
theorem physical_integral_inner_young
    (δ : ℝ) (hδ : 0 < δ) (a b : Field)
    (ha : Continuous a) (hb : Continuous b) :
    -2 * (∫ x in unitCube, inner ℝ (a x) (b x)) ≤
      δ * (∫ x in unitCube, ‖a x‖ ^ 2) +
        (∫ x in unitCube, ‖b x‖ ^ 2) / δ := by
  have hi : IntegrableOn (fun x => inner ℝ (a x) (b x)) unitCube volume :=
    (ha.inner hb).continuousOn.integrableOn_compact isCompact_unitCube
  have ha2 : IntegrableOn (fun x => ‖a x‖ ^ 2) unitCube volume :=
    (ha.norm.pow 2).continuousOn.integrableOn_compact isCompact_unitCube
  have hb2 : IntegrableOn (fun x => ‖b x‖ ^ 2) unitCube volume :=
    (hb.norm.pow 2).continuousOn.integrableOn_compact isCompact_unitCube
  calc
    _ = ∫ x in unitCube, -2 * inner ℝ (a x) (b x) :=
      (integral_const_mul _ _).symm
    _ ≤ ∫ x in unitCube, δ * ‖a x‖ ^ 2 + ‖b x‖ ^ 2 / δ :=
      integral_mono (hi.const_mul (-2))
        ((ha2.const_mul δ).add (hb2.div_const δ))
        (fun x => physical_inner_young δ hδ (a x) (b x))
    _ = _ := by
      rw [integral_add (ha2.const_mul δ) (hb2.div_const δ),
        integral_const_mul, integral_div]

/-- Projected physical forcing costs its own L2 square and an arbitrarily
chosen positive share of the error's Laplacian square. -/
theorem dissipationRatePairing_projected_forcing_le
    (δ : ℝ) (hδ : 0 < δ) (N : ℕ) (c : FourierCoeff)
    (hreal : SpectralReality c) (hsol : SpectralSolenoidal c)
    (F : Field) (hF : Continuous F) :
    dissipationRatePairing N c
        (cutoffCoeff N (fun k => coefficientLeray k (datumFourierCoeff F k))) ≤
      δ * coefficientLaplacianSquare N c +
        (∫ x in unitCube, ‖F x‖ ^ 2) / δ := by
  rw [dissipationRatePairing_cutoff_right,
    dissipationRatePairing_leray_right N c _ hsol,
    dissipationRatePairing_fourier_eq_physical N c F hF]
  have h := physical_integral_inner_young δ hδ
    (laplacian (finiteSynthesis N c)) F
    (laplacian_contDiff _ (finiteSynthesis_contDiff N c)).continuous hF
  rw [finite_laplacian_integral_norm_sq N c hreal] at h
  exact h

/-- The physical forced H1 estimate leaves half the viscous term available.
The equation is literal, and the only inhomogeneous term in the bound is the
actual L2 square of its physical forcing field. -/
theorem PHYSICAL_FORCED_ERROR_ENSTROPHY_INEQUALITY :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ ν : ℝ, 0 < ν → ∀ N : ℕ,
      ∀ c : ℝ → FourierCoeff, ∀ F : Field, Continuous F →
      ∀ s : Set ℝ, ∀ t : ℝ,
      (∀ k : Frequency, k ∉ cutoffModes N → ∀ i : Fin 3, c t k i = 0) →
      SpectralReality (c t) → SpectralSolenoidal (c t) →
      (∀ k ∈ cutoffModes N, ∀ i : Fin 3,
        HasDerivWithinAt (fun r => c r k i)
          (galerkinRhs ν N (c t) k i +
            cutoffCoeff N
              (fun l => coefficientLeray l (datumFourierCoeff F l)) k i) s t) →
      ∃ d : ℝ,
        HasDerivWithinAt (fun r => coefficientDissipation N (c r)) d s t ∧
        d + (ν / 2) * coefficientLaplacianSquare N (c t) ≤
          C / ν ^ 3 * (coefficientDissipation N (c t)) ^ 3 +
            (2 / ν) * (∫ x in unitCube, ‖F x‖ ^ 2) := by
  obtain ⟨C, hC, hbound⟩ := FINITE_ERROR_ABSORPTION_FROM_PHYSICAL
  refine ⟨C, hC, ?_⟩
  intro ν hν N c F hF s t hsupp hreal hsol heq
  let f : FourierCoeff :=
    cutoffCoeff N (fun k => coefficientLeray k (datumFourierCoeff F k))
  refine ⟨(-2 * ν) * coefficientLaplacianSquare N (c t) -
    2 * coefficientEnstrophyNonlinearPower N (c t) +
    dissipationRatePairing N (c t) f,
    forced_coefficient_dissipation_identity ν N c f heq, ?_⟩
  have hself := hbound ν hν N (c t) hsupp hreal hsol
  have hforce := dissipationRatePairing_projected_forcing_le
    (ν / 2) (by positivity) N (c t) hreal hsol F hF
  change dissipationRatePairing N (c t) f ≤
    (ν / 2) * coefficientLaplacianSquare N (c t) +
      (∫ x in unitCube, ‖F x‖ ^ 2) / (ν / 2) at hforce
  have hdiv : (∫ x in unitCube, ‖F x‖ ^ 2) / (ν / 2) =
      (2 / ν) * (∫ x in unitCube, ‖F x‖ ^ 2) := by
    field_simp [hν.ne'] <;> ring
  rw [hdiv] at hforce
  linarith

end

/-!
Guarded scalar bootstrap for the actual Galerkin error estimate.

The derivative estimate is required only while the nonnegative error is at
most one. A strict exponential comparison fence proves this guard on the
whole slab, after which the signed Gronwall theorem sharpens the estimate.
The guard is a conclusion, never an input trajectory bound.

Prepared candidate for cached external verification only. No local Lean
execution has been performed.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

open Set Filter
open scoped Topology

namespace MethbokeAddon.EhrenfestObstruction

noncomputable section

/-- A cubic error term is linear below the unit threshold. -/
theorem cubic_le_self_of_mem_unit_interval
    {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 ≤ x) (hx1 : x ≤ 1) : x ^ 3 ≤ x := by
  have hsq : x ^ 2 ≤ x := by
    nlinarith [mul_nonneg hx (sub_nonneg.mpr hx1)]
  have hcube : x ^ 3 ≤ x ^ 2 := by
    nlinarith [mul_nonneg hx (sub_nonneg.mpr hsq)]
  exact hcube.trans hsq

/-- The explicit fence has derivative `(2*C+1)` times its value. -/
theorem small_forcing_fence_hasDerivAt (C epsilon t : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => 2 * epsilon * Real.exp ((2 * C + 1) * s))
      ((2 * C + 1) * (2 * epsilon * Real.exp ((2 * C + 1) * t))) t := by
  have harg : HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => (2 * C + 1) * s) (2 * C + 1) t :=
    hasDerivAt_const_mul (2 * C + 1)
  have hfence := harg.exp.const_mul (2 * epsilon)
  have hrate :
      2 * epsilon * (Real.exp ((2 * C + 1) * t) * (2 * C + 1)) =
        (2 * C + 1) * (2 * epsilon * Real.exp ((2 * C + 1) * t)) := by
    ring
  rw [hrate] at hfence
  -- Default transparency identifies the real normed-module instances.
  convert! hfence using 1

/-- A small positive forcing gives a global fence on the chosen compact
slab from a derivative inequality that is only assumed below one.

The stronger, convenient smallness test is sufficient for every forcing
sequence tending to zero on a fixed slab; it avoids constructing a first
exit time. No derivative at the right endpoint is required.
-/
theorem guarded_cubic_small_forcing_bound
    {D d : ℝ → ℝ} {C epsilon T : ℝ}
    (hC : 0 ≤ C) (hepsilon : 0 < epsilon)
    (hsmall : 2 * epsilon * Real.exp ((2 * C + 1) * T) ≤ 1)
    (hD : ContinuousOn D (Icc 0 T))
    (hinit : D 0 ≤ 0)
    (hderiv : ∀ t ∈ Ico 0 T, HasDerivWithinAt D (d t) (Ici 0) t)
    (hguard : ∀ t ∈ Ico 0 T, D t ≤ 1 →
      d t ≤ C * (D t + (D t) ^ 3) + epsilon) :
    ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T,
      D t ≤ 2 * epsilon * Real.exp ((2 * C + 1) * t) ∧ D t ≤ 1 := by
  let B : ℝ → ℝ := fun t => 2 * epsilon * Real.exp ((2 * C + 1) * t)
  have hK : 0 ≤ 2 * C + 1 := by linarith
  have hBpos (t : ℝ) : 0 < B t := by
    dsimp [B]
    positivity
  have hBupper : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T, B t ≤ 1 := by
    intro t ht
    apply le_trans _ hsmall
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
      (Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ht.2 hK))
      (by positivity : 0 ≤ 2 * epsilon)
  have hBlower : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T, 2 * epsilon ≤ B t := by
    intro t ht
    have hexp : 1 ≤ Real.exp ((2 * C + 1) * t) := by
      simpa only [Real.exp_zero] using
        (Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (mul_nonneg hK ht.1))
    simpa only [mul_one] using
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hexp (by positivity : 0 ≤ 2 * epsilon))
  have hfence : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T, D t ≤ B t := by
    intro t ht
    refine image_le_of_deriv_right_lt_deriv_boundary
      (f' := d) (B := B) (B' := fun r => (2 * C + 1) * B r)
      hD ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ht
    · intro r hr
      exact (hderiv r hr).mono (fun s hs => hr.1.trans hs)
    · exact hinit.trans (hBpos 0).le
    · intro r
      exact small_forcing_fence_hasDerivAt C epsilon r
    · intro r hr heq
      have hrcc : r ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) T := ⟨hr.1, hr.2.le⟩
      have hunit : D r ≤ 1 := by
        rw [heq]
        exact hBupper r hrcc
      have hnonneg : 0 ≤ D r := by
        rw [heq]
        exact (hBpos r).le
      have hcube := cubic_le_self_of_mem_unit_interval hnonneg hunit
      have hlinear : C * (D r + (D r) ^ 3) ≤ 2 * C * D r := by
        nlinarith [mul_nonneg hC (sub_nonneg.mpr hcube)]
      have hrate := hguard r hr hunit
      have hlower := hBlower r hrcc
      rw [heq] at hlinear hrate
      nlinarith
  intro t ht
  exact ⟨hfence t ht, (hfence t ht).trans (hBupper t ht)⟩

/-- Once the guarded estimate closes, the signed Gronwall inequality gives
the usual sharp linear comparison. This bounds the derivative above and
does not incorrectly assume a bound on its absolute value.
-/
theorem guarded_cubic_small_forcing_gronwall
    {D d : ℝ → ℝ} {C epsilon T : ℝ}
    (hC : 0 ≤ C) (hepsilon : 0 < epsilon)
    (hsmall : 2 * epsilon * Real.exp ((2 * C + 1) * T) ≤ 1)
    (hD : ContinuousOn D (Icc 0 T))
    (hnonneg : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T, 0 ≤ D t)
    (hinit : D 0 ≤ 0)
    (hderiv : ∀ t ∈ Ico 0 T, HasDerivWithinAt D (d t) (Ici 0) t)
    (hguard : ∀ t ∈ Ico 0 T, D t ≤ 1 →
      d t ≤ C * (D t + (D t) ^ 3) + epsilon) :
    ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T, D t ≤ gronwallBound 0 (2 * C) epsilon t := by
  have hfence := guarded_cubic_small_forcing_bound
    hC hepsilon hsmall hD hinit hderiv hguard
  have hlinear : ∀ t ∈ Ico 0 T, d t ≤ (2 * C) * D t + epsilon := by
    intro t ht
    have htcc : t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) T := ⟨ht.1, ht.2.le⟩
    have hunit := (hfence t htcc).2
    have hcube := cubic_le_self_of_mem_unit_interval (hnonneg t htcc) hunit
    have hrate := hguard t ht hunit
    nlinarith [mul_nonneg hC (sub_nonneg.mpr hcube)]
  have hg := le_gronwallBound_of_liminf_deriv_right_le hD
    (fun t ht _r hr =>
      ((hderiv t ht).mono (fun s hs => ht.1.trans hs)).liminf_right_slope_le hr)
    hinit hlinear
  intro t ht
  simpa only [sub_zero] using hg t ht

/-- On a fixed slab every positive forcing sequence converging to zero
eventually satisfies the explicit smallness test. Thus the cutoff-uniform
unit error bound follows from the differential estimate itself.
-/
theorem eventually_guarded_cubic_unit_bound
    {D d : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ} {epsilon : ℕ → ℝ} {C T : ℝ}
    (hC : 0 ≤ C)
    (hepsilon : ∀ᶠ n in atTop, 0 < epsilon n)
    (hlim : Tendsto epsilon atTop (𝓝 0))
    (hD : ∀ n, ContinuousOn (D n) (Icc 0 T))
    (hinit : ∀ n, D n 0 ≤ 0)
    (hderiv : ∀ n, ∀ t ∈ Ico 0 T,
      HasDerivWithinAt (D n) (d n t) (Ici 0) t)
    (hguard : ∀ n, ∀ t ∈ Ico 0 T, D n t ≤ 1 →
      d n t ≤ C * (D n t + (D n t) ^ 3) + epsilon n) :
    ∀ᶠ n in atTop, ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T, D n t ≤ 1 := by
  have hscaled : Tendsto
      (fun n => 2 * epsilon n * Real.exp ((2 * C + 1) * T))
      atTop (𝓝 (0 : ℝ)) := by
    simpa only [mul_zero, zero_mul] using
      (hlim.const_mul 2).mul_const (Real.exp ((2 * C + 1) * T))
  have hsmall : ∀ᶠ n in atTop,
      2 * epsilon n * Real.exp ((2 * C + 1) * T) < 1 :=
    hscaled.eventually (Iio_mem_nhds (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 1))
  filter_upwards [hepsilon, hsmall] with n hpos hnsmall
  intro t ht
  exact (guarded_cubic_small_forcing_bound hC hpos hnsmall.le
    (hD n) (hinit n) (hderiv n) (hguard n) t ht).2

/-- Interior derivative version of the guarded bootstrap. Continuity and
the strictly positive fence at zero provide a starting point `a` with
`0 < a ≤ t` where `D a < B a`. The comparison on `[a,t]` therefore uses
only derivatives strictly inside the original slab, with no limit of
initial-time derivatives and no first-exit construction.
-/
theorem guarded_cubic_small_forcing_bound_interior
    {D d : ℝ → ℝ} {C epsilon T : ℝ}
    (hC : 0 ≤ C) (hepsilon : 0 < epsilon)
    (hsmall : 2 * epsilon * Real.exp ((2 * C + 1) * T) ≤ 1)
    (hD : ContinuousOn D (Icc 0 T))
    (hinit : D 0 ≤ 0)
    (hderiv : ∀ t ∈ Ioo 0 T, HasDerivAt D (d t) t)
    (hguard : ∀ t ∈ Ioo 0 T, D t ≤ 1 →
      d t ≤ C * (D t + (D t) ^ 3) + epsilon) :
    ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T,
      D t ≤ 2 * epsilon * Real.exp ((2 * C + 1) * t) ∧ D t ≤ 1 := by
  let B : ℝ → ℝ := fun t => 2 * epsilon * Real.exp ((2 * C + 1) * t)
  have hK : 0 ≤ 2 * C + 1 := by linarith
  have hBpos (t : ℝ) : 0 < B t := by
    dsimp [B]
    positivity
  have hBcont : Continuous B := by
    dsimp [B]
    fun_prop
  have hBupper : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T, B t ≤ 1 := by
    intro t ht
    apply le_trans _ hsmall
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
      (Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ht.2 hK))
      (by positivity : 0 ≤ 2 * epsilon)
  have hBlower : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T, 2 * epsilon ≤ B t := by
    intro t ht
    have hexp : 1 ≤ Real.exp ((2 * C + 1) * t) := by
      simpa only [Real.exp_zero] using
        (Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (mul_nonneg hK ht.1))
    simpa only [mul_one] using
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hexp (by positivity : 0 ≤ 2 * epsilon))
  have hfence : ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T, D t ≤ B t := by
    intro t ht
    by_cases ht0 : t = 0
    · subst t
      exact hinit.trans (hBpos 0).le
    have htpos : 0 < t := lt_of_le_of_ne ht.1 (Ne.symm ht0)
    have hTpos : 0 < T := htpos.trans_le ht.2
    have hpair : ContinuousOn (fun s => (D s, B s)) (Icc 0 T) :=
      hD.prodMk hBcont.continuousOn
    have hnear : ∀ᶠ s in 𝓝[Icc 0 T] (0 : ℝ), D s < B s :=
      hpair 0 ⟨le_rfl, hTpos.le⟩
        (IsOpen.mem_nhds (isOpen_lt continuous_fst continuous_snd)
          (hinit.trans_lt (hBpos 0)))
    have hnearGT : ∀ᶠ s in 𝓝[>] (0 : ℝ), D s < B s :=
      nhdsWithin_le_of_mem (Icc_mem_nhdsGT_of_mem ⟨le_rfl, hTpos⟩) hnear
    obtain ⟨a, haD, ha⟩ := (hnearGT.and (Ioc_mem_nhdsGT htpos)).exists
    refine image_le_of_deriv_right_lt_deriv_boundary
      (f' := d) (B := B) (B' := fun r => (2 * C + 1) * B r)
      (hD.mono (fun s hs => ⟨ha.1.le.trans hs.1, hs.2.trans ht.2⟩))
      ?_ haD.le ?_ ?_ ⟨ha.2, le_rfl⟩
    · intro r hr
      exact (hderiv r ⟨ha.1.trans_le hr.1, hr.2.trans_le ht.2⟩).hasDerivWithinAt
    · intro r
      exact small_forcing_fence_hasDerivAt C epsilon r
    · intro r hr heq
      have hrio : r ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) T :=
        ⟨ha.1.trans_le hr.1, hr.2.trans_le ht.2⟩
      have hrcc : r ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) T := ⟨hrio.1.le, hrio.2.le⟩
      have hunit : D r ≤ 1 := by
        rw [heq]
        exact hBupper r hrcc
      have hnonneg : 0 ≤ D r := by
        rw [heq]
        exact (hBpos r).le
      have hcube := cubic_le_self_of_mem_unit_interval hnonneg hunit
      have hlinear : C * (D r + (D r) ^ 3) ≤ 2 * C * D r := by
        nlinarith [mul_nonneg hC (sub_nonneg.mpr hcube)]
      have hrate := hguard r hrio hunit
      have hlower := hBlower r hrcc
      rw [heq] at hlinear hrate
      nlinarith
  intro t ht
  exact ⟨hfence t ht, (hfence t ht).trans (hBupper t ht)⟩

/-- The eventual unit bound needed by E09, requiring only actual interior
time derivatives and closed-slab continuity of each error trajectory.
-/
theorem eventually_guarded_cubic_unit_bound_interior
    {D d : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ} {epsilon : ℕ → ℝ} {C T : ℝ}
    (hC : 0 ≤ C)
    (hepsilon : ∀ᶠ n in atTop, 0 < epsilon n)
    (hlim : Tendsto epsilon atTop (𝓝 0))
    (hD : ∀ n, ContinuousOn (D n) (Icc 0 T))
    (hinit : ∀ n, D n 0 ≤ 0)
    (hderiv : ∀ n, ∀ t ∈ Ioo 0 T, HasDerivAt (D n) (d n t) t)
    (hguard : ∀ n, ∀ t ∈ Ioo 0 T, D n t ≤ 1 →
      d n t ≤ C * (D n t + (D n t) ^ 3) + epsilon n) :
    ∀ᶠ n in atTop, ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T, D n t ≤ 1 := by
  have hscaled : Tendsto
      (fun n => 2 * epsilon n * Real.exp ((2 * C + 1) * T))
      atTop (𝓝 (0 : ℝ)) := by
    simpa only [mul_zero, zero_mul] using
      (hlim.const_mul 2).mul_const (Real.exp ((2 * C + 1) * T))
  have hsmall : ∀ᶠ n in atTop,
      2 * epsilon n * Real.exp ((2 * C + 1) * T) < 1 :=
    hscaled.eventually (Iio_mem_nhds (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 1))
  filter_upwards [hepsilon, hsmall] with n hpos hnsmall
  intro t ht
  exact (guarded_cubic_small_forcing_bound_interior hC hpos hnsmall.le
    (hD n) (hinit n) (hderiv n) (hguard n) t ht).2

end

end MethbokeAddon.EhrenfestObstruction

import MethbokeAddon.EhrenfestObstruction.PhysicalForcing

/-!
Literal transport cross terms and their cutoff-independent L2 bounds.
These estimates use C1 bounds of a given smooth reference field and the
physical finite Parseval identities for the error field.

Prepared source: external cached compiler and axiom audit are still required.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

open Set MeasureTheory SingularClosure
open scoped BigOperators ContDiff RealInnerProductSpace

namespace MethbokeAddon.EhrenfestObstruction

noncomputable section

/-- The literal bilinear transport `(a · ∇) b`. -/
def physicalTransport (a b : Field) : Field :=
  fun x => fderiv ℝ b x (a x)

theorem physicalTransport_continuous (a b : Field)
    (ha : Continuous a) (hb : ContDiff ℝ ∞ b) :
    Continuous (physicalTransport a b) :=
  (hb.continuous_fderiv (by simp)).clm_apply ha

theorem physicalTransport_norm_le (a b : Field) (x : Vec) :
    ‖physicalTransport a b x‖ ≤ ‖fderiv ℝ b x‖ * ‖a x‖ :=
  ContinuousLinearMap.le_opNorm _ _

/-- Exact quadratic expansion of the actual physical convection operator. -/
theorem convection_add_eq_transport
    (w v : Field) (hw : ContDiff ℝ ∞ w) (hv : ContDiff ℝ ∞ v) :
    convection (w + v) =
      convection w + physicalTransport v w + physicalTransport w v + convection v := by
  funext x
  have hwx := hw.differentiable (by norm_num) x
  have hvx := hv.differentiable (by norm_num) x
  change fderiv ℝ (w + v) x (w x + v x) =
    fderiv ℝ w x (w x) + fderiv ℝ w x (v x) +
      fderiv ℝ v x (w x) + fderiv ℝ v x (v x)
  rw [fderiv_add hwx hvx, ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, map_add, map_add]
  abel

/-- The true truncation residual in the error equation. -/
def physicalReferenceResidual (U v r : Field) : Field :=
  fun x => physicalTransport r U x + physicalTransport v r x

/-- The residual sign follows directly from the literal differential operator. -/
theorem physicalReferenceResidual_eq_convection_sub
    (U v : Field) (hU : ContDiff ℝ ∞ U) (hv : ContDiff ℝ ∞ v) :
    physicalReferenceResidual U v (U - v) = convection U - convection v := by
  funext x
  have hUx := hU.differentiable (by norm_num) x
  have hvx := hv.differentiable (by norm_num) x
  change fderiv ℝ U x (U x - v x) + fderiv ℝ (U - v) x (v x) =
    fderiv ℝ U x (U x) - fderiv ℝ v x (v x)
  rw [fderiv_sub hUx hvx, map_sub, ContinuousLinearMap.sub_apply]
  abel

theorem physicalReferenceResidual_continuous (U v r : Field)
    (hU : ContDiff ℝ ∞ U) (hv : Continuous v) (hr : ContDiff ℝ ∞ r) :
    Continuous (physicalReferenceResidual U v r) :=
  (physicalTransport_continuous r U hr.continuous hU).add
    (physicalTransport_continuous v r hv hr)

theorem norm_add_sq_le_two (a b : Vec) :
    ‖a + b‖ ^ 2 ≤ 2 * (‖a‖ ^ 2 + ‖b‖ ^ 2) := by
  have hs := (sq_le_sq₀ (norm_nonneg (a + b))
    (add_nonneg (norm_nonneg a) (norm_nonneg b))).mpr (norm_add_le a b)
  nlinarith [sq_nonneg (‖a‖ - ‖b‖)]

theorem physicalReferenceResidual_norm_sq_le
    (M : ℝ) (hM : 0 ≤ M) (U v r : Field) (x : Vec)
    (hDU : ‖fderiv ℝ U x‖ ≤ M) (hv : ‖v x‖ ≤ M) :
    ‖physicalReferenceResidual U v r x‖ ^ 2 ≤
      (2 * M ^ 2) * ‖r x‖ ^ 2 +
        (6 * M ^ 2) * gradientSquareDensity r x := by
  have hru : ‖physicalTransport r U x‖ ≤ M * ‖r x‖ :=
    (physicalTransport_norm_le r U x).trans
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hDU (norm_nonneg _))
  have hvr : ‖physicalTransport v r x‖ ≤ ‖fderiv ℝ r x‖ * M :=
    (physicalTransport_norm_le v r x).trans
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hv (norm_nonneg _))
  have hru2 : ‖physicalTransport r U x‖ ^ 2 ≤ M ^ 2 * ‖r x‖ ^ 2 := by
    calc
      _ ≤ (M * ‖r x‖) ^ 2 :=
        (sq_le_sq₀ (norm_nonneg _) (mul_nonneg hM (norm_nonneg _))).mpr hru
      _ = _ := by ring
  have hvr2 : ‖physicalTransport v r x‖ ^ 2 ≤
      M ^ 2 * (3 * gradientSquareDensity r x) := by
    calc
      _ ≤ (‖fderiv ℝ r x‖ * M) ^ 2 :=
        (sq_le_sq₀ (norm_nonneg _) (mul_nonneg (norm_nonneg _) hM)).mpr hvr
      _ = M ^ 2 * ‖fderiv ℝ r x‖ ^ 2 := by ring
      _ ≤ _ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
        (fderiv_norm_sq_le_three_gradientSquareDensity r x) (sq_nonneg M)
  have h := norm_add_sq_le_two (physicalTransport r U x) (physicalTransport v r x)
  change ‖physicalTransport r U x + physicalTransport v r x‖ ^ 2 ≤ _
  nlinarith

/-- The truncation residual is controlled by the actual physical H1 tail. -/
theorem physicalReferenceResidual_l2_le
    (M : ℝ) (hM : 0 ≤ M) (U v r : Field)
    (hU : ContDiff ℝ ∞ U) (hv : Continuous v) (hr : ContDiff ℝ ∞ r)
    (hDUM : ∀ x ∈ unitCube, ‖fderiv ℝ U x‖ ≤ M)
    (hvM : ∀ x ∈ unitCube, ‖v x‖ ≤ M) :
    (∫ x in unitCube, ‖physicalReferenceResidual U v r x‖ ^ 2) ≤
      (6 * M ^ 2) * ((∫ x in unitCube, ‖r x‖ ^ 2) + physicalDissipation r) := by
  have hR := physicalReferenceResidual_continuous U v r hU hv hr
  have hiR : IntegrableOn (fun x => ‖physicalReferenceResidual U v r x‖ ^ 2)
      unitCube volume :=
    (hR.norm.pow 2).continuousOn.integrableOn_compact isCompact_unitCube
  have hiE : IntegrableOn (fun x => ‖r x‖ ^ 2) unitCube volume :=
    (hr.continuous.norm.pow 2).continuousOn.integrableOn_compact isCompact_unitCube
  have hiD := gradientSquareDensity_integrableOn hr
  have hE : 0 ≤ ∫ x in unitCube, ‖r x‖ ^ 2 :=
    integral_nonneg (fun _ => sq_nonneg _)
  calc
    _ ≤ ∫ x in unitCube,
        (2 * M ^ 2) * ‖r x‖ ^ 2 + (6 * M ^ 2) * gradientSquareDensity r x := by
      apply integral_mono_ae hiR
        ((hiE.const_mul (2 * M ^ 2)).add (hiD.const_mul (6 * M ^ 2)))
      filter_upwards [ae_restrict_mem isCompact_unitCube.measurableSet] with x hx
      exact physicalReferenceResidual_norm_sq_le M hM U v r x (hDUM x hx) (hvM x hx)
    _ = (2 * M ^ 2) * (∫ x in unitCube, ‖r x‖ ^ 2) +
        (6 * M ^ 2) * physicalDissipation r := by
      rw [integral_add (hiE.const_mul (2 * M ^ 2)) (hiD.const_mul (6 * M ^ 2)),
        integral_const_mul, integral_const_mul, physicalDissipation]
    _ ≤ _ := by nlinarith [mul_nonneg (sq_nonneg M) hE]

theorem norm_sub_sub_sq_le_three (a b c : Vec) :
    ‖a - b - c‖ ^ 2 ≤ 3 * (‖a‖ ^ 2 + ‖b‖ ^ 2 + ‖c‖ ^ 2) := by
  have hn : ‖a - b - c‖ ≤ ‖a‖ + ‖b‖ + ‖c‖ :=
    (norm_sub_le (a - b) c).trans (add_le_add (norm_sub_le a b) (le_refl ‖c‖))
  have hs := (sq_le_sq₀ (norm_nonneg (a - b - c))
    (add_nonneg (add_nonneg (norm_nonneg a) (norm_nonneg b))
      (norm_nonneg c))).mpr hn
  nlinarith [sq_nonneg (‖a‖ - ‖b‖), sq_nonneg (‖a‖ - ‖c‖),
    sq_nonneg (‖b‖ - ‖c‖)]

/-- Residual plus the two reference/error transport terms. -/
def physicalErrorForcing (v w R : Field) : Field :=
  fun x => R x - physicalTransport v w x - physicalTransport w v x

theorem physicalErrorForcing_continuous (v w R : Field)
    (hv : ContDiff ℝ ∞ v) (hw : ContDiff ℝ ∞ w) (hR : Continuous R) :
    Continuous (physicalErrorForcing v w R) :=
  (hR.sub (physicalTransport_continuous v w hv.continuous hw)).sub
    (physicalTransport_continuous w v hw.continuous hv)

/-- A pointwise estimate separating the residual from the reference C1
constant and the actual error gradient and energy densities. -/
theorem physicalErrorForcing_norm_sq_le
    (M : ℝ) (hM : 0 ≤ M) (v w R : Field) (x : Vec)
    (hv : ‖v x‖ ≤ M) (hDv : ‖fderiv ℝ v x‖ ≤ M) :
    ‖physicalErrorForcing v w R x‖ ^ 2 ≤
      3 * ‖R x‖ ^ 2 + (9 * M ^ 2) * gradientSquareDensity w x +
        (3 * M ^ 2) * ‖w x‖ ^ 2 := by
  have hvw : ‖physicalTransport v w x‖ ≤ ‖fderiv ℝ w x‖ * M :=
    (physicalTransport_norm_le v w x).trans
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hv (norm_nonneg _))
  have hwv : ‖physicalTransport w v x‖ ≤ M * ‖w x‖ :=
    (physicalTransport_norm_le w v x).trans
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hDv (norm_nonneg _))
  have hvw2 : ‖physicalTransport v w x‖ ^ 2 ≤
      M ^ 2 * (3 * gradientSquareDensity w x) := by
    calc
      _ ≤ (‖fderiv ℝ w x‖ * M) ^ 2 :=
        (sq_le_sq₀ (norm_nonneg _) (mul_nonneg (norm_nonneg _) hM)).mpr hvw
      _ = M ^ 2 * ‖fderiv ℝ w x‖ ^ 2 := by ring
      _ ≤ _ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
        (fderiv_norm_sq_le_three_gradientSquareDensity w x) (sq_nonneg M)
  have hwv2 : ‖physicalTransport w v x‖ ^ 2 ≤ M ^ 2 * ‖w x‖ ^ 2 := by
    calc
      _ ≤ (M * ‖w x‖) ^ 2 :=
        (sq_le_sq₀ (norm_nonneg _) (mul_nonneg hM (norm_nonneg _))).mpr hwv
      _ = _ := by ring
  have h := norm_sub_sub_sq_le_three (R x)
    (physicalTransport v w x) (physicalTransport w v x)
  change ‖R x - physicalTransport v w x - physicalTransport w v x‖ ^ 2 ≤ _
  nlinarith

/-- Both cross terms are controlled by the finite error's H1 square, with a
constant independent of the cutoff. No derivative of the error is assumed
small in a supremum norm. -/
theorem finite_physicalErrorForcing_l2_le
    (M : ℝ) (hM : 0 ≤ M) (N : ℕ) (c : FourierCoeff)
    (hreal : SpectralReality c) (v R : Field)
    (hv : ContDiff ℝ ∞ v) (hR : Continuous R)
    (hvM : ∀ x ∈ unitCube, ‖v x‖ ≤ M)
    (hDvM : ∀ x ∈ unitCube, ‖fderiv ℝ v x‖ ≤ M) :
    (∫ x in unitCube, ‖physicalErrorForcing v (finiteSynthesis N c) R x‖ ^ 2) ≤
      3 * (∫ x in unitCube, ‖R x‖ ^ 2) +
        (12 * M ^ 2) * coefficientDissipation N c := by
  have hw := finiteSynthesis_contDiff N c
  have hF := physicalErrorForcing_continuous v (finiteSynthesis N c) R hv hw hR
  have hiF : IntegrableOn
      (fun x => ‖physicalErrorForcing v (finiteSynthesis N c) R x‖ ^ 2)
      unitCube volume :=
    (hF.norm.pow 2).continuousOn.integrableOn_compact isCompact_unitCube
  have hiR : IntegrableOn (fun x => ‖R x‖ ^ 2) unitCube volume :=
    (hR.norm.pow 2).continuousOn.integrableOn_compact isCompact_unitCube
  have hiD := gradientSquareDensity_integrableOn hw
  have hiE : IntegrableOn (fun x => ‖finiteSynthesis N c x‖ ^ 2)
      unitCube volume :=
    (hw.continuous.norm.pow 2).continuousOn.integrableOn_compact isCompact_unitCube
  have hE : (∫ x in unitCube, ‖finiteSynthesis N c x‖ ^ 2) =
      coefficientEnergy N c := by
    rw [← physicalEnergy_eq_integral_norm_sq, FINITE_PHYSICAL_ENERGY_PARSEVAL N c hreal]
  have hEP := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
    (coefficientEnergy_le_dissipation N c) (by positivity : 0 ≤ 3 * M ^ 2)
  calc
    _ ≤ ∫ x in unitCube,
        3 * ‖R x‖ ^ 2 + (9 * M ^ 2) * gradientSquareDensity (finiteSynthesis N c) x +
          (3 * M ^ 2) * ‖finiteSynthesis N c x‖ ^ 2 := by
      apply integral_mono_ae hiF
        (((hiR.const_mul 3).add (hiD.const_mul (9 * M ^ 2))).add
          (hiE.const_mul (3 * M ^ 2)))
      filter_upwards [ae_restrict_mem isCompact_unitCube.measurableSet] with x hx
      exact physicalErrorForcing_norm_sq_le M hM v (finiteSynthesis N c) R x
        (hvM x hx) (hDvM x hx)
    _ = 3 * (∫ x in unitCube, ‖R x‖ ^ 2) +
        (9 * M ^ 2) * coefficientDissipation N c +
          (3 * M ^ 2) * coefficientEnergy N c := by
      have hsum12 :
          (∫ x in unitCube, 3 * ‖R x‖ ^ 2 +
            (9 * M ^ 2) * gradientSquareDensity (finiteSynthesis N c) x) =
          (∫ x in unitCube, 3 * ‖R x‖ ^ 2) +
            ∫ x in unitCube, (9 * M ^ 2) * gradientSquareDensity (finiteSynthesis N c) x :=
        integral_add
          (f := fun x : Vec => 3 * ‖R x‖ ^ 2)
          (g := fun x : Vec => (9 * M ^ 2) * gradientSquareDensity (finiteSynthesis N c) x)
          (hiR.const_mul 3) (hiD.const_mul (9 * M ^ 2))
      have hsum123 :
          (∫ x in unitCube, 3 * ‖R x‖ ^ 2 +
            (9 * M ^ 2) * gradientSquareDensity (finiteSynthesis N c) x +
              (3 * M ^ 2) * ‖finiteSynthesis N c x‖ ^ 2) =
          (∫ x in unitCube, 3 * ‖R x‖ ^ 2 +
            (9 * M ^ 2) * gradientSquareDensity (finiteSynthesis N c) x) +
            ∫ x in unitCube, (3 * M ^ 2) * ‖finiteSynthesis N c x‖ ^ 2 :=
        integral_add
          (f := fun x : Vec => 3 * ‖R x‖ ^ 2 +
            (9 * M ^ 2) * gradientSquareDensity (finiteSynthesis N c) x)
          (g := fun x : Vec => (3 * M ^ 2) * ‖finiteSynthesis N c x‖ ^ 2)
          ((hiR.const_mul 3).add (hiD.const_mul (9 * M ^ 2)))
          (hiE.const_mul (3 * M ^ 2))
      rw [hsum123, hsum12,
        integral_const_mul, integral_const_mul, integral_const_mul,
        FINITE_PHYSICAL_REAL_ENSTROPHY_PARSEVAL N c hreal, hE]
    _ ≤ _ := by linarith

/-- The forced error obeys the cubic differential inequality with explicit
reference and residual terms. The universal self-interaction constant is
independent of the cutoff and of the reference field. -/
theorem FINITE_ERROR_CROSS_ENSTROPHY_INEQUALITY :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ ν : ℝ, 0 < ν → ∀ M : ℝ, 0 ≤ M →
      ∀ N : ℕ, ∀ c : ℝ → FourierCoeff, ∀ v R : Field,
      ContDiff ℝ ∞ v → Continuous R →
      (∀ x ∈ unitCube, ‖v x‖ ≤ M) →
      (∀ x ∈ unitCube, ‖fderiv ℝ v x‖ ≤ M) →
      ∀ s : Set ℝ, ∀ t : ℝ,
      (∀ k : Frequency, k ∉ cutoffModes N → ∀ i : Fin 3, c t k i = 0) →
      SpectralReality (c t) → SpectralSolenoidal (c t) →
      (∀ k ∈ cutoffModes N, ∀ i : Fin 3,
        HasDerivWithinAt (fun r => c r k i)
          (galerkinRhs ν N (c t) k i +
            cutoffCoeff N (fun l => coefficientLeray l
              (datumFourierCoeff
                (physicalErrorForcing v (finiteSynthesis N (c t)) R) l)) k i) s t) →
      ∃ d : ℝ,
        HasDerivWithinAt (fun r => coefficientDissipation N (c r)) d s t ∧
        d ≤ C / ν ^ 3 * (coefficientDissipation N (c t)) ^ 3 +
          (24 * M ^ 2 / ν) * coefficientDissipation N (c t) +
            (6 / ν) * (∫ x in unitCube, ‖R x‖ ^ 2) := by
  obtain ⟨C, hC, hbound⟩ := PHYSICAL_FORCED_ERROR_ENSTROPHY_INEQUALITY
  refine ⟨C, hC, ?_⟩
  intro ν hν M hM N c v R hv hR hvM hDvM s t hsupp hreal hsol heq
  have hF := physicalErrorForcing_continuous v (finiteSynthesis N (c t)) R
    hv (finiteSynthesis_contDiff N (c t)) hR
  obtain ⟨d, hd, hineq⟩ := hbound ν hν N c
    (physicalErrorForcing v (finiteSynthesis N (c t)) R) hF
    s t hsupp hreal hsol heq
  refine ⟨d, hd, ?_⟩
  have hforce := finite_physicalErrorForcing_l2_le M hM N (c t)
    hreal v R hv hR hvM hDvM
  have hscaled := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hforce (by positivity : 0 ≤ 2 / ν)
  calc
    d ≤ d + (ν / 2) * coefficientLaplacianSquare N (c t) :=
      le_add_of_nonneg_right
        (mul_nonneg (by positivity) (coefficientLaplacianSquare_nonneg N (c t)))
    _ ≤ _ := hineq
    _ ≤ C / ν ^ 3 * (coefficientDissipation N (c t)) ^ 3 +
        (2 / ν) * (3 * (∫ x in unitCube, ‖R x‖ ^ 2) +
          (12 * M ^ 2) * coefficientDissipation N (c t)) :=
      add_le_add (le_refl _) hscaled
    _ = _ := by ring

end

/-!
Time differentiation of the literal physical Fourier integrals on an actual
initial classical front. Interior differentiation and closed-slab continuity
are proved separately so that no boundary differentiation certificate is used.
Source-prepared only; external cached verification is still required.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

open Set Filter MeasureTheory Metric SingularClosure
open MethbokeAddon.WeakFouriermanB
open scoped BigOperators ContDiff Topology

namespace MethbokeAddon.EhrenfestObstruction
noncomputable section

private theorem reference_mem_of_half_ball {S t r : ℝ}
    (ht : t ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) S)
    (hr : r ∈ closedBall t (min t (S - t) / 2)) :
    r ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) S := by
  have hh : |r - t| ≤ min t (S - t) / 2 := by
    simpa only [Metric.mem_closedBall, Real.dist_eq] using hr
  have hleft := min_le_left t (S - t)
  have hright := min_le_right t (S - t)
  have hl := (abs_le.mp hh).1
  have hu := (abs_le.mp hh).2
  constructor <;> linarith [ht.1, ht.2]

/-- Complex-valued version of the actual finite-front cube differentiation lemma. -/
theorem local_hasDerivAt_complex_cube_integral
    (S : ℝ) (F D : ℝ → Vec → ℂ)
    (hF : ContinuousOn (fun z : ℝ × Vec => F z.1 z.2) (localFrontSpacetime S))
    (hD : ContinuousOn (fun z : ℝ × Vec => D z.1 z.2) (localFrontSpacetime S))
    (hd : ∀ t ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) S, ∀ x : Vec,
      HasDerivAt (fun r => F r x) (D t x) t)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) S) :
    HasDerivAt (fun r => ∫ x in unitCube, F r x)
      (∫ x in unitCube, D t x) t := by
  let ρ : ℝ := min t (S - t) / 2
  have hρ : 0 < ρ := div_pos (lt_min ht.1 (sub_pos.mpr ht.2)) (by norm_num)
  have hFc (r : ℝ) (hr : r ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) S) : Continuous (F r) :=
    hF.comp_continuous (continuous_const.prodMk continuous_id) (fun _ => hr)
  have hDc (r : ℝ) (hr : r ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) S) : Continuous (D r) :=
    hD.comp_continuous (continuous_const.prodMk continuous_id) (fun _ => hr)
  have hsubset : closedBall t ρ ×ˢ unitCube ⊆ localFrontSpacetime S := by
    intro z hz
    exact reference_mem_of_half_ball ht hz.1
  obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ :=
    ((isCompact_closedBall t ρ).prod isCompact_unitCube).exists_bound_of_continuousOn
      (hD.mono hsubset)
  have hbound : ∀ᵐ x ∂volume.restrict unitCube,
      ∀ r ∈ closedBall t ρ, ‖D r x‖ ≤ C := by
    filter_upwards [ae_restrict_mem isCompact_unitCube.measurableSet] with x hx
    intro r hr
    exact hC (r, x) ⟨hr, hx⟩
  have hdiff : ∀ᵐ x ∂volume.restrict unitCube,
      ∀ r ∈ closedBall t ρ, HasDerivAt (fun q => F q x) (D r x) r :=
    Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun x r hr => hd r (reference_mem_of_half_ball ht hr) x
  have hmeas : ∀ᶠ r in 𝓝 t, AEStronglyMeasurable (F r) (volume.restrict unitCube) := by
    filter_upwards [Ioo_mem_nhds ht.1 ht.2] with r hr
    exact (hFc r hr).aestronglyMeasurable
  exact (hasDerivAt_integral_of_dominated_loc_of_deriv_le
    (μ := volume.restrict unitCube) (F := F) (F' := D)
    (bound := fun _ : Vec => C) (closedBall_mem_nhds t hρ) hmeas
    ((hFc t ht).continuousOn.integrableOn_compact isCompact_unitCube)
    (hDc t ht).aestronglyMeasurable hbound
    (continuous_const.continuousOn.integrableOn_compact isCompact_unitCube) hdiff).2

/-- Dominated complex integration also preserves continuity at time zero. -/
theorem initial_complex_cube_integral_continuousOn_Icc
    (S : ℝ) (F : ℝ → Vec → ℂ)
    (hF : ContinuousOn (fun z : ℝ × Vec => F z.1 z.2) (initialFrontSpacetime S))
    (T : ℝ) (hTS : T < S) :
    ContinuousOn (fun r => ∫ x in unitCube, F r x) (Icc (0 : ℝ) T) := by
  have hsubset : Icc (0 : ℝ) T ×ˢ unitCube ⊆ initialFrontSpacetime S := by
    intro z hz
    exact ⟨hz.1.1, hz.1.2.trans_lt hTS⟩
  obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ :=
    ((isCompact_Icc : IsCompact (Icc (0 : ℝ) T)).prod isCompact_unitCube).exists_bound_of_continuousOn
      (hF.mono hsubset)
  apply continuousOn_of_dominated (μ := volume.restrict unitCube)
    (bound := fun _ : Vec => C)
  · intro r hr
    have hc : Continuous (F r) :=
      hF.comp_continuous (continuous_const.prodMk continuous_id)
        (fun _ => ⟨hr.1, hr.2.trans_lt hTS⟩)
    exact hc.aestronglyMeasurable
  · intro r hr
    filter_upwards [ae_restrict_mem isCompact_unitCube.measurableSet] with x hx
    exact hC (r, x) ⟨hr, hx⟩
  · exact continuous_const.continuousOn.integrableOn_compact isCompact_unitCube
  · filter_upwards with x
    exact hF.comp (continuous_id.prodMk continuous_const).continuousOn
      (fun r hr => ⟨hr.1, hr.2.trans_lt hTS⟩)

/-- A fixed Fourier character preserves joint continuity of the actual integrand. -/
theorem datumFourierIntegrand_continuousOn_spacetime
    (u : Velocity) (s : Set (ℝ × Vec))
    (hu : ContinuousOn (fun z : ℝ × Vec => u z.1 z.2) s)
    (k : Frequency) (i : Fin 3) :
    ContinuousOn (fun z : ℝ × Vec => datumFourierIntegrand (u z.1) k i z.2) s := by
  exact (((fourierCharacter_contDiff k).continuous.star.comp continuous_snd).continuousOn).mul
    (Complex.continuous_ofReal.comp_continuousOn
      ((EuclideanSpace.proj i : Vec →L[ℝ] ℝ).continuous.comp_continuousOn hu))

/-- The time derivative passes through each literal physical Fourier integral. -/
theorem local_datumFourierCoeff_hasDerivAt
    (u : Velocity) (S : ℝ)
    (hu : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ × Vec => u z.1 z.2) (localFrontSpacetime S))
    (k : Frequency) (i : Fin 3) (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) S) :
    HasDerivAt (fun r => datumFourierCoeff (u r) k i)
      (datumFourierCoeff (timeDerivative u t) k i) t := by
  apply local_hasDerivAt_complex_cube_integral S
    (fun r x => datumFourierIntegrand (u r) k i x)
    (fun r x => datumFourierIntegrand (timeDerivative u r) k i x)
  · exact datumFourierIntegrand_continuousOn_spacetime u _ hu.continuousOn k i
  · exact datumFourierIntegrand_continuousOn_spacetime (timeDerivative u) _
      (local_timeDerivative_continuousOn u S hu) k i
  · intro r hr x
    have hc := (EuclideanSpace.proj i : Vec →L[ℝ] ℝ).hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt r
      (local_time_hasDerivAt u S hu r hr x)
    have hz := Complex.ofRealCLM.hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt r hc
    exact hz.const_mul (star (fourierCharacter k x))
  · exact ht

/-- An admitted initial classical front supplies the interior coefficient derivative. -/
theorem initial_front_datumFourierCoeff_hasDerivAt
    (ν S : ℝ) (a : Field) (u : Velocity) (p : Pressure)
    (H : InitialClassicalFront ν S a u p)
    (k : Frequency) (i : Fin 3) (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) S) :
    HasDerivAt (fun r => datumFourierCoeff (u r) k i)
      (datumFourierCoeff (timeDerivative u t) k i) t :=
  local_datumFourierCoeff_hasDerivAt u S
    (H.velocity_smooth.mono (fun z hz => ⟨hz.1.le, hz.2⟩)) k i t ht

/-- The actual reference coefficient curve is continuous on each shorter closed slab. -/
theorem initial_front_datumFourierCoeff_continuousOn_Icc
    (ν S : ℝ) (a : Field) (u : Velocity) (p : Pressure)
    (H : InitialClassicalFront ν S a u p)
    (k : Frequency) (i : Fin 3) (T : ℝ) (hTS : T < S) :
    ContinuousOn (fun t => datumFourierCoeff (u t) k i) (Icc (0 : ℝ) T) :=
  initial_complex_cube_integral_continuousOn_Icc S
    (fun t x => datumFourierIntegrand (u t) k i x)
    (datumFourierIntegrand_continuousOn_spacetime u _ H.velocity_smooth.continuousOn k i)
    T hTS

/-- Differentiating the actual Fourier divergence constraint proves tangency
of the physical time derivative; it is not an independent spectral premise. -/
theorem initial_front_timeDerivative_fourier_solenoidal
    (ν S : ℝ) (a : Field) (u : Velocity) (p : Pressure)
    (H : InitialClassicalFront ν S a u p)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) S) :
    SpectralSolenoidal (datumFourierCoeff (timeDerivative u t)) := by
  intro k
  have hj (j : Fin 3) :=
    (initial_front_datumFourierCoeff_hasDerivAt ν S a u p H k j t ht).const_mul (k j : ℂ)
  have hsum : HasDerivAt
      (fun r => ∑ j : Fin 3, (k j : ℂ) * datumFourierCoeff (u r) k j)
      (∑ j : Fin 3, (k j : ℂ) * datumFourierCoeff (timeDerivative u t) k j) t := by
    simpa only [Fin.sum_univ_three, Pi.add_apply] using! ((hj 0).add (hj 1)).add (hj 2)
  have hzero : HasDerivAt (fun _ : ℝ => (0 : ℂ))
      (∑ j : Fin 3, (k j : ℂ) * datumFourierCoeff (timeDerivative u t) k j) t := by
    apply hsum.congr_of_eventuallyEq
    filter_upwards [isOpen_Ioo.mem_nhds ht] with r hr
    exact (smoothSigmaZero_fourier_solenoidal
      (initial_front_smooth_slices ν S a u p H r ⟨hr.1.le, hr.2⟩) k).symm
  exact hzero.unique (hasDerivAt_const t (0 : ℂ))

/-- Leray fixes the actual Fourier transform of the physical time derivative. -/
theorem initial_front_timeDerivative_fourier_leray
    (ν S : ℝ) (a : Field) (u : Velocity) (p : Pressure)
    (H : InitialClassicalFront ν S a u p)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) S) (k : Frequency) :
    coefficientLeray k (datumFourierCoeff (timeDerivative u t) k) =
      datumFourierCoeff (timeDerivative u t) k :=
  coefficientLeray_eq_of_solenoidal k _
    (initial_front_timeDerivative_fourier_solenoidal ν S a u p H t ht k)

end
end MethbokeAddon.EhrenfestObstruction

/-!
# The actual physical reference tail

The physical L2 energy and physical gradient energy of the literal remainder
U - P_N U are bounded by its actual H1 coefficient norm. The harmless factor
12 comes from separate bounds on three velocity and nine gradient components.
No physical remainder-bound premise is introduced.

Prepared source only; matching external cached compilation and audits required.
No local Lean/Lake/kernel execution was used.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

open Set MeasureTheory SingularClosure

noncomputable section

/-- An actual H0 state bounds the full square sum of any one component. -/
theorem torusSobolev_H0_component_tsum_norm_sq_le
    (c : TorusSobolev 0) (i : Fin 3) :
    (∑' k : Frequency, ‖c.val k i‖ ^ 2) ≤ ‖c‖ ^ 2 := by
  apply tsum_le_of_sum_le' (sq_nonneg ‖c‖)
  intro s
  have h := torusSobolev_finite_weighted_sum_le 0 c
    (s.product ({i} : Finset (Fin 3)))
  have hproduct :
      (∑ ki ∈ s.product ({i} : Finset (Fin 3)),
        ‖sobolevWeightedCoeff 0 c.val ki‖ ^ 2) =
      ∑ k ∈ s, ∑ j ∈ ({i} : Finset (Fin 3)),
        ‖sobolevWeightedCoeff 0 c.val (k, j)‖ ^ 2 :=
    Finset.sum_product s ({i} : Finset (Fin 3))
      (fun ki : FourierIndex => ‖sobolevWeightedCoeff 0 c.val ki‖ ^ 2)
  rw [hproduct] at h
  simpa only [Finset.sum_singleton, torusSobolev_weightedCoeff_norm,
    pow_zero, one_mul] using h

/-- Smooth physical scalar Parseval, stated for the original physical field. -/
theorem smooth_periodic_component_parseval
    (v : Field) (hv : ContDiff ℝ ∞ v) (hp : SpatialPeriodic v) (i : Fin 3) :
    (∫ x in unitCube, (v x i) ^ 2) =
      ∑' k : Frequency, ‖datumFourierCoeff v k i‖ ^ 2 := by
  have hr := ALL_SOBOLEV_IMP_RAPID_SCALAR (datumFourierCoeff v)
    (fun s => SMOOTH_DATUM_MEM_TORUS_SOBOLEV s v hv hp)
  have h := critical_smoothFourierSynthesis_component_parseval
    (datumFourierCoeff v) hr (datumFourierCoeff_reality v) i
  simpa only [smoothFourierSynthesis_datum_eq v hv hp,
    Complex.normSq_eq_norm_sq] using h

/-- The actual physical energy is controlled by the actual H0 coefficient state. -/
theorem smooth_periodic_physicalEnergy_le_H0_norm_sq
    (v : Field) (hv : ContDiff ℝ ∞ v) (hp : SpatialPeriodic v)
    (c : TorusSobolev 0) (hc : c.val = datumFourierCoeff v) :
    physicalEnergy v ≤ 3 * ‖c‖ ^ 2 := by
  have hcomponent (i : Fin 3) : (∫ x in unitCube, (v x i) ^ 2) ≤ ‖c‖ ^ 2 := by
    rw [smooth_periodic_component_parseval v hv hp i, ← hc]
    exact torusSobolev_H0_component_tsum_norm_sq_le c i
  unfold physicalEnergy
  rw [integral_finsetSum Finset.univ
    (f := fun i x => (v x i) ^ 2) (μ := volume.restrict unitCube)
    (fun i _ => (((EuclideanSpace.proj i : Vec →L[ℝ] ℝ).continuous.comp
      hv.continuous).pow 2).continuousOn.integrableOn_compact isCompact_unitCube)]
  calc
    _ ≤ ∑ _i : Fin 3, ‖c‖ ^ 2 := Finset.sum_le_sum (fun i _ => hcomponent i)
    _ = _ := by simp [Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul]

/-- One-order inclusion controls the actual physical velocity energy. -/
theorem smooth_periodic_physicalEnergy_le_H1_norm_sq
    (v : Field) (hv : ContDiff ℝ ∞ v) (hp : SpatialPeriodic v)
    (c : TorusSobolev 1) (hc : c.val = datumFourierCoeff v) :
    physicalEnergy v ≤ 3 * ‖c‖ ^ 2 := by
  have hcoeff : (torusSobolevInclusionLinear 0 c).val = datumFourierCoeff v := by
    rw [torusSobolevInclusionLinear_coeff, hc]
  have h := smooth_periodic_physicalEnergy_le_H0_norm_sq v hv hp
    (torusSobolevInclusionLinear 0 c) hcoeff
  exact h.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
    (pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) (torusSobolevInclusion_norm_le 0 c) 2)
    (by norm_num))

/-- The actual derivative multiplier controls the physical gradient energy. -/
theorem smooth_periodic_physicalDissipation_le_H1_norm_sq
    (v : Field) (hv : ContDiff ℝ ∞ v) (hp : SpatialPeriodic v)
    (c : TorusSobolev 1) (hc : c.val = datumFourierCoeff v) :
    physicalDissipation v ≤ 9 * ‖c‖ ^ 2 := by
  have hcoordinate (j : Fin 3) :
      physicalEnergy (coordinateDerivative v j) ≤ 3 * ‖c‖ ^ 2 := by
    have hd : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (coordinateDerivative v j) :=
      (contDiff_infty_iff_fderiv.mp hv).2.clm_apply contDiff_const
    have hdp : SpatialPeriodic (coordinateDerivative v j) :=
      coordinateDerivative_spatialPeriodic j v hp
    have hcoeff : (ehrenfestTorusSobolevCoordinateDerivative 0 j c).val =
        datumFourierCoeff (coordinateDerivative v j) := by
      rw [ehrenfestTorusSobolevCoordinateDerivative_coeff, hc,
        datumFourierCoeff_coordinateDerivative j v hv hp]
    have h := smooth_periodic_physicalEnergy_le_H0_norm_sq
      (coordinateDerivative v j) hd hdp
      (ehrenfestTorusSobolevCoordinateDerivative 0 j c) hcoeff
    exact h.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
      (pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _)
        (ehrenfestTorusSobolevCoordinateDerivative_norm_le 0 j c) 2)
      (by norm_num))
  rw [physicalDissipation, integral_gradientSquareDensity_eq_sum_physicalEnergy v hv]
  calc
    _ ≤ ∑ _j : Fin 3, 3 * ‖c‖ ^ 2 :=
      Finset.sum_le_sum (fun j _ => hcoordinate j)
    _ = _ := by simp [Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul]; ring

/-- A physical H1 bound proved from coefficient identification and scalar Parseval. -/
theorem smooth_periodic_physical_H1_le_torusSobolev
    (v : Field) (hv : ContDiff ℝ ∞ v) (hp : SpatialPeriodic v)
    (c : TorusSobolev 1) (hc : c.val = datumFourierCoeff v) :
    (∫ x in unitCube, ‖v x‖ ^ 2) + physicalDissipation v ≤ 12 * ‖c‖ ^ 2 := by
  have hE := smooth_periodic_physicalEnergy_le_H1_norm_sq v hv hp c hc
  have hD := smooth_periodic_physicalDissipation_le_H1_norm_sq v hv hp c hc
  rw [physicalEnergy_eq_integral_norm_sq] at hE
  linarith

/-- Actual physical Fourier integration commutes with field subtraction. -/
theorem ehrenfest_datumFourierCoeff_sub (a b : Field)
    (ha : Continuous a) (hb : Continuous b) :
    datumFourierCoeff (a - b) = datumFourierCoeff a - datumFourierCoeff b := by
  funext k i
  unfold datumFourierCoeff datumFourierIntegrand
  simp only [Pi.sub_apply, PiLp.sub_apply, Complex.ofReal_sub, mul_sub]
  exact integral_sub (datumFourierIntegrand_integrableOn ha k i)
    (datumFourierIntegrand_integrableOn hb k i)

/-- Literal physical remainder after the original nonzero Fourier cutoff. -/
def physicalReferenceTail (N : ℕ) (v : Field) : Field :=
  v - finiteSynthesis N (datumFourierCoeff v)

theorem physicalReferenceTail_smooth (N : ℕ) (v : Field)
    (hv : ContDiff ℝ ∞ v) : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (physicalReferenceTail N v) :=
  hv.sub (finiteSynthesis_contDiff N (datumFourierCoeff v))

theorem physicalReferenceTail_periodic (N : ℕ) (v : Field)
    (hp : SpatialPeriodic v) : SpatialPeriodic (physicalReferenceTail N v) := by
  intro x j
  change v (x + unitVector j) -
      finiteSynthesis N (datumFourierCoeff v) (x + unitVector j) =
    v x - finiteSynthesis N (datumFourierCoeff v) x
  rw [hp x j, finiteSynthesis_periodic N (datumFourierCoeff v) x j]

theorem physicalReferenceTail_coeff (N : ℕ) (v : Field) (hv : Continuous v) :
    datumFourierCoeff (physicalReferenceTail N v) =
      datumFourierCoeff v - cutoffCoeff N (datumFourierCoeff v) := by
  rw [physicalReferenceTail, ehrenfest_datumFourierCoeff_sub v
    (finiteSynthesis N (datumFourierCoeff v)) hv
      (finiteSynthesis_contDiff N (datumFourierCoeff v)).continuous,
    criticalGalerkin_datumFourierCoeff_finiteSynthesis N (datumFourierCoeff v)
      (datumFourierCoeff_reality v)]

/-- The actual physical remainder is bounded by the concrete H1 tail state. -/
theorem physicalReferenceTail_physical_H1_le
    (n : ℕ) (v : Field) (hv : ContDiff ℝ ∞ v) (hp : SpatialPeriodic v)
    (c : TorusSobolev 2) (hc : c.val = datumFourierCoeff v)
    (hz : ∀ i : Fin 3, c.val 0 i = 0) :
    (∫ x in unitCube, ‖physicalReferenceTail (n + 1) v x‖ ^ 2) +
      physicalDissipation (physicalReferenceTail (n + 1) v) ≤
        12 * ‖referenceH1Tail n c‖ ^ 2 := by
  apply smooth_periodic_physical_H1_le_torusSobolev
    (physicalReferenceTail (n + 1) v)
    (physicalReferenceTail_smooth (n + 1) v hv)
    (physicalReferenceTail_periodic (n + 1) v hp) (referenceH1Tail n c)
  rw [referenceH1Tail_coeff n c hz, hc,
    physicalReferenceTail_coeff (n + 1) v hv.continuous]

/-- Physical L2-plus-gradient decay at the actual positive Fourier cutoff. -/
theorem physicalReferenceTail_physical_H1_le_rate
    (n : ℕ) (v : Field) (hv : ContDiff ℝ ∞ v) (hp : SpatialPeriodic v)
    (c : TorusSobolev 2) (hc : c.val = datumFourierCoeff v)
    (hz : ∀ i : Fin 3, c.val 0 i = 0) :
    (∫ x in unitCube, ‖physicalReferenceTail (n + 1) v x‖ ^ 2) +
      physicalDissipation (physicalReferenceTail (n + 1) v) ≤
        12 * (((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)⁻¹ * ‖c‖) ^ 2 := by
  exact (physicalReferenceTail_physical_H1_le n v hv hp c hc hz).trans
    (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
      (pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) (referenceH1Tail_norm_le n c) 2)
      (by norm_num))

/-- The coefficient state in the physical estimate can be constructed directly from v. -/
theorem smoothDatum_physicalReferenceTail_physical_H1_le_rate
    (n : ℕ) (v : Field) (hv : ContDiff ℝ ∞ v) (hp : SpatialPeriodic v)
    (hz : SpectralMeanZero (datumFourierCoeff v)) :
    (∫ x in unitCube, ‖physicalReferenceTail (n + 1) v x‖ ^ 2) +
      physicalDissipation (physicalReferenceTail (n + 1) v) ≤
        12 * (((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)⁻¹ * ‖smoothDatumSobolev 2 v hv hp‖) ^ 2 :=
  physicalReferenceTail_physical_H1_le_rate n v hv hp
    (smoothDatumSobolev 2 v hv hp) (smoothDatumSobolev_coeff 2 v hv hp) hz

/-- Uniform physical reference-tail decay on every strictly shorter closed slab. -/
theorem initial_front_uniform_physical_H1_tail
    (ν S : ℝ) (a : Field) (u : Velocity) (p : Pressure)
    (H : InitialClassicalFront ν S a u p)
    (T : ℝ) (hTS : T < S) :
    ∃ K : ℝ, 1 ≤ K ∧ ∀ n t (ht : t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) T),
      (∫ x in unitCube, ‖physicalReferenceTail (n + 1) (u t) x‖ ^ 2) +
        physicalDissipation (physicalReferenceTail (n + 1) (u t)) ≤
          12 * (((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)⁻¹ * K) ^ 2 := by
  obtain ⟨K, hK, hbound⟩ := initial_front_uniform_sobolev_norm ν S a u p H 2 T hTS
  refine ⟨K, hK, ?_⟩
  intro n t ht
  have htime : t ∈ Ico (0 : ℝ) S := ⟨ht.1, ht.2.trans_lt hTS⟩
  have hs := initial_front_smooth_slices ν S a u p H t htime
  have h := physicalReferenceTail_physical_H1_le n (u t) hs.smooth hs.periodic
    (initialFrontSobolev 2 ν S a u p H t htime)
    (initialFrontSobolev_coeff 2 ν S a u p H t htime)
    (initialFrontSobolev_meanZero 2 ν S a u p H t htime)
  exact h.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
    (pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _)
      (referenceH1Tail_norm_le_of_norm_le n
        (initialFrontSobolev 2 ν S a u p H t htime) K (hbound t ht)) 2)
    (by norm_num))

end

/-!
The pressure-free Fourier equation of the actual smooth reference field.
Every term is the physical Fourier integral or the literal native Leray map.
No projected-equation certificate is taken as a hypothesis.
Prepared source only; external cached compilation and auditing are required.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

open Set SingularClosure
open MethbokeAddon.WeakFouriermanB
open scoped ContDiff

namespace MethbokeAddon.EhrenfestObstruction
noncomputable section

/-- Fourier transformation and Leray projection of the literal physical NSE. -/
theorem initial_front_projected_fourier_rhs
    (ν S : ℝ) (a : Field) (u : Velocity) (p : Pressure)
    (H : InitialClassicalFront ν S a u p)
    (k : Frequency) (i : Fin 3) (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) S) :
    datumFourierCoeff (timeDerivative u t) k i =
      -((ν * (2 * Real.pi) ^ 2 * (galerkinFreqSq k : ℝ) : ℝ) : ℂ) *
          datumFourierCoeff (u t) k i -
        coefficientLeray k (datumFourierCoeff (convection (u t)) k) i := by
  have hu : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ × Vec => u z.1 z.2)
      (localFrontSpacetime S) :=
    H.velocity_smooth.mono (fun z hz => ⟨hz.1.le, hz.2⟩)
  have hus := initial_front_smooth_slices ν S a u p H t ⟨ht.1.le, ht.2⟩
  have hdt : Continuous (timeDerivative u t) :=
    (local_timeDerivative_continuousOn u S hu).comp_continuous
      (continuous_const.prodMk continuous_id) (fun _ => ht)
  have hconv : Continuous (convection (u t)) :=
    (initial_convection_continuousOn u S H.velocity_smooth).comp_continuous
      (continuous_const.prodMk continuous_id) (fun _ => ⟨ht.1.le, ht.2⟩)
  have hps : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (p t) := by
    rw [← contDiffOn_univ]
    exact H.pressure_smooth.comp
      (contDiff_const.prodMk contDiff_id).contDiffOn (fun x _ => ⟨ht.1.le, ht.2⟩)
  have hgrad : Continuous (SingularClosure.gradient (p t)) :=
    criticalWeak_gradient_continuous _ hps
  have hfield : timeDerivative u t + convection (u t) + SingularClosure.gradient (p t) =
      ν • laplacian (u t) :=
    funext (fun x => H.equation t ⟨ht.1.le, ht.2⟩ x)
  have hfourier : datumFourierCoeff (timeDerivative u t) +
      datumFourierCoeff (convection (u t)) + datumFourierCoeff (SingularClosure.gradient (p t)) =
      (ν : ℂ) • laplacianCoefficient (datumFourierCoeff (u t)) := by
    calc
      _ = datumFourierCoeff
          (timeDerivative u t + convection (u t) + SingularClosure.gradient (p t)) := by
        rw [datumFourierCoeff_add _ _ (hdt.add hconv) hgrad,
          datumFourierCoeff_add _ _ hdt hconv]
      _ = _ := by
        rw [hfield, datumFourierCoeff_real_smul,
          datumFourierCoeff_laplacian (u t) hus.smooth hus.periodic]
  have hFk := congrArg (fun c : FourierCoeff => coefficientLeray k (c k)) hfourier
  change coefficientLeray k
      (datumFourierCoeff (timeDerivative u t) k + datumFourierCoeff (convection (u t)) k +
        datumFourierCoeff (SingularClosure.gradient (p t)) k) =
      coefficientLeray k
        ((ν : ℂ) • (-(laplacianFrequency k : ℂ) • datumFourierCoeff (u t) k)) at hFk
  rw [coefficientLeray_add_arg, coefficientLeray_add_arg,
    initial_front_timeDerivative_fourier_leray ν S a u p H t ht k,
    datumFourierCoeff_gradient_leray_eq_zero (p t) hps
      (H.pressure_periodic t ⟨ht.1.le, ht.2⟩) k,
    coefficientLeray_smul_arg, coefficientLeray_smul_arg,
    coefficientLeray_eq_of_solenoidal k _ (smoothSigmaZero_fourier_solenoidal hus k)] at hFk
  have hmode := congrArg (fun v : Fin 3 → ℂ => v i) hFk
  change datumFourierCoeff (timeDerivative u t) k i +
      coefficientLeray k (datumFourierCoeff (convection (u t)) k) i + 0 =
      (ν : ℂ) * (-(laplacianFrequency k : ℂ) * datumFourierCoeff (u t) k i) at hmode
  simp only [add_zero] at hmode
  apply eq_sub_iff_add_eq.mpr
  calc
    _ = (ν : ℂ) * (-(laplacianFrequency k : ℂ) * datumFourierCoeff (u t) k i) := hmode
    _ = _ := by
      simp only [laplacianFrequency, Complex.ofReal_mul]
      ring

/-- The actual reference coefficient solves the pressure-free Fourier NSE. -/
theorem initial_front_projected_fourier_hasDerivAt
    (ν S : ℝ) (a : Field) (u : Velocity) (p : Pressure)
    (H : InitialClassicalFront ν S a u p)
    (k : Frequency) (i : Fin 3) (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) S) :
    HasDerivAt (fun r => datumFourierCoeff (u r) k i)
      (-((ν * (2 * Real.pi) ^ 2 * (galerkinFreqSq k : ℝ) : ℝ) : ℂ) *
          datumFourierCoeff (u t) k i -
        coefficientLeray k (datumFourierCoeff (convection (u t)) k) i) t := by
  rw [← initial_front_projected_fourier_rhs ν S a u p H k i t ht]
  exact initial_front_datumFourierCoeff_hasDerivAt ν S a u p H k i t ht

/-- Projection at the same literal finite cutoff commutes with reference time differentiation. -/
theorem initial_front_cutoff_fourier_hasDerivAt
    (ν S : ℝ) (a : Field) (u : Velocity) (p : Pressure)
    (H : InitialClassicalFront ν S a u p)
    (N : ℕ) (k : Frequency) (i : Fin 3) (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) S) :
    HasDerivAt (fun r => cutoffCoeff N (datumFourierCoeff (u r)) k i)
      (cutoffCoeff N (fun q j =>
        -((ν * (2 * Real.pi) ^ 2 * (galerkinFreqSq q : ℝ) : ℝ) : ℂ) *
            datumFourierCoeff (u t) q j -
          coefficientLeray q (datumFourierCoeff (convection (u t)) q) j) k i) t := by
  by_cases hk : k ∈ cutoffModes N
  · simpa only [cutoffCoeff, if_pos hk] using
      initial_front_projected_fourier_hasDerivAt ν S a u p H k i t ht
  · simpa only [cutoffCoeff, if_neg hk] using hasDerivAt_const t (0 : ℂ)

/-- The actual projected reference coefficient is continuous up to time zero. -/
theorem initial_front_cutoff_fourier_continuousOn_Icc
    (ν S : ℝ) (a : Field) (u : Velocity) (p : Pressure)
    (H : InitialClassicalFront ν S a u p)
    (N : ℕ) (k : Frequency) (i : Fin 3) (T : ℝ) (hTS : T < S) :
    ContinuousOn (fun t => cutoffCoeff N (datumFourierCoeff (u t)) k i)
      (Icc (0 : ℝ) T) := by
  by_cases hk : k ∈ cutoffModes N
  · simpa only [cutoffCoeff, if_pos hk] using
      initial_front_datumFourierCoeff_continuousOn_Icc ν S a u p H k i T hTS
  · simpa only [cutoffCoeff, if_neg hk] using
      (continuousOn_const : ContinuousOn (fun _ : ℝ => (0 : ℂ)) (Icc (0 : ℝ) T))

end
end MethbokeAddon.EhrenfestObstruction
