/-!
# Actual velocity and Frechet operator norm bounds for the reference front

Finite-dimensional component estimates give uniform projected norms. Compactness
of the actual spatial derivative fields gives the original reference derivative
bound, including time zero. No norm-bound certificate is assumed.

Prepared source only; external cached compilation and axiom audits are required.
No local Lean/Lake/kernel execution was used.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

open Set MeasureTheory SingularClosure
open MethbokeAddon.WeakFouriermanB
open scoped BigOperators ContDiff

namespace MethbokeAddon.EhrenfestObstruction
noncomputable section

/-- A common absolute component bound controls the actual Euclidean norm. -/
theorem vec_norm_le_two_mul_of_component_abs_le
    (v : Vec) (B : ℝ) (hB : 0 ≤ B) (h : ∀ i : Fin 3, |v i| ≤ B) :
    ‖v‖ ≤ 2 * B := by
  have hcomponent (i : Fin 3) : (v i) ^ 2 ≤ B ^ 2 := by
    simpa only [sq_abs] using (sq_le_sq₀ (abs_nonneg (v i)) hB).mpr (h i)
  have hsquare : ‖v‖ ^ 2 ≤ 3 * B ^ 2 := by
    rw [EuclideanSpace.real_norm_sq_eq]
    calc
      _ ≤ ∑ _i : Fin 3, B ^ 2 := Finset.sum_le_sum (fun i _ => hcomponent i)
      _ = _ := by simp [Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul]
  apply (sq_le_sq₀ (norm_nonneg v) (mul_nonneg (by norm_num) hB)).mp
  nlinarith [sq_nonneg B]

/-- The native coordinate decomposition controls the actual Frechet operator norm. -/
theorem fderiv_norm_le_sum_coordinate_norm (v : Field) (x : Vec) :
    ‖fderiv ℝ v x‖ ≤ ∑ j : Fin 3, ‖coordinateDerivative v j x‖ := by
  simpa only [coordinateDerivative] using
    opNorm_le_sum_coordinate_norm (fderiv ℝ v x)

/-- A common bound on the three coordinate derivative vectors controls fderiv. -/
theorem fderiv_norm_le_three_mul_of_coordinate_norm_le
    (v : Field) (x : Vec) (B : ℝ)
    (h : ∀ j : Fin 3, ‖coordinateDerivative v j x‖ ≤ B) :
    ‖fderiv ℝ v x‖ ≤ 3 * B := by
  calc
    _ ≤ ∑ j : Fin 3, ‖coordinateDerivative v j x‖ :=
      fderiv_norm_le_sum_coordinate_norm v x
    _ ≤ ∑ _j : Fin 3, B := Finset.sum_le_sum (fun j _ => h j)
    _ = _ := by simp [Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul]

/-- A common bound on all nine derivative components gives an operator bound. -/
theorem fderiv_norm_le_six_mul_of_component_abs_le
    (v : Field) (x : Vec) (B : ℝ) (hB : 0 ≤ B)
    (h : ∀ j i : Fin 3, |coordinateDerivative v j x i| ≤ B) :
    ‖fderiv ℝ v x‖ ≤ 6 * B := by
  calc
    _ ≤ 3 * (2 * B) := fderiv_norm_le_three_mul_of_coordinate_norm_le v x (2 * B)
      (fun j => vec_norm_le_two_mul_of_component_abs_le
        (coordinateDerivative v j x) B hB (h j))
    _ = _ := by ring

/-- Joint initial-front smoothness gives a uniform actual spatial derivative norm. -/
theorem initial_joint_smooth_uniform_fderiv_norm
    (u : Velocity) (S : ℝ)
    (hu : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ × Vec => u z.1 z.2)
      (initialFrontSpacetime S))
    (T : ℝ) (hTS : T < S) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 1 ≤ C ∧ ∀ t (ht : t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) T) (x : Vec)
      (hx : x ∈ unitCube), ‖fderiv ℝ (u t) x‖ ≤ C := by
  have hsum : ContinuousOn
      (fun z : ℝ × Vec => ∑ j : Fin 3, ‖coordinateDerivative (u z.1) j z.2‖)
      (initialFrontSpacetime S) := by
    apply continuousOn_finset_sum
    intro j _
    exact (initial_coordinateDerivative_contDiffOn u S hu j).continuousOn.norm
  have hsubset : Icc (0 : ℝ) T ×ˢ unitCube ⊆ initialFrontSpacetime S := by
    intro z hz
    exact ⟨hz.1.1, hz.1.2.trans_lt hTS⟩
  obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ :=
    ((isCompact_Icc : IsCompact (Icc (0 : ℝ) T)).prod isCompact_unitCube).exists_bound_of_continuousOn
      (hsum.mono hsubset)
  refine ⟨max 1 C, le_max_left _ _, ?_⟩
  intro t ht x hx
  have hCt : |∑ j : Fin 3, ‖coordinateDerivative (u t) j x‖| ≤ C := by
    simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs] using hC (t, x) ⟨ht, hx⟩
  exact (fderiv_norm_le_sum_coordinate_norm (u t) x).trans
    ((le_abs_self _).trans (hCt.trans (le_max_right _ _)))

/-- One actual uniform norm bound for the projected velocity, its derivative,
and the original reference derivative on every shorter closed physical slab. -/
theorem initial_front_uniform_C1_norms
    (ν S : ℝ) (a : Field) (u : Velocity) (p : Pressure)
    (H : InitialClassicalFront ν S a u p)
    (T : ℝ) (hTS : T < S) :
    ∃ M : ℝ, 1 ≤ M ∧ ∀ N t (ht : t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) T) (x : Vec)
      (hx : x ∈ unitCube),
      ‖finiteSynthesis N (datumFourierCoeff (u t)) x‖ ≤ M ∧
      ‖fderiv ℝ (finiteSynthesis N (datumFourierCoeff (u t))) x‖ ≤ M ∧
      ‖fderiv ℝ (u t) x‖ ≤ M := by
  obtain ⟨B, hB, hprojected⟩ :=
    initial_front_uniform_projected_C1_components ν S a u p H T hTS
  obtain ⟨C, hC, hreference⟩ :=
    initial_joint_smooth_uniform_fderiv_norm u S H.velocity_smooth T hTS
  have hB0 : 0 ≤ B := le_trans zero_le_one hB
  refine ⟨max (6 * B) C, hC.trans (le_max_right _ _), ?_⟩
  intro N t ht x hx
  have h := hprojected N t ht x
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, (hreference t ht x hx).trans (le_max_right _ _)⟩
  · exact (vec_norm_le_two_mul_of_component_abs_le
      (finiteSynthesis N (datumFourierCoeff (u t)) x) B hB0 h.1).trans
      ((mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by norm_num : (2 : ℝ) ≤ 6) hB0).trans
        (le_max_left _ _))
  · exact (fderiv_norm_le_six_mul_of_component_abs_le
      (finiteSynthesis N (datumFourierCoeff (u t))) x B hB0 h.2).trans
      (le_max_left _ _)

end
end MethbokeAddon.EhrenfestObstruction

/-!
# Actual pressure Fourier coefficients are annihilated by Leray projection

The scalar Fourier derivative identity is obtained from the existing
physical periodic integration-by-parts theorem by embedding the scalar in
the first vector component. The zero frequency is handled explicitly.
No Fourier completeness or infinite-series representation is assumed.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

open Set MeasureTheory SingularClosure
open scoped BigOperators ContDiff

namespace MethbokeAddon.EhrenfestObstruction

noncomputable section

/-- A scalar field embedded as the first component of a physical vector field. -/
def pressureAsFirstComponent (p : Vec → ℝ) : Field :=
  fun x => p x • unitVector (0 : Fin 3)

/-- The actual scalar pressure Fourier integral. -/
def scalarPressureFourierCoeff (p : Vec → ℝ) (k : Frequency) : ℂ :=
  ∫ x in unitCube, star (fourierCharacter k x) * (p x : ℂ)

@[simp]
theorem pressureAsFirstComponent_apply_zero (p : Vec → ℝ) (x : Vec) :
    pressureAsFirstComponent p x 0 = p x := by
  simp [pressureAsFirstComponent, unitVector]

theorem pressureAsFirstComponent_contDiff
    (p : Vec → ℝ) (hp : ContDiff ℝ ∞ p) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (pressureAsFirstComponent p) := by
  exact hp.smul contDiff_const

theorem pressureAsFirstComponent_periodic
    (p : Vec → ℝ) (hp : SpatialPeriodic p) :
    SpatialPeriodic (pressureAsFirstComponent p) := by
  intro x i
  change p (x + unitVector i) • unitVector (0 : Fin 3) =
    p x • unitVector (0 : Fin 3)
  rw [hp x i]

/-- The scalar pressure coefficient is an integrable physical Fourier integral. -/
theorem scalarPressureFourierIntegrand_integrableOn
    (p : Vec → ℝ) (hp : ContDiff ℝ ∞ p) (k : Frequency) :
    IntegrableOn (fun x : Vec => star (fourierCharacter k x) * (p x : ℂ))
      unitCube volume := by
  have h := datumFourierIntegrand_integrableOn
    (pressureAsFirstComponent_contDiff p hp).continuous k (0 : Fin 3)
  change IntegrableOn (fun x : Vec =>
    star (fourierCharacter k x) * (pressureAsFirstComponent p x 0 : ℂ))
    unitCube volume at h
  simpa only [pressureAsFirstComponent_apply_zero] using h

theorem datumFourierCoeff_pressureAsFirstComponent_zero
    (p : Vec → ℝ) (k : Frequency) :
    datumFourierCoeff (pressureAsFirstComponent p) k 0 =
      scalarPressureFourierCoeff p k := by
  simp only [datumFourierCoeff, datumFourierIntegrand,
    scalarPressureFourierCoeff, pressureAsFirstComponent_apply_zero]

theorem pressureAsFirstComponent_coordinateDerivative_zero
    (p : Vec → ℝ) (hp : ContDiff ℝ ∞ p) (j : Fin 3) (x : Vec) :
    coordinateDerivative (pressureAsFirstComponent p) j x 0 =
      fderiv ℝ p x (unitVector j) := by
  have hd : HasFDerivAt (fun y : Vec => p y • unitVector (0 : Fin 3))
      ((fderiv ℝ p x).smulRight (unitVector (0 : Fin 3))) x :=
    ((hp.differentiable (by simp) x).hasFDerivAt).smul_const (unitVector (0 : Fin 3))
  change (fderiv ℝ (fun y : Vec => p y • unitVector (0 : Fin 3))
    x (unitVector j)) 0 = fderiv ℝ p x (unitVector j)
  rw [hd.fderiv]
  change (fderiv ℝ p x (unitVector j) • unitVector (0 : Fin 3)) 0 =
    fderiv ℝ p x (unitVector j)
  simp [unitVector]

/-- Exact componentwise Fourier multiplier for an actual smooth periodic
scalar pressure gradient. -/
theorem datumFourierCoeff_gradient
    (p : Vec → ℝ) (hp : ContDiff ℝ ∞ p) (hperiod : SpatialPeriodic p) :
    datumFourierCoeff (SingularClosure.gradient p) =
      fun k i => derivativeSymbol i k * scalarPressureFourierCoeff p k := by
  funext k i
  have hcomponent (x : Vec) :
      SingularClosure.gradient p x i =
        coordinateDerivative (pressureAsFirstComponent p) i x 0 := by
    change fderiv ℝ p x (unitVector i) =
      coordinateDerivative (pressureAsFirstComponent p) i x 0
    exact (pressureAsFirstComponent_coordinateDerivative_zero p hp i x).symm
  have hbridge :
      datumFourierCoeff (SingularClosure.gradient p) k i =
        datumFourierCoeff (coordinateDerivative (pressureAsFirstComponent p) i) k 0 := by
    change (∫ x in unitCube,
      star (fourierCharacter k x) * (SingularClosure.gradient p x i : ℂ)) =
      ∫ x in unitCube, star (fourierCharacter k x) *
        (coordinateDerivative (pressureAsFirstComponent p) i x 0 : ℂ)
    apply integral_congr_ae
    refine Filter.Eventually.of_forall ?_
    intro x
    change star (fourierCharacter k x) * (SingularClosure.gradient p x i : ℂ) =
      star (fourierCharacter k x) *
        (coordinateDerivative (pressureAsFirstComponent p) i x 0 : ℂ)
    exact congrArg (fun r : ℝ => star (fourierCharacter k x) * (r : ℂ)) (hcomponent x)
  have hfourier := congrFun (congrFun
    (datumFourierCoeff_coordinateDerivative i (pressureAsFirstComponent p)
      (pressureAsFirstComponent_contDiff p hp)
      (pressureAsFirstComponent_periodic p hperiod)) k) (0 : Fin 3)
  change datumFourierCoeff (coordinateDerivative (pressureAsFirstComponent p) i) k 0 =
    derivativeSymbol i k * datumFourierCoeff (pressureAsFirstComponent p) k 0 at hfourier
  rw [datumFourierCoeff_pressureAsFirstComponent_zero] at hfourier
  exact hbridge.trans hfourier

/-- Every vector parallel to its integer frequency is annihilated by the
literal finite-dimensional Leray map, including frequency zero. -/
theorem coefficientLeray_frequency_mul_eq_zero (k : Frequency) (z : ℂ) :
    coefficientLeray k (fun i => (k i : ℂ) * z) = 0 := by
  funext i
  by_cases hk : k = 0
  · subst k
    simp [coefficientLeray]
  · have hden := frequency_complex_square_sum_ne_zero k hk
    simp only [coefficientLeray, hk, if_false, Pi.zero_apply]
    have hsum :
        (∑ j : Fin 3, (k j : ℂ) * ((k j : ℂ) * z)) =
          (∑ j : Fin 3, (k j : ℂ) ^ 2) * z := by
      rw [Finset.sum_mul]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro j _
      ring
    rw [hsum]
    field_simp [hden] <;> ring

theorem coefficientLeray_derivativeSymbol_mul_eq_zero (k : Frequency) (z : ℂ) :
    coefficientLeray k (fun i => derivativeSymbol i k * z) = 0 := by
  have hsymbol : (fun i => derivativeSymbol i k * z) =
      (fun i => (k i : ℂ) * ((((2 * Real.pi : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) * z)) := by
    funext i
    simp only [derivativeSymbol, Complex.ofReal_mul, Complex.ofReal_intCast]
    ring
  rw [hsymbol]
  exact coefficientLeray_frequency_mul_eq_zero
    k ((((2 * Real.pi : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) * z)

/-- The actual Fourier coefficients of a smooth periodic pressure gradient
vanish after the actual modewise Leray projection. -/
theorem datumFourierCoeff_gradient_leray_eq_zero
    (p : Vec → ℝ) (hp : ContDiff ℝ ∞ p) (hperiod : SpatialPeriodic p)
    (k : Frequency) :
    coefficientLeray k (datumFourierCoeff (SingularClosure.gradient p) k) = 0 := by
  rw [datumFourierCoeff_gradient p hp hperiod]
  exact coefficientLeray_derivativeSymbol_mul_eq_zero k (scalarPressureFourierCoeff p k)

end

end MethbokeAddon.EhrenfestObstruction

/-!
Algebraic state and reconstruction bounds for the actual canonical Galerkin
error against the Fourier cutoff of a physical reference field.

These are coefficient identities and inequalities. No error evolution,
uniform error bound, or NSE obstruction is asserted by this module.
Prepared source only; external cached verification is required.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

open Set Filter SingularClosure
open MethbokeAddon.WeakFouriermanB
open scoped BigOperators

namespace MethbokeAddon.EhrenfestObstruction

noncomputable section

theorem complex_normSq_add_le_twice (z w : ℂ) :
    Complex.normSq (z + w) ≤ 2 * Complex.normSq z + 2 * Complex.normSq w := by
  simp only [Complex.normSq_apply, Complex.add_re, Complex.add_im]
  nlinarith [sq_nonneg (z.re - w.re), sq_nonneg (z.im - w.im)]

/-- Weighted coefficient triangle inequality for the actual H1 square. -/
theorem coefficientDissipation_add_le_twice (N : ℕ) (c v : FourierCoeff) :
    coefficientDissipation N (c + v) ≤
      2 * coefficientDissipation N c + 2 * coefficientDissipation N v := by
  unfold coefficientDissipation
  calc
    _ ≤ (∑ k ∈ cutoffModes N,
        (∑ i : Fin 3,
          (2 * ((2 * Real.pi) ^ 2 * (galerkinFreqSq k : ℝ) * Complex.normSq (c k i)) +
          2 * ((2 * Real.pi) ^ 2 * (galerkinFreqSq k : ℝ) * Complex.normSq (v k i))))) := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro k hk
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro i hi
      have hfreq : 0 ≤ (galerkinFreqSq k : ℝ) := by
        exact_mod_cast galerkinFreqSq_nonneg k
      have hweight : 0 ≤ (2 * Real.pi) ^ 2 * (galerkinFreqSq k : ℝ) :=
        mul_nonneg (sq_nonneg _) hfreq
      have hh := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
        (complex_normSq_add_le_twice (c k i) (v k i)) hweight
      simpa only [Pi.add_apply] using (by nlinarith [hh] :
        (2 * Real.pi) ^ 2 * (galerkinFreqSq k : ℝ) *
          Complex.normSq (c k i + v k i) ≤
          2 * ((2 * Real.pi) ^ 2 * (galerkinFreqSq k : ℝ) * Complex.normSq (c k i)) +
          2 * ((2 * Real.pi) ^ 2 * (galerkinFreqSq k : ℝ) * Complex.normSq (v k i)))
    _ = _ := by simp only [Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.mul_sum]

/-- Reconstructing the Galerkin state from error plus reference. -/
theorem coefficientDissipation_le_error_plus_reference
    (N : ℕ) (c v : FourierCoeff) :
    coefficientDissipation N c ≤
      2 * coefficientDissipation N (c - v) + 2 * coefficientDissipation N v := by
  simpa only [sub_add_cancel] using coefficientDissipation_add_le_twice N (c - v) v

theorem coefficientDissipation_cutoff_eq (N : ℕ) (c : FourierCoeff) :
    coefficientDissipation N (cutoffCoeff N c) = coefficientDissipation N c := by
  unfold coefficientDissipation
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro k hk
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i hi
  rw [cutoffCoeff_apply_of_mem c hk i]

theorem coefficientDissipation_zero_eq (N : ℕ) :
    coefficientDissipation N (0 : FourierCoeff) = 0 := by
  simp [coefficientDissipation]

theorem spectralReality_sub {c v : FourierCoeff}
    (hc : SpectralReality c) (hv : SpectralReality v) : SpectralReality (c - v) := by
  intro k i
  change c (-k) i - v (-k) i = star (c k i - v k i)
  rw [hc k i, hv k i, star_sub]

theorem spectralSolenoidal_sub {c v : FourierCoeff}
    (hc : SpectralSolenoidal c) (hv : SpectralSolenoidal v) :
    SpectralSolenoidal (c - v) := by
  intro k
  simp only [Pi.sub_apply, mul_sub, Finset.sum_sub_distrib, hc k, hv k, sub_self]

/-- The literal coefficient error, with the actual cutoff `n+1`. -/
def canonicalErrorCoeff (ν : ℝ) (hν : 0 < ν) (a : SmoothDatum)
    (u : Velocity) (n : ℕ) (t : ℝ) : FourierCoeff :=
  (canonicalFamily ν hν a n).coeff t - cutoffCoeff (n + 1) (datumFourierCoeff (u t))

theorem canonicalErrorCoeff_initial
    (ν : ℝ) (hν : 0 < ν) (a : SmoothDatum) (u : Velocity)
    (hinit : u 0 = a.val) (n : ℕ) : canonicalErrorCoeff ν hν a u n 0 = 0 := by
  funext k i
  simp only [canonicalErrorCoeff, Pi.sub_apply]
  rw [(canonicalFamily ν hν a n).initial k i, hinit]
  simp only [cutoffCoeff, Pi.zero_apply, sub_self]

theorem canonicalErrorCoeff_initial_front
    (ν : ℝ) (hν : 0 < ν) (a : SmoothDatum)
    (S : ℝ) (u : Velocity) (p : Pressure)
    (H : InitialClassicalFront ν S a.val u p) (n : ℕ) :
    canonicalErrorCoeff ν hν a u n 0 = 0 :=
  canonicalErrorCoeff_initial ν hν a u H.initial n

theorem canonicalErrorCoeff_support
    (ν : ℝ) (hν : 0 < ν) (a : SmoothDatum) (u : Velocity)
    (n : ℕ) (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 ≤ t)
    (k : Frequency) (hk : k ∉ cutoffModes (n + 1)) (i : Fin 3) :
    canonicalErrorCoeff ν hν a u n t k i = 0 := by
  simp only [canonicalErrorCoeff, Pi.sub_apply]
  rw [(canonicalFamily ν hν a n).mode_support t ht k hk i,
    cutoffCoeff_apply_of_not_mem (datumFourierCoeff (u t)) hk i, sub_self]

theorem canonicalErrorCoeff_reality
    (ν : ℝ) (hν : 0 < ν) (a : SmoothDatum) (u : Velocity)
    (n : ℕ) (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 ≤ t) :
    SpectralReality (canonicalErrorCoeff ν hν a u n t) :=
  spectralReality_sub ((canonicalFamily ν hν a n).real_symmetry t ht)
    (cutoffCoeff_preserves_reality (n + 1) (datumFourierCoeff_reality (u t)))

theorem canonicalErrorCoeff_solenoidal
    (ν : ℝ) (hν : 0 < ν) (a : SmoothDatum) (u : Velocity)
    (n : ℕ) (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 ≤ t) (hu : SmoothSigmaZero (u t)) :
    SpectralSolenoidal (canonicalErrorCoeff ν hν a u n t) :=
  spectralSolenoidal_sub ((canonicalFamily ν hν a n).solenoidal t ht)
    (cutoffCoeff_preserves_solenoidal (n + 1) (smoothSigmaZero_fourier_solenoidal hu))

theorem canonicalErrorCoeff_solenoidal_front
    (ν : ℝ) (hν : 0 < ν) (a : SmoothDatum)
    (S : ℝ) (u : Velocity) (p : Pressure)
    (H : InitialClassicalFront ν S a.val u p)
    (n : ℕ) (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Ico (0 : ℝ) S) :
    SpectralSolenoidal (canonicalErrorCoeff ν hν a u n t) :=
  canonicalErrorCoeff_solenoidal ν hν a u n t ht.1
    (initial_front_smooth_slices ν S a.val u p H t ht)

theorem canonical_error_initial_dissipation
    (ν : ℝ) (hν : 0 < ν) (a : SmoothDatum) (u : Velocity)
    (hinit : u 0 = a.val) (n : ℕ) :
    coefficientDissipation (n + 1) (canonicalErrorCoeff ν hν a u n 0) = 0 := by
  rw [canonicalErrorCoeff_initial ν hν a u hinit n, coefficientDissipation_zero_eq]

/-- The half-enstrophy normalization cancels the factor two in the square
triangle estimate. This is valid at every time without an evolution premise. -/
theorem canonical_enstrophy_le_error_plus_reference
    (ν : ℝ) (hν : 0 < ν) (a : SmoothDatum) (u : Velocity) (n : ℕ) (t : ℝ) :
    canonicalEnstrophy ν hν a n t ≤
      coefficientDissipation (n + 1) (canonicalErrorCoeff ν hν a u n t) +
        coefficientDissipation (n + 1) (datumFourierCoeff (u t)) := by
  have h := coefficientDissipation_le_error_plus_reference (n + 1)
    ((canonicalFamily ν hν a n).coeff t)
    (cutoffCoeff (n + 1) (datumFourierCoeff (u t)))
  rw [coefficientDissipation_cutoff_eq] at h
  change coefficientDissipation (n + 1) ((canonicalFamily ν hν a n).coeff t) / 2 ≤ _
  change coefficientDissipation (n + 1) ((canonicalFamily ν hν a n).coeff t) ≤
    2 * coefficientDissipation (n + 1) (canonicalErrorCoeff ν hν a u n t) +
      2 * coefficientDissipation (n + 1) (datumFourierCoeff (u t)) at h
  linarith

/-- Explicit algebraic reconstruction step. The unit error premise is to
be discharged by the differential bootstrap; this theorem does not supply it. -/
theorem eventual_canonical_slab_bound_of_error_and_reference
    (ν : ℝ) (hν : 0 < ν) (a : SmoothDatum) (u : Velocity) (T K : ℝ)
    (herror : ∀ᶠ n in atTop, ∀ t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) T,
      coefficientDissipation (n + 1) (canonicalErrorCoeff ν hν a u n t) ≤ 1)
    (hreference : ∀ n t, t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) T →
      coefficientDissipation (n + 1) (datumFourierCoeff (u t)) ≤ K) :
    ∀ᶠ n in atTop, ∀ t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) T,
      canonicalEnstrophy ν hν a n t ≤ 1 + K := by
  filter_upwards [herror] with n hn
  intro t ht
  exact (canonical_enstrophy_le_error_plus_reference ν hν a u n t).trans
    (add_le_add (hn t ht) (hreference n t ht))

end

end MethbokeAddon.EhrenfestObstruction

theorem smooth_front_eventual_slab_bound_of_unit_error
    (ν : ℝ) (hν : 0 < ν) (a : SmoothDatum)
    (S T : ℝ) (u : Velocity) (p : Pressure)
    (H : InitialClassicalFront ν S a.val u p) (hTS : T < S)
    (herror : ∀ᶠ n in atTop, ∀ t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) T,

/-!
The literal forced coefficient equation for an actual Galerkin/reference
difference. The final theorem derives its equation from a Galerkin solution
and an actual classical front. No error evolution law is assumed there.

Prepared source: external cached compiler and axiom audit are still required.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

open Set MeasureTheory SingularClosure
open MethbokeAddon.WeakFouriermanB
open scoped BigOperators ContDiff RealInnerProductSpace

namespace MethbokeAddon.EhrenfestObstruction

noncomputable section

theorem datumFourierCoeff_sub (a b : Field) (ha : Continuous a) (hb : Continuous b) :
    datumFourierCoeff (a - b) = datumFourierCoeff a - datumFourierCoeff b := by
  funext k i
  unfold datumFourierCoeff datumFourierIntegrand
  simp only [Pi.sub_apply, PiLp.sub_apply, Complex.ofReal_sub, mul_sub]
  exact integral_sub (datumFourierIntegrand_integrableOn ha k i)
    (datumFourierIntegrand_integrableOn hb k i)

theorem coefficientLeray_sub_arg (k : Frequency) (v w : Fin 3 → ℂ) :
    coefficientLeray k (v - w) = coefficientLeray k v - coefficientLeray k w := by
  funext i
  by_cases hk : k = 0
  · simp [coefficientLeray, hk]
  · simp only [coefficientLeray, if_neg hk, Pi.sub_apply, mul_sub,
      Finset.sum_sub_distrib, sub_div]
    ring

/-- Actual physical forcing, with reference truncation residual and both
transport cross terms. Its arguments are the reference and error coefficients. -/
def finiteReferenceErrorForcing
    (N : ℕ) (U : Field) (b w : FourierCoeff) : Field :=
  physicalErrorForcing (finiteSynthesis N b) (finiteSynthesis N w)
    (physicalReferenceResidual U (finiteSynthesis N b) (U - finiteSynthesis N b))

/-- The exact forcing field equals the difference of the actual convection
operators, after adding back the error's self convection. -/
theorem finiteReferenceErrorForcing_eq_convection
    (N : ℕ) (U : Field) (c b w : FourierCoeff)
    (hU : ContDiff ℝ ∞ U) (hsum : c = w + b) :
    finiteReferenceErrorForcing N U b w =
      convection U - convection (finiteSynthesis N c) +
        convection (finiteSynthesis N w) := by
  have hconv : convection (finiteSynthesis N c) =
      convection (finiteSynthesis N w) +
        physicalTransport (finiteSynthesis N b) (finiteSynthesis N w) +
        physicalTransport (finiteSynthesis N w) (finiteSynthesis N b) +
        convection (finiteSynthesis N b) := by
    rw [hsum, finiteSynthesis_add]
    exact convection_add_eq_transport _ _
      (finiteSynthesis_contDiff N w) (finiteSynthesis_contDiff N b)
  unfold finiteReferenceErrorForcing
  rw [physicalReferenceResidual_eq_convection_sub U (finiteSynthesis N b)
    hU (finiteSynthesis_contDiff N b), hconv]
  funext x
  simp only [physicalErrorForcing, Pi.sub_apply, Pi.add_apply]
  abel

/-- Fourier transformation of the literal forcing field. -/
theorem finiteReferenceErrorForcing_fourier
    (N : ℕ) (U : Field) (c b w : FourierCoeff)
    (hU : ContDiff ℝ ∞ U) (hsum : c = w + b)
    (hcsupp : ∀ k : Frequency, k ∉ cutoffModes N → ∀ i : Fin 3, c k i = 0)
    (hcreal : SpectralReality c)
    (hwsupp : ∀ k : Frequency, k ∉ cutoffModes N → ∀ i : Fin 3, w k i = 0)
    (hwreal : SpectralReality w) :
    datumFourierCoeff (finiteReferenceErrorForcing N U b w) =
      datumFourierCoeff (convection U) - coefficientTransport N c +
        coefficientTransport N w := by
  have hc := convection_continuous (finiteSynthesis_contDiff N c)
  have hw := convection_continuous (finiteSynthesis_contDiff N w)
  have hcu := convection_continuous hU
  rw [finiteReferenceErrorForcing_eq_convection N U c b w hU hsum,
    datumFourierCoeff_add _ _ (hcu.sub hc) hw,
    datumFourierCoeff_sub _ _ hcu hc,
    datumFourierCoeff_convection_finiteSynthesis N c hcsupp hcreal,
    datumFourierCoeff_convection_finiteSynthesis N w hwsupp hwreal]

/-- Subtracting the projected reference vector field from the actual finite
NSE vector field gives the error vector field plus its literal forcing. -/
theorem finite_error_rhs_identity
    (ν : ℝ) (N : ℕ) (U : Field) (c b w : FourierCoeff)
    (hU : ContDiff ℝ ∞ U) (hsum : c = w + b)
    (hcsupp : ∀ k : Frequency, k ∉ cutoffModes N → ∀ i : Fin 3, c k i = 0)
    (hcreal : SpectralReality c)
    (hwsupp : ∀ k : Frequency, k ∉ cutoffModes N → ∀ i : Fin 3, w k i = 0)
    (hwreal : SpectralReality w)
    (k : Frequency) (hk : k ∈ cutoffModes N) (i : Fin 3) :
    galerkinRhs ν N c k i -
        (-((ν * (2 * Real.pi) ^ 2 * (galerkinFreqSq k : ℝ) : ℝ) : ℂ) * b k i -
          coefficientLeray k (datumFourierCoeff (convection U) k) i) =
      galerkinRhs ν N w k i +
        cutoffCoeff N (fun l => coefficientLeray l
          (datumFourierCoeff (finiteReferenceErrorForcing N U b w) l)) k i := by
  rw [cutoffCoeff_apply_of_mem _ hk i,
    finiteReferenceErrorForcing_fourier N U c b w hU hsum hcsupp hcreal hwsupp hwreal]
  simp only [galerkinRhs, Pi.add_apply, Pi.sub_apply,
    coefficientLeray_add_arg, coefficientLeray_sub_arg]
  have hmode : c k i = w k i + b k i :=
    congrArg (fun d : FourierCoeff => d k i) hsum
  rw [hmode]
  ring

/-- An actual Galerkin solution minus the actual projected classical front
satisfies the forced error equation at every interior reference time. -/
theorem initial_front_galerkin_error_hasDerivAt
    (ν S : ℝ) (a : Field) (u : Velocity) (p : Pressure)
    (H : InitialClassicalFront ν S a u p)
    (N : ℕ) (g : GalerkinSolution ν a N)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) S)
    (k : Frequency) (hk : k ∈ cutoffModes N) (i : Fin 3) :
    HasDerivAt
      (fun r => (g.coeff r - cutoffCoeff N (datumFourierCoeff (u r))) k i)
      (galerkinRhs ν N (g.coeff t - cutoffCoeff N (datumFourierCoeff (u t))) k i +
        cutoffCoeff N (fun l => coefficientLeray l
          (datumFourierCoeff (finiteReferenceErrorForcing N (u t)
            (cutoffCoeff N (datumFourierCoeff (u t)))
            (g.coeff t - cutoffCoeff N (datumFourierCoeff (u t)))) l)) k i) t := by
  let b : ℝ → FourierCoeff := fun r => cutoffCoeff N (datumFourierCoeff (u r))
  let w : FourierCoeff := g.coeff t - b t
  have hU := initial_front_smooth_slices ν S a u p H t ⟨ht.1.le, ht.2⟩
  have hbreal : SpectralReality (b t) :=
    cutoffCoeff_preserves_reality N (datumFourierCoeff_reality (u t))
  have hwsupp : ∀ l : Frequency, l ∉ cutoffModes N → ∀ j : Fin 3, w l j = 0 := by
    intro l hl j
    change g.coeff t l j - cutoffCoeff N (datumFourierCoeff (u t)) l j = 0
    rw [g.mode_support t ht.1.le l hl j, cutoffCoeff_apply_of_not_mem _ hl j]
    simp
  have hwreal : SpectralReality w := by
    intro l j
    change g.coeff t (-l) j - b t (-l) j = star (g.coeff t l j - b t l j)
    rw [g.real_symmetry t ht.1.le l j, hbreal l j, star_sub]
  have hsum : g.coeff t = w + b t := by
    dsimp [w]
    simp
  have hg := (g.equation t ht.1.le k hk i).hasDerivAt (Ici_mem_nhds ht.1)
  have hb : HasDerivAt (fun r => b r k i)
      (-((ν * (2 * Real.pi) ^ 2 * (galerkinFreqSq k : ℝ) : ℝ) : ℂ) * b t k i -
        coefficientLeray k (datumFourierCoeff (convection (u t)) k) i) t := by
    simpa only [b, cutoffCoeff, if_pos hk] using
      initial_front_cutoff_fourier_hasDerivAt ν S a u p H N k i t ht
  have hd := hg.sub hb
  rw [finite_error_rhs_identity ν N (u t) (g.coeff t) (b t) w hU.smooth hsum
    (g.mode_support t ht.1.le) (g.real_symmetry t ht.1.le) hwsupp hwreal k hk i] at hd
  exact hd

end

end MethbokeAddon.EhrenfestObstruction

/-!
The cutoff-uniform cubic inequality for the actual canonical Galerkin error.
All constants are obtained from the actual smooth classical front on a
strictly shorter closed time slab. No error bound, residual estimate, or
evolution certificate is an input to the final theorem.

Prepared source: external cached compiler and axiom audit are still required.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

open Set MeasureTheory SingularClosure
open MethbokeAddon.WeakFouriermanB
open scoped BigOperators ContDiff RealInnerProductSpace

namespace MethbokeAddon.EhrenfestObstruction

noncomputable section

/-- The actual classical front forces a uniform cubic H1 error inequality,
with an actual truncation error decaying as the inverse squared cutoff. -/
theorem initial_front_canonical_error_differential_inequality
    (ν : ℝ) (hν : 0 < ν) (a : SmoothDatum)
    (S T : ℝ) (u : Velocity) (p : Pressure)
    (H : InitialClassicalFront ν S a.val u p) (hTS : T < S) :
    ∃ C A : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ 0 < A ∧ ∀ n t, t ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) T →
      ∃ d : ℝ,
        HasDerivAt
          (fun r => coefficientDissipation (n + 1) (canonicalErrorCoeff ν hν a u n r))
          d t ∧
        d ≤ C * (coefficientDissipation (n + 1) (canonicalErrorCoeff ν hν a u n t) +
              (coefficientDissipation (n + 1) (canonicalErrorCoeff ν hν a u n t)) ^ 3) +
            A / (((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 2) := by
  obtain ⟨C₀, hC₀, hcross⟩ := FINITE_ERROR_CROSS_ENSTROPHY_INEQUALITY
  obtain ⟨M, hM, hnorm⟩ := initial_front_uniform_C1_norms ν S a.val u p H T hTS
  obtain ⟨K, hK, htail⟩ := initial_front_uniform_physical_H1_tail ν S a.val u p H T hTS
  have hMpos : 0 < M := by linarith
  have hKpos : 0 < K := by linarith
  let C : ℝ := C₀ / ν ^ 3 + 24 * M ^ 2 / ν + 1
  let A : ℝ := 432 * M ^ 2 * K ^ 2 / ν
  have hC : 0 < C := by dsimp [C]; positivity
  have hA : 0 < A := by dsimp [A]; positivity
  have hL : C₀ / ν ^ 3 ≤ C := by
    dsimp [C]
    have hB : 0 ≤ 24 * M ^ 2 / ν := by positivity
    linarith
  have hB : 24 * M ^ 2 / ν ≤ C := by
    dsimp [C]
    have hL₀ : 0 ≤ C₀ / ν ^ 3 := by positivity
    linarith
  refine ⟨C, A, hC, hA, ?_⟩
  intro n t ht
  have htS : t ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) S := ⟨ht.1, ht.2.trans hTS⟩
  have htIcc : t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) T := ⟨ht.1.le, ht.2.le⟩
  have htIco : t ∈ Ico (0 : ℝ) S := ⟨ht.1.le, htS.2⟩
  let b : FourierCoeff := cutoffCoeff (n + 1) (datumFourierCoeff (u t))
  let v : Field := finiteSynthesis (n + 1) b
  let r : Field := u t - v
  let R : Field := physicalReferenceResidual (u t) v r
  have hUs := initial_front_smooth_slices ν S a.val u p H t htIco
  have hvs : ContDiff ℝ ∞ v := finiteSynthesis_contDiff (n + 1) b
  have hrs : ContDiff ℝ ∞ r := hUs.smooth.sub hvs
  have hRc : Continuous R := physicalReferenceResidual_continuous (u t) v r
    hUs.smooth hvs.continuous hrs
  have hvM : ∀ x ∈ unitCube, ‖v x‖ ≤ M := by
    intro x hx
    simpa only [v, b, finiteSynthesis_cutoffCoeff] using
      (hnorm (n + 1) t htIcc x hx).1
  have hDvM : ∀ x ∈ unitCube, ‖fderiv ℝ v x‖ ≤ M := by
    intro x hx
    simpa only [v, b, finiteSynthesis_cutoffCoeff] using
      (hnorm (n + 1) t htIcc x hx).2.1
  have hDUM : ∀ x ∈ unitCube, ‖fderiv ℝ (u t) x‖ ≤ M :=
    fun x hx => (hnorm (n + 1) t htIcc x hx).2.2
  have hRbound := physicalReferenceResidual_l2_le M hMpos.le (u t) v r
    hUs.smooth hvs.continuous hrs hDUM hvM
  have hrtail : (∫ x in unitCube, ‖r x‖ ^ 2) + physicalDissipation r ≤
      12 * (((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)⁻¹ * K) ^ 2 := by
    simpa only [r, v, b, physicalReferenceTail, finiteSynthesis_cutoffCoeff] using
      htail n t htIcc
  have hRsmall : (∫ x in unitCube, ‖R x‖ ^ 2) ≤
      (6 * M ^ 2) * (12 * (((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)⁻¹ * K) ^ 2) :=
    hRbound.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hrtail (by positivity))
  have heq : ∀ k ∈ cutoffModes (n + 1), ∀ i : Fin 3,
      HasDerivWithinAt (fun q => canonicalErrorCoeff ν hν a u n q k i)
        (galerkinRhs ν (n + 1) (canonicalErrorCoeff ν hν a u n t) k i +
          cutoffCoeff (n + 1) (fun l => coefficientLeray l
            (datumFourierCoeff (physicalErrorForcing v
              (finiteSynthesis (n + 1) (canonicalErrorCoeff ν hν a u n t)) R) l)) k i)
        univ t := by
    intro k hk i
    exact (initial_front_galerkin_error_hasDerivAt ν S a.val u p H (n + 1)
      (canonicalFamily ν hν a n) t htS k hk i).hasDerivWithinAt
  obtain ⟨d, hd, hineq⟩ := hcross ν hν M hMpos.le (n + 1)
    (canonicalErrorCoeff ν hν a u n) v R hvs hRc hvM hDvM univ t
    (canonicalErrorCoeff_support ν hν a u n t ht.1.le)
    (canonicalErrorCoeff_reality ν hν a u n t ht.1.le)
    (canonicalErrorCoeff_solenoidal_front ν hν a S u p H n t htIco) heq
  refine ⟨d, hd.hasDerivAt (by simp), ?_⟩
  have hN : 0 < ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) := by positivity
  have hforce : (6 / ν) * (∫ x in unitCube, ‖R x‖ ^ 2) ≤
      A / (((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 2) := by
    calc
      _ ≤ (6 / ν) * ((6 * M ^ 2) *
          (12 * (((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)⁻¹ * K) ^ 2)) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hRsmall (by positivity)
      _ = _ := by
        dsimp [A]
        field_simp [hν.ne', hN.ne'] <;> ring
  have hD := coefficientDissipation_nonneg (n + 1) (canonicalErrorCoeff ν hν a u n t)
  have hLcub := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hL (pow_nonneg hD 3)
  have hBD := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hB hD
  linarith

end

end MethbokeAddon.EhrenfestObstruction

/-!
Eventual canonical Galerkin enstrophy bounds from an actual smooth initial
front. The error differential inequality, its small forcing, the scalar
bootstrap and the projected-reference bound are all derived internally.
The final theorem has no assumed uniform Galerkin or error bound.

Prepared source only: every dependency and this endpoint still require
matching authorized external cached compilation and axiom auditing.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

open Set Filter SingularClosure
open MethbokeAddon.WeakFouriermanB
open scoped BigOperators Topology

namespace MethbokeAddon.EhrenfestObstruction

noncomputable section

/-- The actual error coefficients are continuous up to the initial boundary. -/
theorem canonicalErrorCoeff_continuousOn_Icc
    (ν : ℝ) (hν : 0 < ν) (a : SmoothDatum)
    (S T : ℝ) (u : Velocity) (p : Pressure)
    (H : InitialClassicalFront ν S a.val u p) (hTS : T < S)
    (n : ℕ) (k : Frequency) (i : Fin 3) :
    ContinuousOn (fun t => canonicalErrorCoeff ν hν a u n t k i)
      (Icc (0 : ℝ) T) := by
  have hc : ContinuousOn (fun t => (canonicalFamily ν hν a n).coeff t k i)
      (Icc (0 : ℝ) T) :=
    ((canonicalFamily ν hν a n).coefficient_continuous k i).mono (fun t ht => ht.1)
  have hv := initial_front_cutoff_fourier_continuousOn_Icc
    ν S a.val u p H (n + 1) k i T hTS
  change ContinuousOn (fun t => (canonicalFamily ν hν a n).coeff t k i -
    cutoffCoeff (n + 1) (datumFourierCoeff (u t)) k i) (Icc (0 : ℝ) T)
  convert! hc.sub hv using 1

/-- Finite summation gives closed-slab continuity of the actual H1 error square. -/
theorem canonical_error_dissipation_continuousOn_Icc
    (ν : ℝ) (hν : 0 < ν) (a : SmoothDatum)
    (S T : ℝ) (u : Velocity) (p : Pressure)
    (H : InitialClassicalFront ν S a.val u p) (hTS : T < S) (n : ℕ) :
    ContinuousOn
      (fun t => coefficientDissipation (n + 1) (canonicalErrorCoeff ν hν a u n t))
      (Icc (0 : ℝ) T) := by
  unfold coefficientDissipation
  apply continuousOn_finset_sum
  intro k hk
  apply continuousOn_finset_sum
  intro i hi
  exact continuousOn_const.mul
    (Complex.continuous_normSq.comp_continuousOn
      (canonicalErrorCoeff_continuousOn_Icc ν hν a S T u p H hTS n k i))

/-- The forcing rate at the literal nonzero cutoff tends to zero. -/
theorem forcing_div_nat_succ_sq_tendsto_zero (A : ℝ) :
    Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => A / (((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 2)) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
  have h :=
    ((tendsto_one_div_add_atTop_nhds_zero_nat (𝕜 := ℝ)).pow 2).const_mul A
  simpa [div_eq_mul_inv, inv_pow] using h

/-- Actual smooth-front boundedness of the canonical spectral approximants.

The smooth physical front is the only analytic hypothesis. In particular,
the eventual unit error and enstrophy bounds are conclusions of the proof.
The cutoff is always `n+1` and the physical datum is fixed for all indices.
-/
theorem initial_front_eventual_canonical_enstrophy_bound
    (ν : ℝ) (hν : 0 < ν) (a : SmoothDatum)
    (S T : ℝ) (u : Velocity) (p : Pressure)
    (H : InitialClassicalFront ν S a.val u p) (hTS : T < S) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ᶠ n in atTop, ∀ t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) T,
      canonicalEnstrophy ν hν a n t ≤ C := by
  obtain ⟨C, A, hC, hA, hdiff⟩ :=
    initial_front_canonical_error_differential_inequality ν hν a S T u p H hTS
  let D : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ := fun n t =>
    coefficientDissipation (n + 1) (canonicalErrorCoeff ν hν a u n t)
  have herror : ∀ᶠ n in atTop, ∀ t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) T, D n t ≤ 1 := by
    apply eventually_guarded_cubic_unit_bound_interior
      (D := D) (d := fun n t => deriv (D n) t)
      (epsilon := fun n => A / (((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 2)) hC.le
    · exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun n => by positivity)
    · exact forcing_div_nat_succ_sq_tendsto_zero A
    · intro n
      exact canonical_error_dissipation_continuousOn_Icc ν hν a S T u p H hTS n
    · intro n
      exact (canonical_error_initial_dissipation ν hν a u H.initial n).le
    · intro n t ht
      obtain ⟨rate, hrate, hbound⟩ := hdiff n t ht
      exact hrate.differentiableAt.hasDerivAt
    · intro n t ht hunit
      obtain ⟨rate, hrate, hbound⟩ := hdiff n t ht
      have hderiv : deriv (D n) t = rate := hrate.deriv
      change deriv (D n) t ≤ _
      rw [hderiv]
      exact hbound
  exact smooth_front_eventual_slab_bound_of_unit_error ν hν a S T u p H hTS herror

end

past its reciprocal-clock horizon. -/
theorem stopped_forbids_initial_front
    (ν : ℝ) (hν : 0 < ν) (a : SmoothDatum)
    (eStar gamma : ℝ) (R : ℕ → ℝ)
    (hStopped : StoppedForDatum ν hν a eStar gamma R)
    (S : ℝ) (u : Velocity) (p : Pressure)
    (H : InitialClassicalFront ν S a.val u p)
    (hTS : 1 / gamma < S) : False := by
  exact stopped_rejects_eventual_slab_bound ν hν a eStar gamma R hStopped
    (initial_front_eventual_canonical_enstrophy_bound
      ν hν a S (1 / gamma) u p H hTS)

/-- For the single fixed stopped datum, a global smooth NSE pair is impossible. -/
theorem stopped_forbids_global_smooth
    (ν : ℝ) (hν : 0 < ν) (a : SmoothDatum)
    (eStar gamma : ℝ) (R : ℕ → ℝ)
    (hStopped : StoppedForDatum ν hν a eStar gamma R)
    (u : Velocity) (p : Pressure)
    (H : GlobalSmoothNSE ν a.val u p) : False := by
  exact stopped_forbids_initial_front ν hν a eStar gamma R hStopped
    (1 / gamma + 1) u p
    (global_smooth_to_initial_front ν (1 / gamma + 1) a.val u p H)
    (lt_add_one _)

/-- The exact coefficient-dynamical implication, with a single explicit
stopped-bound hypothesis. No operator realization or singular witness is
assumed as an additional field. -/
theorem EHRENFEST_OBSTRUCTION_DYNAMICAL
    (ν : ℝ) (hν : 0 < ν)
    (hStopped : StoppedCommutatorBound ν) : Not (NSE_B ν) := by
  intro hNSE
  rcases hStopped with ⟨_hν, a, eStar, gamma, R, hStop⟩
  obtain ⟨u, p, H⟩ := hNSE a.val a.property
  exact stopped_forbids_global_smooth ν hν a eStar gamma R hStop u p H
